episodes.title: Taarak Mehta Introduces Himself And Society Members
episodes.synopsis: Taarak Mehta introduces himself and the society members of Gokuldham Society starting with his wife, Anjali Mehta, followed by his dear friend, Jethalal Champaklal Gada, who always lands in some or the other problem. What will be the Judge's final decision? Will Jethalal find a unique way to solve his never-ending problem?
episodes.summary: Taarak Mehta introduces Gokuldham Society and its residents, who each complain to him about Jethalal's son Tapu (Sodhi, Hathi, Iyer, Bhide and others). A distressed Jethalal is consoled by Taarak, and the episode ends with Tapu planning to play cricket in the compound again.

episodes.title: Jethalal's Son Tapu Decides To Spend His Holiday
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal's son Tapu decides to spend his holiday playing cricket in the premises of Gokuldham society but soon, the game lands young Tappu in trouble. Irked by the damage done by Tapu to their property, the society members approach Jethalal Gada for a solution to this problem. What will Jethalal do?
episodes.summary: Tapu sells his books to buy cricket gear and plays at Abdul's shop, and his ball breaks Anjali's glasses and hits Sodhi. The neighbours, led by an angry Sodhi, confront Jethalal, and he promises them there will be no more complaints about Tapu.

The Inspector presses charges of indulging into child labour on Jethalal and incarcerates him for the same. On learning of this news, a worried Daya approaches Taarak Mehta for help. Will Taarak be of any help in the matter?

episodes.title: Jethalal Confronts Daya About Buying Bomb For Tappu
episodes.synopsis: Daya and the other ladies of the colony decide to go shopping for Diwali. Jethalal returns home and confronts Daya about buying a bomb for Tapu. He then reveals to her the events that occurred at the shop in the afternoon, when his father walks in and scolds him. How will Bhide celebrate his Diwali?

episodes.title: Jethalal's Irksome Behavior
episodes.synopsis: Bhide is scared and holds Jethalal responsible for his condition. Champaklal gets tired with Jethalal's irksome behaviour. Jethalal asks Daya for the money, which he had given before, but gets upset with her behaviour. He is surprised to see Bhide's changed behaviour. Bhide is tensed while a woman reaches his house and places a big order for pickle to Madhavi.

episodes.title: Taarak Mehta Feels Lonely On Diwali
episodes.synopsis: Taarak Mehta feels lonely as Anjali is not with him on the occasion of Diwali. Jethalal is facing stinginess and is unable to fulfil his family's requirements. Bhide and other friends are upset about inflation. They decide to do a Laxmi Poojan and ask Jethalal to contribute. Will Jethalal be ready to contribute? Find out in this episode.

episodes.title: Champaklal Celebrates The New-Year With The Children
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal celebrates the occasion of new-year with the children. Jethalal gets tired of Daya's behaviour. Bhide tries to tease him while he goes to repair Daya's sandals. Jethalal gets upset when Daya informs him that Sunder is coming. Will Sunder bring in any more trouble in Jethalal's life?

episodes.title: The Gada Family Is Going Out Of Their Limits To Welcome Daya's Brother
episodes.synopsis: Daya's brother Sunder is coming to Gokuldham Society and the Gada family is ready to receive him. Jethalal is not at all happy with this. Sunder has not turned up yet and Jethalal gets a call from Natu Kaka to come to the shop. Will Sunder come? What new troubles is he going to bring in Jethalal's life?

episodes.title: Sunders New Scheme
episodes.synopsis: Panic ensues as Sunder's bag is missing and the blame comes on Jethalal's head. Sunder calls his mother in Ahmedabad who tells him that his bag is in Ahmedabad and is not lost. Natu Kaka books a flight ticket for Jethalal as Daya tells him to get Sunder's bag from Ahmedabad. A lot of money has been spent on Sunder and Jethalal is not comfortable with this. Find out in this episode.

episodes.title: Jethalal Is Apprehensive About Sunder's Scheme
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is apprehensive about Sunder's scheme and warns him that he shouldn't involve Gokuldham society members in his plan. Sunder meets the society members and tells them about his scheme. Then he meets the women and shares his scheme with them. He does his best to fool them off their money. Daya also lauds her brother before them and takes guarantee of their money. Will the scheme work?

episodes.title: Jethalal Is Suspicious About Sunder
episodes.synopsis: The women of Gokuldam try to arrange the money through all means possible. Daya attempts to make Taarak Mehta understand as to how her husband's best friend will not earn money. Bhide attempts to tease his friends as they have allowed their wives to invest in Sunder's scheme. Jethalal also has to invest in the scheme because of Babita but is suspicious about Sunder.

episodes.title: Jethalal Worries About Sunder Committing Some Fraud
episodes.synopsis: Babita is excited about her investment and asks Jethalal for Sunder. Jethalal worries about Sunder committing some fraud with the society member's money. Komal and other friends meet Daya, but she is worried about Sunder being kidnapped. Taarak Mehta is also pensive regarding Sunder. All the women are upset about Sunder and worried about their investment money. Where is Sunder?

episodes.title: Gokuldham Members Are Enraged At Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Bhide gets furious on Madhavi as she had invested in Sunder's scheme. Bhide and other friends make a plan to meet Jethalal and enquire about Sunder. They get enraged at him and warn him saying they can lodge a complaint against him in the police station. Meanwhile, Sunder reaches society.

episodes.title: Sunder Gives Them A Surprising News
episodes.synopsis: Daya and other Gokuldham society members get surprised when Sunder turns up. Jethalal gets enraged at him. Meanwhile, Sunder gives them surprising news. Bhide and Iyer meet Jethalal as they want to invest their money again. Daya and other friends discuss the television serial deeply. But, something goes wrong while they are watching the serial. What goes wrong? Find out in this episode.

episodes.title: Tapu's Strike Against His School Authority
episodes.synopsis: Daya is angry as repeated episodes are being telecast on the television. Madhavi is also upset about this as there is a strike after a dispute between the union members and the producers. Daya and her friends decide to conduct a havan to solve this problem as Daya is slightly superstitious. Meanwhile, Tapu makes a plan to solve his problem. What is his problem?

episodes.title: The Principal Summons The Parents
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and Sodhi want to meet the principal, but Jethalal is scared of Bhide coming to know about the leader. Rita tries to telecast this news on live TV, but Jethalal doesn't allow her to do so. Meanwhile, Bhide and Sodhi reach there. The principal gets tensed after seeing the struggling behaviour of Jethalal and Bhide. What will happen to Tapu?

episodes.title: Tapu And His Army Are Not Ready To End The Strike
episodes.synopsis: Komal gets enraged at Goli and asks to end the strike, but she is shocked at his behaviour. Bhide takes Tapu's frustration out on Sonu. Jethalal wants to share the problem with his best friend, Taarak Mehta. Champaklal goes to school with them. He tries to explain to Tapu and the other children about the unfair nature of their demands. Will Tapu listen to Champaklal?

episodes.title: Daya Plans To Celebrate Her 25th Wedding Anniversary
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal has to go to a social convention, but he wants to rest at home. She gets suspicious as Jethalal pretexts with her saying he wants to enjoy the Sunday with his friends. Tapu's friends reach at home while Jethalal is resting. He tries to scare them away. Meanwhile, Babita reaches there and Jethalal gets scared of someone catching them together alone in the house. Will someone catch them?

episodes.title: Jethalal Is Disturbed By The Presence Of Two Ladies
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is alone at home and he is encountered by the presence of various women, one of them is Sweety. Will Jethalal be a true husband? Who is Sweety? Find out in this episode of Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashma.

episodes.title: Sweety Threatens To Commit Suicide
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal attempts to explain something to Champaklal and Daya as they believe he is having an affair with Sweety. Sweety threatens to commit suicide. Jethalal asks Nattu Kaka to prove his innocence, but something goes wrong. Bhide and Sodhi reach Jethalal's home as Bhide is suspicious about the whole situation. What proof does she have?

episodes.title: Tapu Finds Proof
episodes.synopsis: Tapu finds proof of his father's affair with Sweety. Jethalal tries to explain to Daya and Champaklal that he is innocent. Tapu makes a plan to find out the truth. Will Tapu succeed in his plan? Will Jethalal be proved innocent?

episodes.title: Daya Accidently Insults Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is worried when he sees Babita tensed and believes it's because of Iyer. Daya accidentally insults Jethalal while he is talking to Babita. Champaklal gets surprised when his old friend, Premji, and his wife reach Gokuldam and invite them for their daughter's marriage. Jethalal doesn't want to go with them and talks to Champaklal about this. Will Champaklal agree?

episodes.title: Champaklal Decides To Get Tapu Married
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal is worried whether Tapu will run away to get married or will he seek his consent. Champaklal decides to get Tapu married and tells Daya about his decision. Daya believes Champaklal is suffering from a disease. Jethalal gets shocked when he comes to know about Tapu's marriage. What will Jethalal do?

episodes.title: Tapu Decides To Marry
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal gets shocked when Champaklal informs him about Tapu's marriage. He shares his problem with Taarak Mehta. He then attempts to explain to Champaklal that child marriage is illegal. Tapu has an idea while playing pretend-marriage with dolls. He decides to marry as he wants a bicycle. Tapu's friends also want to marry when they come to know about Tapu's marriage. What will Jethalal do?

episodes.title: Sonu's Marriage Proposal For Tapu
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham Society members meet Jethalal and get furious with him for their children's problem as they want to marry. Jethalal shares his feeling with them as he is also against their marriage. Daya gets misunderstood as Bhide had come with Sonu's marriage proposal for Tapu. Champaklal gets ready to get them married. Will Champaklal succeed?

episodes.title: Bhide's Final Answer
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and Madhavi get shocked when Champaklal and Daya meet them regarding Tapu's proposal for Sonu. Bhide gets enraged and insults Champaklal. Daya feels upset as Bhide has insulted them and rejected their marriage proposal. Bhide discusses this with Sodhi and Taarak Mehta and wants to lodge a complaint in the police station. How will the problem of Tapu's marriage be solved?

episodes.title: Daya Is Excited For Tapu's Marriage
episodes.synopsis: Daya is excited about Tapu's marriage and invites Madhavi for the ceremony. All the rituals are going on and the women dance. Jethalal is tensed as he is against this marriage, making Chamapklal angry. Meanwhile, Daya and her entire family get surprised as Sundar reaches there with his neighbours. Jethalal gets shocked when he comes to know about this. How will Jethalal solve this?

episodes.title: Gada Convinces Everybody For Tapu's Marriage
episodes.synopsis: It is celebration time for the entire Gokuldham Society as the Gada family manages to convince everybody for the marriage of their child Tapu. Taarak Mehta is caught in a battle of wits. He cannot decide whether to follow his morals and avoid this child marriage or as a friend be a part of it? Watch this episode to find out Taarak's take on this?

episodes.title: Tapu's Marriage Rituals
episodes.synopsis: The marriage rituals are going on with full groove and everybody is supposedly very happy. The rituals are complete and a new journey will start from here. Jethalal is not happy with all this. Will he be able to solve this problem?

episodes.title: Jethalal Tensed In Tapu's Marriage
episodes.synopsis: To start a new happily married life, everyone in the family needs to be happy. But out of all people, Jethalal is the only one who is tensed. When Jethalal's life seems to be happy, there are problems galore that come his way. Sundar has left the hotel, without paying the bills and like always Jethalal has to pay it off. Find out what happens to Jethalal now.

episodes.title: Daya Has Entered A Quarrel
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and Tapu for the first time have figured that they talk to their wives alike, have tea alike, work alike and think alike. Meanwhile, Daya has entered a quarrel with the entire society with relation to her daughter-in-law who is supposedly being targeted. What is the problem and why have the police been called?

episodes.title: Jethalal Watches Tapu's Marriage
episodes.synopsis: It turns out that Jethalal has been seeing a dream of Tapu's marriage for a long time and all the events have just been too disturbing for his liking. But his only fear is that these events might actually turn out to be true. Jethalal tries to fool around with the father of the girl so that he says a no for marriage. Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.title: Jethalal Has Smelled Trouble
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal has smelled trouble after calling H.K. Gandhi and has taken more trouble by calling up his own father in a different voice trying to call off the wedding. Meanwhile, the two families decide that Tapu and Chutki should once at least meet each other. What will happen when they meet?

episodes.title: Taarak Is Against Child Marriage
episodes.synopsis: The Gada and the Gandhi family have decided to meet each other and Jethalal is getting tensed day by day. Taarak Mehta has been called to oppose the idea of child marriage. Will Taarak be successful?

episodes.title: Lohri Is Round The Corner
episodes.synopsis: The Gada family has finally managed to tell Gandhi, family, about the confusion and matters, are likely to be solved now. Lohri is round the corner and the Punjabi's are in a full groove. Sodhi's family relatives have decided to visit him on Lohri. But there are more reasons for Sodhi's excitement, find out what they are and how does Roshan react to them?

episodes.title: Sodhi Has Lied
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi likes to party all the time. But more than that, he is a family man and likes to keep his wife and children happy. Sodhi has lied at his house and gone to his friend's party. He ends up drinking a lot at the party and has not reached home till late night and Roshan is tensed. What condition is Sodhi in and what happens when he reaches Gokuldham?

episodes.title: Drunk Roshan Singh Sodhi
episodes.synopsis: Roshan Singh Sodhi has been absolutely drunk and he is not being allowed back in his house. He tries absolutely crazy things to get back in his house. Will they work? How does excessive consumption of alcohol be a problem for him? Find out in this episode.

episodes.title: Sodhi's Efforts
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi's efforts to seek the attention of his wife are beginning to take a new high and he has decided to not come down from the building's roof. What will happen if he does not come down? Will Roshan forgive him?

episodes.title: Celebrations Of Lohri In Gokuldham Society
episodes.synopsis: When the festivals are around the corner, people become very excited. Sodhi's relatives from Punjab have decided to convert Gokuldham society into a mini-Punjab. The celebrations of Lohri are taking their shape. Find out how Gokuldham prepares for Lohri and Uttaran?

episodes.title: Gokuldham Society Is In Mood For Celebrations
episodes.synopsis: The entire Gokuldham society is surrounded by festivity and everyone is in the mood for celebrations. The celebrations of Uttaran are coming straight from Gujarat and Sundar has sent a parcel straight from Gujarat for the Gada family in Mumbai. Find out how these celebrations take place when a mini-India resides in Gokuldham.

episodes.title: Kite Flying Competition Between Jetha And Sodhi
episodes.synopsis: The festival of Makkar Sakranti is a huge success, and Gokuldam learnt a message about love. Jetha and Sodhi are having a really tight competition. It is time for the golden kite. The tensions are high and Bhide is supporting Sodhi heavily. Who will win this competition? Will anybody sit on the donkey? Find out in this episode.

episodes.title: Dr. Hathi Has Lost 30 Kilos Of Weight
episodes.synopsis: Dr Hathi has lost 30 kilos of weight, supposedly and Daya decides that her husband too should lose weight. Jethalal has to go to sleep without food and Daya has also locked the kitchen. Jetha is becoming desperate to have some food. He calls up Bhide to place an order with Madhavi. The next morning, Jetha has no food in his tummy. How will Jetha's problems be in front of the entire society?

episodes.title: Dr. Hathi Gets Stuck In Auto Rickshaw
episodes.synopsis: Dr Hathi eats after he has gained 30 kilos of weight. The entire Gokuldham has formed a human chain to pull Dr Hathi out of the auto-rickshaw. Without any result or any ideas, they decide to pull off the rickshaw's top and take Dr Hathi out. Bhide comes up with a plan to pull him out. What is the plan? Will it be successful?

episodes.title: Clash Of Plans
episodes.synopsis: Dr Hathi attempts to get customers in his clinic but is still unsuccessful. Jethalal finds himself unaware of the importance of 26th January. Bhide gets upset by the adult knowledge levels in Gokuldham Co-operative Society and decides to have a meeting for the same. Whose plan is going to work?

episodes.title: Taarak Declares A Cultural Dance Program
episodes.synopsis: Bhide is tensed as all the women want to enjoy Republic Day on their own. Tapu and his friends want to celebrate Republic Day as they wish. Taarak Mehta tries to explain to them and declares a Cultural Dance Program on this occasion. All the couples practice for the dance competition. Who will win the competition? Find out in this episode of Taarak Mehta ka Ooltah Chashma.

episodes.title: Special Guest In Gokuldham's Cultural Dance Program
episodes.synopsis: All the couples are excited as Gokuldham Society members have organized a cultural dance program on the occasion of Republic Day. Taarak Mehta welcomes their special guest and judges. Who is the special guest of the occasion?

episodes.title: Winner Of Gokuldham's Cultural Dance Program
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham Society members show their cultural performance as they have organized a cultural dance program on the occasion of Republic day. Taarak Mehta sings a song on the request of Jethalal and other society members. Jethalal and Daya have been declared the winner of the competition. But, another society member opposes the judge's decision. Will the judges change their decision?
episodes.note: The only video found for this episode is 12 minutes long, so it may be only part of the episode. Try the previous and next episode, or SonyLIV (Premium), for the rest.

episodes.title: Babita Suggests Jethalal To Exercise
episodes.synopsis: Taarak Mehta gets annoyed with the society members behaviour. Bhide and other society members start feeling guilty for what they have done. Jethalal gets annoyed with Daya's behaviour. Meanwhile, Champaklal gets angry at him. Babita suggests Jethalal should exercise. Daya and Champaklal get surprised with Jethalal's changed behaviour.

episodes.title: Jethalal Starts Dieting
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal decides to start dieting as Babita has suggested. But he could not help it after seeing delicious food for dinner. Daya and Tapu wish Jethalal would watch a movie with them as Sundar has acted in that film, but Jethalal is not ready to do so as he is excited to exercise with Babita. Tapu has a plan to make Jethalal watch the movie. What is the plan?

episodes.title: Jethalal Is Excited To Go For Exercise With Babita
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is scared when he sees his family in search of Champaklal's sandal as he had worn his sandals in excitement while going for exercise with Babita. Babita suggests Daya and other friends that they should also exercise. Bhide worries for the new generation as they are computer savvy and discusses this with Sodhi and Dr Hathi. Will Jethalal face any problems while exercising?

episodes.title: A Burglar Snatches Jethalal's Mobile
episodes.synopsis: After facing many difficulties, Jethalal is ready to start his exercise with Babita but is surprised when he finds Babita doing Yoga. Meanwhile, a burglar snatches his mobile. Jethalal tries to chase him and catch him. Bhide and Sodhi make fun of him and tease him. Jethalal tells Champaklal about this but gets annoyed with Daya. Meanwhile, Tapu reminds him they have to go for a movie.

episodes.title: Jethalal And His Family Reach The Theatre
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and the entire family reach the theatre to watch the movie in which Sundar has acted. While returning, Jethalal gets shocked when he comes to know about the taxi strike. Tapu asks his grandfather to donate blankets to beggars. Jethalal gets surprised when he sees Babita at his home. How will Jethalal react to this surprise?

episodes.title: Daya Gave Away Jethalal's New Pants
episodes.synopsis: After seeing Jethalal get capital gains out of the charity work, the others also decide to work around a profit generating model for themselves. Champaklal is extremely pleased with the children and Abdul for helping him out with the donations. Will the others be successful in earning money through donations, like Jethalal?

episodes.title: Blanket Donation Fraud
episodes.synopsis: Everyone is furious over the blanket donation fraud. Champak Chacha discovers what the beggars actually require. Jethalal's wife kills his romantic mood, after which he goes to his shop to discover that his father has taken away cash which was earmarked for a client.

episodes.title: Champaklal Gets Arrested
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal tries to get back the money from his father which he refuses. Meanwhile, Champaklal gets arrested. Why does he get arrested? Has he committed a fraud? Find out in this episode full of confusion only on Sony Liv.

episodes.title: Police Abduct Bapuji
episodes.synopsis: There's a new thief in town at the Adarsh Nagar colony. The police abduct Bapuji mistaking him to be a most wanted criminal, Natwarlal. Meanwhile, Tapu reaches home and informs Jethalal and Daya about the same. Will Bapuji be rescued in time? Will Jethalal manage to rescue his father? Find out in this hilarious episode.

episodes.title: Champaklal In Jail
episodes.synopsis: Dr. Hathi finds out about Champaklal through the news and informs everyone. Everyone decides to go and get him back. Meanwhile, Jethalal's client comes to ask for the cash. Daya is worried about her husband and father-in-law. Will they be successful in getting Champaklal out of jail?

episodes.title: Real Thief Confesses His Crime
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal and the others get into a tiff with the news reporter at the police station, and later on the real thief comes and confesses his crime. Will Champaklal get out of jail now? Find out in this episode.

episodes.title: Maid becomes A Huge Trouble For Gokuldham Society Wives
episodes.synopsis: The women of Gokuldham Society find themselves in a fix when they can't trace their maid Rukmani's whereabouts. Their daily work is interrupted when she doesn't come on time. She finally comes and gives a fair justification. Will it be fruitful? Find out in this episode.

episodes.title: Daya Asks Jethalal For Another Mobile Phone For Rukmani
episodes.synopsis: Taarak Mehta is excited about his wife returning back from her home after two months. Everyone else in the society hears about this and gets excited too. Daya asks Jethalal for another mobile phone to give to Rukmani. Will Jethalal agree to Daya's request?

episodes.title: Rukmani Confesses Her Problems To Daya
episodes.synopsis: Daya and the others try to figure out why Rukmani is upset and what could possibly be bothering her. Rukmani later confesses her problems and issues to leave the ladies upset as well. Will the ladies help solve Rukmani's problem?

episodes.title: Gokuldham Men Try Their Hand At Doing All Household Tasks
episodes.synopsis: Everyone in the Gokuldham Co-operative Society starts complaining about not having Rukmani do all the chores. The men try their hand at doing all household tasks. How far they'll go in their pursuit? Will they fail or will they succeed? Watch this hilarious episode to find out.

episodes.title: Hunt For Maid Begins In Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: Rukmani has left the job which has put everyone in Gokuldham society in huge trouble. The maid hunt is on. The women decide to place an advertisement on television. Even, the kids are a part of this hunt. They put the posters all around the colony. Will they find someone? Will she be as good as Rukmani?

episodes.title: A New Helper
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham members stumble upon a man who is looking for a job and is ready to help them in their household. However, when Haathi tells him to start working, he tells them that he will join from tomorrow and he needs some money in advance. Is he a fraud? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.title: A Good News
episodes.synopsis: Jetha goes to the shop to see that Nattu Kaka is not in the shop yet. When he asks another helper in the shop and the other one does not know either, he tells him to keep a tab on people in the shop. Daya calls him to tell him that there is good news and asks him to guess it. What is the good news?

episodes.title: Lovely Is Trying To Divide
episodes.synopsis: Lovely, society's new maid is trying to divide every woman of the Gokuldham society by provoking them against each other. Everyone realizes this and blasts Lovely. She calls the police. Everyone in the Gokuldham society defends themselves. Whom do the police arrest? Find out in this episode.

episodes.title: Crazy Toothpaste Is Making Gokuldham Go Crazy
episodes.synopsis: Crazy toothpaste is making everyone at the Gokuldham society go crazy. The free whistle with the product has made every kid in the society make noise all through the day. While trying to fiddle with it, Bhide swallows the whistle. What will happen to him?

episodes.title: Bhide Is Struggling With The Whistle Stuck In His Throat
episodes.synopsis: Bhide is struggling with the whistle stuck in his throat. Mrs Bhide calls the throat specialist and takes an appointment. He is not ready for operation. There is a meeting happening on how to solve Bhide's problem. What solution will the residents of Gokuldham Society come up with for their secretary?

episodes.title: Daya's Trick Works On Bhide
episodes.synopsis: The society members try different tricks on Bhide to solve his whistle problems. Daya comes running from behind and hits Bhide from behind. The trick actually works and Bhide's whistle comes out. Tapu fills up the water balloons and is hitting everyone in the society. Bhide comes and complains about Tapu to his father. Will Jethalal stop Tapu?

episodes.title: Bhide Doesn't Want The Society To Celebrate Holi
episodes.synopsis: Bhide wants society not to celebrate Holi as the kids have their exams approaching. Everyone mutually decides that there wouldn't be any Holi at their society, which leaves the kids disappointed. Daya's brother Sunder arrives from Gujarat. He promises the Gada family that he will make sure the society plays Holi. Will Sunder manage to do this?

episodes.title: Sunder Promises To Call Shahrukh Khan And Sachin Tendulkar
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal challenges Sunder to call a cricketer or a film-star the next morning. He accepts the challenge. Gokuldham society celebrates the pre-holi ceremony. Everyone asks Sunder which star is he calling the next day. Sunder promises to call Shahrukh Khan and Sachin Tendulkar to their society. Will he be able to call them?

episodes.title: Sachin Tendulkar And Shahrukh Khan Arrive In Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: Everyone in the Gokuldham society is excited about Sachin Tendulkar and Shahrukh Khan coming to celebrate Holi with them. Their duplicates arrive at Gokuldham society. A TV journalist shows up and reveals that they are the duplicates. Society members are shattered. How will Sunder convince them now?

episodes.title: Gokuldham Society Celebrates Holi
episodes.synopsis: It is revealed in front of the society that Sachin and Shahrukh are duplicates. Everyone is annoyed at Sunder but Champaklal comes in and tells everyone that it is not Sunder's fault and tells everyone to not be selfish. Finally, its time to celebrate Holi. Everyone at the Gokuldham society is going crazy celebrating the festival.

episodes.title: Sunder's Friend Chhagan And Magan Are In Mumbai
episodes.synopsis: Sunder has sent rice and dal in huge quantities from Ahemdabad to Jethalal and Daya. Sunder calls Daya and tells her that his friends Chhagan and Magan are in Mumbai and they need Rs. 25,000. Magan drops in and Jethalal gives him Rs. 20,000. Is there trouble awaiting Jethalal?

episodes.title: Jethalal Made A Mistake By Giving 20,000 to Magan
episodes.synopsis: Sunder's friend Chhagan drops in. Jethalal gives him Rs. 5,000. He asks for 15 more. Jethalal realizes that he has made a mistake by giving 20,000 to Magan. Chagan has a flight to catch and he needs money urgently. How will Jethalal arrange for money?

episodes.title: Zoravar Comes With 3 Burly Looking Men To Jetha's House
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal fails to arrange money for Chagan and wife. They curse him as they will miss their flight and honeymoon. Champaklal agrees to give money to them. A man named Zoravar comes with 3 burly looking men to Jethalal's house. He is Chagan's wife, Chhabili's father. He is shocked to know they have gone to Goa. What will happen next?

episodes.title: Zoravar Is Taking Jethalal To Ahmedabad
episodes.synopsis: Zoravar is taking Jethalal to Ahmedabad with him. Suddenly, Chagan and his wife drop in the society. Chagan tells his father that Chhabili only pushed him to come to him and say sorry. Vinay Pathak is Tarak Mehta's friend and comes over. How do people in Gokuldham society react to this?

episodes.title: Tapu Tells His Father That He Won't Write His Exams
episodes.synopsis: Tapu tells his father that he won't write his exams. Jetha blames Champaklal for Tapu's lack of discipline. Champaklal gets angry and promises to leave the house. Champaklal puts a condition that he won't go back if Tapu is ready to write his exams. Will he get ready? Find out in this episode.

episodes.title: Abdul Promises To Help Tapu To Cheat In The Exams
episodes.synopsis: Everyone's life in the house revolves around Tapu's exams. Parents in the colony are getting ready for their children's exams. Abdul, the shopkeeper of the Gokuldham society promises to help Tapu cheat in the exams. Will Tapu cheat in the exam? Will anyone find out?

episodes.title: Tapu Gets Caught In Exams
episodes.synopsis: The kids write their exams. The mobile phone that was given by Abdul to Tapu suddenly rings in the class, and his teacher catches him. After Daya convinces him, he lets Tapu write the exam. Tapu and Abdul say sorry to Jethalal. Pappu calls up Tapu and promises to give Maths question paper to him for Rs. 5,000. Will Tapu buy it?

episodes.title: Tapu Is Buying The Question Paper
episodes.synopsis: Bhide tells everyone in the society that Tapu is buying the question paper. All of them go to the park where Tapu is about to meet Pappu. But the plan fails when the police arrive. The inspector reveals that Tapu only complained against Pappu since he was trying to sell the exam paper.

episodes.title: Fight Between Babita And Mr Iyer
episodes.synopsis: Since all the kids are studying at Bhide's house, all the adults are having a good time in the Gokuldham society. The society is shocked when suddenly, kitchen utensils start falling out from Iyer and Babita's house. Jetha goes to their house to know the reason. Why are they fighting? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.title: Babita Decides To Leave Mr Iyer's Home
episodes.synopsis: Babita is leaving her home as Iyer has insulted her mother. Taarak Mehta and his wife convince Babita not to divorce Iyer. A fight takes place again and this time Iyer is leaving. People are trying to convince Iyer not to go. But, Iyer is not ready to listen. Will he go back to Chennai? Find out in this episode.

episodes.title: Police Comes And Arrests Iyer For Beating Babita
episodes.synopsis: The situation is getting out of control and the final decision is that there will be a divorce between Iyer and Babita. Iyer reveals that they were just making a fool of everyone. Suddenly, the police come and arrest Iyer for beating his wife. Will Iyer prove his innocence?

episodes.title: A Candidate Wants Jethalal To Donate 10 TV Sets
episodes.synopsis: A candidate for the election has come to Jethalal's shop and wants to install 10 TV sets around the area. Jetha is very happy but they want him to donate the 10 TV sets and not sell them. Daya goes and invites Madhavi for the Mahavir Jayanti but Bhide says that she will have to take written permission from the secretary. Will strict Bhide give permission?

episodes.title: Gada Family Organises A Function
episodes.synopsis: Gada family is all set for the function that they are going to organize in Gokuldham society. They invite everyone and ask them to be available and gather for the function at the correct time. Watch this episode to find out how the members of the society celebrate the function.

episodes.title: A Dental Appointment
episodes.synopsis: When Jetah asks Daya for tea, she tells him that he cannot have anything as Haathi has told them to not eat anything for the dental appointment. How will Jethalal's dental appointment be?

episodes.title: Jethalal Fails To Break The Walnut With His Teeth
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal fails to break the walnut with his teeth and his teeth start paining. Jethalal takes the medicine but it doesn't work. He is scared to go to a dentist. Jethalal is trying to hide from everyone but Champaklal reveals this fact to everyone in the Gokuldham society. How will everyone react?

episodes.title: Jethalal Afraid Of Visiting A Dentist
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is back from the shop early because of the toothache. Komal and Babita suggest him to go to Dr Kutkutiya. He finally gives in to the pressure and agrees to go to the dentist. Jethalal is trying to find excuses for not going to the dentist. He says that he won't go without Tarak Mehta. After Taarak's arrival, he is left with no excuse. Watch his escapade with the dentist.

episodes.title: Hooligan Gives A Tight Slap To Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal, Daya, and Tarak Mehta go to see the dentist. Hooligan suddenly enters the clinic and tells everyone to run away. Daya gets into an argument with the hooligan and he pushes her. Jethalal tries and fights with him but he slaps him hard. This breaks his tooth and his toothache is completely fine. Will Jethalal see the dentist now?

episodes.title: Mehta's Wife Has Injured Her Foot
episodes.synopsis: Tarak Mehta is busy working on his new article. Meanwhile, his wife has injured her foot which brings trouble to him. He has to go to the ration store to get detergent powder. The shopping for a washing powder becomes an adventure for Taarak Mehta. Will he be successful in buying it?

episodes.title: Taarak Mehta Gives The Passes To Dharmesh
episodes.synopsis: Tarak Mehta doesn't understand how to handle this simple transaction. There is a lot of crowd and confusion at the shop. The shopping for a washing powder becomes an adventure for Taarak Mehta. Will he be successful in buying it?

episodes.title: Jaggu Is Looking For Taarak To Beat Him
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal tells Tarak Mehta, that some guy called Jaggu is looking for him to beat him. He tells Taarak that Jaggu is Meenakshi's husband, whom he criticized in the detergent shop. Jaggu's men mistake Iyer for Tarak Mehta and beat him. Will they find the real Taarak?

episodes.title: Jaggu Surprises Mehta By Dropping In Suddenly At Night
episodes.synopsis: Jaggu is convinced that Tarak Mehta didn't do anything and goes off. Jaggu surprises him by dropping in suddenly at night at their house. This time he comes with his wife, Meenakshi. She wants Taarak Mehta to write a film script for her. Will he do it?

episodes.title: Jethalal Refuses To Take Tapu For The Picnic
episodes.synopsis: The exams are over and kids of the Gokuldham society are super excited. They want to go to a picnic on their vacations. Tapu requests his father to take him to the picnic, but, he refuses. None of the fathers wants to take the kids for the picnic. What will Tapu sena do now?

episodes.title: Tapu Sena Go On A Rebellion By Not Playing Cricket
episodes.synopsis: The kids go on a rebellion by not playing cricket which makes all the men sad. The women of the society announced in a meeting at night that they will go with the kids for a picnic. The men are initially reluctant to let them go but when they hear the women are going to Tikujini Wadi, all of them get ready to go. But will the women allow them?

episodes.title: Natu Kaka Gets An Expensive Camera For Tapu
episodes.synopsis: Nattu Kaka gets an expensive camera for Tapu to take along to the picnic. Gogi doesn't let his parents sleep since he is very excited to go. After taking most of the rides in the park, they realize that Gogi is missing. Champaklal takes the responsibility of searching him. Can he find Gogi? Where did he go?

episodes.title: Gogi Is Lost
episodes.synopsis: The women try and pacify Mrs Sodhi since Gogi is missing. Anjali finally gives in and tells Tarak Mehta that Gogi is lost. Sodhi gets paranoid as soon as the men at the Gokuldham society tell him about Gogi. He drives them to Tiku Ji ki Wadi. Champaklal spots Gogi sleeping in a water tube. How did he reach there?

episodes.title: Search For Gogi Begins
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi and men reach Tiku Ji Ki Wadi late at night. They get to know that they found Gogi and have left. They plan to drive back but the car refuses to work. The men push the car all through the way from Tiku Ji Ki Wadi. Watch this episode to find out the struggle through which the men of Gokuldham society go through.

episodes.title: Anjali Suggests Them To Organize A Kitty Party
episodes.synopsis: It's a new day at the Gokuldham society. Women are planning their vacations and they infer it will be a boring affair. They all go to Madhavi's house and they make plans to have a good time. Anjali suggests them to organize a kitty party for their entertainment. Will the men allow them? Find out in this episode.

episodes.title: Men Are Excited For The Kitty Party
episodes.synopsis: All the men are excited about the kitty party. Even Jethalal is very happy as Babita will also come to attend the party. Bhide is against Madhavi to be a part of the kitty party. She tells this to other women. Will they manage to convince him? Find out in this episode.

episodes.title: Wives Pressurize Bhide To Allow Madhavi To Join The Kitty Party
episodes.synopsis: All the women of the society try and pressurize Bhide to allow Madhavi to be a part of the Kitty. Bhide finally gives in to the pressure. Jethalal wants to stay at home as he wants to be around the kitty party. Will he be able to convince Daya to let him stay? Find out in this episode.

episodes.title: Cat Fight Amongst The Ladies
episodes.synopsis: All ladies play a game where they enact as couples. Daya and Madhavi act as wife and husband. Everything is fine until Madhavi feels bad and starts a catfight, assuming that Daya insulted her husband. What will happen and who will resolve their fight?

episodes.title: Daya Vs Madhavi
episodes.synopsis: Everyone is concerned about the fight between Daya and Madhavi, as now, it has become a big issue in the society. Even Jethalal and Bhide have gotten involved in it now. How will this issue get resolved now?

episodes.title: Robbery Scenes
episodes.synopsis: Everyone gets to know that some robbery took place in the nearby society. Daya and Jethalal are terrified and they start packing their valuables. The whole society is on alert and is afraid of any upcoming robbery.

episodes.title: Chain Snatching
episodes.synopsis: Anjali and Daya are out today for some shopping and suddenly Daya notices a beautiful necklace on Anjali's neck. She compliments her and within 15 minutes of their notice, some goons on a bike, snatch her necklace and go away. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodes.title: Daya Hides Twenty Five Lakhs
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal gives twenty-five lakh rupees to Daya to keep them safe at home. Daya keeps them in Tapu's school bag, Jethalal is very furious and calls her extremely dumb. What will happen to the money?

episodes.title: Police Chaos
episodes.synopsis: All the people from Gokuldham Society join together and wait for the police. The police arrives late and everyone accuses the police of not coming early and they suspect those three chain snatchers. Meanwhile, Mohanlal is worried about his money and plans to get out of India.

episodes.title: Daya's Mistake
episodes.synopsis: Daya and Jethalal have a fight in the compound. Just when Taarak comes and tries to resolve their fight, Jethalal expresses his anger that Daya had revealed about their personal financial details to her friend, on the road. Meanwhile, Taarak organizes a meeting of all men at the soda shop.

episodes.title: New Watchman
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal appoints a new watchman for himself. Meanwhile, everyone from Gokuldham Society asks him to stand in front of the society gate, as they are told that he is there to guard the whole society. Will everyone come to know about the truth?

episodes.title: Jethalal At Gunpoint
episodes.synopsis: Three thieves break in Jethalal's house and question him at gunpoint about those Rs. 25 lakhs. But he realizes that it was all just a bad dream. In the morning, a woman comes into the society, from RELAX security agency.

episodes.title: A Friendly Tip
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal gives the watchman a tip and tells him to especially keep an eye out for his house in particular. Later on, Sodhi decides to test the watchman's ability by dressing up as a burglar. Will Sher Singh pass in this test.

episodes.title: Let's Catch The Thieves
episodes.synopsis: Tapu is running around the house, practising Karate. Daya comes up with new plans to catch any thief who would break into her house. Meanwhile, Gogi is scared of the thieves but Champaklal consoles him.

episodes.title: Tapu's Team Training
episodes.synopsis: Tapu and his friends make a pact that they have to save their society from these so-called thieves. So, they plan a circuit training that will help them to beat these thieves. Meanwhile, the thieves come to the society, dressed as repairmen.

episodes.title: Tapu Sena Vs The Theives
episodes.synopsis: The thieves dress as repairmen and break into Jethalal's house. They hold Daya at gunpoint and try to make their escape. However, Tapu is standing in their way, ready to teach them a lesson.

episodes.title: Tapu Sena's Interview
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal finally hands over the 25 lakhs to its rightful owner. Meanwhile, Rita Reporter comes to take Tapu Sena's interview after they bravely fought and captured the thieves. Watch the episode to find out more.

episodes.title: Sweets Or Salad?
episodes.synopsis: Anjali forces Taarak to eat a salad for breakfast. Meanwhile, Daya comes in with bowl full of ladus. However, Taarak trades in his breakfast for the ladus while Jethala has to suffer through the salad. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodes.title: Popatlal Is Coming Back
episodes.synopsis: All the ladies are discussing Popatlal's marriage and him returning back to Gokuldham. Meanwhile, a truck enters the society, carrying a familiar passenger. Who has entered the society now? Watch the episode to find out.

episodes.title: Problematic Popatlal
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal has a fight with the truck driver in the middle of the night at the society compound. The truck driver recounts all the moments Popatlal made the journey difficult for him. How will this issue get resolved? Watch the episode to find out.

episodes.title: Breaking The Lock
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal has created a big problem for all the society members in the middle of the night. He can't find the keys to his apartment and all his stuff is lying in the compound. However, Tapu suggests a way they can enter the apartment.

episodes.title: Jethalal's Lucky Shirt
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal visits Jethalal's house in the morning. Meanwhile, Jethalal is preparing for a big party that is coming to make a huge order from China. Meanwhile, Daya is searching for Jethalal's lucky, yellow shirt.

episodes.title: Gujarati To Chinese
episodes.synopsis: Nattu Kaka is ready to learn Chinese for the Chinese party that is coming to make a huge order at Gada Electronics. Meanwhile, talking to the Chinese customer, Daya enters the shop with Jethalal's lucky shirt. What product is the Chinese customer trying to push Jethalal?

episodes.title: Daya's Vow Of Silence
episodes.synopsis: Daya has taken a vow of silence after Jethalal is annoyed by her habit of speaking too much. However, when Jethalal needs her help, he regrets saying anything to her. Find out what will happen next by watching the episode.

episodes.title: Daya's Silence
episodes.synopsis: Daya is continuing with her vow of silence but that is causing Jethalal a lot of worries. He is realizing that his life is incomplete without hearing Daya's voice. Will he apologize to her and make things alright?

episodes.title: Jethalal Woos Daya
episodes.synopsis: Jeethalal tries to make it up to Daya by any means possible but every effort of his seems futile. However, Jethalal is not eating anything and hence has got a fever. Will Daya finally put her husband before the vow of silence?

episodes.title: Goli's Cousin
episodes.synopsis: Komal is going to her brother's house but Goli doesn't wanna go. Tapu Sena convinces Komal to let Goli stay in Gokuldham. However, Komal has called Goli's Uncle and Aunt to take care of him while she is gone.

episodes.title: Cruel Monty
episodes.synopsis: Goli's cousin, Monty, has come to Gokuldham Society and is going to stay there for a few days. However, he turns out to be very rude and Tapu doesn't like him. Today Tapu and his friends are playing a cricket match, he is waiting to teach Monty a lesson.

episodes.title: The Bet
episodes.synopsis: As Bhide gets hit by the ball while the children play cricket, an argument breaks out between Jethalal and Bhide. A cricket match is finalized between Bhide and Jhethalal on the following Saturday, on the condition that the loser will have to clean the Gokuldham Society.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Premiere League
episodes.synopsis: As the ladies and the children of the Gokuldham Society decide to participate in the match as well, Taarak flips the coin for the team selection. Bhide and Jethalal, being the captains, choose their respective teams for the upcoming cricket match. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodes.title: Jabardast Jetha VS Bindass Bhide
episodes.synopsis: When Babita declares to sponsor Jethalal's team, Mohan steps forward and sponsors Bhide's team. Both the teams get ready for the match and start practising and making strategies in secret. Keep watching the show to find out more.

episodes.title: Getting Ready For The Match
episodes.synopsis: Both the team captains, Jethalal and Bhide, give a pep talk to their respective teams and as they reach the compound to practice, an argument breaks out between the teams, as to who practices first. Later, while discussing the game rules, the meeting gets interrupted when Sundar visits Gokuldham.

episodes.title: It's Showtime!
episodes.synopsis: According to Sundar's plan, Tapu Sena gathers a lot of sponsors for the match to bear the recurring expenses. Sundar and Monica are ready to host the match. The two teams perform song and dance before the match and praise their respective team members. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodes.title: Daya Does Wonders
episodes.synopsis: The match begins with a boom as Bindaas Bhide team wins the toss and chooses to bat. Tapu plays brilliantly as expected by everyone, but Daya shocks the whole team and the entire audience with her exceptional performance. Keep watching the show to catch up on all the excitement.

episodes.title: A Tight Competition
episodes.synopsis: With a hattrick, Daya blows everyone's mind off just like Sonu does with her batting. Bhide's team stands at 84 runs whereas Jethalal's team requires 13 runs from 6 balls to win. Who will take home the GPL trophy home? Keep watching the show to find out.

episodes.title: Mayhem In The Match
episodes.synopsis: As the last run that is needed to be scored by Jethalal's team to win the match, the police comes and confiscates the bat and ball to stop the match, stating that a night match without police permission is prohibited. What will happen now?

episodes.title: The Breakfast Affair
episodes.synopsis: A hungry Jethalal is unable to have his favourite snack, as unexpected guests come over and finish up all the food. However, he calms down and plans on romancing with Daya. But Daya, on the other hand, decides to go to the mall What will Jethalal do now?

episodes.title: Jethalal Romances With Daya
episodes.synopsis: While Daya is working in the kitchen, Jethalal comes and gets romantic with Daya. However, Daya has a plan to go shopping at a mall that has just opened up, along with all of her friends from Gokuldham.

episodes.title: Jethalal Looks After The Kid
episodes.synopsis: Daya has gone shopping with the other ladies while Jethalal has to look after the kid. However, Jethalal is not enjoying his time as the kid is extremely naughty and is creating a nuisance all over the house.

episodes.title: Awkward Situation Between Jethalal And Babita
episodes.synopsis: Babita comes to visit the kid in Jethalal's house. But the kid starts saying mean things about both of them, which makes Jethalal and Babita awkward. Meanwhile, Daya has found her purse and is returning home. Watch the episode to find out more.

episodes.title: Dr. Hathi Arrives In Tempo
episodes.synopsis: Dr Hathi is back to the Gokuldham Society after a break. He makes a heroic entry in a tempo, eating bananas. Everyone is happy to see him, however, Hathi is finding it difficult to get out of the situation he is in.

episodes.title: Jethalal Seeks For Babita's Attention
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is praying from his balcony when he suddenly sees Babita. He starts trying hard and makes noises to gather her attention. Jethalal wants to know Babita's problem and wants to help her.

episodes.title: Jethalal Misinterpreted The Situation
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal gets to know from somewhere that it is Babita's birthday. So he gets flowers for her and visits her house to give her birthday wishes. Babita tries to convey to him that it is not her birthday. But Jetha, in his excitement, does not understand.

episodes.title: Jethalal Gets Panicky
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal receives a call from Mehta and gets to know that it's Babita's birthday and there is a party with a western theme. Jethalal gets worried as he hears this and decides to learn western dance, and while practicing gets caught by his wife.

episodes.title: Struggle Of Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Daya reacts unexpectedly after catching Jethalal dancing with a stranger, he explains that she is a dance instructor. Later on, they find out everybody received an invitation card except them.

episodes.title: One Problem At A Time
episodes.synopsis: A sorrowful Jethalal, after realizing the embarrassment of his family for not being invited, decides to go away. Suddenly, Babita shows up at his house and finds out about the issue. She clarifies everything and finally invites them. After all of this, a new problem arises.

episodes.title: Finally Party Time
episodes.synopsis: As it's a western-themed party, Daya tells Jethalal that she won't be comfortable wearing western clothes in front of Champaklal. After a while, Champaklal himself solves this problem for them by deciding not to attend the party at all. They at last leave for the party.

episodes.title: Daya Astonishes Everyone
episodes.synopsis: All of Gokuldham has arrived for the birthday bash with full spirit and excitement. Babita has a superb entry being the birthday girl and is looking stunning. Daya steals the limelight and astonishes everybody with her unseen attire and look.

episodes.title: One Night, Two Different Plans
episodes.synopsis: The women of Gokuldham have decided to keep a Jagran for the well-being of their husbands and ask them to stay awake at night. The men hesitate at first, but eventually, they all agree because they decide to have their plan of having a party while their wives are busy with the Jagran.

episodes.title: Realization
episodes.synopsis: All the women are decked up for the Jagran and are ready to leave for the clubhouse, whereas, the men are waiting for their chance to begin the party at Taarak's place. All of them finally reach Taarak's place without knowing that he has something else planned for them.

episodes.title: Battle Of Antakshari
episodes.synopsis: As Taarak made all the men of Gokuldham realize that what they were doing was wrong, everybody goes for the Jagran to accompany their wives. They also decide to play Antakshari the whole night. Jethalal begins the Antakshari round and everybody has a great time singing and dancing.

episodes.title: Meeting At Sodhis
episodes.synopsis: Daya loses in the Antakshari deliberately, so that everybody can sleep and makes Jethalal order food for everyone, as everybody seems hungry. This gesture of hers makes Champaklal and Jethalal proud. Later, all the residents gather at Sodi's house to plan for the anniversary of Gokuldham Society.

episodes.title: Gokuldham's Anniversary Celebration Begins
episodes.synopsis: Taarak invites his friend as the chief guest for the Gokuldham Society Anniversary function. They conducted a dance performance by the Gokuldam residents. The couples gave their debut in the rain dance performance.

episodes.title: Raju Srivastav Visits Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: Members of Gokuldham celebrate completing 200 episodes with Raju Srivastav. They have a few amazing dance performances lined up.

episodes.title: The Gadas Plan On A Trip
episodes.synopsis: As Krishna Janmashtami is approaching, Daya requests Jetha to plan a trip to visit her family. Will Jetha agree to this?

episodes.title: Tapu's Essay
episodes.synopsis: Tapu writes an essay on the first showers of the year. Will his parents be impressed with it?

episodes.title: Jetha Lal's Trip To London
episodes.synopsis: Jetha gets an opportunity to go on a trip to London. Nattu Kaka thinks that he's the cause for this trip. What will Jetha say to this?

episodes.title: Raksha Bhandan At Gokuldham Society.
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is in turmoil & wonders how to tell his family that they were not going to London. He decides to tell his family after Raksha Bandhan event. Meanwhile, all the ladies come over to Jetha's house and give him a list of things to buy from London. What will Jetha do next?

episodes.title: London Trip Canceled
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal finally takes the courage to inform his family at the breakfast table that the London trip was canceled. Champaklal demands answers and asks if he was planning to go alone. But when Jetha explains the situation, his family decides to support him and let him go alone.

episodes.title: Jethas Preparation For London
episodes.synopsis: Jetha and his family are excited that he is going to London. Everyone is demanding gifts from Jetha, which is slowly upsetting him. Watch this episode and find out.

episodes.title: Jetha's Send Off
episodes.synopsis: The members of the society including Jetha's family send Jetha off to the airport. Will the family be happy about Jetha's trip or not?

episodes.title: Jethas Digestive Pills
episodes.synopsis: As Jethalal gets into the plane, Daya bhabhi runs behind him to give him his digestive pills. Will Daya get into trouble for loving her husband?

episodes.title: Sundarlal Helps Tappu Sena
episodes.synopsis: Sundarlal visits Jetha's place and decides to help Tappu Sena regarding a financial matter. What is this favor that makes Tappu Sena jump with joy?

episodes.title: Dahi Handi Competition At Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: The members of Gokuldham Society celebrate Krishna Janmashtami together. They even arrange the famous Dahi Handi Competition for which, there is a huge prize. Will Tappu Sena win the game?

episodes.title: Prevention Against Swine Flu
episodes.synopsis: As the deadly disease, swine flu is spreading, Daya has her own way of protecting herself from the flu. What is Daya's way?

episodes.title: Bhide The Philosopher
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and his family have arranged for a bhajan session and Sonu is excited to help them along with Tappu Sena. Meanwhile, Bhide gets deeply philosophical with his wife and starts explaining the purpose of life.

episodes.title: Roshan Bhabi's Party
episodes.synopsis: The ladies of Gokuldham get together to discuss Roshan's party. During the conversation, Daya is reminded of Jetha's absence.

episodes.title: Preparations For Ganesh Chaturti
episodes.synopsis: As Ganesh Chaturti is approaching, Bhide sends an invite to every house in the society. When Abdul gives the invitation to the Gadas, Champaklal sees the price everyone has to contribute and gets angry. What is the price fixed by Bhide?

episodes.title: Jetha In London
episodes.synopsis: The society celebrates Ganesh Chaturti together while Jetha is in London on his business trip. Will Jethalal get homesick?

episodes.title: Daya Misses Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: While Jetha is on a business trip in London, Daya misses him and remembers all the good times they had before he left.

episodes.title: Ethnic Day Contest At Gokuldham Society
episodes.synopsis: On the account of Ganesh Chaturti, Gokuldham Society arranges an ethnic day contest. The prize is given to the winner by Randeep Huda. Who is the winner?

episodes.title: Garba At Gada Electronics
episodes.synopsis: Daya comes to look after Jetha's shop to look after the business. She comes up with a sales pitch which becomes a big hit. What is this new scheme?

episodes.title: Couples Shayari Time At Gokuldham Society
episodes.synopsis: While celebrating Ganesh Chaturthi, Gokuldham Society members decide to have fun amongst themselves by playing a few games. One such game is the couple Shayari. what poems one loved one sings to another.

episodes.title: Daya's Shayari On Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: While playing the couple Sharyari game, Daya recites an emotional poem for her husband, saying that she misses him. Meanwhile, Jethalal calls her from London to give her a surprise. What is this surprise?

episodes.title: Robbery At Gokuldham!
episodes.synopsis: Tappu Sena returns from school to witness the donation box open. They all scream and alarm their parents about the robbery. How will the Gokuldham residents solve this problem?

episodes.title: Remembering Funny Incidents From The Past
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham has a special guest at Ganesh Chaturthi puja and all the residents take a moment to remember everyone's funny incidents from the past. They also realize how these little incidents brought all the residents to become one big family.

episodes.title: Daya Misses Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Jetha is still in London on business and Daya on the other hand, is unable to sleep as she's missing her husband.

episodes.title: Jethalal Returns From London
episodes.synopsis: As Daya starts the aarti, Jetha makes an entry back home. Everyone in the colony is excited to have him back.

episodes.title: Gifts From London
episodes.synopsis: Now that Jetha has come home, Tappu demands that he gets his gifts immediately. So, Jetha decides to unpack and distribute everyone's gifts to them.

episodes.title: No Gift For Iyer
episodes.synopsis: Daya and Jetha decide to visit their fellow residents and give them their gifts. Will everyone like their presents?

episodes.title: Jethalal Back To His Lazy Practices
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is back to his lazy practices now that hes back from London. He uses the difference in timings as his excuse to sleep longer but, will that work?

episodes.title: Jethalals New Look
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is back from London and has returned with a new look. What does everyone else think about his new look?

episodes.title: Jethalal's New Friend From London
episodes.synopsis: A lady visits the Gada family and asks Daya to pass on a gift to Jetha. Everyone in the society is surprised to have this visitor. But, what is Daya's opinion on this?

episodes.title: Jethalals Intervention
episodes.synopsis: Daya lets her friends know about the guest she had. Shocked to hear the news from Daya, the ladies tell their husbands about the new visitor who in turn decide to have an intervention for Jethalal.

episodes.title: Jethalal Is Angry
episodes.synopsis: Knowing that everyone has arranged an intervention for him for a wrong reason, Jethalal gets angry. Later, he talks to his wife and asks her to trust him. They make it up together and convey their love for each other.

episodes.title: Goli Sees Jethalal Getting A Haircut
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal finally decides to get a haircut and ends up at a street barber's shop. Goli sees Jetha on the road and demands to reveal it to others. Later, he loses his purse and gets caught with the police. How did all this happen?

episodes.title: Karie Visits The Gadas
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal's friend Karie decides to visit the Gada family. Daya gets excited to welcome her and decides to give her a grand welcome. Will Karie like the welcome?

episodes.title: Karie Loves Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: Karie visits everyone at Gokuldham Society and loves the hospitality provided by the society members.

episodes.title: Navaratri At Gokuldham Society
episodes.synopsis: It is the first day of Navaratri and everyone at Gokuldham is excited. The ladies have decided to go shopping for Navaratri outfits. Will Karie be included as well?

episodes.title: Popatlal Has Fallen In Love
episodes.synopsis: Navaratri is here and everyone at Gokuldham society is super excited to celebrate it together. Meanwhile, the ladies find out that Popatlal has a crush on Karie. Parallelly, Gada electronics comes up with a new Navaratri offer.

episodes.title: Popatlal's Demand
episodes.synopsis: The ladies go shopping for Dandiya costumes along with Sundar and Karie. They all are at Ahmedabad when Popatlal calls Daya. He demands for the same coloured and patterned dress as Karie's. Will he be satisfied?

episodes.title: Navaratri At Ahmedabad
episodes.synopsis: The ladies decide to stay back at Ahmedabad for one more day to celebrate Navaratri. They all dance and enjoy. Meanwhile, their husbands come all the way to Ahmedabad to bring them home.

episodes.title: Popatlal Stuck In Ahmedabad
episodes.synopsis: The members of the society return to Gokuldham Society return home from Ahmedabad. But, they realize that theyve left Popatlal behind on the way.

episodes.title: Jethalal Unhappy About Popatlal's Crush
episodes.synopsis: Hungover from the Navaratri celebrations, Jethalal wakes up to a shocking news. Daya informs him that she thinks Popatlal has a crush on Karie. Hearing this makes Jethalal furious. How will he react?

episodes.title: Popatlal Gets A Makeover To Impress
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal seeks help from the ladies in the society, with regards to his love for Karie. So they have a conversation with Karie to figure out the way for making her fall in love with Popatlal. Hence they give a makeover to Popatlal, on the assumption that Karie will love him for his handsomeness.

episodes.title: Popatlal's Disastrous Date With Kerry
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal and Kerry go to the park, he was struggling hard to keep up with his image in front of Kerry. But there were a lot of disturbances, and Kerry's handbag was snatched away by a petty thief. Popatlal tried to show his heroism but his efforts went in vain, though they got her bag back, Popatlal was beaten black and blue.

episodes.title: Jethalal The Villain
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal, on his way to work, sees Popatlal being comforted by Karie. Later, Karie shares her happiness with Daya and does the Garba with her out of happiness.

episodes.title: Jethalal And Diwali Games
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal is talking to his friend on the phone and explaining to him how much times have changed. Later, he blesses his family members to live a long and a prosperous life.

episodes.title: Ajay Devgan Visits The Gadas
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and Daya have a miscommunication and forget to bring him home from Gada electronics. Ajay Devgn runs into Champaklal and drops him home.

episodes.title: Diwali With Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: The members of Gokuldham are very excited to celebrate Diwali, the festival of lights. Watch this episode to see how Gokuldham society members celebrate Diwali.

episodes.title: Jethalal Gets A Mobile For Babita
episodes.synopsis: Babita is looking for a new phone to gift her brother. She approaches Jetha for the phone. Will Jetha be able to get the phone or not?

episodes.title: Sundar Takes The Red Cherry Phone Away
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal, while trying to look for his spectacles packs the phone in Sundar's bag. How will Iyer receive the new Red Cherry Phone?

episodes.title: Jetha In Trouble
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal tries to contact Sundar with Taarak's help. Meanwhile, Iyer asks Jethalal about the phone which leads Jethalal to explode.

episodes.title: Daya Vs Jetha
episodes.synopsis: Daya is stern on to make Jetha believe that no matter what, Sundar can never steal the phone as he claims he has! Both of them get into a verbal fight. Watch to find out whether Sundar really stole a phone or no! Stay tuned!

episodes.title: Jethalal And Daya At War
episodes.synopsis: Sundar returns from Bangalore but forgets his bags in the taxi. Meanwhile, Daya and Jetha continue to fight. Will they make up for themselves?

episodes.title: Daya Leaves Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: After falsely accusing Daya's brother, Jethalal feels guilty about it. But, Daya decides to keep her word and leaves Jethalal with her brother. Will she come back?

episodes.title: Jethalal Seeks For Taarak's Help
episodes.synopsis: Not being sure whether Sundar has the mobile phone, Jetha seeks Taarak's help. Taarak comes up with a backup plan to help his friend out before Babita asks again.

episodes.title: Too Many Mobile Phones
episodes.synopsis: To save their relationships with one another, Sundar and Jethalal buy a new red cherry mobile each and hide them. Will they get into a bigger mess?

episodes.title: Champaklal Solves The Problem
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal finds the phone in Sundar's bag. Daya decides to leave the house but, Champaklal steps in and solves the chaos. Watch this episode to know more.

episodes.title: Tappu Wins A Prize At The Camp
episodes.synopsis: The kids return from the camp and narrate their stories to Champaklal. Later, Tapu says that he won the Best Boy prize in the camp.

episodes.title: Taarak's Mind Block
episodes.synopsis: Taarak Mehta is having a mind block and is finding new ways to write a new article. Later, Tapu creates a problem to drink milk while Jetha is on a business call. Will Jetha scold him?

episodes.title: Tappu Sena's TV Ad
episodes.synopsis: Rita visits Gokuldham Society and asks the parents if Tapu Sena can audition for a TV advertisement. How will the parents react?

episodes.title: Audition Day.
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena is excited about their auditions but, their parents are more excited about their auditions. Will the kids get through the auditions?

episodes.title: Daya Admires Sodhi
episodes.synopsis: After the auditions, the members of Gokuldham society return home. Daya observes Sodhi's excitement about the audition and love for his son and admires his fatherhood.

episodes.title: Roshan Singh Sodhi Is Disappointed
episodes.synopsis: Roshan Sodhi learns that all the kids have got selected for the ad shoot except for Gogi. He makes a scene about this issue and makes sure everyone knows that he is disappointed. Later, rest of the kids go for the shoot and become famous.

episodes.title: Gogi Sodhi Is Angry.
episodes.synopsis: While the other kids from the Tapu Sena are at the ad shoot, Gogi is angry and throwing tantrums at his parents for not being selected. His parents, Mr. and Mrs. Roshan are trying their best to convince him. What will happen next?

episodes.title: Daya Is Excited For Tappu
episodes.synopsis: Daya is very excited about her son's ad coming on TV. She is calling everyone she knows and informing them to watch the ad without fail. Later, she comes up with a brilliant plan to watch the ad together with the society members.

episodes.title: Lights, Camera, Power Off!
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham society gathers to watch the ad in which their children have acted. But, just before the ad gets telecasted, the power goes off at Gokuldham society. How will the society members watch the ad now?

episodes.title: Tappu Sena Is Famous
episodes.synopsis: After Tapu Sena acts in an advertisement, people start recognizing them and take autographs. Gogi feels bad for not being a part of this and threatens to run away if he doesn't become famous.

episodes.title: Tappu Has A Plan To Make Gogi Feel Special
episodes.synopsis: Gogi forces Tapu to make him famous. Tapu soon comes up with a mysterious, secret plan to make Gogi appear on TV. But, clearly warns Tapu Sena to not tell this to anyone. Will Gogi become famous?

episodes.title: Gogi Goes Missing
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena comes up with a plan to hide Gogi and spreads fake news that he's missing. How will this plan work? Will Tapu Sena get into trouble?

episodes.title: Mr. And Mrs. Sodhi Are Worried
episodes.synopsis: Now that Tapu Sena has established that Gogi is missing, the parents are freaking out. They look for Gogi in and around the society but, fail to find him. Where will they find Gogi?

episodes.title: Gokuldham Society Visit The Police Station
episodes.synopsis: The members of Gokuldham Society decide to report a complaint to the police. Meanwhile, the Tapu Sena is waiting for Gogi's missing case to telecast on TV.

episodes.title: Tappu Sena In Trouble
episodes.synopsis: Seeing Gogi missing from the flat where Tappu Sena had hidden him in, they are petrified. Muddled, they go to Champaklal for help. Will Gogi be found?

episodes.title: The Police Create A Fuss
episodes.synopsis: When the police learn that Gogi has been found within the society, they are furious. They later explain that it was their duty to inform the police about Gogi being found. Gogi is extremely happy as he gets selected to act in an advertisement.

episodes.title: Taarak Is Sick Of Diet Food
episodes.synopsis: Anjali again presents a plate of freshly cut salad in front of Taarak. She refuses when he asks her to add something to it for it to not taste bland. She later asks Taarak to join a gym, but he denies. Will Anjali make Taarak join the gym?

episodes.title: Stubborn Champaklal
episodes.synopsis: While Jethalal and Bhide argue with each other, Champaklal carries the LPG cylinder himself and leaves for his house. Seeing this, Jethalal runs behind him and takes the cylinder from him.

episodes.title: Babita Decides To Join A Club
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal finds that a rat has nibbled onto his shoes. Left without any option, he has to go out wearing Daya's footwear. Later, Babita gets an offer to become a swimming instructor at a club. Will she take the offer?

episodes.title: Babita Influences The Ladies To Take Swimming Classes
episodes.synopsis: Babita decides to be a swimming coach at the club. She calls the ladies to join the club and learn swimming from her. Will the ladies join the swimming class?

episodes.title: Jethalal Also Wants To Learn Swimming
episodes.synopsis: After learning that the ladies are planning to take swimming classes, Jethalal is eager to learn swimming from Babita. He seeks help from Taarak. Will Taarak help his friend out?

episodes.title: Jethalal Asks Babita To Teach Him Swimming
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal, eager to learn swimming, visits Babita's house and asks her if he can learn swimming. But is there a twist? Will Jethalal be disappointed?

episodes.title: Ladies Have Fun At The Swimming Club
episodes.synopsis: All the women from Gokuldham society gather at the Silver Club to learn swimming. Meanwhile, Jetha decides to learn swimming from Babita at any cost.

episodes.title: Men Want To Swim Too
episodes.synopsis: The men also want to learn swimming and want to learn it along with the women. But, they come up with an idea to go swimming along with their family. They take suggestions from Taarak Mehta. Will the men be content with the decision?

episodes.title: Jethalal As A Sardar
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal somehow finds a friend at the club and sneaks in as a waiter. He not only sneaks in, but he sneaks in as a Sardar. But, he is shocked and frightened by the female guard at the pool. Why is he scared of the female guard?

episodes.title: Jethalal Saves The Day
episodes.synopsis: The entire Gokuldham society meets at the club which startles Jethalal. While Jetha decides to change and join the gang, he notices a man clicking pictures of women in the pool. What will Jethalal do next?

episodes.title: Champak Intervenes Jethalal's Romantic Mood
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is in a romantic mood. He is expressing his love for his wife Daya, asking her for a head massage. But, Champaklal, is interfering their lovely mood. Will Jethalal ignore him or burst out at him?

episodes.title: Jethalal Gets Robbed
episodes.synopsis: When Sundar asks for money, Jethalal leaves his house to give him money. On the way, he meets a stranger who asks him for the police station. When Jethalal starts to answer, he points a knife at him and threatens to kill him.

episodes.title: Tapu's Last Examination
episodes.synopsis: It is Tapu's last examination and he is well prepared. His family wishes him good luck before sending him to the school. Will their blessings be upon him? Will Tapu successfully complete the exam?

episodes.title: Goli Wants A Vacation
episodes.synopsis: Now that the exams are over, Goli wants a vacation. But, Hansraj being a doctor, says that he cannot close his clinic for a long time. How will Goli react?

episodes.title: Operation Christmas Celebration
episodes.synopsis: The elders of Gokuldham gather around to surprise Tapu Sena for Christmas. The men go for Christmas shopping at a mall. Will the kids be surprised?

episodes.title: Guess The Santa
episodes.synopsis: As a surprise to the kids, the elders of Gokuldham society plan on a big Christmas celebration. They all dress up as Santa Claus and ask the kids to guess who their parents are. Tapu then comes up with a great idea.

episodes.title: Nattu Kaka Dances At Gada Electronics
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal comes to his shop in the morning to witness Nattu Kaka dance. When asked why he says he was checking the stereo as they'd received a complaint. Later, Jethalal tries to get the New Year's Party Passes.

episodes.title: All Men's Party
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal gets passes for New Years and all the men decide to go to the party without their family. Will the wives agree?

episodes.title: Sundar Tears Jetha's Party Passes
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is excited about the party for New Year's Eve and talks to Sodhi about it. Just then, Sundar comes to the shop and asks him if he wants passes for a different party. He then breaks Jetha's heart by tearing the passes. What will Jethalal do now?

episodes.title: Sundar's Party
episodes.synopsis: Daya assumes that Jethalal and Sundar will get into a fight because of Sundar's mischief. Later, everyone celebrates New Year's Eve at the society.

episodes.title: Dance Till You Drop
episodes.synopsis: The celebrations continue as Taarak continues to pick chits from the bowl. The dance continues all night and Taarak notices a small glitch. Meanwhile, Jethalal is hoping he could dance with Babita. Will he get a chance?

episodes.title: Jethalal's Dream Come True
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal finally gets a chance to dance and he is delighted to dance with Babita. Will Iyer be happy about it or jealous of it? Watch this episode and find out.

episodes.title: The Ladies Fool Their Husbands
episodes.synopsis: At the after-party, the ladies decide to serve iced tea instead of alcohol to prove it to them that they don't need alcohol to have fun. The next morning, Jethalal feels very lazy, but Daya wants him to be more active.

episodes.title: Popatlal Is Angry
episodes.synopsis: When everyone in the society wakes up happy, Popatlal gets out of the house half-naked and starts screaming for justice. How will everyone react? What does he want justice for?

episodes.title: Popatlal VS Bhide
episodes.synopsis: When Popatlal creates a problem early in the morning, everyone in the society gets disturbed. Popatlal accuses Bhide for his problem. Later, Anjali shares with her friends about the funny incident that happened in her house. What happened with Popatlal?

episodes.title: Taarak Invites Everyone To The Garden Early In the Morning
episodes.synopsis: Taarak has something planned up his sleeves and he invites everyone in the society at the garden. Jethalal is very unhappy about losing sleep and attending a meeting early in the morning. Will he attend the meet?

episodes.title: Gokuldham Laughing Club
episodes.synopsis: Taarak Mehta arranges for a laughing session early in the morning. Jetha gets disappointed because he would have to give up his sleep. Later, Jetha and Champaklal share their memories with Tapu.

episodes.title: Gadas Go To Ahmedabad
episodes.synopsis: Sundarlal sends a letter to the Gada's inviting them to Ahmedabad. While the family is very excited, Jethalal is not even close to being interested. Jethalal comes up with a plan to escape the trip. What is the plan?

episodes.title: Makar Sakranti Preparations

Daya, according to her mother's advice, plans to send Jethalal to perform the task to get rid of the ghost. Watch this episode only on Sony LIV.

episodes.title: Iyer And Popatlal Encounter With The Ghost
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi, Popatlal, and Iyer guard the society at night. But after some time, Sodhi goes to his home. After hearing Popatlal scream, the society members go down to find Popatlal and Iyer. Popatlal and Iyer tell the society members about their encounter with the ghost. What did they see? Bhide explains him everything and after listening, he decides to hold an auction, whoever bids the highest, gets the apartment.
