episodes.synopsis: Jethalal gets romantic with Daya and also sings a song for her. All the members of Gokuldham society are extremely happy with the success of Tapu Sena's Ganpati decoration. To know Tapu Sena's special and unique gift, watch this episode.

episodes.title: The Morning Surprise
episodes.synopsis: Bhide feels bad as Sodhi tells him to leave the job of Secretary of Gokuldham Society. Bhide tells everybody to get ready by 9 AM and also talks about a surprise. What surprise has Bhide planned?

episodes.title: Gokuldham Society's Celebrations
episodes.synopsis: As part of Bhide's surprise to the society members, he takes them all to Siddhivinayak for the puja. Later on, all of them go on a Mumbai darshan in an open bus. Everyone in Gokuldham is happy, and thank Bhide while they enjoy the ride. Back home, they all cut the cake and do Garba. Join the celebration.

episodes.title: Thanking Bhide For The Trip
episodes.synopsis: All the members of Gokuldham Society express their gratitude towards Bhide for organizing an unforgettable trip. Bhide expresses his gratitude towards Madhvi.

episodes.title: Jethalal Loses The Key
episodes.synopsis: All the members of Gokuldham Society are searching for Jethalal's Key. Iyer comes up with an idea. Will Iyer's idea work?

episodes.title: Breaking The Door
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji gets irritated with Jethalal as he lost the key and also gives him an ultimatum to find the key or find the locksmith who can either open or break the door. All efforts have gone in vain. Will Jethalal succeed in finding the key?

episodes.title: Finding The Key
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal Keeps on searching for the key around Gokuldham Society. Meanwhile, Chacha Ji gets worried about Jethalal. Police find them lingering around because of a key, so they send them back to the society.

episodes.title: Celebrating The Joyful Moment
episodes.synopsis: Everyone in the society is chanting to find the key. Taarak, Bhide, and Jethalal enter the society in search of the key and are quite upset. Tapu finds the key in his pocket and everyone joyfully celebrates the moment.

episodes.title: Newspapers Exchange
episodes.synopsis: Early morning Bapuji gets a Bengali newspaper, and it ends up being Babita Ji's newspaper. Jethalal gets excited to go to her house to exchange the papers, but Iyer comes home to return the paper first.

episodes.title: Bagha and Bawri's Mistake
episodes.synopsis: Bagha and Bawri get special sweets to feed the cow, and mistakenly the Sweetbox gets exchanged and remains in Gada Electronics. Jethalal comes and eats a couple of sweets. When Bagha and Bawri explain this to Jethalal, he gets really angry.

episodes.title: Surprise For Bapuji
episodes.synopsis: All the Women from Gokuldham society gather and practice Garba for Navratri. Jethalal calls Daya saying there's a surprise for Bapuji, and Bapuji accidentally hears them talking and gets curious.

episodes.title: Bapuji's Plan
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal gets to know that Bapuji knew about the surprise. Jethalal makes another plan and makes sure it's a secret. Bapuji makes Tapu asks about the surprise. Will Babuji be able to figure out Jethalal's surprise?

episodes.title: Bapuji Gets Worried
episodes.synopsis: Bhide is helping Jethalal to Surprise Bapuji. Meanwhile, Bapuji waits all night to know the surprise. Watch the episode to find out what the surprise is.

episodes.title: The Big Surprise
episodes.synopsis: 100s of cyclists arrive in Gokuldham society who goes to Temple every year by cycling. This time they will start their journey with a green flag by Bapuji. Everyone in the society gets happy and excited.

episodes.title: Discussing About The Competition
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji gets happy with the surprise and gives ancestors belonging. Jethalal and the family members get really happy, Later all women gather to discuss the yearly competition.

episodes.title: Navratri Celebrations
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and Tapu Sena get the tattoo artists to Gokuldham society for the Navratri celebration. Everyone starts the preparations for Navratri.

episodes.title: Navratri Night
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal calls his shop and Bawri picks up the call. Jethalal starts ranting on Bagha, and then Daya takes the phone to invites Bhaga and Bawri for the Garba night. Jethalal gets a special tattoo and is excited about it.

episodes.title: Special Guests Arrive
episodes.synopsis: Special guests arrive in Gokuldham society, and the Garba night begins where everyone enjoys and cherishes the moment.

episodes.title: Jethalal Completes His Work
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal tends to forget things at home. When Bapuji lost a button of his kurta, he asks Jethalal for help. Jethalal struggles to find the thread and needle and even struggles to complete his work. Bapuji gets happy thinking Jethalal completed the work.

episodes.title: Daya's Colorful plan
episodes.synopsis: Daya is singing a song and asks Jethalal to decode it. Later, she says that they should color their house for this Deepawali. Meanwhile, Bhide fights with his wife regarding the food.

episodes.title: Jethalal's Day Off
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal takes a day off and gets a call from Daya. She informs him that someone has come home and is waiting for him. Later, when Jethalal is sleeping, Daya disguised as a Terrorist, wakes him up, and he gets astonished.

episodes.title: Jethalal Cleans His House
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is forced to clean the house and is cursing in front of Bapuji. Jethalal tries to make a scene to make them stop his work but ends up making a mess.

episodes.title: The Cleaning Situation
episodes.synopsis: Babita forces Iyer to clean the house, and Iyer is sad about it. He tries to make a scene to get rid of the work. Meanwhile, there is a similar situation in everyone's home.

episodes.title: The Big Mistake
episodes.synopsis: All the Men from Gokuldham society are fed up with the cleaning work. Everyone gathers while taking the trash out and ends up chit-chatting amongst each other.

episodes.title: Making A Mess
episodes.synopsis: All the Men threw the trash in the Society. It ends up lingering around and the society looks like a mess. Later, they realize that it is their own mistake.

episodes.title: Taking The initiative
episodes.synopsis: When all the members of the society realize it's their own mistake because of which the society looks like a mess. They take up the initiative to clean the surrounding.

episodes.title: Diwali Meeting
episodes.synopsis: Daya makes delicious food, which makes Jethalal happy. Daya then requests to arrange the Diwali meeting at their place. Jethalal agrees and contacts Bhide. what happens in the meeting? Watch the episode to find out.

episodes.title: Bhide Calls Shahrukh Khan
episodes.synopsis: Bhide had agreed to get Shahrukh Khan for the Diwali celebrations. Popatlal helps Bhide in finding the number. When they get the number, Bhide calls Shahrukh Khan, and he agrees to come.

episodes.title: Shahrukh Khan Cancels The Plan
episodes.synopsis: Celebrations begin when Shahrukh Khan agrees to come to Gokuldham society to celebrate Diwali. When Shahrukh Khan calls Jethalal, Jethalal mistakes him with someone else and embarrasses him. Then Shahrukh Khan calls up Bhide and says he is not coming to Gokuldham Society.

episodes.title: Jethalal's Efforts
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal gets real upset when he gets to know he is the reason behind Shahrukh Khans canceling the plan. Jethalal promises himself he will do anything to get Shahrukh Khan to the Society.

episodes.title: Duplicate Shahrukh Khan
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal tries real hard to get Shahrukh Khan for the celebrations. Tapu gives the best advice to get in touch with Shahrukh Khan through Deepika Padukone. But Jethalal convinces Duplicate Shahrukh Khan to come.

episodes.title: Shahrukh Khan's Entry
episodes.synopsis: On the Occasion of Diwali, everyone is excited to see Shahrukh Khan. When he arrives, Jethalal thinks of him as the duplicate and taunts him. Shahrukh gets angry with Jethalal. Jethalal then realizes he is the real Shahrukh Khan.

episodes.title: Diwali With Happy New Year Cast
episodes.synopsis: Happy New Year cast is in Gokuldham Society celebrating Diwali, and Shahrukh Khan is still angry with Jethalal and is taunting him. Jethalal is trying hard to seek an apology. Everyone requests Shahrukh Khan to forgive Jethalal. Will Shahrukh Khan forgive Jethalal?

episodes.title: Diwali Celebrations
episodes.synopsis: Shahrukh Khan, Deepika Padukone, Sonu Sood, Boman Irani, and Vivaan Shah celebrates Diwali at Gokuldhham Society. Shahrukh Khan forgives Jethalal, and Everyone enjoys the day.

episodes.title: Bad Day For Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji appreciates Jethalal for waking up early. Later, Bapuji realizes it's the Clock which is slow. Bapuji then taunts Jethalal to go to the shop, While Jethalal is going to the shop, Iyer also taunts him.

episodes.title: Popatlal's Issue
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal's mobile gets damaged and he calls up Bagha. Bagha helps Popatlal resolve the situation through call. Bagha makes him throw the phone from the balcony.

episodes.title: Popatlal Wants A New Phone
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal wants a new phone, and he goes to Gada Electronics. Jethalal creates a funny environment with Popatlal while negotiating.

episodes.title: Popatlal Meets A Girl
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal meets a girl at the bus stand and she is a big fan of his work. Both travel in Auto together and Popatlal gets really happy after talking with her. Popatlal then realizes he bought the dummy phone from Jethalal.

episodes.title: Jetha, The Prankster
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal decides to pull a prank on all his friends using Popatlal's phone. He sends fake messages to the wives of all his friends, telling them some terrible lies about their husbands. How will the ladies react to such messages? Check out in this hilarious episode to know.

episodes.title: The Confrontation
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal's prank has caused some severe damage to Taarak and others. The ladies have started confronting their husbands based on Jethalal's fake messages. With their wives suspicious about them, Taarak and others decide to confront Popatlal. What will Popatlal do now? Check out in this episode.

episodes.title: The Prank Backfires!
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal's prank backfires on him when Popatlal and others call the police in Gokuldham to catch the thief who has stolen the phone. Jethalal is scared as everyone is now suspicious of him being the thief. What will Jethalal do now? Check out in this episode.

episodes.title: Bagha's Gift For Bawri
episodes.synopsis: Bagha offers a gift to Bawri on the occasion of their first relationship anniversary. Bagha recalls how they met each other. Bawri asks Bagha for some quality time without any disturbance but Bagha tells her that he has work and can't skip without taking permission from Jethalal. Will Bagha and Bawri spend some quality time?

episodes.title: Jethalal Scolds Bagha
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal scolds Bagha. He tells him that he can't celebrate his first meet anniversary with Bawri by leaving his work. Jethalal strictly warns Bawri if she pays an unwanted visit without his permission in the shop, he will take action against him. Will Bagha be able to celebrate his first meet ceremony?

episodes.title: Bagha Takes Up Responsibility
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is shocked after learning from Mr. Arora that Bagha had done an appreciable job after fixing the technical issue of air condition and recommended the proper service towards the customer requirements. Jethalal gets excited after Mr. Arora decides to give a huge order of Air conditioners for his new restaurant.

episodes.title: Daya's Hard Work
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is surprised after learning that Daya removed the oil stains from Jethalal's shirt. Daya elaborates on the incident to him that how she took an idea from her mother and removes stains in a single wash.

episodes.title: Tapu Sena's Excitement
episodes.synopsis: Tappu Sena gets excited to write an essay about their mothers for homework. Sonu and the team decide to get an idea from the parents to impress the teachers. Later, Bhide and Madhavi are surprised after learning about the topic. Bhide narrates the importance of a mother in our life.

episodes.title: Tapu Starts Studying
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is shocked after learning from Bapuji that Tapu is studying since morning without creating any havoc. Bapuji and Jethalal go to Tapu's room to check on him. Jethalal is surprised looking at Tapu doing his homework and decides to capture a memorable moment in his life.

episodes.title: Award For Valuable Contribution
episodes.synopsis: Daya and the family members are shocked after learning from Sunder that his mother has been awarded by the SamajRatna trophy for her valuable contribution in the society. Sunder also informed the award ceremony will be held in the Mumbai and she will come to Mumbai for receiving the award.

episodes.title: Mother's Arrival
episodes.synopsis: Daya's mother is receiving an award, and everyone is excited about her arrival. Gada Family cleans the whole house and awaits for Mother's arrival.

episodes.title: Welcome Preparation
episodes.synopsis: Daya and the family members are excited to welcome Daya's mother in the society for the achievement of her social work. The society members eagerly want to meet the mother in law of Jethalal and congratulate her for her achievements.

episodes.title: Tappu Sena's Welcome Preparation
episodes.synopsis: Daya insists Jethalal to make a reminder call to Nattu kaka and Bagha for bringing a huge garland for Daya's mother. Tapu Sena calls the band party for welcoming his grandmother into the society. Watch the episode to find out more

episodes.title: Recieving Daya's Mother
episodes.synopsis: The society members are shocked after seeing the garland. Sodhi decides that he will drop the Gada family at the railway station to receive Daya's mother. Abdul informed Bhide that he has forgotten to asks the name of Daya's Mother. Will the Gada family successfully receive Daya's mother?

episodes.title: Jethalal Makes A Mistake
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and family have come to receive Daya's mother at the railway station. Daya and family are tensed that Sunder and his friends did not reach the railway station along with them. Jethalal goofs up at recognizing his mother in law. He offers the garland on another lady.

episodes.title: Jethalal Reaches At The Wrong Venue
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and the family have reached the wrong venue because of miscommunication. Later, Sodhi and the Gada family reaches the correct venue. After reaching the venue, Daya feels proud to see her mother's name on the hoarding with respect. Will Daya meet her Mother?

episodes.title: Function Day
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is scared to go on the stage. Finally, Daya convinces Jethalal to go further and express his relationship with his mother in law. The society members decorate the society to welcome Daya's mother to honor her achievement. Later, Champaklal praises the work of Daya's mother and her sacrifices towards the society and people.

episodes.title: Jethalal's Trouble
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal calls his father Champaklal from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. The opposite happens, and the grandfather joins hands with the grandson to make life a roller coaster troublesome ride for Jethalal.

episodes.title: Jethalal's Confusion
episodes.synopsis: A slight confusion between Jethalal and his wife at an event party cause huge havoc. someone is trying to carve their way in.

episodes.title: Exposing The Imposter
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal believes that the Baa that came to the event is not the actual Baa but an imposter who is after the money. He makes a plan to expose the imposter.

episodes.title: Sundar Disguised As Mother
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal finds out that it was Sundar, who was disguised as his own mother during the entire event. Jethalal believes that Sundar did all this to get the money from the event. Watch the episode to find out why was Sundar Disguised as his mother?

episodes.title: Game Of Statue And Release
episodes.synopsis: A game of statue and release has taken over Gokuldhan society. Everyone is just so much into this little kid's game.

episodes.title: Stopping The Game
episodes.synopsis: The statue game is still going on, and Jethalal is just fed up with this game. While this game seems fun, but everyone just needs to stop.

episodes.title: Game Has Taken A Turn
episodes.synopsis: The statue game has taken a toll on the residents of Gokuldham society. Jethalal has found an open window to irritate his neighbors. Watch the episode to find out.

episodes.title: Jethalal's Revenge
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal uses all his energy and intelligence to disturb Iyer. Nice way to take revenge. Watch the episode to find out.

episodes.title: Bhide Gets Angry
episodes.synopsis: Bhide bursts on Iyer after he has broken an imported vase by throwing a ball in his house and decides to take revenge. Watch this episode to find out what happens next.

episodes.title: Bagha And Bawri Get Busted
episodes.synopsis: Bagha and Bawri get busted by the police. They are caught red-handed in the garden while spending quality time with each other. Bagha tries to clear the misconceptions of Inspector Chalu Pande that they were only spending quality time in the garden, and not doing anything inappropriate. Watch the full episode to find out what happens next.

episodes.title: Bagha and Bawri's Happiness
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji, Jethalal, and Daya tell Bawri and Bagha that they will get them married as soon as possible. Bawri and Bagha are happy with the decision.

episodes.title: Bapuji Plays A Prank
episodes.synopsis: Early in the morning, Jethalal and Bhide fight for water. Daya says she is keeping fast for everyone's health, and Bapuji suggests everyone in the house will keep the fast.

episodes.title: Daya's Misconception
episodes.synopsis: Tappu teaches Rap to Daya, and they do Garba and Rap at the same time. Later, When Daya leaves some work unfinished, Bapuji finishes it and Daya gets astonished.

episodes.title: Jethalal Gets Special Dish
episodes.synopsis: Daya calls and asks Jethalal for his plans. He tells her that he is going out to eat. Daya suggests he should not eat outside as she is preparing some special dishes.

episodes.title: Ekta's Marriage Shopping
episodes.synopsis: All the Women from Gokuldham society go to shopping for Ekta's marriage. Ekta takes too long to decide which saree she wants to buy. Meanwhile, Jethalal is stopping himself from eating outside so that he can have Daya's special dishes.

episodes.title: Jethalal Gets Upset
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is excited to eat delicious food at home, which is prepared by Daya. Jethalal decides to invite Mehta for the dinner to get a change from the food diet. Later, Jethalal gets to know after reaching home that Daya and the society ladies went shopping for the marriage of Anjali's Sister.

episodes.title: Madhavi Loses Her Purse
episodes.synopsis: Madhavi is shocked after she lost her purse in the shop while shopping. Madhavi and the ladies start searching in the shop, but they fail. Later, Madhavi informs everyone that she carried a huge amount of cash and an expensive cellphone. Will Madhavi and ladies succeed in finding purse?

episodes.title: Daya Is Shocked
episodes.synopsis: Daya is shocked after seeing the food which is prepared by Champaklal. Later, Champaklal tells her that he is not angry with her for coming late from shopping. Daya narrates the incident about how she faces trouble while shopping for Ekta's marriage. Daya asks for an apology from everyone about her irresponsibility.

episodes.title: Jethalal Surprises Daya
episodes.synopsis: Jehtalal surprise Daya with a small gift after Champaklal teaches Jethalal a lesson about respecting your wife.

episodes.title: Constrained By The Wives
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal, Taarak, Sodhi, and Bhide are feeling constrained by their wives. The friends decide to party but feel their wives will never allow that to happen. Will Jethalal and Taarak be able to find a way out?

episodes.title: Secret Meeting
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal, Taarak, Sodhi, and Bhide conduct a secret meeting to discuss where they'll party. Popatlal's house is chosen to be the ideal location to organize the party

episodes.title: Jethalal Calls For A Meeting
episodes.synopsis: All the Men from the society are planning for the secret party and are hoping for it to be successful. Jethalal calls for a meeting where he narrates that it is hard to party at this point.

episodes.title: The Party Preparation
episodes.synopsis: Bhide is in a mess after Sodhi puts their plan in jeopardy by speaking of their party in front of Champaklal. On the other hand, Tapu, who has been poking Bhide for a good DJ, now he doesn't want one. What will happen this evening?

episodes.title: Popatlal Cancels The Party
episodes.synopsis: Everyone celebrates the new year party in Gokuldhaam society and enjoy the dance performances. Jethalal spills soft drink on Popatlal and Popatlal creates havoc.

episodes.title: Convincing Popatlal
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal cancels the secret party as he is angry. Sodhi throws Popatlal out of his own house. They start the party and then someone rings the bell. What will happen next? Keep watching!

episodes.title: Champaklal Gets Drunk
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal drinks half a bottle of alcohol and gets drunk. Everyone gets tensed about him. Meanwhile, Champaklal under the influence of alcohol is enjoying himself. All the wives are angry about the secret party they were having. What will happen next?

episodes.title: Champaklal Intoxicated
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal is still intoxicated and the men of Gokuldham are wondering how to sober him down. On the other hand, they are also facing problems from their wives. What will the men of Gokuldham do?

episodes.title: Champaklal Goes On A Ride
episodes.synopsis: After Champaklal gets intoxicated, he takes Sodhi's car and goes on a ride leaving all the men in a tense situation. Will they be able to stop Champaklal in time?

episodes.title: Police Chases Champaklal
episodes.synopsis: After Champaklal is stopped at a police check post, he flees from there, and now along with the men gang, even the cops are chasing Champaklal. How will this story take a twist? Keep watching Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah!

episodes.title: Chalu Pandey Reaches Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: After the female gang gets to know about Champaklal getting intoxicated, they want to know about the truth, and they will force it out of them. Inspector Chalu Pandey is at Gokuldhaam society to arrest Champaklal. Will Champaklal get arrested?

episodes.title: Champaklal's Blessing
episodes.synopsis: After the air gets cleared between the men and women of Gokuldham society, everyone is happy. Jethalal makes a promise to only eat once he returns from the temple barefoot and takes Champaklal's blessing.

episodes.title: Flying Kites
episodes.synopsis: After all the hard work to get in good books of everyone. Jethalal seeks Champaklal's blessing and says he will do anything for their happiness. Later, everyone celebrates the season of kites.

episodes.title: Madhavi's Excitment
episodes.synopsis: Madhavi is excited that she got a huge order of the pickle for the girl's hostel. Bhide jumps after sitting on the sofa as he gets hurt from the needle, which was stabbed by Madhavi while sewing. Watch this episode to find out more.

episodes.title: Babita Scarf
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and Sodhi are fighting each other as they want to be the one returning Babita's scarf. Iyer snatches the scarf from Jethalal, and then he snatches it back in front of the society members and declares himself as the winner of the challenge. But then, Popatlala enters and distracts everyone from the challenge. Watch the episode to find out what happens next.

episodes.title: Bhide and Madhavi's Happiness
episodes.synopsis: After getting money, Madhavi insists Bhide that she wants to buy a bike for him to reduce his troubles, but he strongly opposes it. Instead of buying a bike, he wants to gift a golden necklace to Madhavi. Bhide decides to take the valuable suggestions from the society members on it.

episodes.title: Bhide's Investment
episodes.synopsis: Bhide is worried as he has no idea how to invest money properly. Bhide decides that he will consult with Taarak and society members to gain knowledge about money investment. Will Bhide succeed to get an idea for investing the money?

episodes.title: Champaklal's Miseries
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal is restless after getting a call from his friend Ramji who wants one lakh rupees within a short period of time without informing his family members. Jethalal asks his father about his trouble, but he denies telling him. Later, Champaklal finds an eligible person who can arrange money in a short time. Will Chamapaklal be able to arrange the money?

episodes.title: Helping Champaklal
episodes.synopsis: Bhide is in a dilemma whether he should lend money to Champaklal or not. Champaklal promises Bhide that once the work is done he will tell him the reason for the loan. Will Bhide lend money to Champaklal?

episodes.title: Champaklal Goes On A Ride
episodes.synopsis: Bhide is confused regarding helping Champaklal. Bhide gives reasons to Champaklal stating that he will give the money later. Champaklal keeps troubling Bhide regarding the same.

episodes.title: Jethalal Gets Angry
episodes.synopsis: Bhide is ignoring Champaklal and trying ways to get rid of the problem. Meanwhile, Jethalals loses a big deal because of Bhide. Jethalal gets angry on Bhide and goes to question him.

episodes.title: Chachaji Gets the Money
episodes.synopsis: Chacha Ji takes 1Lakh rupees from Bhide. What is it for? Why is the amount so high? Watch the episode to know more.

episodes.title: Chachaji Goes Missing
episodes.synopsis: Chachaji goes missing and everybody reaches the police station to seek Chalu Pandey's help. They figure out that he has gone missing after taking one lakh rupees from Bhide. Later, Chachaji comes back with a brand new scooter for Bhide, and Madhavi explains to everybody her plan to buy the scooter for Bhide with the help of Chachaji as he would only listen to him in the society.

episodes.title: Bhide's New Bike
episodes.synopsis: Bhide buys a new Bike and is very happy. Bhide thanks Jethalal, Madhvi, and Champak chacha. Everyone rides the bike and enjoys the moment.

episodes.title: Bhide's Dream
episodes.synopsis: Bhide watches his new bike getting stolen and realizes it's a dream. Because of the dream, he gets the bike near his house and parks it.

episodes.title: Bhide's Bike Gets Scratched
episodes.synopsis: Abdul sees that Bhide's new bike got scratches. All the men gather near the bike and call Bhide. Bhide is shocked to see the same.

episodes.title: Get Together Plan
episodes.synopsis: All the women from Gokuldham enter Bhide's house. Bhide surprisingly asks them about their plan. They tell him that they want to have a Valentine party this year, and he agrees.

episodes.title: Storytelling
episodes.synopsis: All the women from Gokuldham are having a kitty party. Daya encourages everyone to showcase their skills and ask about their love stories.

episodes.title: Bagha's Poetry
episodes.synopsis: When officers come to visit Gada electronics and asks for a license, Jethalal gives them the license, but it is the poetry written by Bagha. Jethalal gets angry at Bagha.

episodes.title: Wives Expectations
episodes.synopsis: When all the women heard Anjali's story, they tend to seek the same from their husbands. All the Wives expect their husbands to write poetry for them.

episodes.title: Taarak's Motivation
episodes.synopsis: When all the women expect their husbands to write poetry. All the men gather and go to Taarak. They tell him to write poetry for them.

episodes.title: Writing Poem
episodes.synopsis: Taking the motivation from Taarak Mehta, all the men from Gokuldham tries to write poetry for their wives. Watch the episode to see what happens next.

episodes.title: Competition Planning
episodes.synopsis: Taarak takes a class for all the men to teach them how to write poetry. Meanwhile, Wives decide to organize a competition for the Men.

episodes.title: Poetry Competition
episodes.synopsis: It's the competition day where all the men are prepared to impress their wives. All the wives are excited to see who will be the best.

episodes.title: Where Is Iyer?
episodes.synopsis: Dr. Hathi's poetry reading and Sodhi's entertaining performance are to be followed by Iyer's act. But where is he? Right before the performance, Iyer is not to be found anywhere. Find out what the mystery is all about in this episode.

episodes.title: Iyer Recieves The Award
episodes.synopsis: Iyer hides from everyone because he has nothing written for Babita. Babita taunts him regarding the same and gives him the worst husband award. Later, Iyer comes up with the best poetry.

episodes.title: Jethalal's Valentine
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal enters the stage to tell his poetry, and the paper catches fire. Before Iyer starts to taunt Jethalal, he agrees and recites his poetry and impresses Daya.

episodes.title: Madhvi's Plan
episodes.synopsis: The next day after valentine is peaceful and all the wives are happy with their husband's poetry. Madhvi tries to convince Bhide to go for a ride.

episodes.title: Ganesh Acharya's Entry
episodes.synopsis: Daya gets excited and goes to Dr. Hathi to tell him about his brother, who was lost in childhood will be coming home today. Ganesh Acharya is the brother. Ganesh Acharya explains to everyone that Dr. Hathi is not his brother and his new movie is related to the brothers.

episodes.title: Jethalal's Dinner Menu
episodes.synopsis: Daya asks Jethalal about his favorite food that she will prepare for the dinner. Jethalal suggests one by one, but she denies to accept by giving some unusual reasons. Finally, Daya tells that she has already fixed a menu for dinner. Jethalal gets furious after he gets to know that the menu has already been fixed.

episodes.title: Bagha's Marriage Plan
episodes.synopsis: Bagha reaches the house to bring the lunchbox for Jethalal and Nattu kaka. Bagha request Daya to take some action to fix his marriage with Bawri soon. Later, Daya confirmes that she will start to find the auspicious day for their marriage.

episodes.title: Jethalal's Lunch Box
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal sends Bagha home to get his lunch box. Bagha acts weird regarding the lunch box. Jethalal gets angry and fights to know the truth.

episodes.title: Jethalal Gets Furious
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal gets angry and leaves the shop to go back home for food. Daya also reaches Gada electronics to meet Jethalal. Meanwhile, Jethalal has reached home and is waiting for Daya to serve him food.

episodes.title: Jethalal Skips His Meal
episodes.synopsis: Chamklal's friends are appreciating Daya's specialty food. Jethalal misses the delicious food because of their surprise visit. Later, Daya forces Jethalal that she will cook food again, but he refuses to do it.

episodes.title: Bhide's Seek Help
episodes.synopsis: Bhide is irritating Jethalal by asking the same question about his bike registration number. Bhide doesn't want to miss an auspicious time for the rituals and he doesn't want to perform them until he gets the bike's registration. Meanwhile, Jethalal gets frustrated and denies to help him. Will Bhide get the registration number before missing the auspicious time?

episodes.title: Jethalal Gets Irritated
episodes.synopsis: Bhide forces Jethalal to use his influence to get the registration number for his Bike. Jethalal talks to Bharat to get a confirmation about the registration number. Later, Bhide is shocked after learning that his uncle is severely injured after he fell from the staircase.

episodes.title: Bhide's Uncle Gets Hospitalized
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and Madhavi hurriedly reach uncle's house after learning that he is severely injured. Bhide insists uncle to get admitted to the hospital for better treatment. Later, Bhide is shocked after seeing he is not injured. Uncle reveals that he had fixed a bet with her aunt about the arrival of Bhide and Madhavi.

episodes.title: Garba Practice
episodes.synopsis: Everyone gathers and practice Garba dance in society. Jethalal is wearing a helmet and dancing making it a comic scene.

episodes.title: Daya and Jethalal's Fight
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and Madhvi go on a ride after registration of the bike. When Taarak and Popatlal come home and Jethalal asks Daya to get him masala tea. Daya strictly denies to give him tea because of his wife.

episodes.title: Popatlal Gets Angry
episodes.synopsis: When planning for the Holi celebrations, Popatlal gets angry with Jethalal and goes home. Later, Daya explains to Jethalal and ask him to apologize.

episodes.title: Sundar's Holi Plan
episodes.synopsis: On the occasion of Holi, when everyone is set to play, someone locks everyone's door. When Abdul comes to help them, Abdul gets a strange message saying he should not help anyone from Gokuldham society.

episodes.title: Daya Hides Jethalal's Wallet
episodes.synopsis: Daya hides the wallet of Jethalal to trouble him. Daya is shocked after seeing Jethalal has stored a family photo in his wallet. After Jethalal leaves for the work, Popatlal reaches the Gada's house to inform about his nightmare to Daya and ask for a solution.

episodes.title: Jethalal Gets Huge Order?
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal gets excited after receiving a call from Ajay Mallya. He has invited Jethalal to his office for a huge order of electronics. Will Jethalal get a huge order and improve the profit margin of the business?

episodes.title: Madhavi Gets A Huge Order
episodes.synopsis: Madhavi is excited that she has got a huge order of pickle for the girl's hostel. Bhide jumps after sitting on the sofa and gets hurts from the needle which was kept by Madhavi while sewing. Jethalal taunts Bhide that he has woken up early morning for doing his personal work.

episodes.title: Jethalal Scolds Bawri
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal scolds Bagha. He tells him that he can't celebrate his first meet anniversary with Bawri by leaving his work. Jethalal strictly warns Bawri if she pays an unwanted visit without his permission in the shop, he will take action against him. Will Bagha be able to celebrate his first meet ceremony?

episodes.title: Jethalal Invites Bawri
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal scolds Bagha. He tells him that he can't celebrate his first meet anniversary with Bawri by leaving his work. Jethalal strictly warns Bawri if she pays an unwanted visit without his permission in the shop, he will take action against him. Will Bagha be able to celebrate his first meet ceremony?

episodes.title: Bawri's Lies
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal had thought Bawri is lucky for his shop but eventually, Bawri has put Jethalal in trouble. Jethalal is furious at Bawri and decides to take action.

episodes.title: Anjali's Writing
episodes.synopsis: Anjali shares that she wants to write a script, but she is not able to decide a subject for it. Later, Taarak tells her to choose a decent subject that she feels comfortable writing about. What will Anjali decide her subject for the script?

episodes.title: Dr. Hathi's Awareness Programme
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and Dr. Hathi decide to spread awareness about the diseases in the society members about health issues. Later, Dr. Hathi tells Bhide about the disease symptoms and their causes.

episodes.title: The Unknown Baby
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and family members are shocked after seeing that Daya got a small baby from the temple road. After enquiring, Daya narrates the incident which happened in the temple with the family members. Will Daya and the members find the existence of an unknown baby?

episodes.title: Bhide Scolds Abdul
episodes.synopsis: Bhide scolds Abdul that he found his bike beside the road instead of society compound. Abdul tells Bhide that he is unaware of it. Later, Dr. Hathi suggests Bhide to ask Madhavi about it. Will Bhide find the exact reason for his concern?

episodes.title: Bhide Gets Worried
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and Abdul tied a chain to the scooter to prevent it from theft. Bhide is tensed that the ladies did not return home since morning. Later, Bhide is trying to call Madhavi to know about her whereabouts, but she deliberately avoids receiving his call.

episodes.title: Bhide's Bike Gets Stolen
episodes.synopsis: The men from the Gokuldham society are shocked that the ladies did not pick up the call. The ladies file a complaint at the police station about the bike. The society members are tensed that the ladies did not receive a call even after consistently trying it.

episodes.title: Chalu Pandey Taking Actions
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and the society members are shocked after learning that Madhavi has filed a complaint of a bike stolen from the market before. Inspector Chalu Pande assures Bhide that the search team is consistently tracing the location of his bike and will find it soon. Will Police succeed to trace the location of the bike?

episodes.title: Jethalal Lies About Dieting
episodes.synopsis: Sonu prepares a dish and Jethalal asks Sonu to get some of it to his house. Iyer comes to impress Babita, Jethalal lies about dieting and doesn't get to eat the dish prepared by Sonu. Stay tuned for the daily dose of laughter!

episodes.title: Popatlal And The Vegetable Vendor
episodes.synopsis: Frustrated by his single life, Popatlal comes up with an idea and shares it with the vegetable vendor, Sunita, as a business prospect for her. He asks her to find a suitable girl for him to get married to. Will Sunita accept the offer. Stay tuned

episodes.title: Babita's Dinner Offer
episodes.synopsis: Daya is at the hospital awaiting the good news. Jethalal and Champaklal are planning for dinner. Babita pays a surprise visit and offers them dinner.

episodes.title: Champaklal Scolds Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal awaits the arrival of Daya. Champaklal lashes out at Jethalal for being irresponsible. Popatlal surprises Bhide by stating that he is getting married.

episodes.title: Shock Awaits Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Daya finally returns to her home but a shock awaits Jethalal. Daya is holding a baby in her hands, Jethalal and Champaklal are left shocked. Watch the episode to find out more.

episodes.title: Taking Care Of Baby
episodes.synopsis: The society members are helping Daya take care of the baby. Meanwhile, Daya and Jethalal are on the way to the temple with Roshan Sodhi.

episodes.title: Difficulties With The Baby
episodes.synopsis: Daya and Jethalal are busy taking care of Kushi. Jethalal is finding it difficult to cope with the stress of having to take care of a baby.

episodes.title: Thanking Kushi
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham society members are busy tracing Kushi's parents. Kushi, who has become a favorite of the society members. They have found happiness thanks to Kushi.

episodes.title: Finding Kushi's Parents
episodes.synopsis: People rush into Gokuldham society saying, Kushi is their baby and they want Kushi back. People of Gokuldham society are speechless.

episodes.title: Confusing Situation
episodes.synopsis: Daya and Jethalal are determined to find Kushi's parents. The society members are still clueless about the identity of Kushi's parents. Will Daya be able to find Kushi's parents?

episodes.title: Finding Information About Kushi
episodes.synopsis: After the discussion has been at length in terms of what has to be done to find Khushi's parents. The people of Gokuldham have decided to go to the police station and with the help of a reporter, that is Popatlal, they intend to find out information about Khushi's parents.

episodes.title: Cross-Questioning Inspector Pandey
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal and Sodhi reach the police station to inquire about the missing person report in Inspector Pandey's station, where Popatlal himself gets into cross-questioning with Inspector Pandey.

episodes.title: Playing It Smart
episodes.synopsis: All the people from Gokuldham society act smart and send Popatlal to the police station to know more about missing complaints.

episodes.title: Happy By Kushi's Arrival
episodes.synopsis: All the people from Gokuldham society are excited and are giving lots of love to baby Kushi. Tapu Sena takes Kushi to the garden to play, dance and sing.

episodes.title: Kushi's Trip Jethalal's Shop
episodes.synopsis: Kushi is welcomed by the society members to their respective houses. Then, Kushi makes a trip to Gada Electronics and meets Baga and Nattu Kaka.

episodes.title: Jethalal Complains To Daya
episodes.synopsis: Kushi is the center of Daya and Jethalal's life at the moment. The couple has devoted their time and energy to take care of Kushi. Jethalal complains to Daya that she doesn't give him enough time these days.

episodes.title: Kushi Goes Missing
episodes.synopsis: Khushi goes missing and everyone is looking for her. Finally, Khushi was with Sonu in the clubhouse which gives everyone a sigh of relief. Jethalal thinks of adopting Khushi.

episodes.title: Kushi's Parents
episodes.synopsis: A couple comes and claims that they are Khushi's parents and tell them that Khushi got abducted. Daya is emotional about the departure of Khushi. Are they her parents? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.title: Fake Parents
episodes.synopsis: Strangers come to Gokuldham society disguised as Kushi's parents asking for the Baby. Everyone from Gokuldham gets sentimental. Later, the truth gets revealed.

episodes.title: Kushi's Mother
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldhaam members get to know that Khushi's mother had left Khushi in the temple because of severe difficulties in life. Daya decides to find her mother and tries to help her.

episodes.title: Tracking Kushi's Mother
episodes.synopsis: Daya, Champaklal, Bhide, Sodhi, and Popatlal track down Baby Khushi's address from the temple and the hospital. All members of Gokuldham Society get together to plan for action. Sodhi is tensed to think of an ingenious plan.

episodes.title: Finding The Reason
episodes.synopsis: The members of Gokuldham society gather in Sodhi's house and decide on sending one member in disguise to Baby Khushi's home to know the reason behind her mother's helplessness.

episodes.title: Khushi's Mother Surbhi
episodes.synopsis: The kids of Gokuldham work on a special gift for Khushi's mother, Surbhi. Baga is asked to deliver the gift. Surbhi Comes to Gokuldham and explains the situation at her home to the members of the society.

episodes.title: Surbhi's Condition
episodes.synopsis: The members of Gokuldham society come up with a plan to bring Surbhi's family to Gokuldham. They tell her family that Surbhi's child was a boy. But Surbhi has a condition.

episodes.title: Surbhi's Story
episodes.synopsis: Surbhi has kept a condition that if her husband wants to stay with his son and Surbhi then he has to leave his parents. Surbhi's husband threatens Surbhi that he will go to the police but Surbhi doesn't budge. All Gokuldhaam members are with Surbhi. What will happen next?

episodes.title: Solving Surbi's Problem
episodes.synopsis: Shekhar and his parents realize their mistake and apologize to Surbhi and all Gokuldham members. Through Rita, Gokuldham members express their love and awareness for females.

episodes.title: Daya Gets Sad
episodes.synopsis: Daya thinks about Khushi and feels sad. Jethalal tries to explain Daya that whatever happened, has happened for good.

episodes.title: Thought Of The Day
episodes.synopsis: There is a discussion about what thought of the day should be written on the board. Everyone gives a try but all their attempts fail.

episodes.title: Jethalal Gets Seminar Invitation
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is invited for a seminar in Thiruvananthapuram and he is getting ready for it. Everyone is enthusiastically helping him. Watch this episode to find out more.

episodes.title: Important Guest
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is off to attend a seminar and Daya gets good news. A very important guest is about to arrive in Gokuldham society to meet Khushi.

episodes.title: Deepika Padukone's Entrance
episodes.synopsis: Deepika Padukone arrives at Gokuldham society and meets Daya. Later, Daya introduces Deepika to Kushi. Watch the full episode to find out more.

episodes.title: Newspaper Thief
episodes.synopsis: Abdul and Bhide find out that someone is stealing their daily newspaper from the stand exactly in the afternoons. They make a plan to find out who could have done it.

episodes.title: Advertisment In Marriage Bureau
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and Popatlal have realized their misdeed and asks for an apology by insisting Champaklal. Popatlal reveals the truth for the sake of his marriage proposal. Further, he has given an advertisement in the marriage bureau looking for a girl.

episodes.title: Vishwajeet's Secret
episodes.synopsis: Vishwajeet is requesting Champaklal not to reveal the secret about the marriage of Popatlal because he wants to surprise him. Popatlal overhears the conversation and then forces them to know it but nobody reveals him the secret.

episodes.title: Troublesome Ride For Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: The great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu isn't enough. The opposite happens and the grandfather joins hands with the grandson to make life a roller coaster troublesome ride for Jethalal.

episodes.title: Popatlal's Trouble
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal meets an elderly man in Gokuldham society and later receives a call from the same person about Popatlal marrying his daughter. Popatlal is overjoyed to hear the news but little does he know that the family of the potential bride is planning to con him.

episodes.title: Bride's Evil Plan
episodes.synopsis: The family of the bride cons Popatlal into agreeing to marry their daughter the same day but Popatlal is unaware of the real reason behind this rush. Watch the episode to know more.

episodes.title: Popatlal's Bride To Be
episodes.synopsis: Champak Chacha along with Popat, Daya, and others visit Bishwajeet's place. Seeing Popatlal's manners, Bishwajeet gets very impressed. Bishwajeet asks Popatlal and his daughter to spend some private time to fix their marriage.

episodes.title: Popatlal's Match-Fixing
episodes.synopsis: Bishwajeet finalizes Popatlal's marriage and asks Champak to eat a few sweets. Bishwajeet further tells Daya that they need to consult an astrologer to decide an auspicious date for Popatlal's marriage.

episodes.title: Popatlal's Marriage Gets Fixed
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal receives a call from the girl's family saying they have finalized him and will be marrying the next day itself. Everyone in Gokuldham society cheers Popatlal.

episodes.title: Sapna Gets Annoyed
episodes.synopsis: Sonu asks Sapna all sorts of questions and this annoys her. Taarak further asks Biswajeet about his business. Watch the full episode to know more.

episodes.title: Popatlal's New Car
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal gets a brand new car as a wedding gift. Everyone from Gokuldham gets Happy to see Popatlal Happy. Later, Popatlal rejects the car.

episodes.title: Fraud Fiance
episodes.synopsis: Everyone is curiously watching towards Poppatlal and his fiance to find out that if she is faking. Later, Minty meets her brother and tells him that their well-crafted plan is working out well.

episodes.title: Fake Minty
episodes.synopsis: The men of the Gokuldham society are chatting among themselves. When Poppatlal and his fiance show up, the men curiously watch towards them. Later, they all find out that Poppatlal's fiance is a fraud and her real name is Minty.

episodes.title: Popatlal's Mortgage
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal and Minty go to the bank to get the money. Later, Bhide finds out Popatlal has kept his house on sale to give money to Minty's family. Watch the full episode to find out more.

episodes.title: Popatlal's Trouble
episodes.synopsis: Troubles don't seem to be going away from Popatlal. He is convinced that to help Minty and her father he should mortgage his flat. The entire Gokuldham society comes to know about this.

episodes.title: Police Arrest The Culprits
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal is devastated and heads for the railway station. Suddenly, the police come to the society and everyone is surprised to see that they have arrested the gang. Minty is the one who has informed the police and she reveals all the truths one by one.

episodes.title: Jethalal's Homecoming
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal calls Daya and informs her that he is coming back after a few days, but he is planning to give her a surprise. He returns to Mumbai the same night but unfortunately, when coming from the Airport to his home, he meets with a lot of troubles.

episodes.title: Is Jetha The Real Thief?
episodes.synopsis: Few people bring in a thief in the Gokuldham society and claim that he has stolen things from their society and has headed over to Gokuldham to do the same. Meanwhile, Daya recognizes the thief, it's Jetha!

episodes.title: Exam Results
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena is very curious about their Exam results. Worried about their future, Tapu Sena discusses with the society members. Watch the Full Episode.

episodes.title: Bhide Gets Worried
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is worried about Tapu's exam results. Bhide gets a call from the parents about the same. Bhide himself is worried about the results.

episodes.title: Urgent Meeting
episodes.synopsis: There is an urgent meeting called to motivate and inspire Tapu Sena. Everyone gives their valuable suggestions. Watch the episode to know more.

episodes.title: Tapu Sena's Future Plan
episodes.synopsis: Everyone gives their valuable suggestions and asks Tapu Sena regarding their plans. Tapu Sena tells their ambition and everyone cheers them to go ahead.

episodes.title: Reporter At Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: A television reporter comes to Gokuldham to know about the kid's reactions to exam results. The results will be announced the next day.

episodes.title: Jethalal's Word To Daya
episodes.synopsis: Daya makes Jethalal wear a sweater on a bright sunny day. Jethalal is angry but remembers he had given his word to Daya and he has no option but to follow it now.

episodes.title: Jethalal's Weird Behavior
episodes.synopsis: Daya's convinces Jethalal to wear a sweater and go to the shop. Bagha and Nattu kaka get curious about Jethalal's weird behavior.

episodes.title: Sweater Day
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal sits in his shop wearing a sweater and is sitting in between all the fans. Later, Jethalal bursts at everyone at home.

episodes.title: Tension About The Results
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji tells Jethalal not to have dinner if he is not feeling well, but Jethalal somehow manages the situation. On the other hand, Bhide and Hathi Bhai are tensed about the results to be declared the next morning.

episodes.title: Secret Of The Oath
episodes.synopsis: All the society members gather at Jethalal's house, adding to his misery, everybody gives their own opinion after hearing the problem Jethalal is suffering from Daya. Jethalal tries his level best to hide the secret of the oath.

episodes.title: Oath Continues
episodes.synopsis: The secret of the oath is out in the open and Daya calls her mother to discuss the next step. Daya disconnects the phone and tells Jethalal that the oath can continue, but from now on Jethalal should not use the fan.

episodes.title: Tapu's Bad Dream
episodes.synopsis: Tapu gets a bad dream and see's that he has got only 40% marks in the exam, and he wakes up scared. Tapu calls up Goli and tells him about his dream, but Goli tells him to relax as it is only a dream. Not satisfied with Goli's answer, Tapu calls up Sonu and tells her about his fear.

episodes.title: Assembling At Bhide's House
episodes.synopsis: Everyone gathers at Bhide's house at 9:00 am to check the tenth class results. Roshan asks about Tapu Sena and Popatlal says that he had met Tapu Sena in the compound, as he was going to the temple.

episodes.title: Result Day
episodes.synopsis: The parents of Tapu, Sonu, and Goli are very happy with the results of their children. Later, everyone appreciates the efforts made by Bhide in helping their children to study and pass with good marks. Jethalal's troubles start again when he has to pay the taxi charges for Sunder's taxi.

episodes.title: Convincing Kunal
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal along with Sodhi and Champak Chacha returns to Gokuldham after convincing Kunal. Hearing all that has happened, everybody is very happy and Daya again starts the Garba.

episodes.title: Bhide Gets Shocked
episodes.synopsis: Tarak and Anjali are sitting and discussing the college admissions of Tapu, Goli, and Sonu. On the other hand, Sonu tries a different hairstyle, and seeing her Bhide is shocked.

episodes.title: Discussing The College Admissions
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and the others gather at Abdul's shop for some soda and to discuss the college admissions of their children. They all decide to go together the next morning to check the first list of college admissions for their children.

episodes.title: Looking For Colleges
episodes.synopsis: Everybody is worried about children's college admission. They decide to go and check various colleges for admission. Watch the Full Episode now to find out more.

episodes.title: Jethalal Worries
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal finalizes a college for admission but later finds out that getting admission is hard in that college. Jethalal gets worried about the same. Watch the episode to find out what happens next.

episodes.title: Bagha's Suggestion
episodes.synopsis: When Jethalal goes to the shop thinking about Tapu Sena's admission, Bagha gives the best option saying Bawri can help Tapu Sena get the admission done in the same college.

episodes.title: Say No To Influence
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal tells Jethalal that he is not ready to get Tapu admitted in the college, by using anybody's influence. Champaklal even calls up Goverdhan Bhai and tells him the same

episodes.title: Lots Of Trouble
episodes.synopsis: A very disappointed Jethalal comes out of the principal's cabin, but Tapu tries to console him. Later while going home, Jethalal tells everything to Daya and Champaklal.

episodes.title: Seeking Setting Bhai's Help
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal with a boost of courage leaves to meet Taarak at the college to expose the notorious activities of Setting Bhai. Reaching the canteen where Setting Bhai is, Jethalal and Taarak approach him and offer to pay him any sum of money for the admission.

episodes.title: The Transaction
episodes.synopsis: Nattu Kaka and Bagha get the cash to Jethala's house and they both are extremely proud of Jethalal when they learn about the purpose of the cash.

episodes.title: Jethalal's Plan
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and Tarak reach the office of the trustee, I.M.Khare with the amount that was asked for. Before entering the office, Jethalal switches on the spy camera in his pen. Watch the Episode to find out what happens next.

episodes.title: Complaint Against I.M Khare
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal accompanied by Taarak walks into the police station. Pandey is shocked when he hears that a trustee of the city's number one college has asked for a donation of 7 Lacs.

episodes.title: Police Lock-Up
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Pandey handcuffs both Jethalal and Taarak and puts them in the lock-up. On the other hand, Daya starts getting worried about Jethalal not having returned home.

episodes.title: Pandey Asks For Evidence
episodes.synopsis: No amount of convincing helps in getting out Jethalal and Taarak from the police lock-up. Inspector Pandey informs that he knows that both are innocent but the law only believes in evidence.

episodes.title: Helping Jethalal And Taarak
episodes.synopsis: People from Gokuldham try everything possible to get Taarak and Jethalal out from the police lock-up. When they are finally out, they try to find more routes to catch hold of Khare.

episodes.title: The Non-Violence Rule
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham plans revenge on I.M Khare following the non-violence rule. Popatlal publishes good things about the college and the trustees.

episodes.title: Khare's Social Message
episodes.synopsis: Everyone in Gokuldham society is just talking about the interview which is published in newspapers. Popatlal has published the interview about I.M. Khare. Watch the Full Episode to find out more.

episodes.title: Khare's Situation
episodes.synopsis: The plan of Jethalal and others have started working, the recent coverage about I.M. Khare's personality in various news channels has started gaining popularity. Watch the Full Episode to find out more.

episodes.title: Transforming Khare's Personality
episodes.synopsis: Women association has decided to felicitate I.M Khare for his contribution towards the society. This is again a part of Jethalal's plan to transform Khare's personality.

episodes.title: Khare Is Being Honoured
episodes.synopsis: The day of the function where Khare is being honored arrives and everyone gets ready for it. Later, Jethalal asks Sodhi to go along with Roshan Bhabi and get Khare to the function.

episodes.title: Lighting The Lamp
episodes.synopsis: Khare tries to light the lamp of Goddess Saraswati but is unable to do so. Khare to save his face requests Champaklal to light the lamp.

episodes.title: The Social Message
episodes.synopsis: Khare is shocked to see Jethalal and Tarak Mehta walking to the stage and starts getting nervous. Khare is relieved when Jethalal and Tarak do not speak anything bad about him but they twist the words to their suitability.

episodes.title: Setting Bhai's Speech
episodes.synopsis: Babita asks Champaklal to come and speak a few words. As Champaklal is speaking, Setting Bhai realizes his mistakes and walks on to the stage to speak a few words.

episodes.title: Gandhigiri Mission Celebration
episodes.synopsis: It is time for celebrations in Gokuldham and everyone is dancing with joy to celebrate the success of the Gandhigiri Mission.

episodes.title: Sundar's Surprise
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is sitting and speaking with Daya about the problems they have faced in the last few days. Suddenly, Jethalal hears the voice of Sundar and is shocked as he can see trouble fast approaching.

episodes.title: Daya Teases Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: An argument starts between Bhide and Jethalal and hearing the commotion, Champak Chacha comes there and asks for the reason. Daya tells everything to Champaklal asks for his advice.

episodes.title: Argument Between Bhide And Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Daya tells everything to Champaklal and asks for his advice. Champaklal says that they should give money to the children for shopping, and also explains the reason for saying so.

episodes.title: Shopping Day
episodes.synopsis: Listening to the advice of Champaklal, the parents of Tapu, Sonu, and Golli give cash to their children for shopping. The children are very excited and leave for shopping.

episodes.title: Tapu's New Journey
episodes.synopsis: Tappu Sena goes to thank Dadaji for his guidance and Dadaji tells them to get ready for their first day in college. Tappu Sena gathers at the temple to seek God's blessings for the new journey of their life.

episodes.title: First Day Of College
episodes.synopsis: Tappu Sena is very happy and excited as it is their first day in college. Pinku, who is already in the college warns them about the ragging that takes place in the college.

episodes.title: Jethalal Pleased With Tappu's Sharp Mind
episodes.synopsis: Maddy thanks Tappu and his friends for having saved him from getting rusticated from the college. The next day morning, Jethalal asks Tappu about his first day in the new college and Tappu tells him everything. Hearing about the ragging incident, Jethalal gets scared but Tappu is able to lay his fears to rest.

episodes.title: Bagha Meets Bawri
episodes.synopsis: Bagha reaches the park to meet Bawri. Bagha expresses his fear that the last time he met her relatives, he had to go to jail, and now God knows what will happen. Bawri says that she is going to introduce him to her parents and talk about their marriage. Will Bawri be able to speak to her parents about Bagha?

episodes.title: Bagha Ki Samasya
episodes.synopsis: Bagha's fiance's parents are in Mumbai and he needs a day off from work on an urgent basis to meet them. To grant his leave Bagha calls Daya to help him out of the situation. Meanwhile, Daya has promised Bagha that she will try her best to ensure that he gets the day off. On knowing this from Daya, Jethalal gets angry and cancels his leave. Now how will Bagha meet his fiance's parents?

episodes.title: Bagha Ke Liye Rishta
episodes.synopsis: Dhanraj Seth wants to purchase five hundred television sets from Gada Electronics, hearing this Jethalal becomes very excited thinking about his huge business benefits. However, on the other hand, Bagha who has left his job with Gada electronics has gone to meet his fiance. Will Bawri's parents accept Bagha as their daughter's groom?

episodes.title: Bagha Intimidates Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal receives a call from Bagha that he will find it very demeaning if he doesn't live up to his expectations as a result will have to fire him from the job. To which, Jethalal gets all riled up.

episodes.title: Pyaar Mein Darna Mana Hai
episodes.synopsis: Poor Bagha who had gone for an urgent meeting with Bawri's parents to discuss his marriage was thrown out of Gada Electronics because of his negligence towards work and his continuous demands to meet Bawri. However, Bagha again is in a big problem as Bawri has lied about Bagha's financial condition to her parents. How will Bagha resolve this problem? Watch this episode to find out

episodes.title: Bagha Aur Bawri Ka Pyaar
episodes.synopsis: Bawri, Bagha, and Nattu Kaka have gone to meet Jethalal at his residence to find a solution to their problem. They want Bagha to present himself before Bawri's parents as the owner of Gada Electronics for one day. However, Bapuji has agreed to their request and instructed Jethalal to do the same. But will everything be fine with Bagha?

episodes.title: Change In Bagha's Plan
episodes.synopsis: Bawri's parents have changed their plan and now they want to visit Bagha's shop in the morning. Once again, a problem has aroused for Jethalal, as he had a meeting with Dhanraj Seth in his shop to fix a deal. At the same time, he has also promised Bagha to help him with his problem. Will Bagha be exposed before his fiance's parents?

episodes.title: Jethalal Gets A Huge Order
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal's trouble increases when Dhanraj Seth walks into the godown. Jethalal tries his best to convince Dhanraj Seth and in the process creates more confusion and doubt in the minds of all. Jethalal somehow manages the confusion and even gets a huge order from Dhanraj Seth. Will Jethalal be able to convince Bawri's parents?

episodes.title: Surprise Visit
episodes.synopsis: Bawri Devi's parents have decided to surprise Bagha by meeting him at the Gokuldham Society. It was Jethalal who saw them arriving in the society and got scared of the consequences. He thought that Bagha could now get exposed in front of Bawri's parents and as a result, his marriage with Bawri is at stake. How Jethalal will manage the situation? Will Bagha be exposed?

episodes.title: Bawri Ke Mata Pita
episodes.synopsis: Bawri's parents have come to visit Gokuldham Society to fix Bagha and Bawri's marriage. Jethalal on seeing them in the society got nervous and tried to manage the situation tactfully. Tensed Jethalal had asked Daya to act as Bagha's sister and he himself acted as their servant. However, on reaching inside the house they started searching for Bagha. Can Bagha's marriage be fixed?

episodes.title: Bagha Ki Mangni
episodes.synopsis: Bagha and Bawri were to be engaged today, but due to some important work, Bawri's parent flew back to Kanpur. Jethalal is worried about the future as Bagha and Bawri, after their engagement, were going to tell the truth to Bawri's parents. Can Bagha and Bawri ever get married?

episodes.title: An Important Call
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and Champaklal are going out for their individual purposes and suddenly they meet Iyer and Babita. As they say their goodbyes, Daya bhabhi calls Jethalal and informs him that he is carrying 'aate ka dibba' rather than his lunch box. On the other hand, Popatlal gets a call from some marriage bureau who asks him to visit their office ASAP. Was this another crank call of Popatlal's life?

episodes.title: Popatlal's Umbrella Goes Missing
episodes.synopsis: The ongoing fight between Bhide and Popatlal is on the verge of ending but suddenly Popatlal asks Bhide to apologize to his umbrella. Bhide gets furious and says that he will never do that. The argument between the two tones down when Popatlal again gets the call. Forgetting everything, Popatlal has now left the society to visit the marriage bureau.

episodes.title: Popatlal's Precious Umbrella
episodes.synopsis: Bhide, after refueling his scooter, is ready to leave for the payment collection but halts as a worried Popatlal comes in the way. Popatlal is in pain because of his lost umbrella and he stops Bhide as he thinks Bhide is the culprit.

episodes.title: Popatlal Wants His Old Umbrella
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal is adamant to get his beloved umbrella back and asks Bhide for the same. A great debate takes place and Bhide finally takes another umbrella to Popatlal and seeks pardon. Popatlal refuses the umbrella and wants his old companion back. Can Popatlal get his old umbrella back?

episodes.title: Popatlal's Pledge
episodes.synopsis: Papotlal returns Bhide's scooter and accepts the new umbrella after the people of Gokuldham requests him continuously. Suddenly Popatlal changes his mind and stands in the rain because he cannot open any other umbrella except his own. Jethalal tries to convince him too but fails. Can his old umbrella be found?

episodes.title: Raksha Bandhan ki Tayyari
episodes.synopsis: On the eve of Raksha Bandhan, Bagha gives Jethalal an advice which will help in business growth and will also help in making new customers. Meanwhile, ladies of Gokuldham are on their way to buy rakhi for their beloved brothers. What is the scheme Bagha suggested to Jethalal? Can Jethalal get benefited by the same?

episodes.title: Sundar's Surprise For Daya
episodes.synopsis: Daya, on the eve of Raksha Bandhan, wants to surprise Sundar and requests Jethalal to make arrangements for their visit to Ahmedabad. Jethalal informs Daya that it won't be possible for him to go but she can pay Sundar a visit if she desires to. Can Jethalal courier the parcel on time? What's the good news Nattu Kaka wants Jethalal to know?

episodes.title: Jethalal Ki Mushkil
episodes.synopsis: Sundar calls Jethalal to tell that, on the eve of Raksha Bandhan he will be visiting Mumbai to celebrate the festival of love with his sister, Daya. On hearing this, Jethalal feels delighted and assures Sundar to keep this news a secret from Daya. Can Jethalal keep his promise?

episodes.title: Daya Bhabhi Ki Zid
episodes.synopsis: Daya bhabhi's persistent demand for visiting Ahmedabad on the eve of Raksha Bandhan has created a great deal of trouble for Jethalal. To seek counseling, Jethalal goes to Taarak's house but cannot tell him the whole story, as he promised Sundar of not telling about his Mumbai arrival to anyone. Can Jethalal get out of this mess?

episodes.title: Dayas Visit To Ahmedabad
episodes.synopsis: Daya is adamant about her decision to visit Ahmedabad and is forcing Jethalal to get ready as they have to leave for the airport. Jethalal tries all his tricks to delay the Gada family's departure for the airport as he is confident of Sundar's visit to Gokuldham. Can Daya bhabhi visit Ahmedabad? Will Sundar come to Mumbai?

episodes.title: Sundar's Surprise For Daya
episodes.synopsis: Sundar surprised Daya on the eve of Raksha Bandhan and ended the ongoing dilemma of Jethalal. GokulDham is celebrating the arrival of Sundar and the auspicious day of Raksha Bandhan. How Jethalal will react to Sundar's arrival? Will Daya be pleased to hear Jethalal's side of the story?

episodes.title: Sundar's Invitation For Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and Sundar are sitting on the couch and are discussing their lives. Sundar also brought a gift for Jethalal which later proved to be an anger-inducing agent for him. Watch this episode to find out more.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Mein Janmashtami
episodes.synopsis: Tappu and his friends remind Bhide about the festival of Janmashtami and ask him whether the society will be celebrating the auspicious day or not. Bhide then walks out of his home to write information about the same. What will happen on the eve of Janmashtami?

episodes.title: Gokuldham Ke Nand Aur Yashoda
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is talking to Daya about the festival of Janmashtami and tells her that he will come home soon. Meanwhile, Nattu and Bagha are listening to Jethalal and afterward inform him about the order placement for Electronic Products. Who will become Yashoda and Nandlal in Gokuldham?

episodes.title: Janmashtami Celebration In Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: Amidst the discussion that who will become Nand and Yashoda, it is decided that a lucky draw will decide the faith of Gokuldham residents. Daya is to declare the results of the lucky draw. Who will win the lucky draw?

episodes.title: Jethalal Ka Vachan
episodes.synopsis: Tappu and his friends pay a visit to Bhide for thanking him as he organized a very good function on the eve of Janmashtami. Meanwhile, Jethalal is impressed by Daya's cooking and has promised her to give whatever she asks for. Can Jethalal fulfill his promise?

episodes.title: Babita concerned about water leakage
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is stopped by Bhide and Abdul as they recognized that Jethalal is wearing two different shoes. Meanwhile, Babita calls Iyer and inquires about the availability of Plumber.

episodes.title: Popatlal's Advice To Iyer
episodes.synopsis: Iyer and Babita pay a visit to Popatlal and tell him about the leakage. Popatlal denies any problem being created on his front and advises Iyer to get his ceiling repaired. Meanwhile, Taarak and Anjali are busy in the household discussion. Can Iyer convince Popatlal Can Bhide to handle the situation?

episodes.title: Popatlal Ki Shikayat
episodes.synopsis: As discussed with Bhide, Iyer couple have decided to complain against Popatlal. They want to sort out the water leakage problem of their bathroom. The reason behind the leakage is the water pipeline connection of their bathroom with Popatlal's house. Bhide, who is a little skeptical about the whole issue, is trying to avoid getting into their personal problem.

episodes.title: Fight Between Iyer And Popatlal
episodes.synopsis: Bhide tries to make Popatlal understand the seriousness of Iyer's situation but Popatlal is adamant about his decision of not getting his bathroom fixed. Meanwhile, Daya wakes Jethalal forcibly as he intends to sleep for a few more hours. Can this war between Iyer and Popatlal end?

episodes.title: Popatlal Agrees For Floor Repair
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal and Iyer are still fighting over the water leakage problem, the situation comes under control after Champaklal joins the discussion as a moderator. Will Popatlal agree for floor repair? Can Iyer find his cool again?

episodes.title: Jethalal Tries To Fix Water Flow
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal seeks Bhide's help for ending his water trouble but Bhide refuses to help Jethalal. After Bhide said no, Jethalal himself tries to rectify the problem but unknowingly creates a massive inconvenience for the entire society. Can Jethalal fix his problem pertaining to water supply Will Bhide spend his day in peace?

episodes.title: Problem Of Water Shortage Solved
episodes.synopsis: The water shortage has made a mess and Gokuldham residents are in pain as their daily chores are incomplete. After much discussion finally, the problem has been rectified and everybody has now resumed their routine work.

episodes.title: Sodhi Breaks Bhide's Door
episodes.synopsis: Bhide is in trouble as his living room's door has got stuck. He called Sodhi but instead of resolving the problem, Sodhi increases Bhide's tension. Bhide is thinking that his horoscope has proved to be a hundred percent true. What did Sodhi do? Why the two men are arguing at Bhide's doorstep?

episodes.title: Home Trouble In Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: Bhide's door gets repaired and now he is relieved from the discomfort caused by the earlier events. On the other hand, women of Gokuldham are racing to get their grocery bags full. What is the issue discussed by Gokuldham's women? Why Daya is pressuring Jethalal?

episodes.title: Jethalal Talks About Renovation
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is sitting with other members of Gokuldham to discuss the renovation of the society flats as everyone is experiencing some or other house-related problems. On the other hand, Tappu Sena is all set to decorate Gokuldham society for the Ganesha Chaturthi celebrations. What is Tappu Sena's plan for Ganeshotsav?

episodes.title: Gokuldham Mein Ganpatiji Ka Aagman
episodes.synopsis: There is chaos in the society as they want to bring Ganesha in the prescribed Muhurat. Meanwhile, the home trouble of Gokuldham residents is getting bigger day by day. Can Ganpatiji be brought in Gokuldham on time? Why Bhide and other men of Gokuldham are worried?

episodes.title: Ganpatiji Ki Sthapana
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Pandey unveils the plot about how he got the opportunity to bring Ganpatiji in Gokuldham. Tappu Sena also discloses the mystery behind Ganpati's pandal and shows everybody their creativity.

episodes.title: Jo Bhi Hoga Dekha Jayega
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena has planned a game for the seniors of the society. The secretary of Gokuldham Society, Bhide, has got nervous about the plans of Tapu Sena. Not only Bhide but everyone in the society is getting nervous and trying to figure out about the tough rules of their tricky game which are going to be played tonight.

episodes.title: The Wheel Of Fortune
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena along with the society members are excited to see Tapu Sena execute the game. Tapu Sena tells the members that when the wheel will be spun, wherever it lands, the person gets paired up according to it!
episodes.note: The only video found for this episode is 12 minutes long, so it may be only part of the episode. Try the previous and next episode, or SonyLIV (Premium), for the rest.

episodes.title: Champaklal's Gangnam Style
episodes.synopsis: Game of Wheels is on and Gokuldham residents are waiting for their names to come up so that they can perform their tasks. Everything is fine but now Taarak and Popatlal are going to perform but Popatlal is far from convinced. What is the task assigned to Taarak and Popatlal?

episodes.title: Qawwali In Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal, after much consideration, has agreed to do Qawwali and now Taarak and Popatlal have spell bounded the entire audience. The next couple is Iyer and Daya. What will be the task assigned to Daya and Iyer? Why Bhide is alone on stage?

episodes.title: Roshan And Tapu Sena's Act
episodes.synopsis: Bhide spins the wheel of fortune and it lands on Roshan and Tapu Sena. Will they perform a rocking act? Watch to find out!

episodes.title: Gokuldham Prepares For The Visarjan
episodes.synopsis: All the members are excited to celebrate Ganesh Chaturthi but feeling a little low as it is the day of the Visarjan. Champaklal lifts everybody's spirit and asks everybody to happily bid farewell to Bappa. Actor Diganath and Anushka Ranjan also come to take Ganesh Ji's blessings for their upcoming movie. Watch the episode to find out more.

episodes.title: Ghar Ka Renovation
episodes.synopsis: Women of Gokuldham are discussing about getting their houses renovated but everyone is worried as the men would not agree with their plans to renovate their house. Can women of Gokuldham change their husband's minds?

episodes.title: Mobile Par Hungama
episodes.synopsis: Jeethalal is having a busy day as different types of customers are coming to his shop for buying or complaining. Meanwhile, Daya is trying to tell Jethalal about the ice cream party.

episodes.title: Discussion On Home Renovation
episodes.synopsis: After much hustle, the residents of Gokuldham are sitting under one roof and discussing about the most pressing issue i.e. home renovation. Ladies of Gokuldham have started the discussion but the course of discussion seems to be moving in the wrong direction. Will men of Gokuldham agree with their wives?

episodes.title: Saptrangi The Interior Designer
episodes.synopsis: For the renovation purpose, Saptrangi has been called by Babita as he is a famous architect and interior decorator. After meeting Saptrangi, residents of Gokuldham are now jotting down their renovation plans. Why Taarak is suspicious about Saptrangi?

episodes.title: Saptrangi Takes Measurements
episodes.synopsis: Residents of Gokuldham are trying to figure out the best design for their home and are waiting for Saptrangi to take measurements of their houses so that work of renovation can be started. Meanwhile, Bhide is more worried about the budget than the interior designing aspect. Can Saptrangi fulfill everyone's wish?

episodes.title: Saptrangi Completes Measurement Process
episodes.synopsis: After taking the measurements of Taarak's house, Saptrangi has now moved to Dr. Hathi's house and is taking measurements for renovation. This activity of Saptrangi will go on till he takes measurements of all the houses of Gokuldham society.

episodes.title: Saptrangi Showcases Interior Designs
episodes.synopsis: It's time to see the designs made by Saptrangi and for that Gokuldham residents are meeting each other at the clubhouse so that they can watch and cherish the newly made designs. Can Saptrangi deliver the designs as per the expectations of Gokuldham residents?

episodes.title: Budget Session
episodes.synopsis: Saptrangi is telling Gokuldham residents about the budget because the budget will decide the faith of renovation in Gokuldham. After the budget session, everyone seems to be pleased by Saptrangi's effort but Bhide is concerned about his expenses as it is exceeding the expected limit. Can Bhide bear the renovation expense?

episodes.title: Unity Of Gokuldham Residents
episodes.synopsis: The plan of renovation has been canceled as Bhide is not having enough money for renovating his house and due to this other members have also said no to the refurbishing of their houses.

episodes.title: First Phase Of Renovation
episodes.synopsis: The first phase of renovation is going to start in few hours and the Gokuldham residents are thinking about the shifting arrangements. Meanwhile, Bhide is trying to live the memories of the past as he taught many young children in the house which is going to get a facelift.

episodes.title: Commencement Of Renovation
