episodes.synopsis: All the men of the Gokuldham Society sit and enjoy soda drink while talking about the English language. Later, Iyer informs Babita that he needs 100 tabs for his office. Babita suggests giving the order to Jethalal. Jethalal ensures he will deliver Iyer's request of the tabs by the evening.

episodes.title: Pending Bills
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal goes to his shop and finds Bagha to place the order for Babaji. Jethalal is told that he needs to clear the pending bills of the company to make new orders.

episodes.title: Bad News For Babitaji
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal cannot make the order for Iyer's tabs, as he can't pay the company it's pending dues. Later, Jethalal and Bagha plan to procure the pending payments from his clients. However, he fears he will have to call Babita ji and give her the bad news.

episodes.title: Jethalal Unable To Get The Order
episodes.synopsis: Babitaji and Iyer arrive at Jethalal's shop and ask him for the tabs. Jethalal tells them he will need more time for the delivery. Later, Jethalal requests the company to deliver the tabs, but they deny all his requests.

episodes.title: Babitaji Angry At Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal narrates the situation to Mehta Sahab who advises him to tell Iyer and Babita the truth about their order. Jethalal arrives at Babitaji's house and tells the truth. Babita is shocked to know that Jethalal couldn't arrange for her order.

episodes.title: Jethalal And Mehta Sahab Plan For Vasooli
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal gets extremely upset as Babitaji gets angry at him and ignores him. Jethalal thinks of going to the client's office, and say that he is corona positive but Mehta tells him that this plan will have severe consequences. Jethalal and Mehta are planning to do something in a way that the client gets caught.

episodes.title: Jethalal Seeks More Help
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and Mehta Sahab decide a plot where Bhide and Sodhi will become clients of Bhogilal's hotel so that they can catch him and ask for Jethalal's payment. Later, Jethalal calls Bhide and Sodhi to his shop and explains everything.

episodes.title: Bhide And Sodhi's Plan
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and Sodhi prepare their plan to visit Bhogilal's place. Sodhi calls his friends as their bodyguard for protection. Later, Jethalal also receives a call from Iyer asking for his delivery. Will Jethalal deliver the order in time?

episodes.title: Sodhi Poses As Crorepati
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and Sodhi get ready and meet Sodhi's friends, who will go as their bodyguards. They meet with Jethalal to discuss their plan again. Soon, everyone leaves to visit Bhogilal's office to get Jethalal's money back.

episodes.title: Jethalal Meets Bhogilal
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi and Bhide arrive at Bhogilal's office and act as clients to set up the trap. Finally, Jethalal comes and they all threaten Bhogilal to give them the money. However, Bhogilal informs them he is in a poor financial situation due to which he won't be able to give the money.

episodes.title: Jethalal In Deep Trouble
episodes.synopsis: Bhogilal reveals that the financial situation of his company has taken a massive hit during these trying times. He apologizes to Jethalal and Bagha for mistreating them and not being able to make the payment. Later, Sodhi and Bhide offer to take money from them to make the order for the tabs but Jethalal denies it.

episodes.title: Jethalal Apologizes
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal feels guilty about not being able to fulfill Iyer's order. He visits Iyer's office, to tell the truth, and apologize to everyone. Later, he seems depressed as sits down to wonder, how to save his company.

episodes.title: Jethalal Plans To Sell His Shop
episodes.synopsis: Bagha helps Jethalal come to his senses and go back home. On reaching home, he finds that everyone is gathered at his house and Babitaji has told Bapuji the truth. Later, Jethalal reveals his plans to come out of this slump.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Without Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Everyone tries to come up with alternate business options for Jethalal. However, Jethalal has decided that it will be best if he sells his shop to clear his dues and go back to his hometown. Everyone feels that the Gokuldham Society won't be the same without Jethalal.

episodes.title: Jethalal Sells His Shop
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal finds a party that is interested to buy his shop immediately. The next day, the man arrives to give the cheque for Gada Electronics, but Bagha doesn't hand over the keys. Jethalal gets furious and wakes up to realize that it was just a dream.

episodes.title: Bapuji Finds A Solution
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji and Tapu make dinner and sweets for Jethalal to lift his spirit. However, Jethalal does not respond to Bapuji and Tapu's surprise. Jethalal narrates his situation and talks about his decision to sell Gada Electronics. Bapuji tells Jethalal that they can sell their ancestral property and clear the debt.

episodes.title: Sundar Brings Good News
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal reluctantly agrees to take Sundar's help for selling their ancestral property. Later, Sunder calls back to give them the good news that a party is ready to buy that property for Rs. 1 crore.

episodes.title: Jethalal's Grandfather's Warning
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal informs everyone about the good news that he has received from Sundar. Later, everyone goes back home and expresses their gratitude for being safe and healthy during these trying times. At night, Jethalal's grandfather visits him in his dream and gives him a warning.

episodes.title: Jethalal Has Changed His Mind
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal wakes Bapuji in the middle of the night and informs him about the dream that he saw. Bapuji explains that it is not Dadaji who is denying to sell the land but his own guilt. Next day, Sundar and his friends arrive at Jethalal's house to leave for the meeting but Jethalal has changed his mind.

episodes.title: Jethalal's Dilemma
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji dreams of his father, where he is told that he is doing a good job by selling the property. However, Bapuji is also told to protect and keep the business running. Later, the client contacts Sundar and tells him that he is ready to pay Rs. 1 crore for Jethalal's ancestral property.

episodes.title: Bhogilal Is Sundar's Client
episodes.synopsis: After listening to Sundar talking to his client, everyone gets suspicious about his catchphrase. On questioning Sundar they find out that it is Bhogilal who wants to buy Jethalal's property for Rs. 1 crore. Everyone gets extremely angry and decides to set him up.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Against Bhogilal
episodes.synopsis: The residents of the Gokuldham society gather at Jethalal's house and make a plan to trap Bhogilal.

episodes.title: Bhogilal Arrives
episodes.synopsis: Bhogilal arrives at Gokuldham Society. Taarak and Sundar keep him busy downstairs while everyone at Jethalal's house is hiding inside the rooms and kitchen.

episodes.title: Bhogilal Meets Bapuji
episodes.synopsis: Bhogilal is at Jethalal's house and questions Bapuji about his land and his son. Meanwhile, other members of the Gokuldham Society are hiding in different rooms.

episodes.title: Bapuji Signs The Papers
episodes.synopsis: Though Bhogilal gets suspicious, he manages to trust Bapuji and gives him papers to sign. However, Bhogilal shows his true colours when Sundar asks him to make the payment.

episodes.title: Bhagwaan Bhogilal Ka Bhala Kare
episodes.synopsis: Bhogilal is still making excuses for not being able to transfer the money. Everyone else is trying to find ways to procure the money that he owes to Jethalal. Will they succeed?

episodes.title: Bhogilal Calls The Police
episodes.synopsis: After finding out that the members of the Gokuldham Society were trying to set him up, Bhogilal plans to turn the tables and get them arrested.

episodes.title: Jethalal And Boghilal's Final Showdown
episodes.synopsis: Boghilal threatens that he will make sure Jethalal will be put behind bars for harassment. However, Jethalal has an ace up his sleeve that will put him in the clear.

episodes.title: The End Of Boghilal
episodes.synopsis: Everyone celebrates as Boghilal is taken to prison, and Jethalal's problems come to an end. Later, Jethalal manages to fulfill Iyer's order.

episodes.title: Happy Days Are Back Again
episodes.synopsis: All members of the Gokuldham Society are happy as they celebrate and dance together. Later, the ladies of Gokuldham gather near the vegetable stall and chat with each other.

episodes.title: Discount On Tuition Fees
episodes.synopsis: At Bhide's house, the parents of the students arrive and ask him to give a discount on tuition fees. All members of the Gokuldham Society want to go to Abdul's soda shop. However, his shop is closed, so they gather at Taarak's house to have a chat.

episodes.title: Bhide's Online Classes
episodes.synopsis: Bhide shares his online class issues with Taarak and Jethalal. He reveals the times have hindered the learning process for the children.

episodes.title: The Students' Future
episodes.synopsis: Bhide's students play antakshari during their online classes. Later, he complains about his students to other members of the Gokuldham Society. Everybody is tensed about the future of students as they have lost track of their studies due to lockdown.

episodes.title: The New Normal
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal goes back and checks on Tapu's online classes. Later, Taarak shares Bhide's worry with Anjali and talks about the new normal.

episodes.title: Jethalal's Maintenance Cheque
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal spends time with Babitaji on his balcony as Bapuji comes from behind and scolds Jethalal for wasting time. Later, Jethalal is stopped by Iyer and Popatlal who ask him for the society's maintenance cheque.

episodes.title: Babita's Special Dinner
episodes.synopsis: Babita is planning to cook a special dinner for Iyer. Suddenly, Jethalal starts getting calls from an unknown number. Who could it be?

episodes.title: Gas Cylinder For Babita
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal comes back home to find a worried Babita standing outside. He asks her to not worry anymore as he is there to solve all her problems.

episodes.title: Jethalal Delivers Gas Cylinder
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal manages to deliver the gas cylinder with the help of Doctor Hathi and Taarak Mehta. Later, Bapuji comes home and thinks that he has been robbed because of all the mess that Jethalal created.

episodes.title: The More The Merrier
episodes.synopsis: Babita invites Jethalal and his family to join them in celebrating her special day with Iyer. Later, Tapu makes everyone dance on this memorable day.

episodes.title: The Infuriating Message
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal receives a message that makes him furious. He shares his anger and worries with Bapuji and Jethalal. Who sent the message?

episodes.title: Popatlal Ki Fan
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal gets a call from a girl named Pooja who says that she is a big fan of him and wants to meet him. Popatlal figures out that the girl is single. What are his plans?

episodes.title: Popatlal's Dream Girl
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal dreams of getting married to a girl whom he is going to meet soon. The next morning, Popatlal is excited and prepares to meet the girl of his dreams.

episodes.title: Popatlal's Wrong Parcel
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal is excited and receives the gift that he had ordered for Pooja. After opening the parcel, he realises that he has received the wrong parcel.

episodes.title: Popatlal's Lost Parcel
episodes.synopsis: Delivery boy comes with the right parcel and to collect the wrong one. However, Popatlal realises that he has lost the parcel that he was supposed to return.

episodes.title: Search For Popatlal's Parcel
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal is in search of his wrong parcel that he is supposed to return. He visits every house in the Gokuldham Society to find clues for his missing mangoes.

episodes.title: Popatlal Gets Impatient
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal gets impatient with the search for his lost parcel. He visits Jethalal and Iyer's house to look for it. Later, Popatlal and Sodhi get in a fight with the delivery boy.

episodes.title: Popatlal Seeks Pandey's Help
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal, tired of searching for his mangoes, resorts to Inspector Pandey's help. After questioning the delivery guy, he calls all members of the Gokuldham society to come out. Will Popatlal manage to meet Pooja with her gifts on time?

episodes.title: Popatlal's Mangoes Found
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Pandey tries to find a middle ground between Popatlal and the delivery boy but fails to do so. Later, he manages to find the mangoes in someone's home. Who could this be?

episodes.title: The Truth About The Parcel
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal finally finds the parcel he has been looking for and is happy about getting to meet Pooja. However, he never imagined the action Inspector Pandey will take for wasting the police's precious time.

episodes.title: Popatlal Meets Pooja
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal gets scolded by Bapuji for not remembering where he has kept his chequebook. Later, Popatlal finally gets to sit down with Pooja and have a conversation.

episodes.title: Preparation To Welcome Pooja
episodes.synopsis: The news that Pooja is coming to Gokuldham Society spreads quickly. Mahila Mandal decides to cook for Poaptlal and Pooja, while Tapu Sena prepares to welcome them.

episodes.title: Pooja Shares Her Feelings
episodes.synopsis: Pooja arrives at the Gokuldham Society, where she gets welcomed by Tapu Sena. Later, Pooja reveals a shocking fact to Popatlal that breaks his heart.

episodes.title: Popatlal - The Guru
episodes.synopsis: The members of the Gokuldham Society wait downstairs to celebrate with Popatlal. However, they get shocked to know that Pooja sees him as her Guru. Later, everyone asks Popatlal to stay hopeful and look at the bright side.

episodes.title: Good News For Everyone
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal calls Jethalal, Taarak, Bhide, Sodhi, Iyer, Dr. Hathi to his place for a party. Later, Asit Bhai calls Taarak as he wants to give a piece of good news to everyone, but they will have to wait for it.

episodes.title: Waiting For Surprise
episodes.synopsis: When Babita asks about the stains on his clothes, Iyer tells her the entire incident. All of them return to their homes and tell their families about Asit Bhai's surprise.

episodes.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Chhota Chasmah
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal thanks Bhide for saving his mobile by heroically catching it. Soon, Asit Bhai sends a link on everyone's mobile and asks them to play it to reveal his surprise for them.

episodes.title: The Troubled Bhide
episodes.synopsis: Bhide is troubled with his online classes, and Jethalal arrives at Bhide's house to talk about one of his students. The next day Bhide gets annoyed further by his friends in the Gokuldham Society.

episodes.title: Bhide Worried About His Students
episodes.synopsis: Bhide teaches a new maths chapter and asks the kids to prepare as he will take a test later in the evening. Bhide leaves for delivery and meets Iyer and Popatlal on the way. He shares his worry about the future of his students with Popatlal.

episodes.title: Bhide Calls For A Parent Meeting
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal and Bhide take a scooter ride to the marriage bureau, where Bhide forgets his phone. Later, during his regular classes, Bhide gets angry and calls for a parent meeting with his students.

episodes.title: Bhide Talks To All Parents
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena sees Bhide in a foul mood and tries to cheer him up. Later, Bhide informs the students and their parents that he is not going to teach them further.

episodes.title: All Parents Arrive At Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal fails to reason with Bhide and seeks help from Taarak Mehta regarding the same. Soon, all the parents arrive at Gokuldham Society to request Bhide to resume the online classes.

episodes.title: Bhide Counsels The Students
episodes.synopsis: Taarak talks to Bhide and tries to give him an outsider's perspective. Soon, Bhide calms down and counsels the kids about the importance of education as he agrees to start the online classes immediately.

episodes.title: Taarak Prays For Health
episodes.synopsis: Mr. Mehta sits in his house reminiscing about the past year. He prays to God to keep everyone safe in the upcoming year as well.

episodes.title: Popatlal's New Mission
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal gets a call from one of his informants, who tells him that his life could be in danger. Popatlal immediately gathers his team and leaves for his new mission.

episodes.title: Mission Kala Kauwa
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal and Bharti explain the situation to Dr. Hathi and request his cooperation to discover the truth. Later, Dr. Hathi meets a probable suspect to extract information about their leader.

episodes.title: Popatlal Gets Distracted
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal and his team continue with their "Kala Kauwa" mission at the Rang Tarang Resort. However, Popatlal gets distracted when he finds an eligible life partner for himself.

episodes.title: Mission Hits A Speedbump
episodes.synopsis: Dr Hathi gets tired after eating too much at the resort. Meanwhile, Popatlal and Bharti get worried about the mission and try to get in touch with him.

episodes.title: Popatlal Finds Determination
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal and Bharti meet a waiter who is scared as her mother does not have the medicines she needs. This makes Popatlal more determined to uncover the people behind the medicine scam.

episodes.title: Chasing Dr Hathi
episodes.synopsis: Dr Hathi receives an important message and leaves to complete the mission. Meanwhile, Popatlal and Bharti have to overcome multiple hurdles to keep up with Dr Hathi.

episodes.title: Dr Hathi Fails
episodes.synopsis: Dr Hathi faces difficulty in getting the deal and fails to record the boss' face. Meanwhile, Popatlal gets distracted as his tour guide takes him sightseeing.

episodes.title: Mission Kala Kauwa Failed
episodes.synopsis: Dr Hathi gets escorted out of the resort by one of the goons and he is not allowed to get in touch with Popatlal. Meanwhile, Bharti and Popatlal are kept busy and distracted by the resort's staff.

episodes.title: Popatlal Takes A Boat Ride
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal and Bharti check the pen camera that Dr Hathi left behind in the bathroom. They take a boat ride to clear their minds and come up with a new plan to revive "Mission Kala Kauwa".

episodes.title: Problems At Gada Electronics
episodes.synopsis: Bagha and Jethalal have to deal with surplus goods at their godown. Later, Popatlal calls Jethalal to give him a piece of good news.

episodes.title: Luring Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal lures Jethalal to the resort so he can assist him with the Mission Kala Kauwa. Later, Dr Hathi calls Popatlal from his home to let him know that he is safe and sound.

episodes.title: Jethalal Is On The Way
episodes.synopsis: Bhide calls Popatlal, hoping he could help him get an order for his pickles from the resort. Later, Jethalal calls Popatlal to give him an update.

episodes.title: Popatlal's Secret
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal and Bharti get paranoid as they think that a waiter at the resort is onto their secret. Meanwhile, Jethalal enjoys a game of antakshari while on the way to the resort.

episodes.title: Jethalal At The Resort
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal inquires about the resort so he can confirm his order for the appliances in 200 rooms. Popatlal tells him to be patient till they manage to meet in person.

episodes.title: Jethalal Finds About The Mission
episodes.synopsis: After Jethalal agrees to get on the boat with Popatlal, he gets reeled in about everything Popatlal has done for Mission Kala Kauwa. Will Jethalal accept the mission?

episodes.title: Jethalal Goes Undercover
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal explains what Jethalal will have to do to bring the mafia down. Jethalal puts on a disguise and tries to set up a meeting with the boss.

episodes.title: The Next Step
episodes.synopsis: Bagha drops the pen camera for Bharti so Popatlal can check what transpired at Jethalal's first meet. They meet again at the swimming pool to decide the next step for their mission.

episodes.title: Finding The Informant
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal realises that one of the waiters at the resort must be providing information to the main boss. Jethalal suggests that they should follow him to find more information about the gang.

episodes.title: Safed Kabootar
episodes.synopsis: The main boss comes up with a new code word and prepares for an important meeting. Meanwhile, Jethalal meets the manager and tries to extract information about all the employees.

episodes.title: Jethalal's New Suspect
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal and others keep their covers intact and steer clear from any suspicion. Jethalal also reveals the name of the person he thinks is the mole in the resort.

episodes.title: Popatlal Meets Sanjana
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal is sure that the receptionist has more allies in the resort. He devises a plan to make sure they can catch them.

episodes.title: Popatlal Proposes To Sanjana
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal sets a romantic mood to propose Sanjana. Little does he know that she is involved in the dealing of the medicines.

episodes.title: Popatlal Gets Caught
episodes.synopsis: After revealing his true identity to Sanjana, Popatlal gets caught by the gang. She calls Popatlal to meet him and sets him up to get captured.

episodes.title: Popatlal Meets The Boss
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal bumps into Sanjana and deals with her discreetly. Popatlal finally comes face to face with the boss of the gang.

episodes.title: Dulhe Ki Khatirdaari
episodes.synopsis: The boss continues to torture Popatlal while his assistant checks for more clues. Jethalal plans to go through the CCTV footage to look for Popatlal in the resort.

episodes.title: Jethalal's New Cover
episodes.synopsis: The boss discovers about Jethalal, who is Popatlal's accomplice. Jethalal, Bagha, and Bapuji take a new disguise to escape from the clutches of the gang.

episodes.title: Popatlal Waits For A Miracle
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal waits for a miracle as he is tied in the pool and will be electrocuted if he tries to move. Jethalal is running around the resort in a disguise trying to look for Popatlal.

episodes.title: Police Arrives At The Resort
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal, Bagha and Bapuji are still on the run from the goons at the resort. Soon, Inspector Chalu Pandey arrives at the resort to investigate the situation.

episodes.title: Jethalal Meets The Boss
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal stumbles onto the boss of the operation and they find out that they are old acquaintances. Madan further tortures Popatlal who is still tied at the centre of the pool.

episodes.title: Pandey Maarega Dande
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal, Babuji, and Bagha celebrate when they see that Inspector Pandey has arrived from Mumbai. They share all the information about the goons that they have.

episodes.title: Pandey Finds Clues
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Pandey suspects that there must be a secret at the pool since it is closed for everyone. To their surprise, they find more clues linked to Popatlal there.

episodes.title: Popatlal Saved
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Pandey finds Popatlal, who tells them how he escaped death. Inspector Pandey's men also catch hold of Madan.

episodes.title: Popatlal Gathers Evidence
episodes.synopsis: Madan demands to be set free, as Popatlal does not have any proof against him. Popatlal manages to find a piece of video evidence that incriminates Madan.

episodes.title: Mission Kala Kauwa Completed
episodes.synopsis: With Madan's arrest, Popatlal's top-secret mission is completed successfully. Popatlal and Jethalal also extend the services of Gokuldham's members to the Rang Tarang resort's owner.

episodes.title: Celebrating The Success
episodes.synopsis: The colony members are in a festive mood as they celebrate the success of Popatlal's secret mission. Bhide and his wife consider going to a resort along with everyone else to congratulate Popatlal.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Plans A Party
episodes.synopsis: Bagha puts Jethalal in the spotlight by asking him a hypothetical question. Everyone from Gokuldham calls Jethalal to show him the excitement for the celebration at the resort.

episodes.title: The Guest Of Honour
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal and his gang get a 5-star treatment at the resort. Meanwhile, everyone at Gokuldham prepares to leave for Rang Tarang resort.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Prepares To Leave
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal locks himself out of his room and has to wake up Bapuji to get in. Everyone from Gokuldham boards the bus to leave for the resort.

episodes.title: Bus Ride To The Resort
episodes.synopsis: All members of the Gokuldham Society board the bus and begin their journey to Rang Tarang resort. They decide to have all the fun and take necessary precautions as well.

episodes.title: Games On The Bus
episodes.synopsis: The families have a blast on the bus, playing different games and teasing each other on their way to Rang Tarang Resort.

episodes.title: Jethalal Prepares For Everyone's Arrival
episodes.synopsis: Everyone on the bus decides to take a small break before proceeding further. Jethalal plans to get done with his meeting quickly so he can prepare for everyone's arrival.

episodes.title: The Fun Journey Continues
episodes.synopsis: Everyone continues to play a variety of games throughout their journey. The gents plan to set up a grand party for Popatlal to celebrate his success.

episodes.title: The Journey Ends
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal ensures that all his friends from Gokuldham receive a warm welcome at the resort. Jethalal reaches the owner's office for his meeting.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Waalo Ka Swaagat
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham members reach the resort reception and start checking themselves in. Popatlal plans to welcome them in a better way.

episodes.title: Party Bag Goes Missing
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal finally gets to meet K.K. but faces issues in communication as he wants to converse in English. Sodhi and Iyer panic as they can't find the bag with party goods in it.

episodes.title: Walk Around The Resort
episodes.synopsis: The gents of Gokuldham seek the manager's help in looking for Sodhi's missing bag. Everyone decides to take a walk around the resort together.

episodes.title: Roaming The Resort
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham members find a mango tree from which they pluck a few mangoes. They later discover the swimming pool area and are amazed by the ambiance.

episodes.title: Kadha For Everyone
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal comes back from his meeting with KK. He tries to give Taarak Mehta a bottle of concoction.

episodes.title: Taarak Books A Hall
episodes.synopsis: Taarak Mehta meets the manager of the resort to book a hall. Later, everyone gathers at the hall for a Gokuldham style function.

episodes.title: Sammaan Samaroh
episodes.synopsis: All members of the Gokuldham Society gather at the hall. Bhide reveals to Jethalal and Popatlal the reason for their gathering.

episodes.title: Narrating The Mission
episodes.synopsis: Dr Hathi, Jethalal and Popatlal narrate the details of Mission Kala Kauwa to all Gokuldham members.

episodes.title: Kala Kauwa Trophy
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal continues to narrate every detail about their mission to everyone. Gokuldham members show their appreciation for Popatlal's efforts by giving him a trophy.

episodes.title: Party Sharty Ka Jugaad
episodes.synopsis: All gents of the Gokuldham Society meet to discuss the party. They ask Popatlal to use his contacts for managing the party.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Dinner
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena enjoys a game of pool in the play area. Everyone decides to meet up for a Gokuldham style dinner at the resort.

episodes.title: Party Sharty Start
episodes.synopsis: Everyone gathers at the hall to enjoy a lavish dinner at the resort.

episodes.title: Bagha Loses Control
episodes.synopsis: Bagha gets drunk and wants to keep dancing. Everyone tries to stop him and take him to his room.

episodes.title: Catching Bagha
episodes.synopsis: Everyone tries different strategies to get Bagha to calm down and go back to his room. Bapuji finds out that Bagha is missing and gets furious.

episodes.title: Bagha Ke Liye Goli
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji catches Bagha and scolds him for his behaviour. The resort's manager gets medicine to help Bagha come back to his senses.

episodes.title: Bapuji Finds The Bottle
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji has a severe case of hiccups and decides to consume some 'kadha.' How will he react when he finds out the original contents of the bottle.

episodes.title: Bapuji Makes Everyone Dance
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji punishes all the men of the Gokuldham Society for lying about the bottle. All the men later apologise for their plan to party.

episodes.title: Joshile Vs Mastane
episodes.synopsis: Everyone is happy that they broke out of their regular lockdown routine to visit the resort. Jethalal and Taarak get into separate teams and play a game in the swimming pool.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Boat Race
episodes.synopsis: Everyone relaxes in the swimming pool area of the resort. Later, everyone gathers at the lake and divide into teams to compete in a boat race.

episodes.title: Check Out From Resort
episodes.synopsis: Everyone goes back to their rooms to rest after the boat race. The next morning, the Gokuldham members start checking out from the resort.

episodes.title: Leaving The Resort
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal arrives late at the lobby for his check out. The owner of the resort sends a present to everyone for helping the resort.

episodes.title: Remembering The Trip
episodes.synopsis: Anjali makes delicious dinner for Taarak as all the colony members meet at Mehta's residence and re-live their resort memories.

episodes.title: Right To Party
episodes.synopsis: The men of the society sit around and remember the trip. They talk about the party incident and come to a conclusion that it is their right to party occasionally.

episodes.title: Remembering Dilip Kumar
episodes.synopsis: The colony members get nostalgic and remember one of the icons of Indian cinema, Dilip Kumar. They cherish his memories by singing his songs.

episodes.title: A Healthy Diet
episodes.synopsis: Everyone gets back to their daily routine and life goes back to normal in Gokuldham. Taarak gets to know that Anjali has plans for him and will only give him healthy food to eat.

episodes.title: Missing Glasses
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji's glasses go missing and they are nowhere to be found. Where could his glasses be? Meanwhile, Taarak gets late for office.

episodes.title: Late For Work
episodes.synopsis: Mr Mehta is running late for work, and there seems to be no available mode of travel for him. Jethalal, as usual, is running late, and Bhide is going in the opposite direction. How does Mr Mehta get to work in time?

episodes.title: The Empty Warehouse
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal gets the shock of his life when he reaches his warehouse and finds that it is empty. He panics and calls Bagha but, he too is of no help. Jethalal decides to call Mr Mehta for help, who is in a tricky situation with his boss for coming late.

episodes.title: Saving Taarak
episodes.synopsis: To get Mr.Mehta a day off from work, Jethalal calls Mr.Mehta's boss and pretends to be Anjali, who has fallen sick all of a sudden.

episodes.title: Magan Saves The Day
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and the society members celebrate the fact that the electronic stock was saved and nothing was stolen. Mr Mehta gets furious that because of Jethalal's misunderstanding he had to take a day off from work.

episodes.title: Taarak Gets Caught
episodes.synopsis: Mr. Mehta's boss finds out that he lied and took a day off from work. He confronts him in the restaurant. Is Mr. Mehta's job in danger?

episodes.title: Taarak Ke Bahane
episodes.synopsis: Taarak reaches home to discover that his wife is going to her friend's place. He is worried that he will have to lie to everyone who question him.

episodes.title: Jalebi Ke Sapne
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji reminisces about his younger days with Tapu. Jethalal asks Baupuji to accompany him for a special breakfast.

episodes.title: Jalebi Ka Order
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal asks Taarak to accompany him for a plate of 'Jalebi' and 'Fafda.' Bapuji does not allow Taarak to eat the 'Jalebi' that Tapu orders online.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Vaccination Drive
episodes.synopsis: Dr Hathi reveals that he will be conducting a vaccination drive and helping everyone in the society to get their shots. Taarak and Jethalal get into a fight when Jethalal declares that he doesn't want to get vaccinated.

episodes.title: Publicity Plans
episodes.synopsis: Bhide informs everyone that Popatlal will publish an article about the vaccination drive. Tapu Sena seeks the help of Ritu for advertising their new song.

episodes.title: The Sena's Vaccination Song
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and Taarak get into another quarrel as Jethalal has a new excuse for not taking the vaccine. Tapu Sena performs the vaccination song that they have been preparing with Taarak.

episodes.title: Convincing To Take A Shot
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and Dr. Hathi are excited to make all the arrangements and start with their vaccination drive. Bhide finds out that Sodhi does not want to take the vaccination either.

episodes.title: Jethalal Ka Brahmastra
episodes.synopsis: Everyone gets up early to prepare for the Gokuldham Vaccination Drive. Jethalal comes up with a clever plan to save himself from the needle.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Vaccinated
episodes.synopsis: Everyone gathers at the camp and gets vaccinated for COVID-19. Taarak reveals that Jethalal isn't sick and is lying to escape the camp.

episodes.title: Jethalal Caught
episodes.synopsis: After his lie gets caught, Jethalal runs away from everyone to save himself from the injection. He seeks Taarak's help to protect himself from the other members of Gokuldham.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Vaccination Rumours
episodes.synopsis: With all the members of the society vaccinated, everyone prepares for outsiders to arrive for the vaccine. They are shocked when no one turns up for getting vaccinated.

episodes.title: Vaccination Drive Sabotaged
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena finds that someone has taken all their vaccination drive banners down. Bhide calls for the police's help to catch the people spreading misinformation.

episodes.title: Colony Members Under Arrest?
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Pandey comes to the colony to arrest the members for running a fake vaccination drive. Are the colony members in trouble?

episodes.title: Convincing People For Vaccination
episodes.synopsis: As the misunderstanding around the vaccination drive clears out, the colony members decide to go out and convince people to come and get vaccinated.

episodes.title: Successful Vaccination Drive
episodes.synopsis: The colony members celebrate the successful vaccination drive and find out that the people who had spread rumours have been caught.

episodes.title: Post Vaccine Effects
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal has a sore arm and Tapu, a fever. Champaklal calls Dr Hathi over. Dr Hathi tactfully rids Jethalal of the sore arm. What will his solution for Tapu be?

episodes.title: Popatlal Returns From Hyderabad
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal returns from Hyderabad. Bhide takes offline classes. His students are extremely happy to be back for offline classes. Meanwhile, Tapu Sena decides to meet to come up with ideas to celebrate Ganesh Chaturthi.

episodes.title: Bhide Wants To Plan Ganesh Utsav
episodes.synopsis: Bhide has decided to plan for the Ganesh Utsav this year, instead of Tapu Sena. He tries to come up with a unique idea to celebrate Ganesh Utsav, but cannot think of anything. Who will plan the celebrations for Ganesh Utsav?

episodes.title: Bhide Prepares For Ganesh Utsav
episodes.synopsis: Bhide speeds up his preparations for Ganesh Utsav and asks Iyer to meet him to decide the budget. Tapu Sena has also started their preparations for Ganesh Utsav, as they do every year. Will Bhide beat Tapu Sena's budget and get to prepare for Ganesh Utsav?

episodes.title: An Excited Bhide
episodes.synopsis: Bhide believes he will beat Tapu Sena and get to organise the upcoming Ganesh Utsav. Everybody waits for Jethalal to reach the clubhouse so that the meeting can begin. Will Jethalal arrive on time?

episodes.title: Champaklal Comes Up With A Solution
episodes.synopsis: The conflict between Tapu Sena and Bhide continues to ascertain who gets to prepare for the upcoming Ganesh Utsav. On seeing the argument escalate at the society meet, Champaklal intervenes and comes up with a solution that is accepted by all. Who will get to prepare for the upcoming Ganesh Utsav?

episodes.title: Ganesha's Message For Bhide
episodes.synopsis: Bhide enumerates the names of Lord Ganesh. Later, he dreams of meeting Lord Ganesh himself, after following Mushak.

episodes.title: Aftermath Of Bhide's Dream
episodes.synopsis: Bhide is at a loss for words because of his dream. He talks to various members of the Gokuldham Society about his dream and everybody tries to think of a way out.

episodes.title: Pandits Create Confusion
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal takes Bhide to a Pandit so they can help Bhide understand his dream. They come back and call everyone to give an update about the situation.

episodes.title: Bappa Arrives At Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: Everyone gets ready to welcome Ganpati Bappa at the Gokuldham Society. Bhide gets anxious before Lord Ganesh arrives.

episodes.title: Bappa's Welcome
episodes.synopsis: The members of Gokuldham Society welcome Lord Ganesh to their care. Bhide reveals the programmes he has planned with Tapu Sena for the celebrations.

episodes.title: Ranga Rang Karyakram
episodes.synopsis: Sunderlal arrives at Jethalal's house with a deal. Bhide calls everyone to let them know about the programmes that are lined up for the celebration.

episodes.title: Independence Day At Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham members are ready to start the Ganpati Utsav. To celebrate the 75th year of independence, everyone dresses up as the freedom fighters of India.

episodes.title: Ganesh Utsav Competition
episodes.synopsis: Bhide takes the Ganesh Utsav forward at the Gokuldham Society. The members take turns to display their costumes.

episodes.title: The Patriots At Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi, Taarak and Bhide put on their costumes and perform their acts. Everyone enjoys the visual and knowledgeable performances that the participants illustrate.

episodes.title: Insaan Se Insaan Jude
episodes.synopsis: The spotlight lands on Anjali, Iyer, and Babita next. They put on their costumes and portray stories from India's freedom fighting days.

episodes.title: Tapu Sena's Combined Act
episodes.synopsis: Impressed by the freedom fighters, everyone hopes that their spirit keeps inspiring our future generations. Members of Tapu Sena put up a joint performance for the society members.

episodes.title: Laut Ke Aayenge
episodes.synopsis: It is finally Popatlal and Jethalal's turn to put on a show. Everyone has tears of joy as they bid farewell to Lord Ganesha.

episodes.title: Sakharam Buddha Ho Gaya
episodes.synopsis: Bhide realises that his scooter has gotten old and needs extra care. He calls Sodhi hoping that he might know a mechanic who can help.

episodes.title: Sakharam Hua Chori
episodes.synopsis: Everyone at the Gokuldham Society gets ready to go to their jobs. Someone suspicious walks into the society who has his eyes set on Bhide's Sakharam.

episodes.title: Sakharam Is Safe
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi calls Bhide to tell him that he sent a mechanic to repair his scooter. Popatlal and Bapuji give Tapu Sena a small history lesson.

episodes.title: Bhide Needs Cash
episodes.synopsis: Bhide needs hard cash that he has to give to Ramakant Kaka. Bhide decides to send Sonu, with Tapu Sena, to the bank to withdraw the money he needs.

episodes.title: Tapu Sena Loses The Cheque
episodes.synopsis: Bhide hands the cheque to his daughter and asks Tapu Sena to head directly to the bank. After losing the cheque at the market, Tapu Sena frantically searches for it everywhere.

episodes.title: Bhide's Money Withdrawn
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena returns to Gokuldham Society and lies to Bhide about his money. Bhide receives a message from his bank that money has been withdrawn from his account.

episodes.title: Bhide Finds The Cheque
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena is in shambles due to the problem they have gotten themselves into. Bhide gets a call from an officer who tells him that he found his cheque lying on the road.

episodes.title: Paiso Ka Jugaad
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena calls their parents and tries to borrow cash so they can give it to Bhide.

episodes.title: Tapu Sena Contacts A Loan Shark
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena contacts a loan shark to help Sonu give the cash to her father. The loan shark informs them about his terms and conditions for lending them the money.

episodes.title: Tapu Sena Ki Complaint
episodes.synopsis: Bhide plays along with the lies that Tapu Sena tells him. He decides to call their parents to tell them about their blunders.

episodes.title: Tapu Sena's Parents Meet
episodes.synopsis: Abdul follows Tapu Sena and updates Bhide of their movement. Tapu Sena's parents gather at Bhide's house and find out about their lies.

episodes.title: Tapu Sena's Confession
episodes.synopsis: Bhide gets enraged by the string of lies Tapu Sena has been telling and blames himself for being a poor teacher. Tapu Sena decides to tell the truth to their parents.

episodes.title: Bapuji Ka Saath
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji tells Tapu Sena that he will always support them if they always stay on the right path. Bhide and Sodhi visit Ramakant Kama to hand him the money.

episodes.title: Bhide Ka Bhayanak Sapna
episodes.synopsis: With Abdul missing from his shop, Bhide prepares soda for everyone. Bhide has a terrible nightmare that keeps disturbing his sleep.

episodes.title: Bhide's Midnight Scare
episodes.synopsis: Bhide calls Sodhi and Jethalal for help in the middle of the night as he thinks there is some trouble at the door. Jethalal and Taarak carry any weapon they can get their hands on and rush to Bhide's home.

episodes.title: Popatlal's Fan Mail
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal receives Kashmiri Kahwa from a fan and calls everyone to his home to have some. Bhide, who leaves his phone at home, looks for all his friends everywhere in the Gokuldham Society.

episodes.title: The Kahwa Party
episodes.synopsis: Bhide gets Bapuji and everyone else's wives to Popatlal's home. They misunderstand the Kahwa to be an alcoholic beverage and begin to revolt against the drinkers.

episodes.title: Taarak Has 30 Minutes
episodes.synopsis: Babita delivers Jethalal's letter to his home before he leaves for his shop. Taarak's boss gives him 30 minutes to find a birth certificate.

episodes.title: Taarak Ka Hathiyaar
episodes.synopsis: The boss's wife calls the office to inform them that she has found the birth certificate. Taarak plans to use his best weapon to take his revenge.

episodes.title: Taarak's Poem
episodes.synopsis: Taarak's boss asks him to read out his poem, but Taarak knows that reading his poem out, will get him in trouble.

episodes.title: Rootha Hua Jetha
episodes.synopsis: After getting into more trouble at work, Taarak tries to seek Jethalal's help. However, an angry Jethalal takes his time to forgive Taarak and give him some advice.

episodes.title: Saving Taarak's Job
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal calls Iyer and asks him to help save Taarak's job. Iyer reluctantly agrees to lie to Taarak's boss about the poem.

episodes.title: Iyer Gets Into Trouble
episodes.synopsis: Taarak's boss calls Iyer and tells him that Iyer's boss is his childhood friend. Iyer calls Taarak to tell him about the trouble he has gotten himself into.

episodes.title: Sutli Bomb Jaisi Kavita
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal forces Taarak to recite his poem in front of Anjali and Babita. Jethalal helps Iyer to calm down so they can find a solution for their problems.

episodes.title: Taarak And Iyer's Meeting
episodes.synopsis: Taarak and Iyer reach the restaurant and wait for their bosses to arrive. Taarak's boss feels that it is his responsibility to counsel his childhood friend to become a better senior.

episodes.title: Democracy In The Office
episodes.synopsis: Taarak's boss claims that there is democracy in his office and everyone is free to express their opinions. But how will he react when Taarak tells him that his 'Boss Bashing' poem was intended towards him?

episodes.title: Supporting The Small Shops
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal narrates the incident about Taarak's boss to Bapuji. Madhvi requests the Mahila Mandal to shop from the local market to support the small businesses that had suffered due to COVID-19.

episodes.title: Diwali Shopping
episodes.synopsis: Taarak writes a poem for the occasion of Diwali and requests Jethalal to hear it. The members of the Gokuldham Society visit the local market for Diwali shopping.

episodes.title: Helping The Needy
episodes.synopsis: The police explain their reasons for raiding the roadside hawkers. Feeling bad about the situation, Mahila Mandal comes up with a solution that helps all the parties.

episodes.title: Permission For Stalls
episodes.synopsis: The hawkers reach Gokuldham Society to set up their stalls. However, they need permission from Bhide, the society's secretary, before doing anything.

episodes.title: Permission Granted
episodes.synopsis: Bhide, after consulting everyone, grants the hawkers permission to set up their stalls. Tapu Sena assures Bhide that they will take care of the security arrangements.

episodes.title: Tapu Sena On High Alert
episodes.synopsis: The shopping fiesta begins at the Gokuldham Society. Tapu Sena catches a pickpocket, who tries to run away with a lot of valuable items.

episodes.title: Ahmedabad Se Surprise
episodes.synopsis: Sundar arrives at Jethalal's house and tells him that he has brought a surprise from Ahmedabad. When Goli tells his father about the kachori, he wishes that he could have some as well.

episodes.title: Kachori Delivery
episodes.synopsis: Goli tries to deliver his mother's handmade kachori to Iyer's house, but faces multiple hurdles along the way.

episodes.title: Jethalal - The Cricketer
episodes.synopsis: Goli distributes kachoris to everyone in Gokuldham Society. Jethalal talks to Bapuji about his shop's interior work. Meanwhile, the kids are playing cricket downstairs and Jethalal flaunts his cricket skills in front of Babita.

episodes.title: Renovation At Gada Electronics
episodes.synopsis: Taarak steps in and saves Jethalal from getting embarrassed in front of Babita. Jethalal, worried that his business is affected by the renovation, seeks Taarak's help again.

episodes.title: Iyer Trips And Falls
episodes.synopsis: Taarak asks Jethalal to stay calm and ask his contractor for a deadline. Iyer trips on a banana peel and breaks his cell phone.

episodes.title: Pyaar Ki Kala
episodes.synopsis: When Bhide finds that Tapu has ordered footwear worth five thousand rupees, he scolds Jethalal for pampering Tapu. Jethalal reaches his shop to find that the contractor hasn't arrived for the meeting.

episodes.title: Jethalal Se Vasooli
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal sends Bagha to a local mobile repair show for fixing Babita's phone. Bhide has to deal with three guys who are adamant about taking 2 lakh rupees from Jethalal.

episodes.title: Jethalal Ke Office Aye Gunde
episodes.synopsis: The goons, who believe that Jethalal owes them money, reach his office and demand money. Jethalal, still confused, tries to figure out who they are and how does he owe them money.

episodes.title: Searching For Santosh Contractor
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal frantically looks for his contractor Santosh. He ends up calling multiple numbers but fails to get in touch with him. Meanwhile, Babita and Iyer wait for Jethalal to come back with her phone.

episodes.title: Finding Babita's Phone
episodes.synopsis: Iyer calls Bagha and asks him about Babita's phone. Jethalal calls the vasooli agents and tries to get the phone back.

episodes.title: Retrieving Babita's Phone
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal calls the goon who has Babita's phone and begs him to give the phone back to him. However, the goon doesn't budge and asks for his money. What compromise does Jethalal need to do to get the phone back?

episodes.title: Jethalal's Lies Get Caught
episodes.synopsis: Iyer and Babita arrive at Jethalal's godown and find that he has been lying about Babita's phone all along. Jethalal turns to Taarak to help him find a solution.

episodes.title: Jethalal Ki Deal
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal gets jumped on by other members of Gokuldham for being irresponsible with Babita's phone. Taarak helps Jethalal to set up a meeting with the vasooli agents.

episodes.title: Paise Do Phone Lo
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi gets ready to take on the vasooli agents with Babita's phone. Jethalal sets up a meeting with the agents in the hopes of returning Babita's phone.

episodes.title: Jethalal Arrested
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal, Taarak and Sodhi are arrested by the police and taken to the station. They get happy to see Inspector Pandey on duty but, he refuses to treat their case in a partial manner.

episodes.title: Jethalal And Gang In Lock-Up
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal, Taarak and Sodhi get locked up in Inspector Pandey's station. They keep requesting Inspector Pandey to show them some leniency.

episodes.title: Jethalal Retrieves Babita's Phone
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal requests Inspector Pandey to drop him, Taarak and Sodhi at Gokuldham Society. Bapuji finds out the story of Jethalal's arrest through Bhide.

episodes.title: Chappal Exchange
episodes.synopsis: Babita thanks Jethalal for repairing and returning her phone safely. Jethalal argues about exchanging the footwear that Tapu ordered online.

episodes.title: Popatlal Ko Laga Jhatka
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal gets angry at Bhide for being carefree about the accidents at the Gokuldham Society. How will the members of Gokuldham solve this new issue?

episodes.title: Madhvi Ki Keemti Saree
episodes.synopsis: Madhvi informs Bhide that her brother, Vinayak, will be coming over with his family. Bhide gets distracted and burns Madhvi's saree by accident.

episodes.title: Bhide Gets Caught
episodes.synopsis: Bhide is in a hurry to leave, but the people of Gokuldham keep coming in his way. Bhide has to hide as he runs into Madhvi and Sonu at the market.

episodes.title: Bhide Looks For A New Saree
episodes.synopsis: A tailor suggests to Bhide that the best option he has is to buy the same saree. Bhide asks Taarak to help him find the saree.

episodes.title: Bhide Goes Saree Shopping
episodes.synopsis: Bhide tries to find the same saree at the shops in the mall. Meanwhile, Madhvi calls Bhide, asking him about her saree.

episodes.title: Bhide Gets The Saree
episodes.synopsis: Bhide buys a replica of Madhvi's Saree from a shop. He sneaks in with the saree and hides it in the cupboard.

episodes.title: Mama Mami Ka Swagat
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and his family finally welcome Madhvi's brother to their house. Everyone notices that Madhvi's saree is different. Will Bhide come clean?

episodes.title: Bhide's Confession And Punishment
episodes.synopsis: Sonu recites the poem she wrote for her Mama and Mami. Bhide confesses that it was him who burned Madhvi's saree.

episodes.title: An Invitation From Big B
episodes.synopsis: Big B calls Asit Kumarr Modi and invites every member of the Gokuldham Society to play KBC. Asit relays the message to Bhide so he can inform everyone to get ready.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Ke Liye Khushkhabri
episodes.synopsis: With Asit Kumarr Modi arriving in Gokuldham Society, what news is he bringing along with him, that has the interest of all the members?

episodes.title: KBC Se Invitation
episodes.synopsis: Asit Ji announces that Gokuldham Society members have been invited to participate in Kaun Banega Crorepati. The society members can't control their excitement at the thought of participating in such a huge show and meeting Big B personally.

episodes.title: Yuva Unstoppable Foundation At Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: The members of the Gokuldham Society return home after their gameplay on the hot seat and congratulate each other. Everyone welcomes the people from Yuva Unstoppable Foundation.

episodes.title: Gokuldham's Eligible Partner
episodes.synopsis: Shubh Mangal Marriage Bureau tells Popatlal that after his appearance on KBC, he has become the most eligible bachelor in the country. Abdul calls Popatlal to inform him that someone is coming over to see him.

episodes.title: Popatlal Ke Liye Do Rishte
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal takes it upon himself to disinfect his house so he can meet Gungun. He gets in trouble when another family stops him on his way to Bhide's house.

episodes.title: Do Rishton Mein Phasa Popatlal
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal drops the second family at Dr Hathi's house and meets Gungun, who is waiting at Bhide's house. Popatlal has to juggle between the two families before coming to a decision.

episodes.title: Popatlal Meets Sneha And Gungun
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal uses a ladder to get up and down Bhide's balcony to meet both families. Who will Popatlal choose, Sneha or Gungun?

episodes.title: Gungun's Father Faints
episodes.synopsis: It appears as Popatlal has made up his mind to marry Sneha, but when he declines Gungun's proposal, Gungun's father loses consciousness. How will this change Popatlal's selection criteria?

episodes.title: No Shaadi For Popatlal
episodes.synopsis: Both families leave Gokuldham Society, revealing that they just wanted to invite the members of the Gokuldham Society to Sneha and Gungun's wedding. A furious Popatlal is calmed down by the Mahila Mandal with their optimism.

episodes.title: Toofani Astrologer
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal, already on the edge, sends a family home, who genuinely came with a marriage proposal. Fuming with anger, he calls his boss and asks him about the astrologer who works for their paper.

episodes.title: Popatlal Meets A Vastu Expert
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal explains to Bhide, Madhvi and Komal the reason for his happiness. Popatlal welcomes Sanjana, a Vastu expert, to the Gokuldham Society.

episodes.title: Giving The Sherwani Away
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal, happy about getting rid of his cursed sherwani, is surprised by his pandit, who delivers his sherwani back to him. Popatlal appoints Tapu Sena to gift his sherwani to an unmarried guy.

episodes.title: Getting Rid Of The Sherwani
episodes.synopsis: All the members of the Gokuldham Society get angry at Popatlal for throwing his sherwani on Bhide. When Bhide calls to confront him about his behaviour, Popatlal asks Bhide to get rid of the sherwani.

episodes.title: Popatlal Ki Sherwani Hai
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal reveals that it was his sherwani, which angers other members of the society. Taarak throws a badminton challenge to Anjali hoping to eat the best street food.

episodes.title: Anjali Finds The Bills
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal brings a hot breakfast for his friends and invites them to his house. Anjali finds a hotel bill amongst Taarak's things and seeks Babita's help to find answers.

episodes.title: Goli's Secret Mission
episodes.synopsis: After feeling betrayed, Anjali decides to spy on Taarak. She bribes Goli to click a picture of Taarak eating in a hotel during his lunch break. Will Goli, the spy, accomplish his mission?

episodes.title: Khiladi Diet Plan
episodes.synopsis: Anjali takes the help of Mahila Mandal with her husband's diet problem. Babita takes Anjali to a reputed dietician, who suggests a 'Khiladi Diet' for Taarak.

episodes.title: Diet Plan Shuru
episodes.synopsis: After having a delicious meal cooked by Anjali, Taarak meets his friends at the soda shop. The next day Anjali surprises Taarak and Jethalal with a special halwa.

episodes.title: Taarak Doesn't Like His Surprise
episodes.synopsis: Anjali reveals her surprise and gets into a fight with Taarak in Jethalal's presence. Goli feels responsible for the fight between the Mehtas and meets Taarak to apologise to him.

episodes.title: Taarak's Special Tiffin
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal asks for more time when Taarak calls him seeking help to quench his appetite for delicious food. Taarak's boss forces him to exchange tiffins so he can get out of eating diet food.

episodes.title: Taarak Gets Tired Of His Diet
episodes.synopsis: Taarak tries to seek everyone's help to find better food without Anjali finding out about it. Anjali gets worried when Taarak does not return home in time.

episodes.title: Taarak Found In A Kabristan
episodes.synopsis: All members of the Gokuldham Society put their heads together to find Taarak. Taarak arrives late in the night in a rickshaw from a cemetery. What was he doing at the cemetery?

episodes.title: Karele Wali Ki Jaan
episodes.synopsis: Taarak comes to his senses when he hears the mention of 'karela'. He narrates the story of the 'karela wali' he met on his way home.

episodes.title: Karele Ka Bhoot
episodes.synopsis: The Mahila Mandal joins forces to help Anjali take care of Taarak. An eerie vibe takes over Gokuldham as everyone starts having visions of a ghost in the society.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Mein Bhoot Ka Darr
episodes.synopsis: Everyone leaves for their home after Taarak has a good homecooked dinner and takes his medicine. The ghost story told by Taarak gives birth to fear in everyone's mind. How will the members of Gokuldham Society overcome their fears?

episodes.title: Taarak Celebrates With Tapu Sena
episodes.synopsis: The Mahila Mandal, worried about Taarak, asks Anjali to give him his favourite delicacies till he gets better. Taarak celebrates with Tapu Sena after their plan succeeds.

episodes.title: Karele Ka Kuan
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena and Taarak enjoy their moment of victory by having some delicious food. As Anjali prays to god to help her family, Taarak worries that soon his lies will be caught.

episodes.title: Taarak's Day Off
episodes.synopsis: Anjali calls Taarak's boss and asks him to give her husband the day off. The dietician arrives at Gokuldham Society to check on the Mehtas.

episodes.title: Psychiatrist For Taarak
episodes.synopsis: Taarak sees a cart carrying 'karela' into the Gokuldham Society and loses his composure. Dr Hathi calls a psychiatrist to help with Taarak's condition. What is wrong with Taarak?

episodes.title: Meeting For Taarak's Health
episodes.synopsis: All members of the Gokuldham Society meet to find a solution for Taarak's condition. After the psychiatrist fails to help, Babita suggests taking help from a Baba.

episodes.title: Taarak Fears The Shock Treatment
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena tries to convince Bhide and Bapuji to stop the Baba from coming to Gokuldham. The Mahila Mandal visits the Mehtas to support them by getting some food for Taarak.

episodes.title: Baba Bhagayega Bhoot
episodes.synopsis: Bhide lies to his customers, neighbours and students to keep the news of Taarak's 'bhoot' coming out. Choodi Wala Baba makes his preparations to help exorcise the ghost inside Taarak.

episodes.title: Baba Ki Rasmein
episodes.synopsis: The 'Choodi Wale Baba' performs his rituals to exorcise the ghost inside Taarak. Taarak and Tapu Sena struggle to find a way out from the mess they have gotten themselves in.

episodes.title: Bottle Khul Chuki Hai
episodes.synopsis: The Baba claims that Madhavi is now hosting the spirit of Suryamukhi. He later explains to everyone how he is going to exorcise the ghost inside Taarak.

episodes.title: Taarak's Scam
episodes.synopsis: Taarak sends everyone in shock when he reveals that he has been acting all along. Bapuji accuses Jethalal of being an accomplice in Taarak's drama. Taarak apologises to everyone for fooling them over the last few days.

episodes.title: Anjali Is Heartbroken
episodes.synopsis: The Choodi Wale Baba reveals that it was just an act that he performed as directed by Anjali. The members of the Gokuldham Society help Taarak and Anjali to solve their diet problem.

episodes.title: Taarak Makes Things Right
episodes.synopsis: To redeem Gokuldham's image, Popatlal tells everyone that he wants to publish the truth about Taarak. Anjali reminds her husband that he has to deal with his boss, whom he spooked earlier.

episodes.title: Preparation For A Potential Client
episodes.synopsis: Bagha helps Jethalal get rid of the stiffness in his body by helping him stretch. They decide to decorate the godown, to make it presentable for hosting an important client meeting.

episodes.title: Jethalal's Sleepless Night
episodes.synopsis: Anxious about his client meeting, Jethalal has trouble falling asleep. He takes his father's blessings and meets his Gokuldham friends before leaving for his godown.

episodes.title: Godown Ki Chaabi
episodes.synopsis: Bagha and Jethalal arrive at the godown early in the morning only to realise that they do not have the keys to the door. Jethalal reaches home and finds out that Bapuji isn't there. Will Jethalal reach his godown in time?

episodes.title: Bapuji Aur Jethalal Ka Miscommunication
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal reaches his godown to find that Bapuji is waiting with the keys in the Gokuldham Society. Bhide agrees to help by offering to drive Bapuji to the godown.

episodes.title: Sakharam Gets Stopped By The Police
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and Bapuji get in trouble when a lady gets hit by Sakharam. Jethalal starts getting anxious as he can't enter the godown, and the time for his meeting ticks closer.

episodes.title: Harr Disha Se Museebat
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji fails to find Bagha in the meeting spot and goes looking around for him. Bagha finds Bhide, who gets fined again for breaking the traffic rules while searching for Bapuji.

episodes.title: Bapuji Welcomes The Client
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and Bhide rush back to Gokuldham to check if Bapuji returned home. Jethalal comes back to the godown to find Bapuji and his client having a good time.

episodes.title: Order Mila Bapuji Ki Wajah Se
episodes.synopsis: Mr Goyal gets extremely happy to spend time with Bapuji and tells Jethalal that he will be given all the orders. The men of the Gokuldham Society meet at the soda shop and discuss who amongst them should leave the society.

episodes.title: Jethalal Ka Important Email
episodes.synopsis: Bagha calls Jethalal to inform him that they failed to read their work emails today. However, Bagha fails to relay the message which makes Jethalal lose his mind.

episodes.title: More Orders For Gada Electronics
episodes.synopsis: Babita informs Jethalal that her friend will visit his shop later. Jethalal promises his friends a party after he finalises a new deal that is coming his way.

episodes.title: Jethalal's Party Confirmed
episodes.synopsis: Bagha calls Jethalal to the godown early, so nothing goes wrong in their meeting. With time in their hands, Jethalal, Taarak and Sodhi decide to have a lavish breakfast.

episodes.title: Jethalal Ki Imandari
episodes.synopsis: The members of Gokuldham, worried about Jethalal, call to check on him. Jethalal's meeting with the Wow Resort's manager goes south when he puts forward an unreasonable demand.

episodes.title: Jethalal Ki A1 Soch
episodes.synopsis: Wow Resort's manager reveals that he was testing the kind of businessman Jethalal is and finalises the deal. Jethalal takes all his friends on a conference call to give them the good news.

episodes.title: Party Kab Aur Kaha Hogi
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and Bagha prepare the godown to welcome his Gokuldham friends. Soon, everyone arrives at the godown to discuss when and where to organise Jethalal's success party.

episodes.title: Party Location Fixed
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal agrees to host Jethalal's success party at his flat but puts forward a condition. Everyone tries to find a way to convince their wives to allow them for a boys' night out.

episodes.title: Jethalal's Mission Permission
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal returns to the society early so he can take permission from Komal and Madhvi for the party. Will he manage to convince them to allow their husbands for a night out?

episodes.title: Mission Permission Ka Teesra Padhav
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal calls Bhide to tell him that Madhvi has permitted him to have a night out. However, everyone gets worried as Jethalal has to request Roshan and Babita, who are known to be very strict. Will mission permission be a success?

episodes.title: Mehfil-E-Jaam Mein Jaane Ki Ijaazat
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal returns to his godown being the bearer of bad news that Anjali has denied Taarak permission to attend the party. Taarak decides to call his beloved wife to get her permission in a different way. Will Jethalal and the gang get to celebrate his success together?

episodes.title: Party Sharty Ki Taiyari
episodes.synopsis: With everyone's wives permitting them to join the party, Jethalal orders an expensive bottle for them to enjoy. Now, the only thing that remains is Bapuji's permission.

episodes.title: Bapuji Is Fed Lies
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal lies to Bapuji and leaves for Popatlal's home to attend the party. However, Bapuji catches Jethalal in the society with the bottle of alcohol. Will the boys be able to party in peace?

episodes.title: Party Ka Maza
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal manages to sneak into Popatlal's house so they can begin their party. The Mahila Mandal sends an important video message to their husbands, who decided to party separately.

episodes.title: Party Ka Popat
episodes.synopsis: The men get excited and share poetry to get their party started. All their hopes go down the drain when Jethalal drops and breaks the bottle. Will they have the party that they worked so hard for?

episodes.title: Yeh Chappal Jethia Ki Chappal Jaisi Hai
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal confronts the male members of the society after hearing the commotion caused by Sodhi and Popatlal. With nowhere else to go for the party-sharty, Sodhi comes up with an idea, but will this plan work out?

episodes.title: Aur Risk Nahi Le Sakte
episodes.synopsis: The men of Gokuldham Society flee their party set up on the pavement when they hear the siren of a police car. The dejected men return to join the Mahila Mandal at their party.

episodes.title: Bagha's Attempt To Create A Diversion
episodes.synopsis: All the male members of the Gokuldham Society remain disheartened because of their failed plans. Later, Champaklal is on the verge of finding out about Jethalal's party sharty.

episodes.title: Bhide Aur Popatlal Ki Ladai
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal and Bhide argue with each other over garbage issues in society. Bhide plays a prank on Popatlal which angers him and he decides to take his revenge.

episodes.title: Popatlal Apologises To Bhide
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal apologises to Bhide in order to seek help regarding his KYC. Later, inspite of being asked to return home early by his mother, Goli takes several detours with Gogi.

episodes.title: A New Tappu Sena Member
episodes.synopsis: Gogi and Goli find a lost and homeless kitten in the park. With no other option in mind, they decide to take the kitten home for its safety. What will happen now?

episodes.title: House For Kitty
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena struggles to find a house for Kitty. They contemplate taking it to their house but are worried about how their parents will react. Will they find a house for Kitty?

episodes.title: Bad News Hain
episodes.synopsis: Goli's parents do not allow keeping Kitty at their house. Tapu and Sonu go to Popatlal's house with hopes. Will he keep Kitty at his house?

episodes.title: Tapu's Plan For Kitty
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena is looking for Kitty, but she is nowhere to be found. Tapu comes up with a plan to keep Kitty in the society, which involves convincing Bhide. Will Bhide get convinced?

episodes.title: Billi Ne Kiya Nuksaan
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and the other society members get annoyed at the fact that a cat was causing destruction to property in the colony and they look for the elusive cat. Meanwhile, the children of the society decide to let Kitty go before the adults get angry.

episodes.title: Box Hil Raha Hai
episodes.synopsis: Tapu scares Bhide, who entered the clubhouse while Goli, Gogi and Sonu try to sneak out a few items from their respective houses for Kitty. Will Tapu Sena succeed in hiding Kitty?

episodes.title: Abdul's Hunt For The Kitten
episodes.synopsis: Bhide questions Goli, Gogi and Sonu as they return to the clubhouse. Later, Goli tries to keep Abdul deviated, as he searches the clubhouse for the cat. Will Abdul find out about Pom Pom?

episodes.title: Abb Ladka Dekhne Nahi Jaa Sakte
episodes.synopsis: With Abdul on their side, Tapu Sena celebrates Pom Pom staying at the clubhouse. Later, the family that arrives at Gokuldham Society, to meet Popatlal, refuses to step any further after Pom Pom crosses their path.

episodes.title: Billi Ka Problem
episodes.synopsis: A worried Abdul tells Taarak and Anjali that Pom Pom, the kitten, has scared away Popatlal's guests. Tapu Sena hides her at their clubhouse. What will happen when Popatlal finds out?

episodes.title: Popatlal Ke Andar Ka Sher
episodes.synopsis: In the light of recent events, Popatlal forces Bhide to resign from the post of secretary. Everyone tries to calm Bhide and Popatlal, who won't stop fighting.

episodes.title: Bapuji's Cat Allergy
episodes.synopsis: With Popatlal hell-bent on getting rid of the cat, Tapu Sena comes up with a plan to save her. Popatlal suggests that they use Bapuji as a cat detector to find Pom Pom.

episodes.title: Billi Ka Darr
episodes.synopsis: Everyone at Gokuldham society is worried about the situation caused by the cat. Goli sneaks out in the middle of the night to check on Pom Pom.

episodes.title: Bhide Bhagayega Billi
episodes.synopsis: Dr Hathi and Komal wake up to realise that Goli is missing from the house. Abdul prevents Bhide from entering the clubhouse where Pom Pom is kept hidden by Tapu Sena.

episodes.title: Bhide Wants The Box
episodes.synopsis: Sonu calls Tapu to inform him that her father is on his way to get the box in which Pom Pom resides. Everyone believes Abdul's lie that Gokuldham is now cat-free. What will Tapu Sena do when their lies are caught?

episodes.title: Apshagun Kuch Nahi Hai
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal shows his appreciation for Bhide's quick action to make the society cat-free. Abdul and Tapu Sena worry about their situation after lying to the members of Gokuldham.

episodes.title: Chasing Pom Pom Around
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena frantically chases Pom Pom around Gokuldham Society. Pom Pom, who is in a playful mood, sneaks into one flat after another. Will it get caught?

episodes.title: Billi Ne Dilaya Sodhi Ko Gussa
episodes.synopsis: Pom Pom enters Sodhi's house and breaks his bottles, and eats Roshan's cupcakes. He gets furious and confronts Bhide and Abdul about the cat. Will Tapu Sena's lies get caught?

episodes.title: Billi Gokuldham Mein Hi Hai
episodes.synopsis: Everyone gets shocked when Popatlal informs them that his guests will soon arrive. Tapu Sena finds out that Pom Pom has made its way to Popatlal's house through the terrace.

episodes.title: Pom Pom In Popatlal's House
episodes.synopsis: With Popatlal out to find a bouquet for his guests, Pom Pom wreaks havoc in his house. Tapu Sena enlists Abdul's help to get into Popatlal's house to retrieve Pom Pom. Will they manage to hide Pom Pom before Popatlal returns?

episodes.title: Ladkiwalo Ka Swagat
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal asks Bhide to join him in welcoming his guests to the Gokuldham Society. Tapu Sena runs into multiple problems while looking for Pom Pom. Will Popatlal's meeting go smoothly?

episodes.title: Rishta Nikla Haath Se
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal's guests get furious when they spot Pom Pom and leave Gokuldham in anger. Popatlal feels betrayed and is out to get his revenge. Will Tapu Sena come forward with the truth?

episodes.title: Tapu Sena Ki Billi
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena tells everyone about how they adopted Pom Pom. Popatlal realises his anger is misdirected and expresses his gratitude to everyone for saving him from a superstitious family.

episodes.title: Pom Pom Ka Parivar
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham family band together to find Pom Pom so they can welcome her to the society. However, they find Pom Pom with a group of other cats and decide to let them be together.

episodes.title: Permission For Lonavala Trip
episodes.synopsis: Sonu gets scared to ask her father for permission to visit Lonavala with Tapu Sena. The men of the Gouldham Society meet at Abdul's shop and talk about Tapu Sena's absence from the society.

episodes.title: Bapuji Talks To Himself
episodes.synopsis: The men of the Gokuldham Society sit at the soda shop and discuss their lives. Bhide and Madhavi spot Bapuji talking to himself on his balcony.

episodes.title: Bapuji Ka Jigri
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji's childhood friend calls him out of the blue and invites him for a night out. Popatlal invites Jethalal, who will be alone, to his house for dinner.

episodes.title: Busy Day At Gada Electronics
episodes.synopsis: Bagha declines Babita's call on Jethalal's phone as he was preoccupied with a client call. Popatlal and Babita put Jethalal in a spot where he has to decide at whose house will he have dinner. Who will Jethalal choose?

episodes.title: Bapuji Goes Out To Party
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal comes home early to return Babita's mixer grinder and see Bapuji off. Jethalal and Popatlal enjoy a lavish feast together.

episodes.title: A Walk To Matka Shop
episodes.synopsis: Everyone takes an evening walk to visit a kulfi store after their dinner. Sodhi returns from his party and is desperate to tell Jethalal what he saw.

episodes.title: Sodhi Ka Sachh
episodes.synopsis: After Sodhi tells everyone what he saw, Jethalal refuses to believe him. Sodhi narrates everything that happened and tries to convince them.

episodes.title: No One Believes Sodhi
episodes.synopsis: When no one believes his story, Sodhi convinces everyone to sniff Bapuji to find out the truth. After finding no trace of alcohol from Bapuji, the members of the society force Sodhi to apologise.

episodes.title: Party Sharty Ke Lakshan
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji complains about a headache and acidity to Jethalal. All the men of Gokuldham Society gather at Jethalal's house to take care of Bapuji.

episodes.title: Bapuji Gets Left Alone
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal has to leave Bapuji alone as he has to visit Pune for a client meeting. Bapuji forces him to stay in Pune for the night. What could Bapuji be up to?

episodes.title: Following Bapuji
episodes.synopsis: To prove he is right, Sodhi and Popatlal decide to follow Bapuji. After witnessing Bapuji's actions, Sodhi and Popatlal refuse to believe their eyes.

episodes.title: Bapuji Doing Party Sharty
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi and Popatlal follow Bapuji into a bar. They call everyone so that they can see the truth with their own eyes.

episodes.title: Recording Bapuji's Actions
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi and Popatlal tell everyone what they saw at the bar. They hide in the garden and record Bapuji entering the society in a drunken state.

episodes.title: Proof Against Bapuji
episodes.synopsis: The men of Gokuldham worry about how to break the news of Bapuji's night out to Jethalal. Jethalal returns from his meeting and suspects that all his friends are hiding something from him.

episodes.title: Toofaan Aa Gaya Hai
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal returns from his client meeting in Pune to discover that Bapuji is still unwell. Taarak gathers everyone at Popatlal's house so they can plan and break the news of Bapuji's nightly escapades to Jethalal.

episodes.title: Beta Baap Ko Kaise Toke?
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal gets shocked when he finds out about Bapuji's drinking habit. Everyone discusses how they can help Bapuji get rid of his addiction.

episodes.title: Jethalal Fails To Confront Bapuji
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal struggles to confront Bapuji about his drinking habit. He goes back to his friends, seeking help for the same.

episodes.title: Sodhi Ka Secret Plan
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi locks Jethalal in a room and comes up with a secret plan to confront Bapuji. The Mahila Mandal gets shocked when they find out about Bapuji's activities.

episodes.title: Sodhi's Plan Backfires
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji introduces his childhood friends to the Purush Mandal and comes clean about his actions. All of Jethalal's friends try to keep Bapuji away from a drunk Jethalal.

episodes.title: Jethalal In Trouble
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji clears all the confusion about his newfound habit. However, the issue of a drunk Jethalal still persists. Can Jethalal's friends get him out of this mess before Bapuji finds out?

episodes.title: Jethalal Back To His Senses
episodes.synopsis: Dr Hathi gets medicine for Jethalal that will bring him back to his senses. Bapuji gets extremely angry at the Purush Mandal for handling the situation poorly. How will everyone manage to calm Bapuji?

episodes.title: Bapuji's Social Service
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji clears everyone's misunderstanding about his nightly escapades. The Purush Mandal apologises to Bapuji for accusing him of drinking without confronting him.

episodes.title: Godown Mein Chori
episodes.synopsis: Sonu returns from her Lonavala trip bearing gifts for her parents. Jethalal tells about his eventful day to his friends while sipping soda at Abdul's shop.

episodes.title: False Alarm
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal apologises to Inspector Pandey for the misinformation he had, due to which he had to call the police. To bring about some change, Jethalal decides to prepare soda for his friends by himself.

episodes.title: Bhangaar Wala Aya
episodes.synopsis: Everyone at Gokuldham is dealing with the problem of having too much old stuff at home. Bhola Bhai comes to the rescue to collect the 'Bhangaar' from everyone's homes.

episodes.title: Amulya Virasat
episodes.synopsis: Bhide stops Madhavi from giving away his prized possession to the 'bhangar wala'. When Jethalal brings Bhide's old music system for repair, Bagha gets worried about the situation.

episodes.title: Sargam Orchestra Repaired
episodes.synopsis: Bagha tells Jethalal how he managed to repair Bhide's tape recorder. Bhide asks Abdul to gather everyone at the clubhouse so they can enjoy some old music together.

episodes.title: The Tape Recorder Works
episodes.synopsis: When Bhide tries to turn on his music system, it does not work. Bagha uses all his skills to figure out the problem so everyone can sing and dance to old Bollywood music.

episodes.title: Golden Memories
episodes.synopsis: The members of Gokuldham Society continue to enjoy old Bollywood songs at the clubhouse. Everyone appreciates the soulful music of that era.

episodes.title: Dancing To Old Songs
episodes.synopsis: The members of Gokuldham Society continue to sing along and dance to their favourite old songs. They reminisce and talk about the famous singers and songwriters of the yesteryears.

episodes.title: Music Ka Dose
