episodes.synopsis: All members of the Gokuldham Society thank Bhide for a memorable musical night. Everyone returns home in a happy and fun mood.

episodes.title: Nimbu Ki Keemat
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji watches the news to find out that the price of lemons has shot up. Meanwhile, Bhide receives an order for lime pickles. How will Bhide manage to complete this order?

episodes.title: Life Gives No Lemons
episodes.synopsis: Bhide reaches a dead end while trying to procure the money that his clients owe him. Meanwhile, everyone at Gokuldham society struggles to find lemons. Will Bhide and Madhvi manage to fulfil the order?

episodes.title: Bappa Ki Delivery
episodes.synopsis: Bhide, under immense stress, almost runs over Popatlal with his Sakharam. Later, a mysterious delivery van drops three sacks at Bhide's residence. What could it be?

episodes.title: Lemons For Bhide
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal advises Bhide to get rid of the lemons before he gets in trouble with the police for hoarding them. Madhvi realises that the delivery of the lemons was meant for them.

episodes.title: Nimbu Wali Lottery
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and Madhvi decide to sell the remaining lemons at a lower price. They fail to find a suitable buyer for the large number of lemons they have left. Who will buy them?

episodes.title: Nimbu Ka Kya Karein?
episodes.synopsis: After Jethalal finds out that Bagha is planning to sell lemons, they quickly return them to Bhide before getting in trouble for hoarding. Bhide gets worried about what to do with the lemons. Will he find a solution?

episodes.title: Finding Buyers
episodes.synopsis: Bhide goes on a calling spree, trying to find a buyer for his lemons. However, most people either don't believe him or aren't interested in his offer. Will Bhide manage to get rid of the stock of lemons?

episodes.title: Deal With A Jamakhor
episodes.synopsis: As Bhide goes to meet the mysterious man who is interested in buying his entire stock of lemons, he gets stopped by the police. The police try to arrest him first but soon realise that the main culprit here is the 'Jamakhor' who called Bhide. Can they nab this public hoarder?

episodes.title: Catching The Jamakhor
episodes.synopsis: After Guddu Khatila dodges the police, he provokes Sodhi and Bhide. Guddu's men try to catch Sodhi and Bhide to get revenge on them for calling the police. Will Inspector Pandey arrive in time to save them?

episodes.title: Thought Of The Day
episodes.synopsis: The Purush Mandal enjoys a glass of lemon soda at Abdul's shop. Jethalal reminds Bhide about writing the thought of the day on the board.

episodes.title: Madhvi Gets Upset
episodes.synopsis: Bhide angers Madhvi with his antics. Popatlal arrives at Bhide's house and offers him to help cheer Madhvi up. However, Bhide refuses and decides to turn Madhvi's frown into a smile by himself.

episodes.title: Group Shopping
episodes.synopsis: The Mahila Mandal shops for vegetables together at the cart in the morning. They get excited after hearing Bhide's plan to shop at the mall and try to convince their husbands to take them to the sale. Will the Purush Mandal agree?

episodes.title: Notice For Bhide
episodes.synopsis: All the couples of Gokuldham Society get together and set out to shop at the mall. A postman shows up at the society looking for Bhide. Will Bhide arrive in time to collect his letter?

episodes.title: Popatlal Ki Galat Information
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal joins Babita and Iyer for breakfast. They find out that the marriage bureau had the wrong information about Popatlal. How will Popatlal handle the situation?

episodes.title: Popatlal Ka Toota Phone
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal takes Bhide's help to rush to Jethalal's shop so he can get his phone repaired. Bagha helps with a replacement phone for Popatlal. Will Popatlal receive the call he has been waiting for?

episodes.title: Waiting For Pratiksha
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal gets tired of waiting for Pratiksha and asks the marriage bureau for her contact number. To kill time, Popatlal reads Pratiskha's bio with Tapu Sena.

episodes.title: Pratiksha Ka Invitation
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal gets an invitation from Pratiksha to meet her. He requests all his friends to get dressed in yellow and come along with him.

episodes.title: Rishte Ka Dress Code
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal convinces everyone at Gokuldham to get dressed in a dress code. Everyone wears yellow and gets ready to meet Pratiksha and her family.

episodes.title: Searching For Pratiksha
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi arranges a minibus for the Gokuldham members to travel together to Pratiksha's house. However, they face some difficulty in finding where she lives. Will they manage to find her?

episodes.title: Meeting Pratiksha's Family
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham members are greeted by Mr Puri's secretary. Everyone introduces themselves to Pratiksha's family.

episodes.title: Popatlal Meets Pratiksha
episodes.synopsis: Babita suggests that Popatlal and Pratiksha should talk to each other in private. Jethalal gives his phone number to Mr Puri before the Gokuldam family takes their leave.

episodes.title: Popatlal Gets Anxious
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal expresses his gratitude to everyone for accompanying him. He has trouble falling asleep as he feels anxious about the Puri family's thoughts about him.

episodes.title: Popatlal Ki Neend
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal wakes Sodhi and Bhide as he is unable to sleep due to a dog barking. Sodhi arranges for a medicine that will help Popatlal to sleep.

episodes.title: Popatlal Kaha Hai?
episodes.synopsis: The colony members are excited to get Popatlal ready for his meeting with his to-be wife. Popatlal however, isn't opening his door nor is he answering his phone. Where could Popatlal be?

episodes.title: Popatlal Gayab Hai
episodes.synopsis: Everyone gathers in Jethalal's house to wait for Mr Puri's phone call. However, Popatlal is nowhere to be found. Where could he be?

episodes.title: Rishte Ke Liye Haan Hai
episodes.synopsis: The Puri family calls Popatlal to tell him that they want Pratiksha to get married to him. However, they also reveal a shocking fact about Pratiksha's past. Will Popatlal look past it and accept the Puri family's proposal?

episodes.title: Shagun Dene Ki Taiyari
episodes.synopsis: All members of the Gokuldham Society get ready to meet the Puri family and give them the shagun. Sodhi arranges a bus for the Gokuldham family to travel together.

episodes.title: Pratiksha Se Sawal
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham family makes a grand entry into the Puri family's mansion. After Pratiksha shows up, Popatlal asks her an important question. What answer will Popatlal receive?

episodes.title: Pratiksha Ka Pyar
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal reveals that he knows who Pratiksha is in love with. He later asks Pratiksha to give her final decision. Will Popatlal receive the answer he wants to hear?

episodes.title: Twist In The Tale
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal gets in touch with Pratiksha's ex-husband and informs him about the wedding. What drama will unfold when Paresh lands up at the venue?

episodes.title: Pratiksha Aur Paresh Ka Milan
episodes.synopsis: With Popatlal and Bapuji's help, Pratiksha and Paresh reconcile their love. Babita and Anjali play a friendly game of badminton.

episodes.title: Jethalal And Babita's Badminton Match
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and Babita's badminton match begins. Jethalal reaches home late and finds Bapuji sleeping on the couch.

episodes.title: Bhide's Mango Consignment
episodes.synopsis: Bhide receives a consignment of mangoes. He distributes it among his friends for everyone to enjoy.

episodes.title: Rumours About Gada Electronics
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal finds out that the daily newspaper did not get delivered in the morning. Later, he gets a piece of annoying news about his shop. What could it be about?

episodes.title: Contractor Gives The Good News
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal shares his worries about his shop with Sodhi, Bhide and Popatlal. Later, when Jethalal meets his contractor, he receives a piece of good news. What could it be?

episodes.title: Meeting Pandit Ji
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal invites a famous astrologer to help him find the most auspicious time to re-open his shop. What suggestions will this astrologer give?

episodes.title: Inauguration Ki Taiyyari
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal invites friends and family over for the re-opening of his shop. Will everything go smooth for Jethalal?

episodes.title: Sundar's Promise
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is excited about his shop's reopening and invites all his neighbours and friends. Meanwhile, Sundar promises to bring Daya back to the colony for the reopening.

episodes.title: Kya Daya Ka Aana Cancel?
episodes.synopsis: Sundar gets into a dilemma as he struggles to gather the courage and tell Jethalal that Daya won't be turning up for the inauguration. Meanwhile, a famous newspaper editor pays a visit to Gokuldham society.

episodes.title: Mehmaano Ko Aamantran
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal invites all his friends and asks them to get to the venue on time. Meanwhile, Bagha creates a special list for Jethalal to personally call and invite. Will they accept his invitation?

episodes.title: Jethalal Ke Liye Gift
episodes.synopsis: The members of Gokuldham try to think of a thoughtful gift for Jethalal on the occasion of his shop's reopening. What will they get him?

episodes.title: Dukaan Ready Hogayi
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal gives an invitation to all his friends for the reopening of his shop. Meanwhile, Sundar comes up with a plan to get Daya for the shop reopening. How will he manage that?

episodes.title: Daya Bhabhi Ka Intezaar
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal eagerly waits for his wife and can't contain his excitement. Can Sundar deliver his promise?

episodes.title: Daya Ki Chitthi
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal comes to know that Daya won't be coming to Gokuldham for the shop's reopening. How will Jethalal react to this heartbreaking news?

episodes.title: Inauguration Ka Josh
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham society members are elated and excited to be a part of the reopening of Gada Electronics. Will the event go as planned?

episodes.title: Bapuji Hue Gayab
episodes.synopsis: Bhide tells Jethalal that he is unable to find Bapuji in the temple. Jethalal decides to report to Inspector Pandey that Bapuji has gone missing. Where could Bapuji have gone?

episodes.title: New Shop Opened
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji inaugurates the renovated Gada Electronics shop in the nick of time as everyone celebrates Jethalal's happiness.

episodes.title: New Shop New Beginning
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal apologises to Inspector Pandey for failing to inform him that Bapuji wasn't missing. Jethalal and Bagha get excited to begin working in their new shop.

episodes.title: Sundar's Business Proposal
episodes.synopsis: Sundar gives Jethalal a business proposition. How will Jethalal respond to the proposal?

episodes.title: Goli Ne Todi Jethalal Ki Khidki
episodes.synopsis: Goli accidentally breaks Jethalal's window while playing cricket. Will Jethalal get consumed in anger or forgive Tapu Sena?

episodes.title: Jethalal Surprises Tapu Sena
episodes.synopsis: To cheer Tapu Sena after the accident in the morning, Jethalal surprises them with a thoughtful gift. They return the favour by treating Jethalal with his favourite savouries.

episodes.title: Dost Ki Help
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal's friend asks him for financial help, which he agrees to provide. However, Jethalal finds out that he does not have that money with him. How will he help his friend?

episodes.title: Cheque Nahi Cash
episodes.synopsis: Bagha collects five lakh rupees cash from Mr Deepak and gets it to the shop safely. However, Bapuji informs Jethalal that they have to leave early for a birthday party.

episodes.title: Peti Ke Andar Peti
episodes.synopsis: Bagha takes the help of Magan to secure the cash kept at the shop. However, Bagha's troubles get doubled as Jethalal gets stuck at a birthday party.

episodes.title: Gada Electronics Mein Chor
episodes.synopsis: Jaggu wakes Jethalal in the middle of the night to tell him that someone is trying to rob his shop. How will Jethalal save his shop?

episodes.title: Pandey Ji Ka Case
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Pandey makes sure that he has all the information before taking any action. Will he manage to solve the case?

episodes.title: Nattu Kaka Ka Hukkum
episodes.synopsis: The thief reveals that he was ordered by Nattu Kaka to help Jethalal. After Jethalal requests Inspector Pandey to let the thief go, Pandey Ji decides never to accept any case from the residents of Gokuldham Society.

episodes.title: Naye Nattu Kaka Ka Swagat
episodes.synopsis: The new Nattu Kaka is the first to arrive at the shop and makes a grand entry. Jethalal and Bagha welcome him to their family with open arms.

episodes.title: Soda Ka Main Sponsor
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal treats all his friends to a soda party at Abdul's shop. Popatlal catches Bhide for not being able to come up with a thought for the day.

episodes.title: Bittu Kaun Hai?
episodes.synopsis: Everyone discusses what should be an appropriate thought for the day. A mysterious boy enters the Gokuldham Society and claims to know Sodhi. Who could it be?

episodes.title: Bittu Ki Mushkilein
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi raises his concerns about Bittu's suspicious behaviour. Bittu opens up about the troubles he is facing at school and home. How will Sodhi deal with the situation?

episodes.title: Bittu Ki Zimmedari
episodes.synopsis: Bittu threatens to run away if he gets forced to continue studying. He later helps Sodhi at his garage. Has Bittu found his passion?

episodes.title: Bittu's Day Out
episodes.synopsis: Nattu Kaka comes up with a marketing plan to increase sales for Gada electronics. Meanwhile, Sodhi takes Tapu Sena and Bittu to a mall.

episodes.title: Bittu Ka Future
episodes.synopsis: Due to the rains, Bhide shifts the soda meeting to the clubhouse. Bhide convinces everyone to take responsibility for helping Bittu. Will they succeed?

episodes.title: Bittu Ki Counselling
episodes.synopsis: After Bittu runs away, Sodhi takes Goli's help to track and find him. Everyone sits with Bittu and tries to counsel him. Will he understand what the grown-ups have to say?

episodes.title: Kya Bittu Ko Ayegi Samajh?
episodes.synopsis: The colony members are worried about Bittu running away due to his hatred towards studying. Will Bittu be found and will he finally realise the importance of education?

episodes.title: Bittu Ko Aayi Samajh
episodes.synopsis: Bittu finally realises his mistakes and agrees to concentrate on his studies. Meanwhile, his parents come and are shocked to see the difference in their son.

episodes.title: Popatlal Ke Gehne
episodes.synopsis: The society members struggle to keep up with the rising cost of living in the city. Popatlal receives a call from the bank asking him to clear his locker and take his belongings before the branch shuts down.

episodes.title: Locker Ki Talaash
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal lives a paranoid life because of not having a locker for his jewellery. Can the Gokuldham residents find him a locker?

episodes.title: Popatlal's Paranoia
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal spends sleepless nights in his house thinking about his jewellery's safety. He finally comes to the conclusion that he must keep the box in one of his neighbour's houses.

episodes.title: Sirf Ek Zimmedar Aadmi
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal decides to keep the jewellery box at Bhide's house. However, Bhide later finds out that Popatlal is going out of town. Will Bhide be able to keep the jewellery safe?

episodes.title: Popatlal Ki Amanat
episodes.synopsis: Bhide gets paranoid after getting Popatlal's jewellery and desperately looks for someone else to pass on the responsibility. Who will he find?

episodes.title: Popatlal Ke Zewar Hue Idhar Se Udhar
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal tries to pass on the responsibility of the jewellery by giving the box to Babita. Will Popatlal's jewellery get mishandled?

episodes.title: Gehno Ki Zimmedari Kaun Le?
episodes.synopsis: Babita passes on the responsibility of the jewellery to Anjali, as she and Iyer have to go somewhere. Will Anjali keep the box or will the exchange of hands continue?

episodes.title: Kya Sodhi Sambhaal Payega Zewar?
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal's jewellery ends up at Sodhi's house. However, due to an emergency, Sodhi has to rush to his garage. Will the box be safe at Sodhi's house?

episodes.title: Popatlal Asks For His Amanat
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal returns after finishing his work and thanks Bhide for keeping his jewellery safely. How will he react when he finds out the truth?

episodes.title: Getting The Box Back
episodes.synopsis: Everyone tries to get Popatlal's box back from the person they gave it to. Jethalal begins to get a bad feeling about the jewellery box. Will his fears come true?

episodes.title: Popatlal Ka Dabba Gayab
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi and his wife realise that they have messed up and given away the box of jewellery to Abdul without informing him what's in it. Can the Sodhis recover the box?

episodes.title: Society Mein Tension
episodes.synopsis: All the residents of Gokuldham society panic as they start blaming each other for the missing Jewellery box. Can they manage to find the box and return it to Popatlal?

episodes.title: Popatlal Ka Darr
episodes.synopsis: Bhide panics at the thought of Popatlal finding out that he has lost his jewellery box, but the society members reassure him that they all will take responsibility for the mistake. Will they find the jewellery or face Popatlal's wrath?

episodes.title: Phas Gaya Bhide
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and Jethalal make excuses in front of Popatlal to delay giving the box. Will Popatlal fall for their lies?

episodes.title: Popatlal Ka Sona
episodes.synopsis: The society members are shocked to see Popatlal with Sodhi's party sharty bag with the jewellery in it. How did Popatlal get his hands on it?

episodes.title: Dabba Khali Hai
episodes.synopsis: After everyone finds the empty jewellery box, they call Bhide to ensure it contains jewellery. How will the members of Gokuldham find the jewellery?

episodes.title: Tapu Sena Distracts Popatlal
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and Sodhi take Tapu Sena's help to distract Popatlal. The members of Gokuldham meet Inspector Pandey and tell him about the theft.

episodes.title: Gehno Ke Saath Kho Kho
episodes.synopsis: The members of Gokuldham Society give Inspector Pandey a list of suspects in the robbery. The police are quick to respond and round up the suspects. Will they find Popatlal's jewellery?

episodes.title: Sabke Ghar Ki Talashi
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Pandey's investigation reveals that the suspects are not guilty of the theft. He insists on checking every household of the Gokuldham members. What will he find?

episodes.title: Jethalal Pakkda Gaya
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal gets arrested when Popatlal's jewellery is found at his house. Everyone apologises to Inspector Pandey and requests him to let Jethalal go.

episodes.title: Locker Ka Intezaam
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena is surprised to hear about the gold being recovered at Jethalal's home. Meanwhile, Jethalal arranges a locker for Popatlal.

episodes.title: Bhide Ke Liye Cheque
episodes.synopsis: Bhide receives a piece of good news early in the morning. He decides to surprise his family and take Sodhi's help.

episodes.title: Goli Spoils Bhide's Surprise
episodes.synopsis: Goli tells Tapu Sena about Bhide's plan to buy a car. When Sonu does not believe the news, they plan to put on a disguise to follow Sodhi and Bhide to find out the truth.

episodes.title: Bhide Ki Choices
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi takes Bhide to a used car shop to look at all the cars that fall into his budget. Goli and Pinku follow them around to find the truth. Which car will Bhide choose?

episodes.title: Surprise Bani News
episodes.synopsis: Sonu does not believe Goli when he tells her that Bhide has bought a car. Goli also lets Popatlal know about Bhide's surprise. How will Popatlal react?

episodes.title: Surprise Hua Fail
episodes.synopsis: Everyone gathers at Popatlal's house to discuss Bhide's surprise. Jethalal returns home and lets Bapuji in on the news.

episodes.title: Har Ghar Tiranga
episodes.synopsis: Bhide can't wait to surprise his family with the new car, but how will his family react to this? Meanwhile, Tapu Sena plans on putting the 'Tiranga' in every house.

episodes.title: Gadi Ka Welcome
episodes.synopsis: The members of Gokuldham Society make preparations to welcome Bhide's new car. Bhide and Sodhi get shocked when they see the car enter the society. What could have gone wrong?

episodes.title: Bhide Reveals His Surprise
episodes.synopsis: Bhide shocks everyone by telling them that he was only helping a friend buy a car. Soon, Bhide reveals his real surprise for his wife and daughter. Later, the members of Gokuldham gather to celebrate 75 years of independence.

episodes.title: Roshan Out Of Town
episodes.synopsis: Roshan goes out of town to meet her family but warns Sodhi not to do 'party-sharty' at home. Will Sodhi go behind her back and break the rules?

episodes.title: Celebrating Nowruz
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham society members get together and celebrate Nowruz with Roshan. Meanwhile, Sodhi and his friends contemplate their 'party-sharty' plan.

episodes.title: Sodhi Ki Party
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi plans a party with his friends in Roshan's absence. Will he get caught?

episodes.title: Nowruz Ki Khushiya
episodes.synopsis: Roshan finally gets to know about Sodhi's elaborate plan and how everyone was involved in it. Later, the entire colony prays for each other's well-being.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Ki Janmashtami
episodes.synopsis: The members of Gokuldham society make preparations to celebrate Janmashtami. Will everything go smooth?

episodes.title: Dahi Handi Time
episodes.synopsis: The members of the Gokuldham colony are excited to start the 'Dahi handi' proceedings. Will everything go smooth?

episodes.title: Govinda Aala
episodes.synopsis: Things get competitive in the Gokuldham colony as all the participants try to break the Handi. Who will win the competition?

episodes.title: Goli Ka Prank
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji is starving and asks Jethalal to order food for him, but Jethalal informs him that Komal would be sending them breakfast. However, when the breakfast arrives, Jethalal gets shocked to see the contents.

episodes.title: Khush Khabri For Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal gets frustrated with Bagha and Nattu Kaka when they delay giving him some good news. What's waiting in line for Jethalal?

episodes.title: Jethalal's USA Trip
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is excited about the opportunity of going to the United States of America. Will he be able to leave on such short notice?

episodes.title: America Jane Ki Khush Khabri
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal shares his happiness with all the colony members. Meanwhile, Bhide is still upset about Popatlal's taunts

episodes.title: America Ki Taiyyari
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal prepares for his journey to the United States of America. Will Jethalal's trip be successful?

episodes.title: America Ki Packing
episodes.synopsis: The members of Gokuldham colony visit Jethalal with various requests, before he leaves for America. How will Jethalal react to this?

episodes.title: Jethalal Chala America
episodes.synopsis: All the neighbours come to see off Jethalal before his departure for America. However, they are worried if Bapuji will be okay while living alone.

episodes.title: Bapuji Ka Khayal
episodes.synopsis: The society members call for a meeting to work out a plan on how to take care of Bapuji during Jethalal's absence.

episodes.title: Ghar Pe Akele Bapuji
episodes.synopsis: As Jethalal leaves for the United States, Bapuji becomes lonely at home. Will he be okay during his time alone?

episodes.title: First Night Alone
episodes.synopsis: All the neighbours come to support Bapuji as she spends his first night alone.

episodes.title: Bapuji Ka Plan Chowpat
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji makes a plan to meet his childhood friend for breakfast, but knowing how the Gokuldham colony is, will he make it on time?

episodes.title: Gokuldham's First Priority - Bapuji
episodes.synopsis: Everyone in the colony goes out of their way to take care of Bapuji. Will everything go smooth?

episodes.title: Bapuji Kidhar Hai?
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji doesn't open his door or answer his phone and sends the entire colony into panic mode. Is Bapuji alright?

episodes.title: Bapuji Hue Gussa
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji gets fed up with his neighbours being over-enthusiastic about taking care of him. Will they be understanding and take a step back?

episodes.title: Welcoming Bappa
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham Colony members are excited about welcoming Bappa. Will everything go according to plan?

episodes.title: Gokuldham Colony Mein Aaye Bappa
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham colony welcomes Bappa with an open heart. How will they celebrate this auspicious occasion?

episodes.title: Bappa Ke Aane Ki Khushiyan
episodes.synopsis: The members of the Gokuldham colony celebrate Bappa's arrival but Anjali expresses her concerns about Taarak not being with her on this auspicious occasion.

episodes.title: Taarak's Gift
episodes.synopsis: Anjali is upset about Taarak not being around during Ganpati but will his gift make up for it?

episodes.title: Taarak Returns
episodes.synopsis: The entire colony is surprised to see Taarak return for the Ganpati celebrations. Meanwhile, Sodhi, Popatlal and Hathi want to know Bhide's questions in advance.

episodes.title: Rangarang Karyakram Ka Excitement
episodes.synopsis: The entire colony prepares for the Rangarang Karyakram. Will everything go smooth during the function?

episodes.title: Rangarang Karyakram Ke Special Guest
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham residents begin the Rangarang Karyakram and invite a special guest to host the entire program. Who will the special guest be?

episodes.title: Bharat Ke Prasiddh Mandir
episodes.synopsis: Sugandha plays a fun quiz with the Gokuldham residents about the famous temples of India. Who will score the most points and win the game?

episodes.title: The Country Of Miracles
episodes.synopsis: The Rangarang Karyakram continues as Sugandha quizzes Babita, Madhavi and Bhide about the famous heritage sites in India. Will they be able to answer all the questions correctly?

episodes.title: Hindustan Ki Pehchaan
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi, Popatlal, and Anjali are next in line to participate in Sugandha's quiz. Will they be able to answer all the questions correctly?

episodes.title: Bharatiya Sanskriti Ki Khaasiyat
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena, Iyer, and Taarak take on the challenge of answering all the quiz questions correctly. Will they be successful?

episodes.title: Rangarang Karyakram Ki Charam Seema
episodes.synopsis: Abdul delivers a surprise performance for the Rangarang Karyakram. Meanwhile, Nattu Kaka and Bagha are next in line for the quiz.

episodes.title: Shradh Ki Zimmedari
episodes.synopsis: Anjali catches Taarak eating samosas with Tapu Sena. Meanwhile, Taarak gets the responsibility of holding Shradh for his late father. Will Taarak be able to perform this important ritual properly?

episodes.title: Shradh Ki Taiyaari
episodes.synopsis: Taarak and the society members prepare for his father's Shradh. Will everything go smooth?

episodes.title: Kauwe Ki Khoj
episodes.synopsis: Taarak is worried as he can't find crows to eat his offerings. Gogi, Pinku, and the others offer their help to make the Shradh successful. Will things go in Taarak's favour this time?

episodes.title: Shradh Specialist
episodes.synopsis: Taarak finally finds a few crows to eat the Shradh food, but Sodhi unknowingly scares them away. When Taarak is about to lose all hope, Abdul comes up with a unique solution. Will Abdul's idea work?

episodes.title: Maha Daan
episodes.synopsis: Taarak and the others make their way to a park to look for crows. However, things take a turn for the worse when a thief steals Taarak's phone. What will he do now?

episodes.title: Jethalal Kab Aayega?
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal's family and friends are eagerly waiting for him to return from his USA trip. However, no one has spoken to him in the past two days. Will Jethalal return home safely?

episodes.title: Jethalal Returns
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal returns to India without informing about his arrival to any of the society members. Will he return home safely?

episodes.title: Jethalal Ka Bura Naseeb
episodes.synopsis: After returning from the USA, three thieves rob Jethalal and steal all of his belongings. What will he do now?

episodes.title: Jethalal Behind Bars
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal tries to file a complaint at the police station about the robbery. But Chalu Pandey refuses to take his complaint and locks him up instead. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Jethalal Ki Ghar Wapsi
episodes.synopsis: Chalu Pandey lets Jethalal, and the others go after listening to their explanation. Jethalal reaches Gokuldham and decides to surprise Bapuji.

episodes.title: Gifts From Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal brings a special shirt for Bapuji from his US trip. However, Jethalal is unaware that someone has mistakenly replaced the shirt with a frock. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Dosti Ki Bhasha
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal calls Taarak at his office, which puts Taarak's job at risk. How will he handle this situation?

episodes.title: Excitement For Navratri
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham residents are eagerly waiting for the Navratri celebrations to begin. Meanwhile, Jethalal finds it difficult to fit into his old Garba dress.

episodes.title: Society Ki Permission
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal wants to perform the first aarti of Navratri to pray for Daya's return. However, Bhide says that he has to take permission from all society members first. Will the society members accept his request?

episodes.title: Jethalal's Meeting
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal gets the opportunity to perform the first aarti of Navratri. However, he gets called to Lonavala for an important meeting. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Jethalal Matlab Musibat
episodes.synopsis: Everyone begins to worry, as Jethalal is getting late for the aarti. Will Jethalal be able to get back in time?

episodes.title: Nav Durga Ke Darshan
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal manages to reach on time and performs the first aarti of Navratri. Later, all the Gokuldham residents play Garba together.

episodes.title: The Last Film Show In Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: Asit Modi brings the star of Chhello Show, Bhavin Rabari and the director, Pan Nalin, to meet all of their favourite Gokuldham residents.

episodes.title: Bachat Mantra
episodes.synopsis: Bhide shares his mantra for savings with Tapu Sena. Meanwhile, Nattu Kaka and Bagha remind Jethalal about submitting his maintenance cheque.

episodes.title: Maintenance Ka Cheque
episodes.synopsis: Bhide celebrates when Jethalal brings the maintenance cheque on time. However, a silly mistake by Jethalal quickly spoils the celebration.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Ki Shaan
episodes.synopsis: Bhide finds out that Tapu is about to return to Gokuldham. Meanwhile, Jethalal scolds Nattu Kaka about spoiling his maintenance cheque.

episodes.title: Doctor Hathi Ki Dawa
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal brings Bapuji to Dr Hathi's clinic to treat his stomach ache. Meanwhile, Gokuldham society members are worried about the moss build-up in the society compound.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Mein Bhookamp
episodes.synopsis: Dr Hathi slips and falls in the society compound because of the moss build-up. Will the society members be able to lift him up?

episodes.title: Sodhi Ka Idea
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi comes up with a unique solution to lift Dr Hathi up from the ground. Will his plan work?

episodes.title: Contractor Kaha Milega?
episodes.synopsis: The members of Gokuldham society decide to repaint the colony but Bhide struggles to find a contractor who is ready to do the job before Diwali. Can a solution be found?

episodes.title: Contractor Ki Khoj
episodes.synopsis: The members of Gokuldham society interview multiple contractors and ask for their budget for repainting their colony. Will a suitable contractor be found on time?

episodes.title: Patakho Ki Testing
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena helps Abdul test the new firecrackers at his shop. Meanwhile, the committee members gather at the clubhouse to finalize a contractor.

episodes.title: Contractors Ki Meeting
episodes.synopsis: Society members sit down for a meeting to select the best contractor out of the top four. Will they be able to make a sound decision?

episodes.title: Contractors Ki Ladai
episodes.synopsis: After interviewing all the contractors, the society members decide to shortlist one. Who will be the one to get the job?

episodes.title: Painting Ka Kaam Shuru
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham residents decide to give the contract for painting the society to Raju Chamke. Will things go according to plan?

episodes.title: Bhide Ka Sabse Bada Darr
episodes.synopsis: The painting job in Gokuldham begins in full zest. However, Bhide is anxious about things going wrong. Will all of his worries come true?

episodes.title: Diwali Ki Excitement
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham residents are excited to celebrate Diwali in the newly painted society. But will the contractor be able to complete the work on time?

episodes.title: Bad News For Bhide
episodes.synopsis: The contractor gives Bhide the bad news and tells him that the painting job won't get finished on time. What will Bhide do now?

episodes.title: Saving Diwali
episodes.synopsis: Bhide is ready to face everyone's anger when the painting job gets delayed. However, he gets a surprise once he steps out of his house.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Ki Diwali
episodes.synopsis: After the painting job gets completed, all Gokuldham residents celebrate Diwali together. The next day, Huma Qureshi and Sonakshi Sinha arrive at Gokuldham to meet Dr Hathi.

episodes.title: Bapuji Ki Treat
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji treats Tapu Sena with pizzas to reward them for saving the Diwali celebrations. Meanwhile, Bhide decides to penalize Jethalal if he doesn't pay the maintenance cheque on time.

episodes.title: Jethalal Ki Penalty
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal lies to Bapuji about giving the maintenance cheque. However, Bhide arrives at Jethalal's house and his lie comes out in front of everyone.

episodes.title: Jethalal Ke Cheques
episodes.synopsis: Bagha and Nattu Kaka request Jethalal to sign some cheques. Later, Babita shows up at Jethalal's shop with some of her friends.

episodes.title: Jethalal Ka Sabak
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal apologises to Bhide for not submitting the maintenance cheque on time. However, Bhide is adamant that if Jethalal doesn't pay the penalty, he will resign from the secretary post.

episodes.title: Jethalal Ki Tarkeeb
episodes.synopsis: Bhide agrees to accompany Jethalal and Taarak to the medical store. But he is unaware that it was all a trick to give him the maintenance cheque. What will Bhide do when he finds out the truth?

episodes.title: Cheque Ka Hungama
episodes.synopsis: Madhavi tells Bhide that she accidentally washed the kurta that the cheque was in. What will happen when Jethalal finds out about this?

episodes.title: Guru Nanak Jayanti Ki Badhaiya
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi and his family celebrate Guru Nanak Jayanti with all Gokuldham residents. Meanwhile, Goli is scared as he spills chutney on Sakharam. What will Bhide do when he finds out?

episodes.title: Guru Nanak Ji Ki Anmol Seekh
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi and his family continue to celebrate Guru Nanak Jayanti and spread happiness among Gokuldham residents.

episodes.title: Tapu Sena's Dinner Plan
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena decides to take Bapuji out for dinner. Will their dinner plan be successful?

episodes.title: Dinner With Bapuji
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji wants to go out for dinner with Tapu Sena, but Jethalal is worried about this plan. How will things pan out?

episodes.title: Restaurant Pahuchne Mein Deri
episodes.synopsis: Problems keep piling up one after another, which causes a delay in the dinner plans. Can Tapu Sena and the others reach the restaurant in time?

episodes.title: International Client
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal scolds Bagha when a customer complains about him. Later, an important client from abroad contacts Jethalal about a big contract.

episodes.title: Taarak's Important Task
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal decides to bring Taarak along with him for the meeting with the international client. However, Taarak refuses as he gets assigned an important task by his boss. What will Jethalal do now?

episodes.title: Office Se Chutti
episodes.synopsis: Taarak decides to make an excuse to dodge office work and attend the meeting with Jethalal. Will this plan work?

episodes.title: Taarak's Lie
episodes.synopsis: Taarak decides to lie to his boss and help Jethalal instead of going to the office. Will Jethalal get into trouble because of this?

episodes.title: International Client's Arrival
episodes.synopsis: Taarak arrives at Jethalal's shop, and all of them await the international client's arrival. Will the business deal go as planned?

episodes.title: Taarak In A Mess
episodes.synopsis: Things get complicated for Taarak as his boss reaches Gada Electronics. Will his boss find out that Taarak lied to him about his injury?

episodes.title: A Surprise For Taarak
episodes.synopsis: Taarak finds out that his boss is headed to his home to surprise him. Taarak rushes back before his boss finds out that he lied about his injury.

episodes.title: Bhide And Abdul's Plan
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and Abdul try to think of excuses to stop Taarak's boss from entering the society. Meanwhile, Taarak and Jethalal encounter a lot of problems while on their way home.

episodes.title: Doctor Hathi To The Rescue
episodes.synopsis: Doctor Hathi stalls Taarak's boss and takes him to his home. Meanwhile, Taarak encounters even more problems while on his way to Gokuldham. Will Taarak's boss find out about his lie?

episodes.title: Tapu Sena's Distraction Plan
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena coaxes Taarak's boss to play cricket with them. Will they be able to buy Taarak enough time to return home?

episodes.title: Efforts Gone In Vain?
episodes.synopsis: Despite all the efforts from Gokuldham residents, Taarak's boss finally finds his way inside Taarak's house. What will happen when he finds out the truth?

episodes.title: Sakharam Goes Missing
episodes.synopsis: Taarak tells everyone how he safely made it back home. Later, Bhide gets a shock as Sakharam goes missing from the society compound.

episodes.title: Bhide's Search For Sakharam
episodes.synopsis: Bhide takes Taarak's help to look for Sakharam. Bhide thinks that Jethalal has played a prank on him by taking Sakharam away. Will his hunch prove to be true?

episodes.title: Late For Work
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal's tension begins in the morning as Nattu Kaka and Bagha get late for work. However, the tension seemingly goes away as Jethalal receives an order for two hundred TVs.

episodes.title: Gambhir Mudda
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal has to go to Daman for an important meeting, and he gives Bhide the responsibility of taking care of Bapuji. Meanwhile, Popatlal gets a call from the marriage bureau about a potential match.

episodes.title: Disheartened Popatlal
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal gets disheartened when things don't work out for him at the marriage bureau. Later, he eavesdrops on Bhide talking to someone about looking for a potential groom. Will Popatlal finally get a match?

episodes.title: The Suitable Groom
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal overhears Bhide's conversation and finds out that his uncle is looking for a suitable groom for his daughter. Will this be the opportunity to get married Popatlal was waiting for?

episodes.title: Finding Vidya's Address
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal takes help from Gogi and Goli to find Vidya's address and meet her in person. Will Popatlal's plan work?

episodes.title: Shiv Ganga Village
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal, Gogi and Goli travel to Shiv Ganga village to meet Vidya and propose to her for marriage. Meanwhile, Bhide decides to apologise to Popatlal for his behaviour.

episodes.title: Popatlal And Vidya
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal decides to meet Vidya at the school where she works as a teacher. Meanwhile, Gogi and Goli's parents begin to grow suspicious about their activities.

episodes.title: Angry Sudhakar
episodes.synopsis: Sudhakar is fuming with anger and decides to confront Bhide about Popatlal's actions. What will happen when Popatlal returns to Gokuldham?

episodes.title: Bhide's Wrath
episodes.synopsis: Bhide is furious with Popatlal for his actions and chases him all around the colony. What will happen when Bhide finally gets his hands on him?

episodes.title: Popatlal Hides
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal sneaks into Iyer and Babita's house to escape Bhide's wrath. But how long will it be before Bhide catches him?

episodes.title: Search For Popatlal
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal hides inside Taarak's house when Iyer refuses to help him. Meanwhile, Bhide looks everywhere around the society in search of Popatlal. What will happen when Popatlal finally catches up to him?

episodes.title: Popatlal's Escape
episodes.synopsis: Taarak tries to lure Bhide away so that Popatlal can escape from the society. Will Popatlal find a safe place to hide?

episodes.title: Bhide Suspects Everyone
episodes.synopsis: Bhide starts doubting everyone and thinks that they are helping Popatlal hide. Will someone slip up and reveal the truth?

episodes.title: Bhide Confronts
episodes.synopsis: Bhide is unable to find Popatlal and his friends tell him to leave the matter for now and confront him when he returns. What will happen next?

episodes.title: Sudhakar Mama Warns Gokuldham Society
episodes.synopsis: Sudhakar Mama arrives in Gokuldham society along with other people from his village to confront Bhide and Popatlal. Will Popatlal finally show his face?

episodes.title: Bhide's Decision
episodes.synopsis: Chalu Pandey agrees to find Popatlal on the condition that Bhide will not take the case back under any circumstance. What will Bhide do now?

episodes.title: Police Complaint Against Popatlal
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham residents are shocked when they learn that Bhide has filed a police complaint against Popatlal. However, Popatlal is still nowhere to be found. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Finding Popatlal
episodes.synopsis: Chalu Pandey reassures Bhide that they will find Popatlal in time. He thinks that Popatlal is hiding within the society compound and assigns a special agent to sniff him out.

episodes.title: Truth Revealed
episodes.synopsis: Everyone who helped Popatlal gets forced to reveal the truth in front of Bhide. Will Popatlal finally show his face?

episodes.title: Will Popatlal be Caught?
episodes.synopsis: Chalu Pandey and his canine look for Popatlal all over the colony. Can 009 find Popatlal's distinct smell and trace him?

episodes.title: Inspector Pandey's Celebration
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Pandey catches Popatlal and asks the rest of the members to back off. Will his celebration of catching the first criminal in Gokuldham Society last long?

episodes.title: Sudhakar Mama Wants Popatlal
episodes.synopsis: Sudhakar Mama arrives at Gokuldham along with a group of people from his village. Will Bhide and the others hand over Popatlal to them?

episodes.title: The Eye Opener
episodes.synopsis: The tables seem to have turned as Sudhakar and Vidya thank Popatlal for opening their eyes. Will Popatlal's wish of getting married finally be fulfilled?

episodes.title: Unlucky Popatlal
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal proves to be unlucky once again, as he finds out that Vidya loves someone else. Meanwhile, Chalu Pandey is adamant about arresting Bhide, as per their deal.

episodes.title: Sonu Ke Special Guests
episodes.synopsis: Sonu prepares breakfast for the special guests that are coming to her house. Bhide and Madhavi are puzzled by the change in her behaviour. Who will the special guests be?

episodes.title: Year End Sale At Gada Electronics
episodes.synopsis: Bhide tells Jethalal and Bapuji about the events that transpired between Popatlal and Sudhakar Mama. Meanwhile, Bagha and Nattu Kaka come up with an innovative offer for increasing sales before the New Year.

episodes.title: New Year Ki Party Ka Rang
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena takes Bhide's help to plan a party for New Year's Eve. They decide to let everyone draw chits with a random colour that they would have to wear at the party.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Welcomes The New Year
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham residents come together to celebrate the New Year together. However, Taarak is worried that something might go wrong. Will Taarak's fears come true?

episodes.title: Naye Saal Ka Naya Suvichar
episodes.synopsis: Bhide kicks off the new year by writing the thought of the day in Sanskrit. However, many Gokuldham residents are puzzled by the meaning behind the thought. Who will be able to decipher its true meaning?

episodes.title: Bharat Ki Pracheen Bhasha
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal tries to decipher the meaning behind the thought written in Sanskrit. Meanwhile, Bagha brings good news for Jethalal in the morning.

episodes.title: Naye Saal Ki Khushkhabri
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal finds out that the profits of Gada Electronics have increased by fifty per cent over the past year. Meanwhile, Bagha rushes to meet Bawri, who has just returned from Kanpur.

episodes.title: Bagha Ka Toota Dil
episodes.synopsis: Bagha gets worried as Bawri gets late for their date. He goes to Bawri's house to check on her but finds that her house is locked.

episodes.title: Bagha Ki Tragic Love Story
episodes.synopsis: Bagha gets depressed when Bawri refuses to talk to him. Will Nattu Kaka and Jethalal be able to cheer up his mood?

episodes.title: Badey Order Ki Tension
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is anxious as he receives a large order, but Bagha is in no condition to work. Meanwhile, Jethalal seeks Taarak's help to find a solution to this problem.

episodes.title: Bagha Bhaag Gaya
episodes.synopsis: Bagha runs away from home and is not picking up his phone. Meanwhile, Jethalal gets tensed about completing the order on time.

episodes.title: Bagha Ho Gaya Seedha
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and the others find Bagha inside a bar, drinking away his sorrow. What will happen when Bagha drinks too much?

episodes.title: Party Sharty Ka Nateeja
episodes.synopsis: Bagha creates a ruckus in the society, and no one is able to handle him. What will Gokuldham residents do now?

episodes.title: Bagha Ki Zidd
episodes.synopsis: Taarak and Anjali come up with a plan to get Bagha to step down from the balcony. Will their plan work?

episodes.title: Nashe Mein Bagha
episodes.synopsis: Bagha's drunk antics become a problem for the entire colony. Can a solution be found?

episodes.title: Bawri Vapas Aa Gayi
episodes.synopsis: Bagha finally takes a sigh of relief when the real Bawri comes in front of him. However, Jethalal is still worried about completing the order on time.

episodes.title: 50 TV Ki Delivery
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is worried that he has to deliver fifty TVs, but Bagha and Nattu Kaka are not picking up his calls. What will Jethalal do now?

episodes.title: Jethalal Ki Angoothi
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal loses his ring in the society compound. Will Bhide be able to help him find his ring?

episodes.title: Bawri's Surprise
episodes.synopsis: Madhavi tells Bhide that the neighbouring society has experienced some ghostly activities. Meanwhile, Bawri arrives at Gada Electronics to surprise Bagha.

episodes.title: Employee Aur Boss Ka Rishta
episodes.synopsis: Nattu Kaka and Bagha ask Jethalal to increase their salary. Meanwhile, Taarak gets in trouble with his boss for trying to skip work.

episodes.title: Taarak Gives Anjali A Surprise
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal gets worried when Taarak does not answer his calls. Later, Taarak calls Anjali to give her a piece of good news.

episodes.title: Taarak Ki Good News
episodes.synopsis: Taarak calls Jethalal to his house to tell him some good news. What will the good news be?

episodes.title: Yellow Shirt Ki Problem
episodes.synopsis: Taarak burns his yellow shirt while ironing it. He asks his fellow Gokuldham society members for their help.

episodes.title: Taarak Ki Akhri Ummeed
episodes.synopsis: Taarak borrows Dr Hathi's yellow shirt, and Anjali helps him alter it. Will Taarak's problem finally get solved?

episodes.title: Taarak Ka Luck
episodes.synopsis: Iyer lends his yellow shirt to Taarak, which fits him perfectly. Gokuldham residents wish him luck for the meeting. Will things go in Taarak's favour?

episodes.title: Taarak Phas Gaya
episodes.synopsis: Taarak gets into an accident in the morning, which spoils his yellow shirt. Everyone blames Jethalal for putting Taarak in that situation. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Taarak's Green Shirt
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji decides to go and talk to Taarak's boss. Later, when Taarak and Bapuji arrive at the office, everyone is shocked to see Taarak's green shirt.

episodes.title: Badey Guru Ji Ke Darshan
episodes.synopsis: Taarak arrives at the office, and his boss sees him in a green shirt. Will Bapuji's plan work out?

episodes.title: Badey Guru Ji Ki Advice
episodes.synopsis: Taarak gives the presentation in front of the clients. However, the clients are not satisfied with his presentation. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Bapuji Ki Jaadui Chhadi
episodes.synopsis: Taarak shares the good news with all the Gokuldham residents and tells them about Bapuji's brilliant idea. Meanwhile, Anjali prepares for the Europe trip.

episodes.title: Boss Ka Surprise
episodes.synopsis: Taarak's boss decides to pay Taarak a surprise visit in the morning. What will Taarak do now?

episodes.title: Surprise Gift For Taarak
episodes.synopsis: Taarak's boss arrives at Gokuldham, and Taarak receives him at the society gate. Meanwhile, Jethalal and Sodhi look for him in the park.

episodes.title: Bade Guruji
episodes.synopsis: Taarak's boss sees Champaklal and says he wants to meet Bade Guruji. Everyone tries to stop him, but he doesn't listen.

episodes.title: Jhoot Ka Jaal
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji explains how he managed to hide from Taarak's boss. Later, Taarak unboxes the gift his boss gave him.

episodes.title: Tapu Sena's Request
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena requests Bhide to buy new games for the society clubhouse. Will Bhide approve their request?

episodes.title: Bagha Ki Laparvahi
episodes.synopsis: Bhide is curious about Tapu Sena's surprise gift. Meanwhile, Jethalal scolds Bagha for talking to Bawri during working hours.

episodes.title: Bagha's Ghost Story
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal gets angry when Bawri shows up at the shop to meet Bagha. Later, Bagha scares Jethalal with a ghost story.

episodes.title: Mystery Box In Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham residents find mystery boxes outside their homes in the middle of the night. Who could be the one behind this prank?

episodes.title: Prankster Of Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: Rest of the Gokuldham residents open their mystery boxes and find that they all have been pranked. However, Bhide has figured out who is behind this mischief. Will his hunch be correct?

episodes.title: Bhide Ka Shak
episodes.synopsis: Bhide begins to think that Goli is the one behind the prank. Will Bhide prove to be right this time?

episodes.title: Toofan Aa Gaya Hai
episodes.synopsis: The prankster writes a cryptic message on the society notice board. Gokuldham residents are scared and they think that a ghost is behind all of this. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Bhoot Ka Hungama
episodes.synopsis: Bhide, Popatlal and the others look for the ghost on the terrace. Meanwhile, Gokuldham residents find a speaker in the middle of the society compound.

episodes.title: Prankster Ki Shart
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham residents are scared and confused as the lights go off in the clubhouse. Meanwhile, the prankster places a very strange condition in front of the society members.

episodes.title: The Prankster Returns
episodes.synopsis: The prankster appears before the society member and he turns out to be none other than a member of Gokuldham. Who could this prankster be?

episodes.title: Tapu Ka Dhamakedar Surprise
episodes.synopsis: Tapu surprises everyone by coming back. Champaklal and Abdul say they helped Tapu in surprising everyone. Later, Tapu apologizes to everyone for scaring them.

episodes.title: Tapu Brings Gifts
episodes.synopsis: Tapu brings special presents for all Gokuldham residents, and he decides to gift them in the middle of the night. Is Tapu planning another prank?

episodes.title: Tapu Ka Style
episodes.synopsis: Tapu makes everyone happy with his thoughtful gifts. In the morning, Sonu decides to prepare a special breakfast for Tapu.

episodes.title: Tapu Ka Result
episodes.synopsis: Tapu shows his disappointing exam results to Jethalal. Later, Tapu decides to talk to Jethalal about joining Gada Electronics.

episodes.title: Gada Pariwaar Ki Nayi Bahu
episodes.synopsis: Tapu's college friend comes to Gokuldham to meet him. Jethalal and Bapuji think this girl could be Tapu's future life partner. Will their assumption prove to be correct?

episodes.title: Bhide Ka Sar Dard
episodes.synopsis: Sonu bursts Bhide's bubble and tells him that Missa is not Tapu's girlfriend. Meanwhile, Tapu celebrates his return by playing cricket with his friends in the society compound.

episodes.title: Tapu Aur Champaklal Ka Dance
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal tells Baga and Nattu kaka that Tapu is back. Tapu and his friends tell Champaklal they want to dance with him.

episodes.title: Babita Needs Help
episodes.synopsis: Babita wants to gift her cousin a TV which is high in demand. She asks Jethalal for his help in acquiring this TV. Will Jethalal accept her request?

episodes.title: Jethalal Ki Pratigya
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal vows to shave his head if he is unable to fulfil his promise to Babita. Meanwhile, Bagha and Nattu Kaka find a customer for the TV.

episodes.title: Profit Ka Dukh
episodes.synopsis: Bawri calls Bagha to fix her scooter. Meanwhile, Nattu Kaka is excited as he secured a profitable deal for the TV. What will Jethalal do when he finds out?

episodes.title: Search For The TV
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal throws a tantrum when he finds out that the TV has been sold. How will Jethalal fulfil the promise he made to Babita now?

episodes.title: Jethalal Ke Baal Khatre Mein Hai
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is unable to find the TV anywhere, and he feels hopeless. Meanwhile, Babita and Iyer arrive at Jethalal's shop, hoping to buy the TV from him. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Jethalal Ka Promise
episodes.synopsis: Jethlalal is stressed about the promise he made to Iyer. Bawri comes to Jethalal's rescue. Will Jethalal keep the promise he made to Iyer?

episodes.title: Holi Ki Taiyyari
episodes.synopsis: The kids of the colony are excited for Holi and begin their preparations for a memorable celebration. Will everything go according to plan?

episodes.title: Holika Dahan In Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena apologizes to Bhide for pranking him. Meanwhile, preparations for the Holi celebration continue in Gokuldham.

episodes.title: Tapu Sena Ke Holi Plans
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena tells everyone about their Holi plans. However, Gokuldham residents are worried that something might go wrong as usual. What troubles will be waiting for them?

episodes.title: Hungame Vaali Holi
episodes.synopsis: Members of the Tapu Sena cover Bhide with Holi colours and drench him with water. Later, Bhide finds out that Tapu mixed itching powder with the colour. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Tension Ke Rang
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham residents are waiting for Dr Hathi to arrive and treat Bhide. Meanwhile, Inspector Chalu Pandey pays them a surprise visit.

episodes.title: Khujli Powder Ka Sach
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Pandey wants to arrest Tapu for throwing itching powder at Bhide. However, Dr Hathi arrives on time and decides to inspect the Holi colours. Will Dr Hathi prove Tapu's innocence?

episodes.title: Aage Ki Soch
episodes.synopsis: Babita and Iyer come to Jethalal's house with a problem, and Tapu gives them a solution. Later, Jethalal asks Tapu about his future plans.

episodes.title: Baccho Ka Bhavishya
episodes.synopsis: All the parents are worried that the kids are not focused on their life goals. Tapu comes up with an idea which will alleviate their tension and also ensure that the fun in their life never ends.

episodes.title: Tapu Sena's New Mission
episodes.synopsis: Taarak talks to the kids about their career goals. Tapu promises that all of them will come up with a plan to make their families proud.

episodes.title: Baccho Ka Secret Project
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and the others ask for Bapuji's help to find out what Tapu Sena is up to. Meanwhile, the kids decide to present their secret project in front of everyone the next day.

episodes.title: Tapu Sena Ka Nimantran
episodes.synopsis: Everyone is wondering what could be Tapu Sena's secret project. Meanwhile, Tapu Sena invites all the residents of Gokuldham to the clubhouse, where they will present their idea.

episodes.title: Bhide Hai Pareshan
episodes.synopsis: Bhide is worried and wants to find out what is Tapu Sena going to do at 8:30 pm and comes up with an idea. Will he be able to find out about their plan?

episodes.title: Program Ka Chief Guest
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham residents arrive at the clubhouse for the special program. All of them are curious about the secret chief guest for their program. Who could it be?

episodes.title: Suspense Khatam Hua
episodes.synopsis: The secret investor turns out to be none other than Asit Kumarr Modi, who helped Tapu Sena put their entire project together. Only one question remains now, what is this secret project that the kids have been working so hard for?

episodes.title: Manoranjan Ka Khazana
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham residents praise Tapu Sena for their innovative ideas and hard work. Later, Gokuldham residents celebrate Gudi Padwa together.

episodes.title: Tapu Sena Ki Safalta
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal confronts Asit Kumarr Modi about not finding a suitable bride for him. Meanwhile, everyone enjoys the rhymes and mobile games created by Tapu Sena.

episodes.title: Rickshaw Kahan Hain?
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and Babita cannot find an auto that is ready to take them to their destination. He then faces a group of angry auto drivers. Will Jethalal reach his shop in time with the important meeting inching closer?

episodes.title: Nayi Scheme
episodes.synopsis: Rustom from Ramsang company decides to put Gada Electronics on the blacklist for Jethalal's unprofessional behaviour. Jethalal sees Rustom running from Gada Electronics and assumes he is a thief. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Gada Electronics Ki Scheme
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is excited about the new scheme that Gada Electronics has been selected for and wishes to see Babita benefit from it. Tapu is keen on marketing this scheme in the best possible way. Later, Jethalal tells the society members about the scheme at Gada Electronics.

episodes.title: Popatlal Calls Out On The Scheme
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal calls out schemes such as the one announced by Jethalal, to be fraudulent. All the society members look forward to making purchases to increase their probability of benefiting from the scheme.

episodes.title: Scheme Ke Liye Excitement
episodes.synopsis: The society members are excited and looking forward to making purchases under the scheme offered by Gada Electronics. Bagha and Natu Kaka have made all the necessary preparations for the big day of the sale. How will Jethalal react?

episodes.title: Tapu Sena Ka Marketing Plan
episodes.synopsis: Bagha and Nattu Kaka ask Bawri to hide before Jethalal reaches the store. Tapu Sena presents their marketing plan for the scheme before Jethalal. Later, a crowd assembles outside Jethalal's shop but doesn't enter the premises. What is the matter?

episodes.title: Jethalal Gets Concerned
episodes.synopsis: All the society members are impressed with the promotional video made by Tapu Sena, for the scheme offered by Gada Electronics. Jethalal shares his worries with Taarak about the probability of things not running smoothly. What will happen?

episodes.title: Sale At Gada Electronics
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal gets anxious when he sees there are no customers at Gada electronics. Bagha gets caps for the employees of Gada electronics. Will people turn up at Gada Electronics?

episodes.title: The Day Of The Scheme
episodes.synopsis: The society members assemble before setting out to make purchases under the scheme at Gada Electronics. Meanwhile, Jethalal's shop is packed with customers. Will the society members reach on time before the coupons run out?

episodes.title: The Society Members Reach The Shop
episodes.synopsis: Sunita reaches Jethalal's shop to make a purchase. While Jethalal and his team continue attending to various customers, the society members, except Babita, arrive at the shop. Will Babita reach in time?

episodes.title: Chalu Panday Arrives At Gada Electronics
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Panday arrives at Jethalal's shop to shop under the scheme followed by Babita. All the society members make their purchases under the scheme and return to the society.

episodes.title: Fantasies About Winning The Lucky Draw
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is happy about the day that it has gone well. The society members decide to sit together at the clubhouse to watch the results of the lucky draw. They fantasize about what they'd do if they won the car.

episodes.title: Kaash Mujhe Car Mil Jae
episodes.synopsis: Bhide interrupts Tapu Sena's enthusiasm for creating a ruckus in the compound. Later, the society members pray to their respective gods, asking god to make them win the car.

episodes.title: Lucky Draw Ka Din
episodes.synopsis: All the society members gather together in the clubhouse for the lucky draw's announcement hoping to win a car under the Ramsang company's scheme. Who will win the car?

episodes.title: Popatlal Wins The Honeymoon Coupon
episodes.synopsis: All the society members gear up for the announcement of the last two coupon prizes. With Popatlal having won the honeymoon coupon, who will win the car?

episodes.title: Khushi Bhet
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal, Bagha and Nattu Kaka recount the events that transpired during the lucky draw viewing at the clubhouse, for Champaklal. Later, an excited Babita decides to attend driving lessons.

episodes.title: Coupon Kahan Gaya?
episodes.synopsis: Babita gets a nightmare and calls Jethalal in the middle of the night to make sure that the coupon is safe with Jethalal. The following morning, Jethalal leaves for his shop with Babita, Bhide and Popatlal coupons.

episodes.title: Taarak Warns Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Taarak warns Jethalal, asking him to be careful with the coupons because of his streak of bad luck when it comes to handling others' responsibilities. Meanwhile, Babita registers for driving lessons and Jethalal tries to speed up the process of Babita receiving the car earlier than customary.

episodes.title: Is The Coupon At Risk?
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is ecstatic to inform Babita about her being able to receive the car on her preferred day. Later, Jethalal calls Taarak in agony, asking for help on a situation with the coupon. What is it regarding?

episodes.title: Car Coupon
episodes.synopsis: Rustom from Ramsung congratulates Jethalal and gives him a certificate of appreciation. Jethalal tells Rustom he doesn't have the car coupon. How will Rustom react?

episodes.title: Babita Ka License
episodes.synopsis: Bagha uses Bawri's idea to prevent Rustom and Babita from learning the truth. Mahila Mandal is very excited because Babita is getting a car. How will everyone react when they get to know about Jethalal's lies?

episodes.title: Sihayi Hatane Ka Idea
episodes.synopsis: Bagha asks Dolly from Ramsung about Babita's car colour. Bagha suggests they should make a duplicate car coupon. Later, Taarak gives an idea to Jethalal on how to get the ink off the car coupon. Will this idea work?

episodes.title: Taarak Ka Tedha Idea
episodes.synopsis: Rustom makes it clear to Jethalal that if he doesn't receive the car coupon before 6 pm, he won't give the car to Babita. Taarak has an idea that he believes could help Jethalal with his problem, but his boss won't let him out of his sight. How will Taarak help Jethalal now?

episodes.title: Car Coupon Ka Sach
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal decides to tell the truth to Rustom about the car coupon. How will Rustom react to the truth?

episodes.title: Sachai Ki Raah
episodes.synopsis: Taarak prepares Jethalal to tell the truth to Babita and Champaklal. Later, Babita along with Tapu Sena plans to surprise Iyer with the new car.

episodes.title: Babita Ki Narazgi
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and Taarak arrive at Babita's house to tell her the truth about the car coupon. How will Babita react when she finds out what happened?

episodes.title: Taarak And Jethalal Are Stressed
episodes.synopsis: Taarak gets upset when Anjali asks him to welcome Babita's new car with everyone. Popatlal calls Jethalal to Abdul's soda shop, but Jethalal avoids his call.

episodes.title: Jethalal Is Restless
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is not able to sleep because he is tense and decides to run away from home. Will he run away from the situation or face the situation and own his mistake?

episodes.title: Dukh Dayak Samachar
episodes.synopsis: Taarak acts irritable and asks Jethalal to talk to Babita. Babita asks Tapu to get a cake for Jethalal. Later, Jethalal writes a letter to Babita. What will happen next?

episodes.title: Jethalal Ka Khat
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal asks Goli to give his letter to Babita. Babita loses the letter and calls Jethalal to ask about the letter. Will Jethalal tell her the truth?

episodes.title: Iyer Ke Liye Surprise
episodes.synopsis: Taarak asks Jethalal to tell Iyer the entire truth. Everyone is eagerly waiting for Babita's car, and Tapu Sena prepares to surprise Iyer.

episodes.title: Car Ka Golmol
episodes.synopsis: Babita asks Jethalal to call Ramsung company and ask about the car. Jethalal tries to tell the truth to Babita in front of everyone when Bagha along with Rustom arrives in Gokuldham society. Will Babita finally learn the truth?

episodes.title: Jethalal's Letter
episodes.synopsis: The entire Gokuldham society cheers for Jethalal. Rustom asks Babita to send the car to his showroom for registration. Babita reads the letter Jethalal had written to her. What will be Babita's reaction?

episodes.title: Chamatkari Baba
episodes.synopsis: Nattu Kaka and Bagha tell everyone that whoever took out the ink from the coupon has asked them not to reveal his identity. Who is this mystery man?

episodes.title: Babita Ke Car Ka Sapna Hua Poora
episodes.synopsis: Babita thanks everyone for making her dream come true. Jethalal asks Taarak to write a letter to Rustom. Later, Gada Electronic employees get sad when they don't get a commission from Jethalal.

episodes.title: Surprise Gift
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal decides to give a surprise gift to Tapu. Later, Bhide stops Tapu Sena from playing cricket at night. What will Tapu Sena do now?

episodes.title: Bhide Gets Protective
episodes.synopsis: Bhide scolds Tapu for calling Sonu inappropriately. Later, Bhide reads Tapu's messages on Sonu's phone and gets furious.

episodes.title: Jasoos Bhide
episodes.synopsis: Bhide follows Tapu and Sonu and spies on them. What will he find after following them?

episodes.title: Tapu Ka Proposal
episodes.synopsis: Bhide gets scared when he finds out his friend's daughter ran away with someone. Later, Bhide sees Tapu planning a surprise for Sonu and proposing to her. How will Bhide react now?

episodes.title: Bhide Ki Sharamnak News
episodes.synopsis: Bhide tells Madhavi about Tapu and Sonu, but she doesn't believe him. Bhide calls Jethalal and says he has a piece of very shocking news for him. How will Jethalal react to Bhide's news?

episodes.title: Problem Kya Hai?
episodes.synopsis: Everyone tries to find out what happened between Bhide and Jethalal. Later, Everyone gathers in Jethalal's house and waits for Bhide to come. What will Bhide do now?

episodes.title: Bhide Ko Laga Jhatka
episodes.synopsis: Tapu gives a surprise to everyone and a return gift to Champaklal. Later, everyone asks Bhide what he wanted to talk to Jethalal about.

episodes.title: Bhide Ki Asli Baat
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal decides to give everyone a dinner treat. Jethalal is curious about what Bhide wanted to tell him and asks for Taarak's help. Will Bhide tell Jethalal the truth?

episodes.title: Popatlal Ki Shaadi Ki Charcha
episodes.synopsis: Anjali and Taarak talk about Popatlal's marriage. Later, the kids tell Champaklal about their new game.

episodes.title: Hasi Khushi Se Raho
episodes.synopsis: Madhavi gets extremely upset because she thinks Bhide doesn't like her food. Later, Gokuldham men meet at Abdul's soda shop, and Taarak's deep words impress everyone.

episodes.title: Popatlal Is Hurt
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal gets angry when Jethalal says girls refuse to get married to him. Later, someone plays the violin in the Gokuldham society, and everybody dances. Who is this talented person?

episodes.title: Matchmaker Vinu Kaka
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal finds out about Vinu Kaka and feels positive about his marriage. Later, Popatlal meets Vinu Kaka and asks him about his marriage. Will Popatlal get any good news?

episodes.title: Kuch Pao Aur Kuch Kho
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal says he needs some time to think about changing his name. Bhide gets worried when Viku Kaka sees Sonu's hand and says she will get married to someone who lives nearby. Later, Popatlal goes to Jethalal and asks for his advice.

episodes.title: Beheno Ka Decision
episodes.synopsis: Bagha makes chits to solve Popatlal's problem. Popatlal decides to let Mahila Mandal make the final decision about his name. Will Mahila Mandal solve Popatlal's problem?

episodes.title: P Se Naam
episodes.synopsis: Everyone tries to find a new name for Popatlal. Later, Popatlal invites everyone to his party to celebrate his name-keeping ceremony.

episodes.title: Name Voting
episodes.synopsis: Everyone arrives at Popatlal's name ceremony party except Jethalal and Champaklal. Later, Popatlal gives a speech to everyone.

episodes.title: Choose One Name
episodes.synopsis: Everyone from Gokuldham society votes for names that would suit Popatlal the most. Whose name will Popatlal choose?

episodes.title: Unlucky Name
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal suggests a few names from the letter P for Popatlal. Later, Popatlal finally finds the perfect name for himself but Iyer says it's not the right name for him. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Alvida Popatlal
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena decides to give a gift to Popatlal. Popatlal's relative's ghost is angry because she doesn't want him to change his name. What will he do now?

episodes.title: Pyaarelal Ka Purse
episodes.synopsis: A girl compliments Pyaarelal for his name and will marry someone with the same name. Pyaarelal's editor is upset with him because he changed his name. Later, Pyaarelal gets into confusion with the police because of his name.

episodes.title: Rishta Aa Gaya
episodes.synopsis: Pyaarelal starts doubting his decision to change the name but Anjali informs him about a proposal that came for him. Later, Pyaarelal asks Taarak to take an off from the office and be with him, but his boss is in a bad mood. What will Taarak do now?

episodes.title: Do Do Rishte
episodes.synopsis: Taarak convinces his boss to give him leave from the office for half a day. Pyaarelal asks Anjali about Sapna. Later, Pyaarelal sets up a meeting with two different girls for marriage on the same day. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Ek Ghante Ki Meeting
episodes.synopsis: Everyone gets ready to meet Sapna and Kalpana. Pyaarelal gets happy when he meets Sapna. Will this meeting change Pyaarelal's life?

episodes.title: Sapna Ka Jawab
episodes.synopsis: Sapna's father asks questions to Pyaarelal. Sapna and Pyaarelal talk in private to get to know each other better. Will Sapna say yes to Pyaarelal?

episodes.title: Sapna Ya Kalpana?
episodes.synopsis: Pyaarelal and Sapna talk it out in person and seem to like each other. However, Pyaarelal is concerned about meeting Kalpana first before giving his decision. Who will he pick?

episodes.title: Hum Dono Ki Haan Hai
episodes.synopsis: Pyaarelal and Kalpana talk in private. Later, Sapna and Kalpana both agree to marry Pyaarelal. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Pyaarelal's Dilemma
episodes.synopsis: Pyaarelal gets into trouble when he says yes to both Kalpana and Sapna for marriage. How will he get out of this problem?

episodes.title: Tapu Sena Ka Idea
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal asks Pyaarelal to refuse to marry either Sapna or Kalpana. Later, Pyaarelal tells Tapu Sena about his problem. Will Tapu Sena find a solution to his problem?

episodes.title: Pyaarelal Under Pressure
episodes.synopsis: Pyaarelal decides to meet Sapna and Kalpana once again. Later, Sapna's family treats Pyaarelal like their son-in-law which makes the situation even more difficult for him.

episodes.title: Pyaarelal Ke Bahane
episodes.synopsis: Pyaarelal tells Sapna he has to leave to attend to a work emergency but instead goes to meet Kalpana. Will Sapna find out about this?

episodes.title: Bohot Sara Khaana
episodes.synopsis: Pyaarelal goes out with Sapna to get to know her better but soon leaves to meet Kalpana. Will Pyaarelal be able to choose one girl between Kalpana and Sapna?

episodes.title: 6 Baje Wali Samasya
episodes.synopsis: Kalpana and Sapna are head over heels in love with Pyaarelal. Pyaarelal is worried because he fixes a date with Kalpana and Sapna at the same time and same place. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Yellow Or Blue?
episodes.synopsis: Kalpana gets a tatto for Pyaarelal. Pyaarelal goes to Sapna while he is on a date with Kalpana. Police find Pyaarelal's behaviour suspicious and keep an eye on him.

episodes.title: Pyaarelal Ka Shagun
episodes.synopsis: Pyaarelal tells his dream to everyone. Kalpana's father fixes a meeting with Pyaarelal to give him Shagun, and Sapna's family also decides to come with Shagun to Pyaarelal's house.

episodes.title: Pyaarelal Ke Khushi Ka Din
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham society members prepare for Pyaarelal and Kalpana's Shagun ceremony. Later, Kalpana comes with her family to Pyaarelal's house.

episodes.title: Kalpana Ka Final Decision
episodes.synopsis: Kalpana and her family find out the truth about Pyaarelal's name and Kalpana decides to break up with him. Later, Jethalal and Taarak give good news to Pyaarelal. What is it?

episodes.title: Yellow Shagun Ceremony
episodes.synopsis: Pyaarelal calls and invites Bagha, Nattu kaka and Bawri for his Shagun ceremony with Sapna. Later, everyone welcomes Sapna and her family to Gokuldham society.

episodes.title: Sapna Ki Love Story
episodes.synopsis: A man named Swapnil loves Sapna, and Pyaarelal brings him to his Shagun ceremony and helps them get together with each other. Later, Pyaarelal decides to change his name back to Popatlal.

episodes.title: Tapu Sena Ki Outstation Trip
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena visit Popatlal and helps cheer up his mood. Later, Tapu informs Jethalal that he is going outstation on a trip with all of his friends.

episodes.title: Leave Ki Permission
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal runs away to save himself from Anjali's diet breakfast. Anjali reminds Taarak of their anniversary when they first met and asks him to take an off from the office. Will Taarak be able to convince his boss to take a leave for a day?

episodes.title: Bagha Ka Idea
episodes.synopsis: Taarak is worried because he doesn't know how to take leave from his office and decides to ask Jethalal for advice. Taarak shares his problem with Bagha. Will Bagha be able to help Taarak with his problem?

episodes.title: Boss Ki Permission
episodes.synopsis: Taarak tries to find out his boss's mood and asks Bagha to call him. Later, Bagha reminds Taarak of the promise he made.

episodes.title: Taarak Ka Special Day
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal finds out that his dream company wants to meet him tomorrow for a meeting. Jethalal asks Taarak to take a leave from his office and attend the meeting with him. How will Taarak manage to help Jethalal and also spend time with Anjali on their anniversary?

episodes.title: Important Meeting Ki Tyaari
episodes.synopsis: Taarak suggests Jethalal to take Bagha and Nattu Kaka for his dealership meeting. Later, Taarak asks Jethalal to stay quiet during the whole meeting and let Bagha and Nattu Kaka speak. Will Jethalal get this dealership?

episodes.title: Bagha Is Well Prepared
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal tells Taarak that Mike Gatting has become his company's manager. Bagha impresses Jethalal with his presentation and English. Will he be able to get the dealership for Gada Electronics?

episodes.title: Hum Meeting Ke Liye Taiyyar Hain
episodes.synopsis: When the guests from the company arrive, they get a little confused seeing Jethalal with a 'Mon Vrat'. The dealership employees walk out as they only want to speak to Jethalal. Will Jethalal get the dealership?

episodes.title: Jethalal Ke Priya Mitra
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal unknowingly exposes Jethalal and Taarak lying in front of the dealership employees. Later, Jethalal books a table for Anjali and Taarak at his friend's restaurant.

episodes.title: Jethalal Ne Baati Mithaiyaan
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal joyfully distributes sweets to all the members of society to commemorate the successful acquisition of a new dealership.

episodes.title: Wakeel Ka Number
episodes.synopsis: All the society members get ready for the monsoons as they run their chores. Meanwhile, Taarak gets called into his boss' cabin. Will he be in trouble?

episodes.title: Bagha Bana Vakeel
episodes.synopsis: Tarak's boss asks him to share his lawyer's number which makes him nervous. He confirms with Bagha and asks him to pretend to be a lawyer. Will he get caught?

episodes.title: Mall Ke Daam
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena accidentally hurts Bhide. Later, Sunita sells vegetables to Mahila Mandal at a higher rate. What will Mahila Mandal do now?

episodes.title: Daya Ki Yaad
episodes.synopsis: Bhide asks Tapu Sena to stop playing video games. Later, everyone asks Jethalal when is Daya coming back and he starts missing her.

episodes.title: Sundar In Trouble
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal gets a call from the police station to inform him that they have arrested Sundar. How will Jethalal help him now?

episodes.title: Jethalal Ko Mila Bhoot
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal gets a call from the police station. Sodhi gives a lawyer's number to Jethalal. Later, Jethalal and his friends have an encounter with a ghost on their way to the police station.

episodes.title: Bin Bulaye Mehman
