episodes.synopsis: Sundar tells Jethalal that he won a challenge because of him and Jethalal asks for his commission. Sundar tricks Jethalal into making tea for him and his friends.

episodes.title: Ghost Show
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Panday is furious with Jethalal for calling him to the police station in the middle of the night for no reason. Later, Sundar and his friends try to scare Inspector Panday by dressing up as ghosts.

episodes.title: Sundar's Friend's Loan
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal apologizes to Inspector Panday on behalf of Jethalal. Sundar tells Jethalal that he has a surprise for him. Later, Sundar wakes up Champaklal and Tapu in the middle of the night.

episodes.title: Ek Bhayanak Sapna
episodes.synopsis: Sundar tells his problem to Champaklal and asks him to come to Ahmedabad with him. Later, Sundar plans a surprise for Jethalal. What is the surprise?

episodes.title: Surprise Ka Secret
episodes.synopsis: Anjali forces Taarak to drink healthy juice. Jethalal wants to know what surprise Sundar is planning for him. Later, everyone gathers at the clubhouse to find out about Sundar's surprise.

episodes.title: Sundar Ka Start Up
episodes.synopsis: Sundar asks Jethalal to do the inauguration of his stall. Everyone enjoys food from Sundar's stall. Later, Sunday tells everyone that he has one more surprise for Jethalal.

episodes.title: Jethalal Tries To Run
episodes.synopsis: Bagha and Nattu Kaka try to convince Jethalal to take up Sundar's offer to join his food business. Jethalal fears that he might have to pay for the lights and decorations. Later, Tapu tells Sundar about the games Tapu Sena has made.

episodes.title: Jethalal Ki Doosri Shaadi
episodes.synopsis: Sundar leaves for Ahmedabad but Jethalal tries to stop him. Taarak asks Jethalal to get re-married. Later, Taarak tricks Sundar and forces him to return to Gokuldham society.

episodes.title: Doosri Shaadi Ke Sapne
episodes.synopsis: Taarak tells Sundar that Jethalal is thinking about getting married again. Later, Champaklal finds out about Jethalal's intentions and gets angry at him. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Daya Ke Wapas Aane Ki News
episodes.synopsis: Sundar says he knew that everyone was acting when they said Jethalal is getting married again. Later, Sundar decides to tell Jethalal when Daya is returning to Gokuldham society.

episodes.title: Iyer Ki Good News
episodes.synopsis: All the Gokuldham men are very happy to sit and have soda together. Iyer gets angry with Jethalal for pulling his leg. Later, Iyer says he has good news for everyone. What is it?

episodes.title: Jethalal Ka Worng Guess
episodes.synopsis: Bhide's morning quote triggers Popatlal. Later, Jethalal gets worried when he finds out that Iyer's good news is not what he was thinking about. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Jethalal Bribes Goli
episodes.synopsis: Taarak and Jethalal ask Goli to go to Iyer's house and find out about his good news. Will Iyer tell the good news to Goli?

episodes.title: Bazigar Iyer
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is afraid of losing while everyone waits for Iyer to come and give the good news. Later, Champaklal learns about Jethalal and Iyer's bet. Who will win this bet?

episodes.title: Car Ki Tamanna
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal congratulates Babita on her new car. Everyone in Gokuldham society wishes they also had a car. Later, Iyer and Babita meet Bagha, Nattu Kaka and Bawri to give them sweets.

episodes.title: Toofani Din
episodes.synopsis: A big storm hits Mumbai, and Anjali asks Taarak not to go to the office. Later, Bagha and Nattu Kaka reach the shop and wait for Jethalal to come.

episodes.title: Barsat Mein Pareshani
episodes.synopsis: Everyone gets a day off from work because of the heavy rains. Bhide plans to spend a romantic day with Madhavi but one of his students shows up. How will Bhide's day go?

episodes.title: Haso Hasao Divas
episodes.synopsis: Iyer plans to watch a movie with Babita at home while Tapu Sena is getting bored and decide to make everyone laugh and entertain them. What will Tapu Sena do now?

episodes.title: Bade Bhi Bane Bacche
episodes.synopsis: Tapu calls the rest of the Gokuldham members outside in his unique style to have fun with them and celebrate the 'Haso Hasao Divas'.

episodes.title: Bhagwan Krishna Ki Gokul Nagri
episodes.synopsis: Taarak's boss scolds him for playing outside instead of working. Inspector Panday also celebrates 'Haso Hasao Divas' with Gokuldham members. Later, Lord Krishna gives his blessings to the Gokuldham society.

episodes.title: Khushiyon Ke 15 Saal
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham Society celebrates 15 years of 'Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah' by reminiscing beautiful memories of the show.

episodes.title: Champaklal Plays Pool
episodes.synopsis: Goli and Tapu have a pool competition which Goli tries to win by cheating. Tapu Sena decides to teach Champaklal how to play pool. Later, Mahila Mandal plans a trip to enjoy the lovely weather.

episodes.title: Mehenge Tamatar
episodes.synopsis: Anjali tells Mahila Mandal that Taarak gave a polythene full of fresh tomatoes to the garbage man. Later, Sunita explains why she has increased the price of all the vegetables.

episodes.title: Tamatar Ka Achar
episodes.synopsis: Madhavi tells Bhide that she forgot to make Mr Nayar's order of tomato pickles. Champkalal explains to Bhide the importance of respecting customers in business. Later, Bhide and Popatlal get into an accident.

episodes.title: Tamatar Milna Hua Mushkil
episodes.synopsis: Bhide struggles to find 40 kilos of tomatoes in one place. Bhide goes to Gada Electronics and sees a lot of tomatoes there. What will Bhide do now?

episodes.title: Tempo Mein Tamatar
episodes.synopsis: Bhide calls his uncle in Nashik who has a farm and asks him if he can give him tomatoes. Later, Taarak tells Bhide that a tempo full of tomatoes was looted on its way to Mumbai from Nashik. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Tamatar Ne Badhai Tension
episodes.synopsis: Baliya is Bhide's last hope for getting his hands on tomatoes in time. Taarak explains why the price of tomatoes has increased drastically. Meanwhile, the Bhide family passes their time by playing a game of cards and watching a movie together.

episodes.title: Tamatar Ki Chori
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and Madhavi get very happy when they see tomatoes. They are not able to bring all the tomatoes to their flat so Bhide decides to stay down with the tomatoes. Later, the tomatoes get stolen.

episodes.title: Kon Hai Tamatar Chor?
episodes.synopsis: Bhide thinks Tapu Sena is messing with him by hiding the tomatoes while Iyer blames Jethalal. Gokuldham society members try to figure out who could've stolen the tomatoes while Bhide calls Inspector Panday for help.

episodes.title: Nau Do Gyaara
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Panday thinks someone from Gokuldham society has stolen Bhide's tomatoes. Later, Inspector Panday sends his men to catch the rickshaw driver whom Abdul saw running away from the society.

episodes.title: Padosi Ne Ki Padosi Ki Madad
episodes.synopsis: Nobody is ready to believe that Popatlal is a thief, but Inspector Panday decides to arrest him. Later, Popatlal tells everyone what actually happened. Will Inspector Panday believe him?

episodes.title: Gas Bich Mien Hui Khatam
episodes.synopsis: Madhavi starts making tomato pickles for her customer while the gas cylinder at Bhide's house gets over. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Time Par Order Ready
episodes.synopsis: Retrieving data. Wait a few seconds and try to cut or copy again.

episodes.title: Independence Day Plans
episodes.synopsis: Bagha and Nattu Kaka tell Jethalal there has been a robbery in their village and ask for their salary in advance. Later, Tapu Sena makes plans for going for an outing instead of celebrating Independence Day with everyone.

episodes.title: Bhide Vs Tapu Sena
episodes.synopsis: Bhide teaches his tuition kids about Independence Day. Later, Tapu Sena asks Bhide if they can go on a picnic to Khandala instead of celebrating Independence Day with everyone. Bhide asks Champaklal to teach the kids a lesson.

episodes.title: Saare Bhartiya Bhai Bhai
episodes.synopsis: Bhide thanks Champaklal for guiding him in the right direction while Taarak writes a poem for Independence Day. Later, everyone gathers to celebrate Independence Day.

episodes.title: Long Drive Ke Sapne
episodes.synopsis: Taarak, Bhide and Jethalal decide to go to the office together while Jethalal gets a chance to ride with Babita in her car.

episodes.title: Chintamani
episodes.synopsis: Dr Hathi's patient, Chintamani, tells Dr Hathi that there is something wrong with him. Mahila Mandal meets for a kitty party while Goli gets ready to go to a medical camp.

episodes.title: Namune Customers
episodes.synopsis: All men from Gokuldham society gather to drink soda and talk about the kinds of customers they have to deal with.

episodes.title: Champaklal Is Sick
episodes.synopsis: Bhide writes a good message on the society board. Champaklal catches a cold while Tapu tells Jethalal about maps on the phone.

episodes.title: All The Best Goli
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal gets ready to go to somebody's wedding, but Bhide drops green chutney on Popatlal's new clothes. Tapu and Sony try to get the stain off his clothes. Will they be successful?

episodes.title: Chintamani Piche Padh Gaya
episodes.synopsis: Chintamani gets all his health tests done and shows his reports to Dr Hathi. Tapu takes Champaklal to Dr Hathi because he is not well. Will Champakal feel better after consulting Dr Hathi?

episodes.title: Danger Bhai
episodes.synopsis: Dr Hathi tells his friends that he is fed up with Chintamani. Dr Hathi gets to know that Chitamani has fainted and is admitted to a hospital. Later, a man named Danger bhai comes to Gokuldham and looks for Dr Hathi.

episodes.title: Inspector Panday Stops Danger Bhai
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Panday and his team arrive on time and save Champaklal from Danger Bhai's injection. Later, Danger Bhai asks Inspector Panday to arrest Dr Hathi also for giving wrong medicine to his brother. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Galat Dawai Ki Kahani
episodes.synopsis: Abdul tells everyone how he hid Dr Hathi from Danger Bhai and called Inspector Panday to save Dr Hathi. Later, Dr Hathi tells Inspector Panday what actually happened with Danger Bhai's brother, Chintamani. Will Danger Bhai forgive Dr Hathi?

episodes.title: Soch Acchi Rakho
episodes.synopsis: Chintamani's kids tell everyone that Chintamani is okay and get to know that Dr Hathi had nothing to do with Chintamani fainting. Later, all Gokuldham members talk to Chintamani and give him hope.

episodes.title: Jethalal Ke Peeth Piche Hua Drama
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal comes back to Gokuldham society and Bhide tells him what happened in the society when he was not there. Later, Chintamani comes to the Gokuldham society with another health problem. What will Dr Hathi do now?

episodes.title: Bhagwat Geeta Ka Shlok
episodes.synopsis: Sonu makes Bhide's tension go away and asks him to write a shlok from Bhagwat Geeta on the society board. Bhide decides to test Tapu Sena. Later, Bhide and Tapu get into a fight.

episodes.title: Tapu Ki Maafi
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and Jethalal get into a fight when Bhide tells Jethalal that Tapu insulted him. Tapu apologises to Bhide for talking back to him and tells him that Tapu Sena won't do Dahi Handi this year. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Iccha Purti Matki
episodes.synopsis: A monk comes to Gokuldham society's temple and gives Tapu Sena an Iccha Purti Matki and says whoever breaks it on Janmashtami his wishes will come true. Who will get to break this matki?

episodes.title: Emergency Society Meeting
episodes.synopsis: Madhavi tells Mahila Mandal about the Iccha Purti matki while Popatlal gets angry because no one told him about the society's emergency meeting. Later, everyone gets excited about Iccha Purti matki.

episodes.title: Matki Phodne Ka Decision
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal tells Jethalal about Iccha Purti matki. Later, everyone gathers for the emergency meeting and waits for Bhide. What is taking Bhide so long?

episodes.title: Gokuldham Society Janmashtami Mahotsav
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham Society members unanimously agree to let Popatlal break the Iccha Purti matki on Janmashtami and wish for a happily married life. However, Popatlal decides to do something else with the matki. What is he planning?

episodes.title: Iccha Purti Matki Ke Rules
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham society celebrates Janmashthami. Later, each family can put down only one name from their family for Iccha Purti matki. Who will get this golden chance?

episodes.title: Ek Pareshaan Parivar
episodes.synopsis: Everyone is excited to know who will break the Iccha Purti matki. Later, a couple comes to Gokuldham society and tells everyone that their son has only a few days left to live.

episodes.title: Sabne Chintan Ko Chuna
episodes.synopsis: Everyone asks Chintan to break the Iccha Purti matki. Tapu Sena helps him break the matki but he keeps falling down. Will he be able to break the matki?

episodes.title: Sabka Bhala Socho
episodes.synopsis: Chintan reveals that he didn't pray for his good health while breaking the matki. Later, all the Gokuldham men sit and chat at the clubhouse, but Jethalal is missing. Where is he?

episodes.title: B.K. Su
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham men talk about business. Jethalal tells Champakal that Tapu is still young to join the business. Later, Jethalal doesn't agree with Bhide's message on the society board. What does the message say?

episodes.title: Paryushan Ki Shuruaat
episodes.synopsis: Tapu tells Champaklal that he wants to take him to Palitana. On arriving at his shop, Jethalal is happy to see it full of customers but short-staffed. Later, Bagha makes a mistake while accepting a payment. How will Jethalal react?

episodes.title: Imaandari
episodes.synopsis: Bagha tells Bawri that Gada Electronis lost ten thousand rupees because of his mistake and Bawri decides to help them. Later, Nattu Kaka finds out something suspicious in the office account. What is it?

episodes.title: Workload Se Pareshaan
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal gets worried when he finds out that Dhanraj Seth has not given other people's money either. Later, Taarak gives advice to Jethalal to keep a manager in his shop to divide the workload. How will Nattu Kaka and Bagha react to this?

episodes.title: Manager Naam Ki Tension
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal's friends urge him to keep a manager for the shop. Meanwhile, Nattu Kaka says that he will leave his job at Gada Electronics if Jethalal hires a new manager. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Badla Bartav
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is looking for a manager for his shop while Nattu Kaka's behaviour changes towards Jethalal. Later, Bagha and Nattu Kaka tell Jethalal they will leave their jobs if he keeps a manager. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Bawri Ki Pariksha
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal imagines what it would be like if he hired Bawri as a manager. Later, Jethalal asks Bawri to give a test so he can decide if she's fit to become a manager or not. Will Bawri pass the test?

episodes.title: Payment Mila Ya Nahi?
episodes.synopsis: Bagha eagerly waits for Bawri to return with the payment. Later, Bawri tells everyone that she didn't get the payment from Dhanraj Seth. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Freelancer Bawri
episodes.synopsis: Bawri tells Jethalal she doesn't want to work at Gada Electronics and that she can do freelancing whenever Gada Electronics needs her. Later, Bagha and Nattu Kaka apologise to Jethalal for their behaviour.

episodes.title: Kharab Speaker
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal tells Bagha and Nattu Kaka that he doesn't like the mega bumper sale written outside Gada Electronics. Later, Tapu Sena takes Gokuldham's speaker to Gada Electronics to get it repaired.

episodes.title: Secret Decoration
episodes.synopsis: Bhide scolds Tapu Sena for buying a new speaker without knowing that it's a gift from Jethalal. Later, Tapu Sena helps set up the mandap for Ganesh Chaturthi.

episodes.title: Celebrating Ganesh Ji
episodes.synopsis: All Gokuldham members share their tea with Taarak. Later, they celebrate Ganesh Chaturthi in full swing.

episodes.title: Sonu Ki Surprise Performance
episodes.synopsis: Bhide wants Sonu to tell him about her Ganesh Chaturthi performance while everyone is excited about Sonu's surprise performance. What is Sonu's surprise?

episodes.title: Mani Brothers Ki Surprise Visit
episodes.synopsis: Sonu impresses everyone with her magnificent performance. Later, Danger Bhai and Chintamani visit Gokuldham society and give gifts to everyone.

episodes.title: Bhagwan Ke Abhushan Ki Raksha
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi, Abdul and Tapu Sena decide to stay near the pandal to protect the jewels while a family hides from them to go inside the mandap. Are they here to steal or do they have some other motive?

episodes.title: Parivar Ke Bhes Mein Chor
episodes.synopsis: Bhide has a very scary dream that all the precious jewels get stolen. Tapu Sena, Sodhi and Abdul find Bhakti's parents near the mandap. What were they doing?

episodes.title: Anghoti Mil Gayi
episodes.synopsis: Bhakti doesn't sleep at all in the night. Gokuldham members look for Bhakti's father's ring in the morning. Later, Tapu discloses that Anjali and Babita are going to do aarti nritya.

episodes.title: Anjali And Babita's Dance
episodes.synopsis: Bhakti's parents try to find an excuse to go to Gokuldham society. Anjali and Babita are excited about their performance. What will happen next?

episodes.title: Ganpati Ki Param Bhakt
episodes.synopsis: Dr Hathi checks Bhakti while Bhakti's parents are worried about Gokuldham members finding out the truth. Later, Gokuldham members ask Bhakti's parents why they don't want to leave Gokuldham society. Will they tell the truth?

episodes.title: Bhakti Ka Vachan
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham residents are unable to decide whether they should let Bhakti stay in the society or not. However, Bhakti is not willing to leave without playing Garba with Ganpati Bappa. Will her wish come true?

episodes.title: Zidd Ya Bhakti?
episodes.synopsis: Bawri asks Komal if she can sing Stuti Bhajan with her in the evening. Bhakti refuses to eat or drink anything. Later, Gokuldham members meet to find a solution for Bhakti.

episodes.title: Bhakti's Wishes
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham members find a way to make Bhakti's wishes come true. Later, Gokuldham members gather and wait for Bhakti to arrive. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Goli Ka Naya Roop
episodes.synopsis: Bawri sings beautifully. Bhakti asks Gokuldham members to leave because she thinks Ganesh ji wants to dance only with her. Later, Goli dresses up as Ganesh ji.

episodes.title: Bhakti Ka Sapna Hua Pura
episodes.synopsis: Bhakti gets very happy and gets emotional when she sees her god with her own eyes. Later, Bhakti calls Gokuldham members to meet her god. Is this Goli in God's clothes or someone else?

episodes.title: Goli Ka Confusion
episodes.synopsis: Goli celebrates with Bhakti and dances with her. Goli gets stuck in traffic and gets confused when he finds out someone has replaced him during the celebration. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Gokuldham Is Blessed
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham members feel blessed by god and they all thank Bhakti for it. Later, everyone gets the same dream about a god. What is the dream?

episodes.title: Babita Ki Dost
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal bumps into Champaklal and Champaklal gets angry. Popatlal meets Babita's friend and tries to impress her. Will she be impressed by Popatlal?

episodes.title: Chai Ne Bigadi Deal
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal orders tea and accidentally spills it on his client, Vicky, who gets angry and insults Jethalal. Later, Jethalal finds out that Vicky is Babita's friend's husband. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Babita Bani Mediator
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and Vicky start fighting in front of Babita and Nisha. Babita tries to resolve the issue between Jethalal and Vicky. Will she succeed in doing so?

episodes.title: Vicky Ka Cheque
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal brings sweets for Taarak and tells him about his big deal and how everything went smoothly. Later, Nattu Kaka tells Jethalal that there's some issue with Vicky's cheque that he gave Jethalal. What will Jethalal do now?

episodes.title: Shiny Dandiya Sticks
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal thinks there's a ghost in his house. Tapu shows his glow in the dark dandiya sticks to Jethalal but Jethalal feels these sticks can be risky. Later, Jethalal scolds Bagha and Bawri when he overhears their conversation.

episodes.title: Ziddi Box
episodes.synopsis: Bhide protects his clothes from getting ruined as he's meeting Amit for a new order. Later, Popatlal asks everyone to open a box, but no one is able to open it. What is in the box?

episodes.title: Navratri Ke Liya Budget Nahi Hai
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham men open Popatlal's box and end up spilling everything that was inside the box. Bhide tells Tapu Sena they don't have a budget to celebrate Navratri this year. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Sabse Pehele Aya Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal arrives at the meeting spot before everyone else and decides to hide and hear what Bhide says behind his back. Later, Bhide asks Jethalal to prove that he is the first one to arrive for the meeting.

episodes.title: Bina Budget Ki Navratri
episodes.synopsis: Bhide gets angry when Popatlal asks him what he does with the society's budget. Tapu Sena comes up with a solution to Navratri on zero budget. Later, Bhide wants to know about Tapu Sena's surprise.

episodes.title: Artists Kaha Hai?
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena welcomes all the Gokuldham members in their own unique style to Gokuldham's Navratri function. Everyone is waiting for the artists to come and perform at the function. Will they reach the society on time?

episodes.title: Cheque Pass Hoga Ya Nahi?
episodes.synopsis: Taarak and Jethalal are worried about whether Jethalal will get his money from Babita's friend on time or not. Later, Anjali gets angry when she finds unhealthy food in Taarak's bag. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Payment Ki Tension
episodes.synopsis: Babita's friend Vicky tears the cheque in front of Jethalal. Meanwhile, a phone call from Jethalal gets Taarak into trouble with his boss.

episodes.title: Gift Ki Khoj
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is confused about what to gift Babita. Later, Jethalal gets a bouquet for Babita but Iyer is allergic to flowers. What will Jethalal gift Babita?

episodes.title: The Perfect Gift
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is in distress as he struggles to find the right gift and consults all his neighbours. Will he find the right gift?

episodes.title: Babita Ka Mushkil Gift
episodes.synopsis: Anjali gets upset with Taarak for not giving her gifts while Jethalal dreams about Babita's gift. Later, Jethalal asks Sundar about Daya.

episodes.title: Chand Par Zameen
episodes.synopsis: Sundar tells Jethalal that he's getting a piece of land on the moon at a very small price and asks Jethalal to give him the money for the same. What will Jethalal do now?

episodes.title: NASA Se Call
episodes.synopsis: Bagha and Nattu Kaka tell customers about their festive special offers. Later, Jethalal gets a call from NASA. What is this call about?

episodes.title: Moon Residential Program
episodes.synopsis: Bagha urges Jethalal to buy land on the moon as a good investment opportunity. Will this be a wise decision for Jethalal?

episodes.title: Chand Par Padosi
episodes.synopsis: Chand Bhai convinces Jethalal to buy three plots on the moon. How will Babita and Gokuldham members react when they find out about this?

episodes.title: Jethalal Ka Zabardast Surprise
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal tells Babita he has a big surprise for her and asks everyone to come to the clubhouse in the evening. How will everyone react when they find out about Jethalal's surprise?

episodes.title: Babita Ke Liye Best Gift
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal tells Babita about his surprise in a very special way. How will everyone react to this?

episodes.title: Sapna Reh Gaya Sapna
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal realises he had slept and he dreamt about buying land on the moon. Jethalal goes to the Moon Residential Program office. Will he buy land on the moon now?

episodes.title: Jethalal Ka Sapna Toota
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal asks Popatlal not to tell anyone that he wanted to buy land on the moon. Jethalal is upset because he couldn't fulfil Babita's wish. What will he do now?

episodes.title: Jethalal's Surprise Gift
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal finally brings a surprise gift for Babita with Taarak's help. Will Babita like the gift?

episodes.title: Diwali Ki Tayariyan
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi plays a prank on Bhide and steals society's notice board. Gokuldham members want Daya to come back and make their Diwali even more special. When is Daya coming back?

episodes.title: Diwali Ka Maahol
episodes.synopsis: Bhide gets angry at Tapu for throwing water at him. Bhide goes to stop Tapu Sena from wasting water but falls down. Later, Taarak surprises Anjali with a present.

episodes.title: Surprise Dham
episodes.synopsis: Mahila Mandal goes to Jethalal's house to find out when is Daya coming back while Champaklal's friend pulls Champaklal's leg. Will they find out the exact date when Daya is coming back?

episodes.title: Sundar Ko Phone Lagao
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal meets a customer who's in a similar problem as him as his wife is also not coming home. Bagha, Nattu Kaka and Jethalal try to contact Sundar to ask about Daya. Will they get in touch with him?

episodes.title: Jethalal Gets Impatient
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal talks to Daya's acquaintance and asks him to go to Daya's house and make him talk to her. Later, Jethalal and Bagha try to call Sundar from an unknown number. Will he pick up the call now?

episodes.title: Sundar Ka Vaada
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is worried that Sundar may not keep his promise. He makes plans to travel to Ahmedabad himself, along with Taarak, to bring Daya back.

episodes.title: Apradhi Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Tapu books tickets for Jethalal and Taarak for Ahmedabad to bring Daya back home. Later, police arrive at the Gokuldham Society to arrest Jethalal. How will Jethalal go to Ahmedabad now?

episodes.title: Jethalal Ne Kara Kya Hai?
episodes.synopsis: Police come to arrest Jethalal while he talks in his sleep. Later, everyone wants to know what crime Jethalal has committed.

episodes.title: Reason Kya Hai?
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Panday is not telling anyone why he's arresting Jethalal and Gokuldham members protest against it. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Humne Kisko Dhamkaya?
episodes.synopsis: Mahila Mandal prays for Jethalal while Jethalal finds Bagha and Nattu Kaka in jail. Why are they in jail?

episodes.title: ACP Ki Biwi Ko Di Dhamki
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Panday informs Jethalal that he has been accused of threatening ACP Prithvi's wife, Jagruti, from Ahmedabad. Jethalal denies these allegations. What will happen next?

episodes.title: Jethalal Ke Khilaaf Complaint
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham Society members arrive at the police station to convince Inspector Panday to let Jethalal go. Will Inspector Panday listen to them?

episodes.title: Misunderstanding Clear Karo
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal explains to ACP Prithvi that his messages were intended for Sundar, not Jagruti, and apologizes for any misunderstanding. Surprisingly, ACP Prithvi and his wife are revealed to be Daya's family friends. Will they withdraw their complaint against Jethalal?

episodes.title: Kiski Galti Hai?
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham men tell Mahila Mnadal what happened at the police station while Jethalal finally gets to talk to Sundar. What will Sundar say now?

episodes.title: Daya Ke Aane Ki Khushi
episodes.synopsis: Everyone is excited when they hear Daya is coming back. Jethalal, Champaklal, and Tapu joyfully engage in garba to celebrate her homecoming. However, amidst the happiness, Taarak is anxious, fearing that something untoward might occur during Diwali.

episodes.title: Sundar Ka Vaada
episodes.synopsis: Taarak is worried if Sundar will fulfil his promise. Later, everyone celebrates Diwali in Gokuldham society. When is Daya coming?

episodes.title: Sundar Ka Intezaar
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena challenges Goli to snatch sukdi from Champaklal's hand. Tapu contacts Sundar to inquire about his location. Is Daya really coming with him?

episodes.title: Swagat Samaroh Hua Flop
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and other Gokuldham members gather to welcome Daya. However, they are shocked to find that Daya is not with Sundar. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Daya Bhabhi Kaha Hai?
episodes.synopsis: All the colony members are upset that Sundar didn't get Daya Bhabhi with him. How will the colony members react to this?

episodes.title: Daya Ka Intezaar
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and all the colony members are sad when they don't see Daya with Sundar. However, Sundar passes on the message that Daya sent for Jethalal and lights a diya on her behalf.

episodes.title: Khush Rehne Ka Secret
episodes.synopsis: It's a happy vibe in the Gokuldham society as everyone is in a good mood post-Diwali. What new adventures will they be up to?

episodes.title: Sakharam Ko Lagi Chot
episodes.synopsis: Bhide gets angry at Tapu Sena for playing badminton near Sakhram. Later, Roshan receives a piece of good news.

episodes.title: Sodhi's Anniversary
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal gets yelled at by his father for delaying a payment. Meanwhile, Sodhi tells everyone that tomorrow is his marriage anniversary.

episodes.title: Anniversary Ki Taiyyari
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi and his friends are excited about his anniversary. Meanwhile, the men of the colony try to figure out what gift to give Sodhi and his wife.

episodes.title: Sodhi Parties With His Friends
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi gets convinced by his friends to party. The male members of the society decide to confront Sodhi as to why they weren't invited for the same. Will Sodhi forget to wish Roshan at twelve while busy partying?

episodes.title: Museebat Ne Yaad Kiya Hai
episodes.synopsis: All the men of Gokuldham society help Sodhi clean up after he parties with his friends. Soon, Abdul calls to tell them that Roshan has just entered the society. Will Sodhi get caught?

episodes.title: Roshan Returns To Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: While Roshan enters her house, Sodhi and his friends hide on the balcony and make their way to Bhide's balcony. How long will Sodhi hide from Roshan?

episodes.title: Planning Sodhi's Escape
episodes.synopsis: The male members of the society come up with an elaborate plan to hide Sodhi at Popatlal's house. Will Sodhi succeed in lying to Roshan?

episodes.title: Kya Sodhi Ka Jooth Pakda Jayega?
episodes.synopsis: While Sodhi lies to Roshan over the phone about being on his way back, his friends who left earlier return to party with him. Meanwhile, Roshan finds the keys to Sodhi's car.

episodes.title: Bhide Ki Chinta
episodes.synopsis: All the men are worried about Sodhi's truth coming out in front of everyone. Meanwhile, Roshan arrives at Bhide's house to ask about Sodhi. Will she find out the truth?

episodes.title: Sodhi Ka Jhooth Pakda Gaya
episodes.synopsis: Bhide tries to assure Roshan that Sodhi is not at fault, while Sodhi lies to her. Later, Roshan visits Popatlal's house to catch Sodhi red-handed. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Sodhi Kaha Hai?
episodes.synopsis: Roshan visits Iyer's house, inquiring about Sodhi's whereabouts. Later, she checks Taarak's house but can't find him there either. Where could Sodhi be?

episodes.title: Jethalal Bhi Hai Gayab
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham men apologize to Champaklal for their deception regarding Sodhi. Meanwhile, Jethalal is discovered missing from his bedroom, leading everyone to speculate that he and Sodhi might be hiding together.

episodes.title: Roshan Ghar Chor Kar Mat Jao
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal declares his ignorance about Sodhi's whereabouts to everyone. Despite exhaustive efforts, Sodhi remains untraceable, leading to Roshan's decision to depart from Gokuldham society and stay with her parents.

episodes.title: Sodhi Aur Roshan Ki Sulha
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi offers a sincere apology to Roshan, mending their differences. Afterwards, the men of Gokuldham question Bhide about his actions, wondering why he went behind their backs.

episodes.title: Anniversary Ki Mithas
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi and Roshan distribute Kada Prasad among all their friends and invite them to their anniversary party. Will things go smoothly for them this time?

episodes.title: Sodhi Aur Roshan Ki Party
episodes.synopsis: Everyone celebrates at a party held in honour of Roshan and Sodhi, making a grand entrance. Later, Champaklal decides to go on a trip with his friends.

episodes.title: Tapu Sena Ka Idea
episodes.synopsis: Tapu tells Tapu Sena what they should organize for the society's party and requests Bhide to invite everyone to the clubhouse, but Bhide refuses. What unfolds next in this situation?

episodes.title: Meeting Ka Reason
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham members gather in the playhouse for a meeting, yet they remain curious about its purpose. Later, Tapu unveils his plan. What exactly is Tapu's strategy?

episodes.title: Fine Dena Hoga
episodes.synopsis: A debate ensues over the ideal fine for an unpopular gift, prompting everyone to brainstorm diverse and thoughtful gift ideas later on. Whose gift will be the worst?

episodes.title: Chit Uthao
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena visits each house, inviting everyone to draw a chit from a bowl, determining the recipient of their gift.

episodes.title: Secret Gift Ka Confusion
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham residents contemplate their gift ideas for the Secret Santa. Will they be able to make the right decision before the party?

episodes.title: Santa Collects Gifts
episodes.synopsis: Nattu Kaka and Bagha dress up as Santa and go to everyone's house in Gokuldham society and collect their gifts. Later, everyone gathers for the party.

episodes.title: Gift Uthao
episodes.synopsis: Bawri suggests a creative way for everyone to express their feelings about the gifts. The person with the least-liked gift will be subject to a fine.

episodes.title: Acche Aur Bure Gifts
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham members continue picking up gifts. Are they liking their gifts or not?

episodes.title: Kisne Diya Gift?
episodes.synopsis: Anjali isn't fond of her gift, but Taarak encourages her to accept it graciously. Meanwhile, Bhide is delighted to discover that Madhavi is the one behind the thoughtful gift for Sonu. Who will pay the fine now?

episodes.title: Pichle Saal Ke Events
episodes.synopsis: Anjali and Taarak are happy with Tapu Sena's idea and discuss all the events from last year. Later, Babita wishes Jethalal a happy new year.

episodes.title: Naye Saal Ka Josh
episodes.synopsis: Bhide asks Jethalal to give the maintenance cheque on time. Meanwhile, Champaklal returns to Gokuldham society and meets Tapu Sena.

episodes.title: Jagah Kam Aur Saman Zyada
episodes.synopsis: Bagha crafts a sales-boosting poem for Gada Electronics. Simultaneously, Bawri pitches a new scheme to Jethalal, Bagha, and Nattu Kaka. Bhide urges Madhavi to organize their home, leading her to decide to declutter by discarding unnecessary items.

episodes.title: Purana Saman Pheko
episodes.synopsis: Bhide insists on keeping his old belongings, explaining their sentimental value to Madhavi. Will Madhavi let him keep his old things?

episodes.title: Madhavi Ko Pata Chala Sach
episodes.synopsis: Abdul tells Bhide about garbage being dumped in the society office, in front of Madhavi. Later, Madhavi discovers the truth, realizing both Bhide and Sodhi deceived her.

episodes.title: Goli's Wise Advice
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal and Madhavi covertly sell Bhide's old items, intending to keep it a secret from him. Bhide confides in Goli about the situation, and Goli offers him wise counsel.

episodes.title: Popatlal Maan Gaya
episodes.synopsis: Bhide seeks Taarak's assistance to persuade Popatlal about the importance of his old belongings. Popatlal tries to buy Bhide's box, but the shopkeeper refuses to sell it. Later, Madhavi shares her diary with her friends.

episodes.title: Bhide Ki Anmol Yaadein
episodes.synopsis: Madhavi loses her old walkman, which makes her understand the attachment Bhide had to his old belongings. Madhavi and Sonu decide to go to the shop and bring Bhide's belongings back.

episodes.title: Bhide Gets His Things Back
episodes.synopsis: Bhide pretends to be upset about his old things, but Madhavi returns them, realizing their sentimental value. Meanwhile, Sukhi tells Sodhi that his car is lucky.

episodes.title: Sodhi Ki Gadi Ruk Gayi
episodes.synopsis: Bhide is urged to throw a party as Sonu triumphs over Tapu in badminton. Sodhi celebrates with soda, sharing stories about his lucky car. However, Sodhi's joy is short-lived as his friend informs him that the car has broken down. Now, what will Sodhi do?

episodes.title: Sher Kharab Ho Gaya
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham men search for Sodhi's friend, Sukhi. They push the car and Sodhi tries to start it but it doesn't work. Later, Gokuldham ladies worry for them.

episodes.title: Sher Ko Kara Repair
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi plans to repair his car. Jethalal suggests getting a new car, but Sodhi chooses to repair the existing one. Later, Sodhi gets ready to drop Roshan at her relative's place and Tapu Sena at the mall. Will his car work fine now?

episodes.title: Tapu Sena Helps Popatlal
episodes.synopsis: Lost in the mall, Popatlal searches for Tapu Sena. He encounters an unmarried girl, and Tapu Sena seizes the opportunity to help Popatlal make a good impression on her.

episodes.title: Popatlal Ki Date
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal and Anokhi decide to go on a long drive together. Tapu Sena congratulates Popatlal, and they celebrate at the mall. Later, Sodhi offers to lend Popatlal his car for the long drive. Will everything go according to Popatlal's plan?

episodes.title: Jethalal Has Jalebi And Fafda
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal prays for his relationship at the temple, while Jethalal, craving jalebi and fafda, considers inviting Taarak and Babita. Jethalal invites Taarak for breakfast, and Taarak waits for Anjali to leave to visit Jethalal's house discreetly.

episodes.title: Popatlal's Date With Anokhi
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal prepares to meet Anokhi, and Sodhi enhances his car for a romantic evening for Popatlal and Anokhi. Champaklal informs Jethalal about attending a bhajan kirtan with Tapu Sena. Later, Popatlal takes Anokhi on a drive.

episodes.title: Gaddi Band Ho Gayi
episodes.synopsis: "Popatlal's meeting with Anokhi triggers memories for Anjali and Taarak. Anokhi suggests they get to know each other better before making commitments. Later, Popatlal's car stops, and he asks Anokhi for help pushing it."

episodes.title: Gaddi Kaha Hai?
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal angrily confronts Sodhi, blaming his car for ruining his date. He insults Sodhi and reveals he left the car in the jungle, angering Sodhi, but Popatlal refuses to disclose the exact location. What will Sodhi do now?

episodes.title: Wrong Match For Popatlal
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal wants his umbrella back, but Sodhi insists on knowing his car's location first. Popatlal tearfully shares the story of Anokhi leaving him due to Sodhi's car but refuses to disclose its whereabouts. Taarak suggests Anokhi may not have been the right match for him.

episodes.title: Sher Ki Missing Complaint
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham men discover Sodhi's car missing, report it at the police station, and unintentionally disrupt Chalu Pandey's outing plans.

episodes.title: Inspector Pandey Looks For Sodhi's Car
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Pandey discloses Popatlal's involvement in the car theft, and Gokuldham residents vow not to interfere. Together, they join the inspector to search for Sodhi's car.

episodes.title: Inspector Pandey Is Angry
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Pandey wants to solve the case on his own. Gokuldham women debate informing Roshan about Sodhi's stolen car. Later, as Pandey gets crucial information about the car which makes him suspect that Gokuldham residents are making a fool out of him.

episodes.title: Ek Aur Complaint
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Pandey plans to arrest all Gokuldham men, bringing them to the society compound. Later, Inspector Pandey receives a call about two people filing a complaint about Sodhi's missing car, stirring confusion.

episodes.title: Sodhi's New Car
episodes.synopsis: Roshan surprises Sodhi with a new car, confessing the old one was never stolen. Inspector Pandey complains about Gokuldham residents causing trouble again.

episodes.title: Sodhi Ke Naye Number
episodes.synopsis: Taarak convinces Anjali to make a sweet treat. Tapu Sena asks Gogi for a treat as his father got a new car. Sodhi excitedly shares the news of his new car number in Gokuldham society.

episodes.title: Permanent Number Ka Celebration
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi shares sweets with everyone in Gokuldham to celebrate getting the permanent number for his new car. Later, Sodhi and Tapu Sena decide to have a party together.

episodes.title: Sodhi Ki Nayi Gaadi
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi celebrates his new car by taking all kids on a joy ride. However, he soon finds out that his car is not where he parked it. Where could it be?

episodes.title: 4000 Episodes Ki Khushi
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi learns there's an issue with his car's number plate while the community joyfully marks the milestone of 4000 episodes of Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah.

episodes.title: 4000 Episodes Ki Journey
episodes.synopsis: The Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah family marks their 4000th episode with jubilant singing, dancing, and a festive cake cutting.

episodes.title: Bhide Ke Liye Surprise
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham residents savour kulfi in celebration of finding Sodhi's lost car. Madhavi has a surprise for Bhide. However, Bhide misconstrues Madhavi and Sonu's actions, believing they are scouting for potential suitors for Sonu's marriage.

episodes.title: Online Scams Se Bacho
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham men enjoy a soda session, but Popatlal feels left out. They discuss online shopping risks. Later, Bhide expresses interest in buying a gold chain for Sonu.

episodes.title: Madhavi's Surprise
episodes.synopsis: Madhavi is worried that Bhide will find out about her surprise from the passbook. Meanwhile, Bhide runs into Popatlal on his way to the bank, and both of them get into an argument.

episodes.title: Madhavi Ko Scam Karne Ki Koshish
episodes.synopsis: Bhide learns about Madhavi's 80,000 rupees and the truth about Sonu's gold chain. Scammers target Madhavi's account, and Mahesh offers to return Bhide's money, but he hesitates due to concerns about leaving Sonu and Madhavi alone.

episodes.title: Madhavi Ka Parcel
episodes.synopsis: Madhavi and Anjali eagerly await Madhavi's parcel, but Madhavi is taken aback by the size of it. Despite having paid online, the delivery person requests payment upon arrival. Is this a potential scam?

episodes.title: Madhavi Takes Cyber Crime Unit's Help
episodes.synopsis: Madhavi and Sonu discover the delivery boy's scam. The bank manager advises Madhavi to involve the police and seek the Cyber Crime Unit's help, while Tapu Sena steps in to assist Sonu.

episodes.title: Madhavi Lies To Bhide
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Pandey asks Abdul to recall any distinctive details about the fraudulent delivery boy. Although Inspector Pandey gets busy with other crucial tasks which upsets Madhavi. Subsequently, Madhavi fabricates a story to Bhide, asserting that she purchased the chain as a gift for Sonu.

episodes.title: Fake Chain For Bhide
episodes.synopsis: Madhavi doesn't want to tell Bhide about the scam and Tapu Sena buys a fake gold chain. Later, Bhide asks Tapu Sena why there's no jeweller's name on the box.

episodes.title: Search For The Scammer
episodes.synopsis: Sonu and Madhavi decide to hide the scam from Bhide for the next two days. Tapu Sena approaches Popatlal, and he agrees to help them find the delivery boy who scammed Madhavi.

episodes.title: Scammer Ko Pakadna Hoga
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena and Popatlal plan to hide the gold chain truth from Bhide. Bhide claims he went to the temple for a new chain to spare Sonu's feelings. Later, they come up with a plan to catch the scammer.

episodes.title: CCTV Shop Kaun Jayega?
episodes.synopsis: Bhide discovers the soda shop empty, and Tapu Sena updates the Gokuldham men about Madhavi's scam. Later, Jethalal and Iyer plan to act as police officers to gather evidence against the scammer at the CCTV shop.

episodes.title: Mahila Mandal Ko Chain Dekhni Hai
episodes.synopsis: Bhide detects a secretive gathering unfolding without his knowledge, but Goli adeptly diffuses the situation with a clever explanation. The Mahila Mandal expresses interest in seeing Sonu's gold chain, leaving Madhavi anxious about potential doubts regarding its authenticity.

episodes.title: Jethalal Ho Raha Hai Late
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal suspects Iyer's plan to leave town and advises Bhide to gift something special to Madhavi. With Champaklal sensing a secret, the group eagerly awaits Jethalal's departure for his shop.

episodes.title: Jethalal And Iyer Banne Police
episodes.synopsis: Bawri comes to shop for a speaker at Gada Electronics. The Gokuldham men and Tapu Sena gather at Jethalal's shop, with Jethalal and Iyer donning police disguises. Later, everyone warns them to steer clear of CCTV cameras.

episodes.title: Nakli Police Ka Mission
episodes.synopsis: Some customers at Gada Electronics mistake Jethalal and Iyer for real policemen. The shopkeeper agrees to show them the recording and both of them find out more information about the scammer.

episodes.title: Tattoo Wala Clue
episodes.synopsis: The CCTV shop owner informs Inspector Panday about two individuals posing as police officers who had previously viewed the footage. Inspector Panday suspects their involvement in the scam. Jethalal and Iyer share the CCTV footage with everyone, revealing a small clue related to the scammer.

episodes.title: Tattoo Artist Ki Help Chahiye Hai
episodes.synopsis: The tattoo artist informs Jethalal and Iyer that the scammer has his tattoo design. With the scammer's phone number and name in hand, the Gokuldham members devise a plan to catch him and decide to seek the tattoo artist's help.

episodes.title: Scammer Ko Diya Lalach
episodes.synopsis: The tattoo artist lures the scammer, Babban, to his studio, claiming the tattoo design has won a prize. Inspector Panday learns about Jethalal and Iyer's fake police officer act at the CCTV shop. Now, everyone awaits the scammer's arrival at the tattoo studio.

episodes.title: Scammer Pakda Gaya
episodes.synopsis: Babban is caught at the tattoo studio, and the Gokuldham members plan to take him to Madhav for identification. Meanwhile, Bhide is left in the dark, and Inspector Panday learns about the Gokuldham members' strategy.

episodes.title: Jethalal And Iyer In Danger
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Panday is furious seeing Jethalal and Iyer in police uniforms, planning their arrest along with the scammer. Later, Madhavi apologizes to Bhide. Will he forgive her?

episodes.title: Popatlal Ka Janam Din
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham residents prepare to celebrate Popatlal's birthday together. Popatlal takes a leave from work to celebrate his birthday. Will things go according to his wishes?

episodes.title: Popatlal Akela Rahega
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal daydreams of a birthday celebration filled with well-wishes for his swift marriage but he is determined not to be pitied so he resolves to steer clear of meeting anyone on his special day.

episodes.title: Akele Mein Birthday
episodes.synopsis: Despite the Tapu Sena's sincere attempt to wish him, Popatlal plays elusive, turning off his phone and celebrating in solitary splendour. Later, Popatlal overhears everyone talking about his marriage.

episodes.title: Birthday Ke Din Gayab
episodes.synopsis: Bhide wishes Popatlal on the society board but can't reach him. They ask Abdul about Popatlal's whereabouts. Meanwhile, Sodhi and Bhide plan a party, unknowingly overheard by Champaklal.

episodes.title: Important Sting Operation
episodes.synopsis: Taarak contacts Popatlal's boss but discovers he is not there either. Gokuldham residents believe Popatlal is engaged in a vital sting operation. Later, Popatlal receives an urgent office assignment, now faced with the task of leaving discreetly for the mission.

episodes.title: Popatlal Ne Bhes Badla
episodes.synopsis: Abdul gives Popatlal a disguise to go incognito outside Gokuldham. When he encounters Mahila Mandal, Abdul concocts a tale to conceal Popatlal's identity.

episodes.title: Surprise Party For Popatlal
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham residents and Popatlal's colleagues kidnap Popatlal and take him to his surprise party. Popatlal tells everyone why he didn't want to celebrate his birthday with them.

episodes.title: Popatlal Bachayega Paise
episodes.synopsis: Abdul grapples with a customer's needs, and Popatlal voices his concern to Bhide about his management of the society. Later, Popatlal proposes a cost-saving idea to address the society's expenses.

episodes.title: Asli Ya Nakli Delivery Boy
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal and Bhide trap the delivery boy in the society office. Seeking help, Bhide contacts Sodhi. Later, the delivery boy tells Popatal that his relative works at a marriage bureau.

episodes.title: Kiska Parcel Hai?
episodes.synopsis: Anjali denies placing any online orders. The delivery boy joins Sodhi, Popatlal, and Bhide in a quest to find out who made the order. Whose parcel is it?

episodes.title: OTP Chahiye Hai
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal advises everyone to open the package and see what's inside, but the delivery boy won't give it to anyone unless they give him the delivery OTP first.

episodes.title: Commissioner Se Panga
episodes.synopsis: Bhide asks Inspector Panday's boss to give him his OTP, but Panday's boss thinks Bhide is trying to scam him. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Adhunik Duniya Ke Nuksaan
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham Society members find out that the parcel belongs to Jethalal. Bhide insists that Jethalal performs two hundred situps for his wrong judgment. What will Jethalal do now?

episodes.title: Taarak Ka Half-Day
episodes.synopsis: Taarak chooses to write an article about Indian festivals while having a great half-holiday. Later, Tapu Sena questions Bhide about the arrangements for the Holi festival.

episodes.title: Holi Par Bach Kar Raho
episodes.synopsis: Mahila Mandal discusses their memories of Holi, while Tapu Sena purchases colours for the festival. Later, Tapu Sena receives a warning from two girls that some boys are throwing colours at everyone. What will Tapu Sena do?

episodes.title: Tapu Sena Ne Sikhaya Sabak
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena watches as a group of boys taunt and throw colour at a girl. They teach them a lesson. Later, Sonu requests that Tapu Sena keep this incident from Bhide.

episodes.title: Holi Celebration Ki Shuruat
episodes.synopsis: Bagha and Nattu Kaka give Jethalal plans to expand Gada Electronics' customer base. Later, when everyone gathers at the Gokuldham Society to celebrate Holi, a group of boys plan to take revenge from Tapu Sena.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Wasiyo Ki Kavita
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham residents recite poems during the Holi celebration, adding to the joy and laughter of the occasion.

episodes.title: Guddu Ka Plan
episodes.synopsis: Guddu wants to take revenge against Tapu and plans on causing trouble at the Holi celebration at Gokuldham. What will he do?

episodes.title: Sonu In Danger
episodes.synopsis: During the Holi celebrations at Gokuldham Society, Sonu is targeted by a group of boys who decide to put colour on her. Who will rescue her?

episodes.title: Bawri Ke Parents Aa Gaye
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal asks Tapu to apologize to Champaklal. Popatlal argues with an auto driver. Later, Bagha and Bawri request Jethalal to meet Bawri's parents.

episodes.title: April Fool Banayenge
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal and friends plan a gathering, while Jethalal and his friends scheme to play an April Fool's prank on the Gokuldham society members.

episodes.title: April Fool Ki Planning
episodes.synopsis: Anjali tricks Taarak with green juice, while Taarak pulls a prank on Goli. Later, the Gokuldham men plan their April Fool's Day prank and party venue.

episodes.title: Sabke Alag Bahane
episodes.synopsis: The men concoct fake excuses to leave and head to the clubhouse for an April Fool's prank, but Bhide finds himself unexpectedly stuck at home, unable to join them.

episodes.title: Clubhouse Mein Party Sharty
episodes.synopsis: All the men try to sneak into the clubhouse, but the clubhouse is locked. Jethalal comes up with a plan to get Bhide out of his house. Will his plan work?

episodes.title: Popatlal Ne Kari Complain
episodes.synopsis: Abdul informs Popatlal that the Gokuldham men are partying without him due to his single status. Popatlal then reveals the truth to the ladies about their husbands' clandestine party.

episodes.title: Champaklal Is Back
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal and Mahila Mandal attempt to locate the Gokuldham men's party. Popatlal consults Abdul for information. Later, Purush Mandli's plans are disrupted by Champaklal's unexpected return.

episodes.title: Sharbat Ya Sharab?
episodes.synopsis: The Purush Mandali plans an April Fool's prank on the Mahila Mandal and Popatlal. Despite their efforts, Popatlal remains suspicious. Later, the Mahila Mandal tests a drink to determine if it's alcohol or juice.

episodes.title: Prank Ulta Padh Gaya
episodes.synopsis: Mahila Mandal and Champaklal pretend to be drunk to prank Purush Mandli, fooling Popatlal. Later, Purush Mandli gathers for soda and a discussion on global warming.

episodes.title: AC On Or Off?
episodes.synopsis: Bagha informs Jethalal about an upcoming company visit for a new product launch. Jethalal wakes up Champaklal and Tapu, disrupting their sleep due to Tapu's AC preference conflicting with Champaklal's comfort.

episodes.title: Electrician Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Babita calls Iyer and complains about a fault in their AC. Jethalal offers to fix the AC when Iyer is unable to find a mechanic. Will he be able to fix the AC?

episodes.title: Babita Ka AC Karna Hai Repair
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal, unable to repair Babita's air conditioner, tries calling Bagha for help, but Bawri intercepts the call and prevents him from speaking to Bagha.

episodes.title: Naya AC Lelo
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal suggests Iyer and Babita to buy a new AC from his shop but Iyer is unsure about this. Will Iyer buy a new AC?

episodes.title: Iyer Ka Mazak
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is very happy that he helped Babita with her AC problem. Iyer plans a prank on Jethalal. Later, Madhavi prepares Bhide's favourite dish but Gokuldham kids eat it.

episodes.title: Tapu Prepares Breakfast
episodes.synopsis: Sonu decides to treat Tapu. Tapu pleasantly surprises Jethalal with his favourite breakfast. Later, Jethalal ends up ditching Taarak to accompany Babita instead.

episodes.title: Jethalal Ki Important Meeting
episodes.synopsis: Tapu goes to Sonu's house for a homemade mango milkshake. Meanwhile, Nattu Kaka and Bagha play the Bhide scooter game, earning a scolding from Jethalal. Later, Arjun from the Supervision company meets with Jethalal for business.

episodes.title: Bawri's Apology
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal's business meeting goes wrong due to Bawri and Bagha's antics. Bawri tries to apologise to Jethalal, but he is not willing to accept. What will happen now?

episodes.title: Bawri Ki Entry Hui Band
episodes.synopsis: Bawri offers an apology gift to Jethalal, but he refuses to accept it. Bagha warns Bawri not to come to Gada Electronics, but she vows to find a way to visit regardless of Jethalal's objections.

episodes.title: Bawri In Gada Electronics
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal tells Taarak that if Bawri shows up at Gada Electronics today, he'll have to fire Bagha. Later, Bawri visits the store in disguise. Will Jethalal recognize her?

episodes.title: Warehoue Mein Kon Hai?
episodes.synopsis: Bagha learns that Bawri has disguised herself and come to Gada Electronics. They talk in the warehouse. Will Jethalal catch them there?

episodes.title: Gokuldham Mein Hai Pooja
episodes.synopsis: Bagha tells Bawri they can't meet secretly without Jethalal knowing. Taarak updates Anjali about Jethalal's concerns with Bawri and Bagha. Later, everyone assembles at Gokuldham society for the pooja.

episodes.title: Bawri In Disguise
episodes.synopsis: Bawri sneaks into the shop in a disguise to meet Bagha, trying to keep their love story hidden from Jethalal. Can their romance survive the challenge of staying hidden from Jethalal's sharp eyes?

episodes.title: The Plan To Catch Bawri
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal suspects that Bawri comes to the shop every day as a customer, and he plans to catch her red-handed. What will he do?

episodes.title: Bawri's New Attempt
episodes.synopsis: Bagha prays that Bawri doesn't come to Gada Electronics but Jethalal is all set to welcome her. Will Bawri take the risk and enter Gada Electronics?

episodes.title: Jethalal Gets Arrested
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Panday arrests Jethalal for misbehavior with a woman. Bagha tells Bawri it's because of her. Later, Taarak fakes illness at work to help Jethalal.

episodes.title: Permission Mil Gayi
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal tells Bawri she caused him to go to jail. Bawri asks for permission to visit Bagha at Gada Electronics during quiet times. Later, Iyer threatens to reveal Jethalal's jail incident to Champaklal.

episodes.title: Husbands Ke Sath Shopping Jana Hai
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and Madhavi get interrupted by Roshan during a sweet moment. Later, the wives discuss their husbands' food choices while buying vegetables and plan to go shopping together with their husbands.

episodes.title: Taarak Ko Chhutti Nahi Mil Rahi
episodes.synopsis: As the ladies get ready for a shopping trip with their husbands, Taarak faces difficulty getting time off work. He asks the other husbands to skip shopping to avoid upsetting Anjali. Will they agree to help him out?

episodes.title: Taarak's Shopping Trip
episodes.synopsis: Taarak arrives at the mall for the shopping trip. Later, Taarak's boss calls him to ask about the poem. What will Taarak do now?

episodes.title: Taarak's Boss In The Mall
episodes.synopsis: All the couples go shopping together. Sodhi jokes with Taarak about Taarak's boss being at the mall, not realizing that Taarak's boss is actually there. What happens when Taarak's boss sees him?

episodes.title: Taarak Mall Mein Hai Ya Nahi?
episodes.synopsis: Taarak's boss follows the Gokuldham men to ask about Taarak's whereabouts at the mall. The secretary suggests they may have seen someone else resembling Taarak. Later, Taarak's boss plans to send his secretary and a doctor to Taarak's house.

episodes.title: Taarak Ki Sundar Kavita
episodes.synopsis: Dr. Hathi tells Dr. Chaddha that Taarak has a headache from not eating Anjali's diet food. Taarak's boss shares that his wife loved the poem he wrote. Later, the Gokuldham men swap tales about their wives' shopping experiences.

episodes.title: Traffic Bohot Hai
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and Bhide argue over a flowerpot. Champaklal asks Jethalal about his political views. Later, Iyer gives Jethalal and Taarak a ride, but they get stuck in traffic.

episodes.title: Konsa Neta Better Hai?
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal strategizes to maintain his friendship with Chana Kumar without upsetting Kurmura Kumar. He discusses with Chana Kumar the complexities of openly supporting him. Meanwhile, Sunita confides her stress to the Mahila Mandal.

episodes.title: Chunaav Ka Mahol
episodes.synopsis: Kurmura Kumar comes to Gokuldham for his election campaign. Popatlal tries to convince everyone to vote for Kurmura Kumar. Later, Sonu goes out of the house to make a delivery.

episodes.title: Sodhi Ka Sapna
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi dreams that Bhide becomes extremely rich. Champaklal asks Tapu Sena to help the birds. Later, Bhide gets upset with Tapu Sena.

episodes.title: Summer Solutions
episodes.synopsis: The members of Gokuldham society fight the summer heat together and get a brilliant idea to put water vessels all around for the animals and birds around.

episodes.title: Zaruratmand Ki Madad
episodes.synopsis: Goli suggests taking a rickshaw, but everyone prefers to walk to Gokuldham society. Along the way, they come across workers labouring in the sun without water. Moved by this sight, they decide to assist the workers. How will they lend a helping hand?

episodes.title: Free Mein Buttermilk
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena asks Roshan to make buttermilk for the workers, sparking Bhide's curiosity. Later, they set up a stall nearby and offer the buttermilk to the workers.

episodes.title: Tapu Sena Ke Acche Vichar
episodes.synopsis: Roshan informs the Mahila Mandal about Tapu Sena's charitable efforts and offers assistance. A buttermilk vendor charges Popatlal for 30 glasses of buttermilk. Later, Taarak praises Tapu Sena's good deeds to Jethalal.

episodes.title: Tapu Sena's Stall
episodes.synopsis: Chana Kumar arrives at Gada Electronics and gives Jethalal more packets of Sing Chana to distribute. Later, the police reprimands Tapu Sena for setting up their stall without permission.

episodes.title: Purush Mandli Ko Karni Hai Madad
episodes.synopsis: The Tapu Sena receives praise for their good work and they pledge to continue their good work throughout the summer. Gokuldham members agree to share expenses for their buttermilk mission. Later, Purush Mandli brainstorm ways to contribute to the Tapu Sena's efforts.

episodes.title: Bina Mewa Kare Sabki Seva
episodes.synopsis: Kurmura Kumar plans to take credit for Tapu Sena's work. Jethalal encounters issues with Chana Kumar. Later, others get inspired by Tapu Sena's good deeds.

episodes.title: Kurmura Kumar Ka Banner
episodes.synopsis: Kurmura Kumar puts his party's banner at Tapu Sena's buttermilk stall, which worries Bhide as it may upset Chana Kumar and cause trouble. Removing the banner could also upset Kurmura Kumar. What will they decide to do next?

episodes.title: Banner Ki Tension
episodes.synopsis: A reporter credits Kurmura Kumar for Tapu Sena's buttermilk stall. Chana Kumar blames Jethalal for supporting Kurmura Kumar and asks him to remove Kurmura Kumar's banner from the stall.

episodes.title: Kurmura Kumar Ki Pyaar Wali Dhamki
episodes.synopsis: Chana Kumar asks Jethalal to convince the Gokuldham members to stop offering free buttermilk. Expecting Kurmura Kumar to oppose removing his banners, Chana is surprised by his unexpected reaction.

episodes.title: Chana Kumar's Suggestion
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham residents are split about removing the banner from the stall after Kurmura Kumar's threat. Later, Chana Kumar gives the residents a suggestion to deal with the problem.

episodes.title: Lemonade Vs Buttermilk
episodes.synopsis: Kurmura Kumar's man asks other Gokuldham members to not help Jethalal and Taarak with the lemonade stall. Gokuldham residents are torn between Chana Kumar and Kurmura Kumar. Later, Jethalal and Taarak struggle to set up their lemonade stall.

episodes.title: Jethalal Ka Nimbu Paani Stall
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and Taarak call Bhide for help to find lemons. They struggle to find a rickshaw while Gokuldham members wait. Later, Jethalal sets up his lemonade stall.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Ho Gaya Hai Divide
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi gets angry at Chana Kumar and Kurmura Kumar. Iyer drops the lemons while Tapu Sena feels bad about not helping Jethalal. Later, Kurmura Kumar's aide scolds the Gokuldham members for assisting Iyer when lemon juice gets in his eyes.

episodes.title: Dono Parties Mein Hua Jhagda
episodes.synopsis: Kurmura Kumar urges Gokuldham not to close the buttermilk stall. Taarak's boss uncovers his lemonade sales lie. Tensions escalate as Kurmura Kumar and Chana Kumar's groups clash over the drinks, sparking a fight.

episodes.title: Jethalal Under Arrest
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Pandey intervenes to resolve the issue between the two parties but his investigation uncovers evidence against Jethalal, leading to his arrest. Will the residents of Gokuldham stop his arrest?

episodes.title: Chana Kumar Ke Supporters
episodes.synopsis: Sunita refuses to sell her vegetables in Gokuldham, as she is loyal to Chana Kumar. Meanwhile, a huge crowd gathers outside Gada Electronics, looking for freebies.

episodes.title: Problems Se Kaise Bache?
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham members face problems due to Kurmura Kumar and Chana Kumar. They decide to shut down the lemonade and buttermilk stall, but Champaklal opposes this.

episodes.title: Mission Paar Paar
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena reviews the plan with everyone to avoid mistakes. Later, Bawri wishes them luck for "Mission Paar Paar," arousing the suspicion of Kurmura Kumar's and Chana Kumar's men.

episodes.title: Ganda Paani Ka Istamal
episodes.synopsis: Kurmura Kumar and Chana Kumar work at the buttermilk and lemonade counters for publicity. Later, food officials shut down Chana Kumar's lemonade counter due to polluted water.

episodes.title: Kumura Aur Chana Fass Gaye
episodes.synopsis: Two men drink buttermilk from the stall and faint. Rita reporter accuses Kurmura Kumar of using bad curd to make buttermilk. What will Kurmura Kumar do now?

episodes.title: Anjali Ka Juice
episodes.synopsis: Taarak urgently calls everyone over, announcing Anjali made juice for them. They all try to avoid tasting it. Later, Abdul gets scolded by Jethalal and Champaklal in front of his friend.

episodes.title: Abdul Ki Duty
episodes.synopsis: Abdul is busy running errands for the Gokuldham society members. Abdul's friend says that everyone is taking him for granted. Will Abdul listen to his advice?

episodes.title: Cake Gir Gaya
episodes.synopsis: Abdul's friend tries to talk to him, but Abdul is always busy. Popatlal drops a cake and angrily blames Bhide for the society's poor maintenance.

episodes.title: Abdul Ki Value Nahi Hai?
episodes.synopsis: Bhide scolds for not getting the pavement repaired. Later, Abdul's friend tells him that he's going abroad and tells him that Gokuldham members don't value him.

episodes.title: Abdul's Birthday
episodes.synopsis: Abdul waits for birthday wishes, telling his friend the Purush Mandli will congratulate him at the office. Will they remember?

episodes.title: The Forgotten Birthday
episodes.synopsis: Abdul feels sad when no one wishes him a happy birthday. Will they finally greet him or will he lose faith in his friends?

episodes.title: Poisoning Abdul's Mind
episodes.synopsis: Abdul's friend tries to manipulate him, saying the colony uses him and nobody cares. Will Abdul fall prey to doubt and mistrust?

episodes.title: Bawri's Phone Call
episodes.synopsis: Abdul asks to borrow Bhide's iron. Meanwhile, Bagha is unable to do his job properly as Bawri keeps calling him.

episodes.title: Bagha Needs A Holiday
episodes.synopsis: Bawri asks Bagha to take a day off to celebrate their special day - the anniversary of the day they first met. But will Jethalal grant him a day off?

episodes.title: Bawri Ka Mantra
episodes.synopsis: Bagha tells Bawri he can't get a holiday because Jethalal's 18 lakh rupees are stuck with PK Daruwala. Bawri suggests an idea to help Jethalal recover the money.

episodes.title: Daruwala Ka Phone Aa Gaya
episodes.synopsis: Bagha is upset that Jethalal didn't give him a holiday. Mr. Daruwala, in Khandala, apologizes for the payment delay. Will Jethalal get his payment today?

episodes.title: Cheque Collect Karna Hai
episodes.synopsis: Bagha and Bawri go to collect Jethalal's cheque, leaving him anxious. They arrive at Mr. Daruwala's resort. Will they get the cheque?

episodes.title: Cheque Ghum Gaya
episodes.synopsis: Bagha and Bawri choose to celebrate their anniversary instead of heading back to Mumbai. Unfortunately, Bawri mistakenly misplaces Jethalal's cheque. What's their next move?

episodes.title: Bag Mili Ya Nahi?
episodes.synopsis: Bawri suggests to Bagha that they should return to Mumbai and confess to Jethalal. They pray for guidance. What will happen next?

episodes.title: Installments Pe Phone
episodes.synopsis: Bagha worries about Jethalal seeing Bawri at his shop, but she goes along anyway. Later, Jethalal finds out his son bought a phone from his shop.

episodes.title: Tapu Sena Ko Mila Invitation
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena's talents are recognized with an invite to a gaming and animation conference in Pune. While everyone's bursting with pride, will everyone be allowed to go to Pune?

episodes.title: Tapu Sena Leaves For Pune
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena heads to Pune for their conference, with parents and elders wishing them luck and safe travels. Popatlal wants to teach Bhide a lesson for leaving his scooter keys behind.

episodes.title: Sakharam Ki Chori
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal plans to teach Bhide a lesson for his absent-mindedness. He hides Sakharam, Bhide's beloved scooter, in a hidden corner of the colony.

episodes.title: Pareshaan Popatlal
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham colony members are having fun at Abdul's shop when Popatlal arrives in a fancy car, looking worried and talking to a suspicious guy. Who could that mysterious man be?

episodes.title: Police Look For Popatlal
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Pandey is trying to take Champaklal to the hospital but the society members react otherwise. Later, the police are looking for Popatlal but he is nowhere to be found. Where is Popatlal?

episodes.title: Popatlal Kaha Hai?
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Pandey is on the lookout for Popatlal and searches for him everywhere. Will he be found?

episodes.title: On Popatlal's Trail
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Pandey and all the members of Gokuldham colony are on the lookout for Popatlal but he is nowhere to be found. Where could he be?

episodes.title: Musibat Ki Jad - Popatlal
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Pandey is searching for Popatlal in society while Popatlal is hiding in Bhide's house creating trouble for Bhide. What has Popatlal done and will Inspector Pandey find him?

episodes.title: Tension Mein Popatlal
episodes.synopsis: After a frantic search, Popatlal is finally discovered locked in his closet. When asked about his disappearance, he opens up about the overwhelming stress and tension that had been building up inside him.

episodes.title: Popatlal Ke Liye Rishta
episodes.synopsis: Everyone is relieved to see Popatlal so happy and relaxed. And to add to the excitement, a potential wedding opportunity is on the horizon! Will Popatlal finally tie the knot and start a new chapter in his life?

episodes.title: Popatlal Ki Kundli
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal grows increasingly impatient as he awaits a phone call from Inspector Pandey to find out if his horoscope matches the girl's. How will Popatlal handle the suspense?

episodes.title: Big Day For Popatlal
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham colony waits for the bride's family to arrive. Will everything go well for Popatlal?

episodes.title: Popatlal Ki Kismat
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal's wait may finally be over as he meets the girl and her family, accompanied by Inspector Pandey and his wife. Will this meeting seal the deal and lead to a long-awaited wedding?

episodes.title: Ladki Ka Decision
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Pandey thoroughly questions Popatlal on several matters before revealing the bride's decision.

episodes.title: Last Chance For Popatlal
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal's heart races as he prepares for his make-or-break meeting with his dream girl. He's determined to win her heart.

episodes.title: Popatlal's Date
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal finally clears the air with his potential bride, laying all his cards on the table. But will his honesty pay off?

episodes.title: Popatlal Ko Kaise Sambhale?
episodes.synopsis: The members of the Gokuldham Society are concerned for Popatlal since Madhubala has left him in limbo about her decision to marry him. How will they support him during this uncertain time?

episodes.title: Popatlal Ki Sagaai
episodes.synopsis: Madhubala and her family meet with Popatlal and his friends to reveal their final decision on their potential union.

episodes.title: Engagement Ki Taiyyari
episodes.synopsis: The entire colony is buzzing with excitement for Popatlal's engagement.

episodes.title: Popatlal Gets Anxious
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal is both thrilled and anxious about his engagement ceremony. Will he be able to keep his nerves in check and make it through the big day without a hitch?

episodes.title: Popatlal's Engagement Day
episodes.synopsis: It's Popatlal's engagement ceremony and everyone is excited. He hopes everything goes as planned. But will it all go smoothly, or will something unexpected happen?

episodes.title: Popatlal's Engagement Ceremony
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal's engagement ceremony is coming up and everyone is eager to welcome his beautiful bride into the family. But will the big day go off without a hitch?

episodes.title: Popatlal Gayab Hain
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal goes missing on his engagement day, and Inspector Pandey holds the Gokuldham members responsible. Where is Popatlal, and will he show up for his engagement?

episodes.title: Popatlal Ki Sagaai Tooti
episodes.synopsis: Dr. Hathi drops a bombshell on Popatlal, revealing that he and Madhubala are both carriers of the rare genetic disorder, Thalassemia minor. The doctor warns that their marriage could lead to serious health complications.

episodes.title: Celebrating Tapu Sena
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena returns from Pune, eager to celebrate their award with the entire colony. However, they're concerned that Popatlal might still be upset about his cancelled wedding and wonder how to approach him.

episodes.title: Kitty Party
episodes.synopsis: The women of Gokuldham gather for a kitty party, eager to share laughter and conversation.

episodes.title: Surprise Haircut
episodes.synopsis: All the women in Gokuldham society decide to surprise their husbands with a fresh haircut. How will the husbands react to this unexpected change in their looks?

episodes.title: Surprise For Bhide
episodes.synopsis: Bhide receives a surprise from his wife and daughter as they unveil their new hair color. Later, Popatlal summons all the men of the colony to his house for an urgent matter.

episodes.title: Jethalal Ka Meetha Sapna
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal believes he is dreaming when Champaklal tells him to go back to sleep instead of waking up. How will Jethalal react when he realizes this might not be just a dream?

episodes.title: Breakfast For Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: Dr. Hathi and his wife organize a grand special breakfast for the Gokuldham residents. They visit each house to ensure nobody eats before the surprise meal.

episodes.title: Banarasi Breakfast
episodes.synopsis: Everyone eagerly anticipates the special Banarasi Breakfast organized by Dr. Hathi on Sunday. Will everything unfold smoothly as planned for this exciting event?

episodes.title: Bhide Looks For Popatlal
episodes.synopsis: Bhide searches for Popatlal, convinced that Popatlal is playing a prank by hiding Sakharam.

episodes.title: Goli Kaha Hai?
episodes.synopsis: Bhide searches for Sakharam and discovers that Goli has gone to get breakfast on Sakharam. Later, they find Sakharam crashed with no sign of Goli.

episodes.title: Goli And Sakharam Return
episodes.synopsis: The colony members express concern about Goli and Sakharam's whereabouts to Inspector Pandey.

episodes.title: A Successful Breakfast
episodes.synopsis: The colony members delight in the delicious breakfast organized by Dr. Hathi and celebrate Goli and Sakharam's return.

episodes.title: Celebrating Sweet 16 Years
episodes.synopsis: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah celebrates 16 years of bringing laughter and joy to millions of viewers every day.

episodes.title: Bhide Ne Rakhi Shart
episodes.synopsis: Bhide makes a daring challenge to the children - if he wins, they can no longer play in the compound, but if he loses, they will never be interrupted again.

episodes.title: Penalty Shoot Out
episodes.synopsis: The colony members line up, each taking turns to shoot their penalty kicks, hoping to score the winning goal.

episodes.title: Roshan Ki Maangein
episodes.synopsis: Roshan demands that Sodhi take her out for a movie, shopping, and restaurant since it's been days since they went out. Meanwhile, Bhide is concerned that everyone will not pay the maintenance fee on time.

episodes.title: Jethalal's Business Trip
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is getting ready for a work trip to Hyderabad and leaves the shop duties to his helpers. But, he tells Baagha to make sure Bawri stays away from the shop.

episodes.title: Early Morning Flight
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is anxious about oversleeping and missing his morning flight. He reaches out to his neighbours for help and companionship. Will anyone come to his aid?

episodes.title: Jethalal Needs A Ride
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal thanks Iyer and Babita for their kindness and their decision to drive him to the airport for his flight. However, things take a sharp turn when he finds himself stranded with a punctured tire on a lonely street.

episodes.title: Jethalal Misses His Flight
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is upset because he missed his flight and fears that Bapuji will scold him. What will he do now?

episodes.title: Jethalal Returns
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal returns to his shop after his flight is cancelled, surprising Nattu Kaka and Baagha.

episodes.title: Everything Is Booked
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal, Bapuji, Iyer, and Babita find out that the restaurant is full. They call other options, but they're all booked too. Can they find a place to eat?

episodes.title: Jal Hi Jeevan Hai
episodes.synopsis: Bhide sets the quote of the day highlighting the importance of water. The question remains: will the colony members truly grasp the severity of the situation?

episodes.title: Ziddi Nalka
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and his family head out in a cab, while Popatlal is waiting for the plumber. He receives a call asking him to get to the office as soon as possible. How will Popatlal handle the situation?

episodes.title: Tala Nahi Todne Denge
episodes.synopsis: A plumber arrives at the colony, looking for Bhide, because he has forgotten his phone inside Bhide's house. However, the colony children refuse to let the plumber break the lock and instead, ask him to wait.

episodes.title: Chaabi Kaha Hai?
episodes.synopsis: The plumber's frustration reaches a boiling point as the keys to the lock remain nowhere to be found in Gokuldham. Meanwhile, Taarak's boss faces a similar predicament, losing his keys as well.

episodes.title: Chaabi Wale Ko Bulao
episodes.synopsis: The situation in Gokuldha becomes chaotic as the plumber loses his temper and threatens to break Bhide's lock. However, Abdul suggests breaking the lock. Can the key maker resolve the issue?"
