episodes.title: Bholaram's Anniversary
episodes.synopsis: Bholaram is distraught that his entire day has been ruined by searching for the keys. Meanwhile, his wife Sushma arrives in Gokuldham colony. Will the colony members be able to make amends and turn his day around?

episodes.title: Ravivaar Ka Plan
episodes.synopsis: Bhide is thrilled about his Sunday plan to enjoy Kothimbir Vadi with his family. However, a series of unexpected events throws a wrench in his plans.

episodes.title: Abdul Kaha Hain?
episodes.synopsis: Goli is eager to get some amchur powder, but Abdul's shop remains closed. Later, Tapu Sena informs the members of the society that Abdul hasn't shown up yet. Where could Abdul be?

episodes.title: Paani Khatam
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal is furious when the water stops mid-shower. He storms down and blames Bhide for the inconvenience.

episodes.title: Abdul Kaha Hai?
episodes.synopsis: The residents of Gokuldham colony are worried because Abdul is nowhere to be found. They search for him at his house and all the places he usually visits, but there is no sign of him.

episodes.title: Abdul Ki Udhaari
episodes.synopsis: The colony members find out that Abdul owes some people money, and they have come to collect it. Maybe that's why he has been hiding for a few days.

episodes.title: Abdul Ki Waapsi
episodes.synopsis: Everyone is expecting Inspector Pandey to find Abdul and bring him back. However, Pandey Ji is coming back empty-handed and Abdul is nowhere to be found.

episodes.title: Abdul Ki Majboori
episodes.synopsis: Abdul's return brings relief to the colony, but he keeps his financial struggles to himself. Despite his cheerful reunion, Abdul is secretly desperate and decides to sell his shop, abandoning his life in the colony.

episodes.title: Abdul Ki Tension
episodes.synopsis: Dr. Hathi mentions to all the men that Abdul has seemed different ever since he returned. What could be troubling Abdul?

episodes.title: Abdul Ke Dukaan Pe Sale
episodes.synopsis: Abdul, desperate for money and on the verge of selling his shop, offers a 50% discount to colony members without disclosing the true reason behind his sale.

episodes.title: Abdul's Urgency
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal checks in on Nattu Kaka and Baagha to ensure the shop is running smoothly in his absence. Meanwhile, Abdul is frantically trying to sell off all the goods to raise the money he desperately needs.

episodes.title: Tapu Sena Investigates
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena is intrigued by Abdul's mysterious behaviour and decides to get to the bottom of it. They confront him, demanding to know the real reason behind his sudden decision to sell everything at a whopping 50% discount.

episodes.title: Spying On Abdul
episodes.synopsis: The Tapu Sena installs a listening device to monitor Abdul's activities, but they feel uneasy about their decision.

episodes.title: Abdul Ki Dukaan
episodes.synopsis: The news that Abdul is attempting to sell his shop sends shockwaves through the colony, leaving all its members stunned and concerned.

episodes.title: Abdul Ka Udhaar
episodes.synopsis: Abdul opens up about his troubles to the members of the Gokuldham Society, who immediately offer to lend him money, but he graciously declines their help. How will Abdul manage to clear his debts on his own?

episodes.title: Abdul's Last Janmashtami
episodes.synopsis: The colony is reeling in disbelief as Abdul prepares to sell his shop and bid farewell. The thought of this being his last festival among them is unbearable. Will Abdul reconsider his decision?

episodes.title: All Eyes On The Matki
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena is confident that they will emerge victorious in the Dahi Handi celebrations and successfully break the Matki. However, the colony members are worried about their chances.

episodes.title: Tapu Sena Find A Loophole
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena is thrilled to participate in the Dahi Handi competition but faces disappointment when they're unable to register.

episodes.title: Matki Kaun Phodega?
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena is eager to participate in the competition, but their rivals mock them due to their lack of practice and experience. Can Tapu Sena prove their doubters wrong?

episodes.title: Bal Gopal Gokuldham Group
episodes.synopsis: The spotlight shines bright on Tapu Sena as they prepare to take on the ultimate challenge of cracking the Matki. With the entire family and neighbourhood on edge, can they pull it off?

episodes.title: Abdul Ki Kahaani
episodes.synopsis: Abdul discloses the real reason behind selling his shop to the Gokuldham residents. Will they stand by him in this decision?

episodes.title: Too Many Customers
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena helps Abdul save his shop by winning the Dahi Handi competition and securing the necessary funds. Meanwhile, Jethalal struggles to manage the shop on his own due to the absence of Nattu Kaka and Bagha.

episodes.title: Ganpati Decorations
episodes.synopsis: The women of Gokuldham want to take charge of the Ganpati decorations and propose their idea to the colony members.

episodes.title: Mahila Mandal's Decoration Planning
episodes.synopsis: The women of Gokuldham are thrilled to welcome Bappa and have taken charge of all the decorations. However, they want to keep their decoration idea a secret from everyone.

episodes.title: Decoration Ka Theme Kya Hai?
episodes.synopsis: The men in the colony are eager to know the theme the women have chosen for the Ganpati celebrations, but their wives are tight-lipped about it.

episodes.title: Decoration Ka Suspense
episodes.synopsis: All the men try different ways to uncover the secrets and learn the theme of the decoration. Meanwhile, Tapu Sena's rivals are envious that Gokuldham's decoration video went viral and decide to sabotage their next Ganpati celebration.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Mein Aaye Pehelwaan
episodes.synopsis: During the Ganapati celebration at Gokuldham Society, Olympic medalist Aman Sehrawat makes a special appearance, accompanied by Asit Modi.

episodes.title: Bappa Ke Darshan
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham colony is abuzz with festive spirit as people throng to visit Bappa and admire the beautiful decorations created by the colony's women. Olympic medalist Aman Sehrawat's special visit adds to the excitement,

episodes.title: Devotion Towards Bappa
episodes.synopsis: The actors from Kahan Shuru Kahan Khatam visit Gokuldham, inviting residents to watch their film. Later, the community opens the 'Daan Peti'. What will they find inside?

episodes.title: Ikkis Lakh Ka Cheque
episodes.synopsis: Shock and excitement erupt in the colony as members discover a staggering donation cheque tucked away in the 'Daan Peti'.

episodes.title: Cheque Ka Kya Karein?
episodes.synopsis: The colony members are shocked, excited, and perplexed about what to do with the enormous donation. They wonder if it's genuine or fake, who the donor is, and whether they should investigate further.

episodes.title: Bank Manager Se Mulaqat
episodes.synopsis: All the colony members gather to meet the bank manager and discuss what to do with the cheque. What will the manager say?

episodes.title: Ganpati Celebrations Ka Cheque
episodes.synopsis: Bhide, Iyer, and Jethalal are thrilled after receiving a cheque worth twenty-one lakhs for Ganpati celebrations, unaware that it's all part of a setup. What unexpected events will unfold next?

episodes.title: Zaroorat Mand Bacche
episodes.synopsis: With the donated money in hand, the colony launches a search for worthy students who need financial support to pursue their educational dreams. Will their efforts lead them to the right children?

episodes.title: Young Minds Unite
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham Society extends an invitation to all prospective candidates to attend the selection process for their scholarship program.

episodes.title: Vicky Ki Saajish
episodes.synopsis: The rivals of Tapu Sena are over the moon after convincingly tricking the Gokuldham colony members into thinking they've received a massive donation. The members are already celebrating and have announced scholarships for the kids. But will they catch on before things get out of hand?

episodes.title: A Big Shock For Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: The colony members are shocked and disappointed when they learn that the cheque for the scholarships has been voided and payment has been stopped. What will they do now?

episodes.title: Vicky Ki Marzi
episodes.synopsis: The colony members are left stunned and shocked, unsure of how to proceed, after Vicky refuses to make the payment and bluntly tells them that he has changed his mind.

episodes.title: Bappa Se Prarthana
episodes.synopsis: Abdul informs the society members that Rita Reporter is arriving in the colony with her cameramen. With Vicky still withholding the funds, Bhide and the other members are left wondering how they will manage to handle the situation.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Society Ki Badnaami
episodes.synopsis: The colony members are torn about how to address the scholarship situation, and they're considering being transparent about what really happened. Will they muster the courage to come clean?

episodes.title: Paiso Ka Bandobast
episodes.synopsis: The colony members are overjoyed when Tapu Sena reveals that the funds have been secured. But how did they miraculously come up with the money?

episodes.title: Sarva Pitru Amavasya
episodes.synopsis: The entire colony comes together to prepare traditional food and make elaborate arrangements for the Sarva Pitru Amavasya ritual, a sacred ceremony to honour and pay respect to beloved ancestors.

episodes.title: Discount Dilemma
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal struggles to sell his electronics as online markets and malls, with their enticing discounts, continue to dominate the market. Will he be able to find a solution to overcome these challenges?

episodes.title: Gada Electronics Ki Nayi Scheme
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal meets with Nattu Kaka and Bagha to discuss new ideas for increasing sales at Gada Electronics. Will they come up with a plan?"

episodes.title: Celebrity At Gada Electronics
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal, Nattu Kaka, and Bagha eagerly await the arrival of a special celebrity at Gada Electronics. Who is the celebrity?

episodes.title: Garba Practice
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham colony is abuzz with Navratri excitement. As the community comes together to perfect their Garba steps, but will the celebrations unfold smoothly, or will unexpected twists and turns add a dash of drama to the festivities?

episodes.title: Bhide Falls Sick
episodes.synopsis: The colony members are excited about Navratri celebrations and decide to start planning the decorations. But with Bhide falling sick suddenly, who will take up the charge?

episodes.title: Navratri Decorations
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena contacts the mandap decorator, but he refuses the job. Undeterred, they reach out to another decorator. Will they succeed in managing the wedding arrangements without Bhide's guidance?

episodes.title: Confronting Danav
episodes.synopsis: The Mahila Mandal visits Danav's home and offers support to his wife. Later, they confront Danav directly. What will be the result of their bold stand?

episodes.title: Mahila Mandal Ki Meeting
episodes.synopsis: Decorations for the event in Gokuldham are underway. Meanwhile, the Mahila Mandal calls for an urgent meeting involving all society members. What could be the pressing issue behind this sudden gathering?

episodes.title: Dushman Ka Dushman Dost Hota Hain
episodes.synopsis: Bhide attempts to contact other decorators, but they all refuse due to the society's conflict with Danav. Later, Popatlal introduces a new decorator named Raka Tabla. Will he step in to assist the members with the Navratri decorations?

episodes.title: Danav Ki Complaint
episodes.synopsis: The ladies of Gokuldham go to the police station to file a complaint against Danav, who beats his wife at home. Will Inspector Pandey be able to help with this situation?

episodes.title: Danav Ki Dhamki
episodes.synopsis: Danav dares the Gokuldham colony members to finish the decorations, saying he'll only help if they apologize. How will the colony members handle this situation?

episodes.title: Danav's Revenge
episodes.synopsis: Everyone in Gokuldham is thrilled about the Navratri celebrations, but Danav is determined to take revenge and ruin their festivities. Will he succeed in his plans?

episodes.title: Saving Danav's Life
episodes.synopsis: Danav's wife rushes in to inform the colony members that Danav is in danger. What has happened to him, and will the colony members decide to help?

episodes.title: Ravan Dahan In Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: The colony members are excited to get back to their festivities and dance Garba. Will the celebrations continue without any trouble until Raavan Dahan?

episodes.title: Japan Ki Special Strawberry
episodes.synopsis: Anjali invites Jethalal and Champaklal over for a strawberry milkshake. Later, Taarak's boss inquires about his Bade Guruji, putting Taarak in a tricky situation.

episodes.title: Taarak's Day Off
episodes.synopsis: Taarak is excited to learn that his boss will be on leave for two days, prompting him to plan some quality time with Anjali. Will his plans go smoothly?

episodes.title: Boss Se Chutkara
episodes.synopsis: Taarak is pleased to have time off from work due to his boss's absence. However, the other employees are now demanding the same. Will Taarak grant their request?

episodes.title: Taarak Ko Ho Rahi Tension
episodes.synopsis: Taarak is anxious, fearing his boss's reaction if it's revealed that the whole office was on break. Could this cost him his job?

episodes.title: Bade Guruji Se Mulaqat
episodes.synopsis: Taarak's boss insists that he organise a meeting with Bade Guruji. Will he manage to make it happen?

episodes.title: Bapuji Ko Kaise Manaye?
episodes.synopsis: Taarak worries about how to get Bapuji to play the role of Bade Guruji for his boss. Can he convince him to go along with it?

episodes.title: Taarak Ki Chinta
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal is irritated with Jethalal for agreeing to Taarak's request and decides not to take on the role of Bade Guruji. How will Taarak handle this setback?

episodes.title: Bade Guruji Ke Saath Mulaqat
episodes.synopsis: Taarak worries whether Bapuji will make it in time to pose as Bade Guruji for Varun. Will everything go smoothly with their pretend meeting?

episodes.title: Guruji's Double Trouble
episodes.synopsis: Taarak and his friends are stumped on how to arrange a meeting between Varun, his boss, and Bade Guruji, especially since Varun is already acquainted with Bapuji. Can they find a fake Bade Guruji in time to pull off the charade?

episodes.title: Boss Aur Guruji Ki Meeting
episodes.synopsis: Taarak finally manages to dress up Popatlal as Bade Guruji, preparing him to meet Varun, the boss's son. Will Taarak's elaborate plan succeed, or will they get caught?

episodes.title: Bade Guruji Ka Parda Faash
episodes.synopsis: Varun and his father seek Bade Guruji's blessings in separate encounters. Will they uncover Taarak's elaborate scheme?

episodes.title: Diwali Ki Taiyyari
episodes.synopsis: With enthusiasm high, the colony members make grand arrangements for Diwali. But will the festivities go smoothly?

episodes.title: Sarees For Mahila Mandal
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal invites the Mahila Mandal to his home and gifts them sarees for Diwali. Meanwhile, the men of Gokuldham gather at Abdul's shop. Later, Bhide makes an announcement about distributing free firecrackers to all society members.

episodes.title: Free Patakhe
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena suggests a collective purchase of firecrackers for everyone in the colony. But will the colony members be on board with this plan?

episodes.title: Allrounder Patakha
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal acquires a super firecracker and can't wait to show it off to the colony members. Will this firecracker live up to the hype, or will it fizzle out?

episodes.title: Patakha Panic
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal's convinced that Allrounder Patakha is going to flop, and he's worried about losing everything. Is he overthinking it, or is there something to his fear?

episodes.title: Allrounder Patakha's Final Test
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham members are thrilled about the Allrounder Patakha and hold a lucky draw to decide who will get to light it. But will it go off with a bang, or turn out to be a dud?

episodes.title: Life After Diwali
episodes.synopsis: The excitement of Diwali fades, leaving the colony members feeling empty. As they try to fill the void, they begin to look for new adventures and challenges to take on.

episodes.title: Jethalal Ki Exercise
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal encourages Jethalal to work out at home. Meanwhile, Bagha and Nattu Kaka devise a plan to attract more customers to the shop.

episodes.title: Surprise Trip
episodes.synopsis: Feeling restless in Gokuldham, Tapu Sena decides it's time for an exciting getaway. Bapuji, noticing their eagerness, hints at the perfect destination where they're sure to have a blast but keeps the location a secret.

episodes.title: Old Is Gold
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji surprises Tapu Sena with a secret trip, building their excitement to a peak. But how will they react when they discover the destination is an old age home?

episodes.title: Fun At The Old Age Home
episodes.synopsis: While Tapu Sena and Bapuji bond with the senior citizens at the old age home, Jethalal and his friends grow increasingly worried. Will they be able to find out where they've gone?

episodes.title: Dairy Strike
episodes.synopsis: The milkmen's strike leaves the colony struggling to get their basic daily supplies. How will the residents manage without milk?

episodes.title: Morning Chai
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham Colony faces a crisis as the milk supply runs dry, leaving everyone without their beloved morning chai. Later, Bhide struggles to decide whether to repair his fridge or replace it.

episodes.title: Bhide's Fridge Repair
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal gets frustrated with Bagha because Bawri keeps visiting the shop repeatedly. Later, Bagha heads to Bhide's house to repair his fridge.

episodes.title: Fridge Ka Sauda
episodes.synopsis: Bhide unknowingly strikes a deal to sell his fridge to a scrap dealer for a shockingly low price. Just in time, Jethalal steps in to stop the sale and tries to help Bhide secure a much better offer. Will Jethalal's intervention save the day?

episodes.title: Jethalal Ke Liye Sunahara Mauka
episodes.synopsis: After successfully delivering the fridge to the businessman, Jethalal is presented with an enticing offer to acquire more old fridges of the same brand for a generous reward.

episodes.title: Cooling King Ka Offer
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal faces difficulty finding old fridges in scrap shops and comes up with an exchange offer to acquire Cooling King brand fridges.

episodes.title: Mega Exchange Offer
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal's social media campaign quickly gains traction, attracting a lot of attention. His tempting offer seems too good to be true and other businessmen start to wonder what the catch is.

episodes.title: Jethalal Ki Khushi
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal successfully acquires all the fridges and is overjoyed. Later, a businessman arrives at Gada Electronics to finalize the deal. How will this transaction unfold?

episodes.title: Jethalal Ki Duvidha
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal finds himself in a dilemma with old fridges cluttering his shop just as a new shipment of fridges is about to arrive. How will he handle the situation?

episodes.title: Macchar Problem
episodes.synopsis: Baagha struggles with the mosquito problem as he and Nattu Kaka look after the fridges overnight, waiting for them to be transferred.

episodes.title: What To Do With The Fridges?
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is concerned about the fridges lying around in the colony with no sign of anyone coming to collect them. What explanation will the businessman give when Jethalal calls him?

episodes.title: Jethalal Ke Saath Fraud
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal goes to the police station to file a complaint against the businessman who scammed him. Will Inspector Pandey be able to help him?

episodes.title: Dunkiwala Ko Kaise Pakde?
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and his neighbours are increasingly worried as they struggle to trace Dunkiwala, the businessman who deceived Jethalal. Will they find a way to catch him?

episodes.title: Dunkiwala Ke Saath Meeting
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and his friends arrange a meeting with Dunkiwala, hoping to catch him red-handed. Will their plan succeed?

episodes.title: Dunkiwala Ka Fraud
episodes.synopsis: Upon discovering that Babu Bakkal is actually Dunkiwala, Jethalal flees from his men, taking the money with him. Will he get caught?

episodes.title: Sodhi's Party Plans
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi is overjoyed about his friend's visit from Punjab for his birthday. Will Roshan give him the green light for a celebration?

episodes.title: Paratha Party
episodes.synopsis: Roshan refuses to allow Sodhi to throw a party for his friends visiting from out of town and suggests a paratha party instead.

episodes.title: No Party Sharty
episodes.synopsis: Roshan hesitates to give Sodhi permission for his party, but his friends promise he will behave. Will she agree?

episodes.title: Harmeet’s Party
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi brings Bhide and Popatlal along for Harmeet's birthday to ensure he doesn't drink. But will the two manage to resist temptation themselves?

episodes.title: Cheers Or Not?
episodes.synopsis: Harmeet tries to trick Sodhi into drinking, but Popatlal and Bhide make sure to keep him in check. Will Harmeet succeed in getting Sodhi tipsy during his birthday celebrations?

episodes.title: Sodhi Ki Party-Sharty
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal and Bhide manage a drunken Sodhi, while Roshan anxiously waits at home. Will Sodhi be allowed into the house?

episodes.title: Bhide Seeks Jethalal's Help
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and Popatlal turn to Jethalal for help in managing a drunken Sodhi. Just as Jethalal is about to leave home, Champaklal catches him. Will this land Jethalal in trouble?

episodes.title: Taarak Ka Idea
episodes.synopsis: The men of Gokuldham rally together to help Bhide and Popatlal manage a drunken Sodhi. They turn to Taarak, hoping he can come up with a plan to get Sodhi safely back to Gokuldham. What solution will Taarak devise?

episodes.title: Anjali Ki Dosti
episodes.synopsis: Anjali learns the truth about how the men of the colony lied to Roshan Bhabhi to save Sodhi after his party-sharty. Will she expose their lies?

episodes.title: Sodhi Confesses
episodes.synopsis: Anjali's plan succeeds, and Sodhi finally admits to his wife about his party-sharty and how the men of the colony made up an excuse to protect him. How will she respond?

episodes.title: Permission To Party
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal grows increasingly worried about his son's future now that he's grown up. Meanwhile, Tapu Sena seeks Bhide's permission to let Sonu attend a late-night party.

episodes.title: Baccho Ka Bhavishya
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and the others grow anxious about their children's future and upcoming marriage proposals. Later, Bhide becomes particularly concerned when he finds Sonu's phone switched off.

episodes.title: Sonu Runs Late
episodes.synopsis: Bhide is on edge, worried that Sonu and Tapu Sena haven't returned from the party. He decides to take matters into his own hands and heads out to check on them.

episodes.title: Sonu Ki Chinta
episodes.synopsis: Bhide's concern for Sonu grows as he struggles with his distrust of Tapu and his desire to find her a suitable match quickly. How will he handle the pressure of having a growing daughter?

episodes.title: Shaadi Ki Umr
episodes.synopsis: Bhide is concerned about Sonu's friendship with Tapu, fearing it might blossom into love. How will he come to terms with the fact that his daughter is now grown up and capable of making her own decisions?

episodes.title: Bhide Ki Jaldbaazi
episodes.synopsis: Worried about Sonu and Tapu's growing friendship, Bhide decides to speed up his search for a groom for Sonu. Meanwhile, Bapuji starts looking for a bride for Tapu.

episodes.title: Suitable Groom For Sonu
episodes.synopsis: Bhide calls in an acquaintance to help arrange Sonu's marriage. How will she react when she finds out?

episodes.title: Shaadi Pressure
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and Champaklal attempt to persuade Tappu to consider marriage, but he firmly refuses. Meanwhile, Sonu faces similar pressure from her parents. How will the duo manage to decline their elders' expectations?

episodes.title: Shaadi Ka Darr
episodes.synopsis: As their families begin the search for suitable life partners, Sonu and Tapu find themselves in a state of panic. Desperate to avoid arranged marriages, will they be able to come up with a plan?

episodes.title: Tapu's Wedding Woes
episodes.synopsis: Tapu is growing increasingly anxious as the pressure to get married mounts, but he's running out of creative excuses to dodge the issue. Will he find a clever way to wriggle out of it?

episodes.title: Tapu And Sonu Hire An Actor
episodes.synopsis: Tapu and Sonu come up with a plan to hire an actor to help them avoid getting married. But will their plan work?

episodes.title: Mission Shaadi Atkao
episodes.synopsis: Tapu and Sonu convince the actor to help them in this situation. Will their plan work out?

episodes.title: Chotelal Ki Bhavishyavaani
episodes.synopsis: Chotelal, disguised as an astrologer, advises Bhide to stop worrying about Sonu's marriage now, in an attempt to help Sonu escape the situation. Will Bhide be convinced?

episodes.title: Popatlal's Suspense
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal keeps the Gokuldham men in suspense about his plans. Meanwhile, a father and son visit Gada Electronics to purchase a phone.

episodes.title: Rahsyamai Meeting
episodes.synopsis: Everyone is eager about Popatlal's huge announcement that will either shake or break their world.

episodes.title: Popatlal's Huge Announcement
episodes.synopsis: As restlessness grows, Popatlal gears up to reveal his much-awaited announcement in the clubhouse.

episodes.title: Sabki Bhavishyavaani
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal uses artificial intelligence to predict everyone's future and reads them out one by one. What surprises and revelations await them?

episodes.title: Bapuji's Future
episodes.synopsis: While Popatlal eagerly shares everyone's future, he hesitates when it comes to Bapuji. What could he be hiding?

episodes.title: Gokuldham New Year Celebration
episodes.synopsis: In Gokuldham, everyone gets ready to welcome the New Year with elaborate celebrations and great enthusiasm.

episodes.title: Secret Surprise
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham members ring in the New Year with great enthusiasm and excitement. Meanwhile, each of them secretly prepares unique balloon surprises for the celebration.

episodes.title: Ek Nayi Shuruaat
episodes.synopsis: Everyone in Gokuldham Colony celebrates and welcomes the New Year with great excitement and festive spirit.

episodes.title: Bapuji Ki Udaan
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji gets the opportunity to release the balloon to kick-start the New Year, but things take an unexpected turn when he ends up floating away with the balloons. Will the others manage to bring him down in time?

episodes.title: Bapuji's Balloon Adventure
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji drifts across the city, carried by balloons, as the colony members race to catch up and figure out how to bring him back down. Will they manage to rescue him?

episodes.title: Bapuji Ko Kaise Utaare?
episodes.synopsis: The colony members panic as they struggle to figure out how to bring Bapuji down. With Inspector Pandey stepping in, can they find a way?

episodes.title: Bapuji Kaha Hai?
episodes.synopsis: As Bapuji floats further away, the colony members lose sight of him. How will they manage to find him and get him down safely?

episodes.title: Maa Ka Abhaas
episodes.synopsis: Sunder's mother senses that Champaklal might leave the country, while the Gokuldham members work to figure out the situation. Meanwhile, Inspector Pandey receives orders to locate Champaklal urgently.

episodes.title: Pakistani Jasoos
episodes.synopsis: As Bapuji floats towards Pakistan, fishermen spot him and mistakenly think he's a Pakistani spy, alerting the authorities. Will they uncover the truth?

episodes.title: Bapuji in Trouble
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji is apprehended by the Pakistani army, who mistake him for an Indian spy. What actions will they take against him?

episodes.title: Bapuji Pakde Gaye
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji gets captured by Pakistani soldiers and interrogated. What will Bapuji say to escape this situation?

episodes.title: Bapuji's Bluff
episodes.synopsis: After being caught by Pakistani soldiers, Bapuji convinces them he's one of their spies. Will they see through his bluff or believe his story?

episodes.title: Bapuji's Rescue
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji finds himself in a tight spot as the Pakistani soldiers see through his bluff. Can he devise a plan to save himself and the fishermen?

episodes.title: Champaklal Is Safe
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal contacts Jethalal via video call to let him know he is safe in Kutch. Will he make it back to Gokuldham without any trouble?

episodes.title: Champaklal Returns Home
episodes.synopsis: As Champaklal returns to Gokuldham, he shares the unbelievable tale of how he was swept away and captured by Pakistani soldiers. How will the residents react to his extraordinary adventure?

episodes.title: AI Ki Bhavishyavaani
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham members find themselves both anxious and excited about the AI predictions. Will they come true, or are they just a hoax?

episodes.title: Jethalal Ko Aaya Sapna
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal dreams that his business is booming, but Bapuji wakes him up. Will his dream turn into reality the next day?

episodes.title: Jethalal Out Of Stock
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal discovers that his storehouse is out of electronics stock. What's preventing him from restocking his appliances?

episodes.title: Dhanda Bandh
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is in a state of panic as the company denies him the essential stock for his electronics store. What could be the reason behind this sudden boycott?

episodes.title: Ramsang Se Panga
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal's business is on the line as Ramsang cuts off his stock supply. Will he be able to find a solution?

episodes.title: Surprise Visit
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is in for a shock when he discovers that a complaint has been lodged against him, leading to his stock being blocked. A surprise inspection of his store is now scheduled, which will seal his fate.

episodes.title: Shutter Bandh
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal faces a crisis when he gets locked out of his shop on the day of a surprise inspection. Will he find a solution?

episodes.title: Venukutti's Arrival
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal hatches an elaborate plan to welcome Venu Kutti. He borrows Sodhi's car, to keep him distracted. Will his scheme unfold as planned?

episodes.title: Nakli Venukutti
episodes.synopsis: Bagha disguises himself as a driver to pick up Mr. Venukutti, while Nattu Kaka poses as him to fool the real driver. Will their plan succeed?

episodes.title: Bagha Tries His Best
episodes.synopsis: Bagha does everything he can to keep Mr. Venukutti occupied while Jethalal rushes to open the shop's shutters. Can he buy enough time?

episodes.title: Cutter And Shutter
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal waits at the entrance of his shop along with Bawri and the locksmith while Bagha is on his way with Mr Venkutti. How will he enter the shop?

episodes.title: Bagha Loses Venukutti
episodes.synopsis: Venukutti gives Bagha the slip and makes his way to Jethalal's shop. Will Jethalal manage to open the shutter before it's too late?

episodes.title: Venukutti Questions Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Mr. Venukutti bombards Jethalal with questions and complaints. Can Jethalal handle the tough interrogation?

episodes.title: Bapuji's Trip
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji is eager to go on a trip with his friends, but Jethalal is hesitant to let him go alone. Will he find a way to join in?

episodes.title: Jethalal Ki Pol Pakdi Gayi
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal discovers that Jethalal is faking his illness. Later, his friends arrive to take him along. Can Jethalal stop him?

episodes.title: Lunch Invitation For Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Tapu and Sonu fight it out over one point in a badminton match. Later, Jethalal gets an invitation for lunch from Babita and Taarak. Whose house will he go to?

episodes.title: Jethalal Ki Duvidha
episodes.synopsis: Taarak suggests a way for Jethalal to enjoy meals at both his home and Babita's house. Will Jethalal be able to pull it off?

episodes.title: Jethalal Ka Jhoot Pakda Gaya
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal, already full from pretending to eat at Babita's house, is caught off guard when Anjali arrives. How will he manage the situation?

episodes.title: Special Day Ki Special Baat
episodes.synopsis: Tapu informs Bhide that he has something special to share with Sonu on this special day, leaving Bhide anxious. What could it be?

episodes.title: Sakharam Par Kabootar Ke Daane
episodes.synopsis: To improve his chances of getting married, Popatlal starts feeding pigeons by placing grains on Bhide's Sakharam. Will Bhide tolerate this?

episodes.title: Bluetooth Baba Ka Interview
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal is given the task of interviewing Bluetooth Baba. How will the conversation unfold?

episodes.title: Bluetooth Baba Ka Prediction
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal panics as he struggles to find a rickshaw. Will Bluetooth Baba's prediction come true?

episodes.title: Bhoot Ka Darr
episodes.synopsis: Fear spreads through the colony as residents believe a ghost is lurking among them. Is there truth to their fears or just a misunderstanding?

episodes.title: Champaklal Ka Darr
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal is startled by a shadow he believes to be a ghost, while Sodhi, Popatlal, and Bhide try to reassure him. Is it really a ghost?

episodes.title: Bhoothnath In Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: The society members grow anxious after Popatlal insists he saw someone inside Mr. Verma's house. Who could it be?

episodes.title: Society Rules For Bhoothnath
episodes.synopsis: Bhide approaches Bhootnath to explain the society's rules. Meanwhile, Taarak questions Jethalal about Tapu's marriage.

episodes.title: Champaklal Aur Raja Mastana Ka Aamna Saamna
episodes.synopsis: During his morning walk, Champaklal's friends propose a potential match for Tapu. Later, Raja Mastnana calls Tapu. What trouble awaits him?

episodes.title: Sonu Ke Liye Ladka
episodes.synopsis: Joshi Kaka visits Bhide with a marriage proposal for Sonu. How will Bhide respond?

episodes.title: Tapu Aur Sonu Ki Majboori
episodes.synopsis: Bhide discovers that Tapu and Sonu tricked him and Champaklal with Raja Mastana's help. Later, he takes Raja Mastana's number from Abdul. How will Tapu and Sonu handle the situation?

episodes.title: Bhide Meets Raja Mastana
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and Madhavi dress up to meet Raja Mastana. What surprises await Tapu and Sonu?

episodes.title: Bhide Ka Surprise
episodes.synopsis: Bhide invites Raja Mastana to Gokuldham in front of Sonu and Tapu. Later, he hints to Champaklal about a surprise in store. What could Bhide be planning?

episodes.title: Raja Mastana's Prediction
episodes.synopsis: Raja Mastana arrives at Gokuldham Society as part of Bhide's plan, leaving Tapu and Sonu stunned. He makes a prediction about their marriage. How will Tapu and Sonu escape this situation?

episodes.title: Tapu And Sonu Get Reprimanded
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and Madhavi are disappointed with Sonu and scold her. Distressed, she calls Tapu for help. How will they resolve the situation?

episodes.title: Kar Bhala To Hoga Bhala
episodes.synopsis: Joshi Kaka presents Sonu with potential matches, but she turns them all down. Meanwhile, Kanji Kaka does the same for Tapu. How will Tapu and Sonu handle this situation?

episodes.title: Sonu And Tapu's Grooming Day
episodes.synopsis: As Madhavi and Sonu head to the parlour, the Mahila Mandal catches them. Later, Bhide informs Champaklal that the ladkewale are coming to see Sonu.

episodes.title: Sonu Aur Tapu Ka Dukh
episodes.synopsis: Sonu feels emotional about leaving the society after her marriage. Later, she and Tapu meet and express their sadness together.

episodes.title: Sonu Ki Mangni
episodes.synopsis: Sonu has a troubling dream that the groom's family has approved of her. Panicked, she calls Tapu for help. How will Tapu and Sonu handle this situation?

episodes.title: Bhaag Ke Shaadi
episodes.synopsis: Tapu suggests that Sonu elope and marry. He seeks Tapu Sena's help. Will their plan work?

episodes.title: Bhide Ki Googly
episodes.synopsis: Tapu and his Sena come together to carry out their plan, but obstacles arise. Later, as Sonu attempts to leave the house, she finds Bhide blocking her path. How will she handle the situation?

episodes.title: Tapu Consoles Sonu
episodes.synopsis: Bhide discovers that Sonu has lied to him. Meanwhile, Tapu comforts Sonu as she feels guilty for deceiving her father. Later, Bhide informs Jethalal about Tapu and Sonu's sudden disappearance. What will happen next?

episodes.title: Bhide And Champaklal Realise Their Mistake
episodes.synopsis: The residents of Gokuldham search for Tapu Sena at Nehru Ground but find no sign of them. Meanwhile, Tapu and Sonu purchase varmala garlands.

episodes.title: Shaadi Ka Pavitra Bandhan
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham members search for Tapu and Sonu, while Tapu comforts Sonu, assuring her about their decision. But what are they really planning?

episodes.title: Bhide Files A Complaint
episodes.synopsis: Bhide files a complaint against Tapu at the police station. Meanwhile, Tapu and Sonu invite the society members to come home. Have they really gotten married?

episodes.title: Varmala Ki Katha
episodes.synopsis: As Jethalal and Bhide enter the society with Inspector Pandey, they are stopped by the Mahila Mandal. Later, Tapu and Sonu finally reveal the truth to everyone.

episodes.title: Tapu Aur Sonu Ka Interrogation
episodes.synopsis: Tapu and Sonu confess that they are not married and reveal the whole truth behind their decision to run away from the society.

episodes.title: Sanskari Aur Samajhdar
episodes.synopsis: Tapu and Sonu reveal the truth, but Inspector Pandey remains suspicious. Their story is confirmed when Dia and Raj's parents arrive at Jethalal's house.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Ki Holi
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham Society celebrates Holika Dahan with great enthusiasm, followed by joyful Holi festivities.

episodes.title: Taarak Ke Liye Mithai
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal brings sweets for Taarak, but Taarak refuses to eat them because of Anjali. Later, Bhide plays a prank on Popatlal.

episodes.title: Popatlal Creates A Scene
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal causes a commotion in the society over earth sacks dumped in the compound. Later, Bhide calls Bhoothnath to scold him for the mess.

episodes.title: Verma Ji Ka Ghar
episodes.synopsis: The Mahila Mandal goes for their daily vegetable shopping. Later, they visit Verma Ji's newly renovated flat, but their visit takes an unexpected turn when a sudden siren startles everyone awake.

episodes.title: Verma Ji Ke Ghar Ka Siren
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham members grow frustrated with the alarm at Verma Ji's house and find a way to turn it off. Later, the Mahila Mandal admits to attempting to enter the house without permission.

episodes.title: Hyderabad Ka Order
episodes.synopsis: Bagha and Nattu Kaka are delighted to see customers arriving early at Gada Electronics. Later, Jethalal receives a call from Hussain in Hyderabad regarding his order.

episodes.title: Meeting Ka Din
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is eager for his meeting with Hussain, but a series of delays keep him from leaving for the office. Will he make it on time?

episodes.title: Jethalal Gets A Lift
episodes.synopsis: Hussain assures Bagha that he will arrive on time, while Jethalal faces multiple delays on his way to the shop. Later, he meets a man named Mahesh who offers him a lift. Will he make it on time?

episodes.title: Jethalal Gets Stuck In The Car
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal finds himself in trouble when his co-passenger suddenly flees, leaving him stuck in the car. Meanwhile, Bagha and Nattu Kaka anxiously await his arrival. Will he reach on time?

episodes.title: Jethalal Runs Late
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal finally manages to convince the driver to drop him at his shop, but he's running out of time. Will he miss out on the business deal?

episodes.title: Kya Deal Hogi Pakki?
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal worries that he might lose the deal due to his delay. However, the person responsible for all the commotion arrives at Gada Electronics. Will he admit his mistake?

episodes.title: Sawal-Jawab Ka Khel
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham men enjoy a question-and-answer game over soda. Later, Bhide is startled when he feels that Sakharam has started talking.

episodes.title: Bhide Ke Ghar Ke Bahar Goni
episodes.synopsis: Roshan discovers a suspicious sack outside Madhavi and Bhide's house and shares her concerns with the Mahila Mandal. Is this the start of a new problem?

episodes.title: Goni Mein Kya Hai?
episodes.synopsis: The police arrive at Gokuldham Society after Popatlal discovers a mysterious gunny sack outside Bhide's house. What secrets lie hidden inside?

episodes.title: Kathal Season
episodes.synopsis: Excitement spreads through the colony as Bhide distributes jackfruit to everyone, a gift from his uncle's farm. However, the women find themselves puzzled over how to cook it.

episodes.title: Gudi Padwa In Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: The Bhides take the initiative to prepare a variety of jackfruit dishes for Gudi Padwa, adding to the festive spirit as all of Gokuldham Colony comes together to celebrate the auspicious day.

episodes.title: Naya Saal Nayi Shuruat
episodes.synopsis: As the new year begins, the residents of Gokuldham Colony are in high spirits, ready to embrace new beginnings. What surprises and adventures await them in the coming year?

episodes.title: Jethalal Ko Hua Profit
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is thrilled as his sales surpass last year's numbers, prompting Natu Kaka and Bagha to request a salary increment. However, his joy turns to worry when he returns home and finds Bapuji missing.

episodes.title: Champaklal Has Tears In His eyes
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal scolds Jethalal for delaying the door repair. Later, at the soda shop, Taarak shares a sher with everyone. Later, Jethalal finds Champaklal crying, but what's the reason behind his tears?

episodes.title: Locked Inside
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji plays a heartfelt tune on his harmonica in memory of his old friend and gets ready to go meet him. But just as he's about to leave, he realises the main door is locked from the outside. Will he be able to get out?

episodes.title: Ghar Ki Chaabi
episodes.synopsis: With the door locked from outside, Jethalal, Tapu, and Bapuji try everything to get out of the house. But nothing seems to work. Will they manage to escape?

episodes.title: Tala Kaise Tode?
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and his family are still locked inside, and despite everyone's efforts, no one can figure out a way to get them out. Will they be rescued in time?

episodes.title: Mannu Se Mulaqat
episodes.synopsis: After being trapped inside the house, Bapuji finally gets out and rushes to meet his childhood friend before he leaves for treatment in America. Will he reach in time?

episodes.title: Bapuji's Race Against Time
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji is on his way to meet his old friend Mannu before he leaves for America, but a blocked road forces them to take a longer route. Will he still be able to make it on time?

episodes.title: Champaklal Meets His Friend
episodes.synopsis: Goli, Gogi, and Pinku try to protect Iyer's car, while Tapu returns with Champaklal after introducing him to his friend. Meanwhile, Jethalal learns that Champaklal has met his friend and is on his way back.

episodes.title: Tala Kisne Maara?
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal remains trapped inside his apartment, struggling to find a way out. The mystery deepens as he wonders who could have locked the door in the first place.

episodes.title: Gogi's Dream Bike
episodes.synopsis: With stars in his eyes and his heart set on his dream bike, Gogi turns to his father, Sodhi, hoping he'll make his wish come true. Will this dream ride become a reality?

episodes.title: Cricket Ka Bhoot
episodes.synopsis: Cricket fever takes over the neighbourhood as Tapu Sena gets ready to enjoy the big match. Gogi and Tapu make things more exciting with a pizza bet on their favourite teams. Who will win the bragging rights?

episodes.title: Rocky's Surprise
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena heads to their favourite pizza place for a fun evening, but Goli surprises them with news about their childhood friend Rocky. What surprise does Rocky have in store for him?

episodes.title: Raato Raat Ameeri
episodes.synopsis: Gogi gets tempted when Rocky introduces him to fantasy cricket with promises of quick money. With his dream bike in sight, will Gogi give in?

episodes.title: Gogi Opens A Bank Account
episodes.synopsis: Gogi visits the bank to open a new account when Popatlal unexpectedly finds his Aadhar card there. Sensing something suspicious, Popatlal immediately calls Sodhi. Will Gogi get caught?

episodes.title: Gogi Ko Hua Munafa
episodes.synopsis: Gogi is thrilled after earning money through a fantasy cricket app. But will this excitement turn into an obsession?

episodes.title: Gogi Ki Nayi Bike
episodes.synopsis: Gogi is over the moon after winning big on the fantasy cricket app and finally getting his dream bike. But with success coming so easily, will he be able to stop himself before it turns into an obsession?

episodes.title: Gogi Needs Money
episodes.synopsis: As the cricket season nears its end, Gogi feels the pressure to go big and cash in on one last opportunity. But with no money in hand, can he find a way to fund his dream?

episodes.title: Gogi Risks It All
episodes.synopsis: Gogi is caught between excitement and anxiety after putting in all his money on the fantasy app. With everything riding on this one game, will he walk away with his dream or face a tough reality?

episodes.title: Gogi Needs More Money
episodes.synopsis: Gogi needs more money to supplement his income and make up for his losses on the fantasy app. However, Tapu gives him a phone instead of cash. How will Tapu deal with this situation in his web of lies?

episodes.title: Gogi Ka Online Course
episodes.synopsis: Gogi finds a way to talk to Sonu and asks her for money. Later, he approaches Pinku with the same request. Will Gogi manage to recover his money?

episodes.title: Gogi's Web Of Lies
episodes.synopsis: Desperate to win big, Gogi lies to Popatlal and borrows ten thousand rupees. With mounting debts and tangled lies, will Gogi be able to escape the trouble he has created for himself?

episodes.title: Gogi Ko Hua Loss
episodes.synopsis: Gogi is stressed as he can't make the profit he needs to pay back his loans. With pressure building from all sides, will he find a way out?

episodes.title: Gogi In Big Trouble
episodes.synopsis: After suffering a major loss on the fantasy app, Gogi finds himself drowning in debt. Will he come clean or dig himself deeper into trouble?

episodes.title: Gogi Kaha Hai?
episodes.synopsis: Gogi goes missing, leaving his family and neighbours shocked as they realise he borrowed money from all of them using different excuses. Will they track him down and confront him?

episodes.title: Gogi Ki Talash
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena, Popatlal, and Sodhi search high and low for Gogi, who has vanished along with the money. Their hunt leads them to Rocky's parents. Where is Gogi?

episodes.title: Sodhi's Vow
episodes.synopsis: Rita Reporter arrives at the society to broadcast the news, hoping it reaches Gogi. Hearing this, Sodhi vows not to eat or drink until Gogi returns. Will their efforts lead to Gogi's return?

episodes.title: Finding Gogi
episodes.synopsis: Everyone is worried because Gogi is nowhere to be found, and Tapu Sena is going wild trying to locate him. Will they find him safe and sound?

episodes.title: Gogi Comes Clean
episodes.synopsis: Gogi gathers his friends and family to confess everything about why he took money from them. Will they understand his reasons or be too hurt to forgive him?

episodes.title: Bhide Pe Aarop
episodes.synopsis: As Bhide prepares for a day out with his wife, Popatlal unexpectedly calls for a meeting and accuses him of something serious. What has triggered Popatlal's anger this time?

episodes.title: Bhide Ke Khilaaf Saboot
episodes.synopsis: With the entire colony watching, Popatlal urges Bhide to open a sealed box he claims contains proof of wrongdoing. Will Bhide be able to defend himself?

episodes.title: Defective Samaan
episodes.synopsis: Babita confronts Jethalal after getting an electric shock from a faulty appliance she bought from him. As more complaints start pouring in, Jethalal is left scrambling to understand what's causing the issue.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Members Ko Laga Shock
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham residents panic after an electric shock incident and rush to turn off the main switch, only to realize the keys are missing. With no other option, they call Bhide for help.

episodes.title: Meter Box Ki Chaabi Kaha Hai?
episodes.synopsis: The entire colony gathers to play table tennis while waiting for Bhide to return with the keys. Will he have them so the electricity can finally be restored?

episodes.title: Bhide Ki Galti
episodes.synopsis: Abdul comes out and informs everyone that he doesn't have the keys and that the electrician has them. This angers the colony members, who blame Bhide for the mishap. Will Bhide be able to find a solution?

episodes.title: Bhootnaath Kidhar Hai?
episodes.synopsis: The colony members are relieved to have electricity restored after a stressful period. However, Bhide and Popatlal remain worried, as Bhootnath has not responded or provided any update on the renovation.

episodes.title: Sonu's Special Dinner
episodes.synopsis: Sonu prepares a special dinner for Bhide and invites all her friends to join. Later, Bhide learns that a new family will soon be moving into Gokuldham Colony. Who could they be?

episodes.title: Waiting For The New Family
episodes.synopsis: All the colony members are excited about the new family moving in, but there's also a hint of concern about whether they'll get along. Who will their new neighbours be?

episodes.title: Naye Parivaar Ka Swagat
episodes.synopsis: The society eagerly prepares to welcome a new member. However, later, Bhoothnath arrives with shocking news that changes everything.

episodes.title: Nakli Customer
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji and Tapu urge Jethalal to bring Daya back from Gujarat. Meanwhile, Baawri surprises everyone by bringing customers to the shop and serving breakfast to Baagha. Will the customers make big purchases?

episodes.title: Himalaya Trip
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal breathes a sigh of relief when he learns there is no complaint against him. Instead, the association is planning a trip to the Himalayas. How will Jethalal react to this unexpected news?

episodes.title: Trip Ki Taiyyari
episodes.synopsis: As Jethalal begins planning for his Himalayan trip, several colony members show interest in joining him. Meanwhile, he starts preparing Bapuji to manage the shop in his absence. Will everything fall into place?

episodes.title: Paiso Ki Baarish
episodes.synopsis: Investment fever grips Gokuldham Society as everyone looks for smart ways to grow their money. Later, Taarak is added to an exclusive investment group claiming to have top analysts. Will he be tempted to join in?

episodes.title: Taarak Runs Late
episodes.synopsis: Taarak is thrilled by the promising investment group, especially after spotting some well-known names. But in the excitement, he loses track of time and gets late for work. Will he make it on time and share the opportunity with his boss?

episodes.title: Taarak Invests Money
episodes.synopsis: Taarak advises his boss to invest, making an investment himself as well. Later, Jethalal turns to Taarak for guidance on the same opportunity. But is it all too good to be true or just a scam in disguise?

episodes.title: Gokuldham Colony Invests Money
episodes.synopsis: After hearing Taarak, everyone in Gokuldham Colony invests in the app. But will this investment bring them gains or is it all just a scam?

episodes.title: Investment Ki Chinta
episodes.synopsis: Everyone in the colony is excited about their new investment, but Bapuji advises Jethalal to wait until the profits actually reach his account. What will Jethalal discover when he finally tries to withdraw the money?

episodes.title: Investment Meeting
episodes.synopsis: The colony members get excited about earning big and gear up for a major investment meeting at night. With high hopes and big dreams, will everything go as planned or will there be a twist?

episodes.title: Bumper Munafa Fund
episodes.synopsis: Excitement runs high in the colony as everyone invests heavily after a successful meeting, dreaming of massive returns within a year. But is this golden opportunity too good to be true?

episodes.title: Investment Ki Excitement
episodes.synopsis: The colony is buzzing with excitement as the moment arrives to check the returns on their big investment. Everyone is sure they've struck gold, but will the outcome match their expectations?

episodes.title: Paiso Ki Baarish Group Mein Error
episodes.synopsis: After spotting an error on the website and in the group, panic spreads among the society members - and even Taarak's boss grows anxious. With no other option, they turn to Inspector Pandey for help.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Mein Fraud
episodes.synopsis: Panic sets in across the colony as the residents realise they've fallen victim to a massive fraud. All their investments are gone. How will they cope with this shock and find a way forward?

episodes.title: Cyber Dhokha
episodes.synopsis: The colony is gripped with panic after discovering their entire investment has vanished. With the cyber crime unit offering no certainty of justice, can they find a way to recover their lost money?

episodes.title: Police Ne Di Good News
episodes.synopsis: As panic takes over the society, the police deliver surprising news that the matter has been resolved. How will the members react to this?

episodes.title: Popatlal Ka Chamatkar
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal surprises everyone as he reveals how he cracked the cyber fraud case with his sharp thinking and courage.

episodes.title: Popatlal In Dhumtara
episodes.synopsis: With the scammers' location finally known, Popatlal gears up in disguise to take them down. Will he be able to break open the fraud ring?

episodes.title: Gokuldham Wasiyo Ke Liye Seekh
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal emerges as a hero after exposing the scam and assuring everyone their money will be returned. Later, the society members apologize to Taarak.

episodes.title: Popatlal Ko Mila Award
episodes.synopsis: While the colony celebrates Popatlal receiving a prestigious government award, Taarak's boss finds himself in trouble when a guest complains about paranormal activity in his bungalow.

episodes.title: Taarak's Leave Application
episodes.synopsis: Taarak asks his boss for a leave, but the boss says he needs time to decide. With strange happenings in his haunted house, will the boss grant the leave?

episodes.title: Boss Se Mulaqat
episodes.synopsis: Taarak is invited to his boss's home for more than just a visit. A strange mystery has taken over the house, and his boss needs help. With his guest in fear, will Taarak step into this eerie situation?

episodes.title: Bungalow Mein Picnic
episodes.synopsis: Taarak is asked by his boss to stay at the bungalow for three days without coming back early. While Taarak doesn't know the real reason, his boss hopes to uncover a ghostly mystery. But the colony members want to come too. Will the boss allow it?

episodes.title: Picnic Ki Taiyyari
episodes.synopsis: The colony is thrilled about a three-day picnic at Taarak's boss' bungalow. But will it be all fun and games, or will something spooky turn the trip upside down?

episodes.title: Gokuldham Waalo Ki Picnic
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena looks forward to the picnic as the rest of Gokuldham packs their bags. Will this getaway bring new memories for everyone?

episodes.title: Bus Mein Masti
episodes.synopsis: With bags packed and spirits high, the colony sets off for their bungalow picnic. But what twists will their road trip take?

episodes.title: Bhoot Bangle Mein Picnic
episodes.synopsis: All the colony members finally arrive at the bungalow, excited for three days of fun and relaxation. But will their getaway turn spooky, just as Taarak's boss had suspected?

episodes.title: Masti Ka Mood On
episodes.synopsis: The colony members settle into the bungalow and begin their picnic as they start to relax. But just as they get comfortable, will something spooky disrupt their fun?

episodes.title: Chakori Se Mulaqat
episodes.synopsis: While everyone is busy having fun at the bungalow, Popatlal strays into the jungle and runs into a mysterious woman named Chakori. Who is she and why is she there?

episodes.title: Raat Ka Intezaar
episodes.synopsis: As the colony members enjoy their time at the bungalow, Chakori waits patiently for night to fall. Will she end up spooking everyone once darkness sets in?

episodes.title: Bhide Ka Darr
episodes.synopsis: Bhide is terrified after spotting Chakori on the terrace. Later, while everyone relaxes by the pool, he sees a shadow again. Will anyone believe what he saw?

episodes.title: Popatlal And Chakori's Friendship
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal is drawn to Chakori and keeps going back to the well, brushing off everyone's concerns. Will his stubbornness cost him dearly?

episodes.title: Last Day In The Bungalow
episodes.synopsis: As everyone enjoys games on their last day at the bungalow, they warn Popatlal to stay away from the well. But will he ignore them once again and go to meet Chakori one last time?

episodes.title: Bangle Mein Party Sharty
episodes.synopsis: It's the final night at the bungalow and the men are all set to party. But with Chakori lurking nearby and Popatlal hoping for a last meeting, will the night turn from fun to fear?

episodes.title: Chakori Ke Saamne Bhide
episodes.synopsis: As the men wrap up their party session and head to bed, Bhide unexpectedly comes face to face with Chakori. Alone and startled, what will the mysterious spirit do to him?

episodes.title: Bhootiya Raat
episodes.synopsis: Bhide spends a spooky night with Chakori, but when he shares his experience, no one believes him and blames it on the effects of the party. Will Chakori make another move?

episodes.title: Popatlal's Plan To Meet Chakori
episodes.synopsis: On the final day of the trip, Popatlal eagerly plans to propose to Chakori. But will he get to meet her, or will there be a twist in his path?

episodes.title: Chakori Se Hua Pyaar
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal has completely fallen for Chakori and is eager to express his feelings to her. But how will his friends react when they finally come face to face with Chakori and learn about his love?

episodes.title: Pyaar Mein Lattu Popatlal
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal is deeply in love with Chakori and feels hurt when Bhide calls her a "Bhootni," causing Chakori to leave in anger. Will Bhide be able to explain his spooky encounter and make the others believe him?

episodes.title: Bhide's Spooky Night
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal is desperate to ask Chakori for forgiveness and make amends. Meanwhile, Bhide tries to explain his spooky night with Chakori to everyone. Will they believe his side of the story?

episodes.title: Toota Popatlal Ka Dil
episodes.synopsis: When the caretaker finally confirms that Chakori is a ghost, Popatlal is left stunned and heartbroken. Will he be able to accept this chilling reality?

episodes.title: Bangle Mein Fase Gokuldham Wale
episodes.synopsis: The colony members decide to leave after learning about the ghost and the spooky events. But will they actually manage to escape?

episodes.title: Gokuldham Residents Get Stuck
episodes.synopsis: The bus meant to pick up the Gokuldham residents doesn't arrive as Chakori had it stopped. Anjali takes charge and calls Taarak's boss. Will they find a way out of the bungalow?

episodes.title: Chakori Ka Saamna
episodes.synopsis: As the colony members get stuck inside the bungalow, Chakori begins to spook them with her antics. How will they handle this eerie night?

episodes.title: Chakori Ki Chetavni
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham members face Chakori, who terrifies them with a strong warning to leave. Will they be able to make it out safely?

episodes.title: Bhootni Ke Saath Shaadi
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal lands in deep trouble when Chakori forces him to marry her. How will he escape this situation?

episodes.title: Chakori Ki Asliyat
episodes.synopsis: Chakori traps Popatlal and forces him into marriage, leaving the colony members worried. Will they save him before it's too late?

episodes.title: Chakori Ka Khel Khatam
episodes.synopsis: Chakori finally admits she is not a ghost, leaving everyone stunned. What shocking secret will she reveal next?

episodes.title: The Real Culprit
episodes.synopsis: Taarak's boss apologises to the Gokuldham members for all the trouble. Later, Popatlal exposes the real mastermind behind Chakori's secret.

episodes.title: Jethalal Returns From His Trip
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal returns from his Himalayan trip and plans to surprise the Gokuldham residents who are having fun at the bungalow.

episodes.title: Naye Parivaar Ka Intezaar
episodes.synopsis: The colony feels lively as repairs finish, and everyone eagerly waits for a new family to move in. But will this new beginning bring joy or unexpected challenges for them?

episodes.title: Bawri Bani Customer
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal gets irritated when Bawri comes to the shop as a customer looking to buy a toaster. Will Jethalal sell her the toaster?

episodes.title: Payment Mein Gadbadi
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal finds himself in a financial crunch as delayed payments prevent him from restocking electronics. Can he arrange the funds in time?

episodes.title: Pachchis Lakh Ki Galti
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is stunned after learning he transferred 25 lakhs to the wrong person. Can he recover the amount before it's too late?

episodes.title: Jethalal Ke Atke Hue Payments
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal, Nattu Kaka, and Bagha split the contacts among themselves and decide to follow up on the pending payments. Will Jethalal be able to find a solution to recover the dues and pay it ahead?

episodes.title: Tension Mein Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal receives a warning that he'll be blacklisted if his dues aren't cleared soon. With mounting pressure, can he find a way out in time?

episodes.title: Asli Parivaar
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal senses Jethalal's worries and confronts him about it. Later, the entire Gokuldham Colony comes together to support him. Will Jethalal be able to pay off Toni Company now?

episodes.title: Paiso Ka Bandobast
episodes.synopsis: With blacklisting looming, Bawri becomes Jethalal's unlikely saviour by helping him arrange the much-needed funds. How will Jethalal react to this?

episodes.title: Jethalal Wants His Money Back
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is desperate to get back the money he mistakenly transferred, but the man who owes him keeps dodging him. Will Jethalal manage to retrieve it?

episodes.title: Jethalal Mila Wakeel Se
episodes.synopsis: Frustrated after repeated failures to recover his money, Jethalal finally consults a lawyer. Will the legal route give him the breakthrough he needs?

episodes.title: Jethalal Feels Helpless
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal fears his case could drag on for years, while Taarak is stressed by his boss's constant calls. Will Jethalal find a way to recover his money?

episodes.title: Celebrating 17 Years Of Endless Laughter
episodes.synopsis: It's celebration time in Gokuldham as Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah completes 17 delightful years. Amidst the joy, Jethalal finds himself cornered when Bapuji begins probing about the money. Will he dodge the question or confess?

episodes.title: Paiso Ki Firauti
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal lies to Bapuji about recovering the money, but later tells the truth to his friends. Will they come up with a plan to help him get it back?

episodes.title: Mission Vasooli
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and his friends take matters into their own hands and show up disguised as goons to recover the lost money. Will they succeed?

episodes.title: Nekchand Ko Mili Dhamki
episodes.synopsis: In a desperate attempt to recover his money, Jethalal and his friends disguise themselves as local goons and confront Nekchand at his house. Will their dramatic plan finally pay off?

episodes.title: Musibat Mein Jethalal And Friends
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and his friends' risky act of dressing up as goons takes a wild turn when Inspector Pandey unexpectedly lands up at Nekchand's house. Can they wriggle their way out of this mess?

episodes.title: Champaklal Aur Tapu Ki Koshish
episodes.synopsis: Nekchand firmly tells his wife that he has no intention of returning Jethalal's money. Meanwhile, Champaklal and Tapu decide to confront Nekchand together. Will they be able to make him change his mind?

episodes.title: Tapu Ka Naya Idea
episodes.synopsis: Tapu and Bapuji return disappointed after failing to get the money back from Nekchand. But Tapu isn't ready to give up just yet. Will his new idea finally turn things around?

episodes.title: Trapping Nekchand
episodes.synopsis: To get back at Nekchand, Babita and Iyer pretend to be real estate agents offering a golden deal. Will Nekchand fall for the bait or outsmart them once again?

episodes.title: Jaal Mein Fasa Nekchand
episodes.synopsis: Babita and Iyer's plan works, and Nekchand shows interest in the property. However, he wants to visit it immediately. Will Babita and Iyer manage to arrange it in time?

episodes.title: Popatlal Bana Pyarelal
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal panics when his wig, crucial to his Pyarelal disguise, goes missing just before meeting Nekchand. Will he be able to manage without getting caught?

episodes.title: Token Ke Liye Taiyyar Nekchand
episodes.synopsis: After much convincing and clever acting, Nekchand finally agrees to pay the token. Will the plan go through as expected?

episodes.title: Nekchand Aaya Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham residents prepare all the documents to present to Nekchand. But when he arrives, will he hand over the token money or will a new problem arise?

episodes.title: Nekchand Ko Mila Sabak
episodes.synopsis: Nekchand's greed backfires as the Gokuldham residents manage to extract the money from him. What will his reaction be?

episodes.title: Nekchand Ko Lautaye Paise
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji's sudden decision to return the money to Nekchand leaves the entire society in shock. The members cannot understand why he would make such a choice. Will they question him?

episodes.title: Naye Parivaar Ka Intezaar
episodes.synopsis: Excitement fills the colony as Verma Ji tells Bhide about a new family moving in. Will the neighbours welcome them warmly or face unexpected surprises?

episodes.title: Bhootnath Ka Badla
episodes.synopsis: Bhootnath takes away the flat keys and says the new family cannot enter until his bills are paid. Will he change his mind and return the keys?

episodes.title: Kab Aayenge Naye Padosi?
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and the colony members are excited to welcome the new family and have prepared for their arrival. But as the wait gets longer, everyone wonders when they will finally reach the colony.

episodes.title: Naye Parivar Ka Tempo
episodes.synopsis: Bhide has to step out for work but fears that the new family might arrive in his absence. Just then, an unknown tempo enters Gokuldham. How will Bhide handle the situation?

episodes.title: Naye Parivaar Ka Swagat
episodes.synopsis: The colony members prepare to welcome the new family, unaware that two tricksters are plotting to steal the tempo filled with their belongings. Will the plan get exposed?

episodes.title: Gokuldham's Newest Members
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham members cannot believe their eyes as camels walk into their neighbourhood. The new family arrives in style, leaving everyone curious and surprised about their grand entry.

episodes.title: Meet The Binjolas
episodes.synopsis: The society gives a warm welcome to Ratan, Rupa and their family, but the big question remains. Will they blend into the colony life with ease or will trouble make its way to their new beginning?

episodes.title: Tempo Ki Chori
episodes.synopsis: As the new family settles into the colony, they are shocked to learn that their tempo filled with belongings has gone missing. How will the family handle this unexpected crisis?

episodes.title: Pandey Ji To The Rescue
episodes.synopsis: With panic spreading in the colony after the missing tempo, the society members call upon Inspector Pandey. Will he be able to crack the case and bring relief to everyone?

episodes.title: Bhide Is Blamed
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Pandey arrives in Gokuldham to investigate the missing tempo, but the driver shifts the blame onto Bhide. Will Inspector Pandey uncover the real culprit?

episodes.title: Bhide Se Poochtach
episodes.synopsis: The new family cannot step into their home because their tempo is missing, and as the situation turns tense, Inspector Pandey begins questioning Bhide and Madhvi to find out what really happened.

episodes.title: Tempo Ki Khoj
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Pandey joins hands with the colony members to trace the missing tempo. But will their search finally lead them to a solid clue?

episodes.title: Ek Tempo Do Number
episodes.synopsis: The colony joins Inspector Pandey to track down the missing tempo. Excitement turns into shock when the tempo they find isn't the right one. Now, with time slipping away, will they be able to locate their belongings?

episodes.title: Tempo Chor Faraar
episodes.synopsis: The thieves go on the run after the media exposes the stolen tempo. Now the pressure is on as the colony and Inspector Pandey try to catch them before they disappear.

episodes.title: Tempo Chor Ka Mila Pata
episodes.synopsis: The colony members rejoice when they hear that the tempo thieves have taken the vehicle to Sodhi's garage for repairs. But the big question remains, will they finally be able to catch them this time?

episodes.title: Sodhi Ka Smart Mechanic
episodes.synopsis: When the colony members reach Sodhi's garage, they are shocked to see the mechanic tied up while the thieves are nowhere to be seen. How will they track down the culprits now?

episodes.title: Choro Ka Peecha
episodes.synopsis: The thieves manage to trick the colony members and escape once again. Now Inspector Pandey and the Gokuldham residents join forces for the chase. But will they be fast enough to catch them this time?

episodes.title: Last Chance For The Binjolas
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Pandey and the Gokuldham members corner the thieves from all directions, leaving no room for escape. Will the Binjolas reclaim what was stolen from them?

episodes.title: Tapu Ne Lagaya Brilliant Idea
episodes.synopsis: Tapu comes up with a smart idea to trace the thieves, and the colony pins all their hopes on him. Will this plan finally work or will the culprits escape yet again?

episodes.title: Tempo Aane Ki Khushi
episodes.synopsis: The pressure mounts on Inspector Pandey as the tempo thieves bluff him and escape. Later, he surprises everyone by bringing the tempo back to the society. How did Inspector Pandey manage to catch the thieves?

episodes.title: Warm Welcome To The Binjolas
episodes.synopsis: With the tempo recovered and belongings restored, the new family finally settles in. The Gokuldham members gather together to give them a heartfelt welcome, marking a fresh start in the colony.

episodes.title: Ganesh Utsav Ki Taiyyari
episodes.synopsis: As the Binjolas settle into the society, Bhide and the others begin planning for Ganesh Utsav while Tapu Sena takes charge of the preparations. What new adventure will this celebration bring?

episodes.title: New Family's Request
episodes.synopsis: The new family begins their journey in Gokuldham colony and on Ganesh Utsav they make a heartfelt request to Bhide. Will the colony members come together to make it happen?

episodes.title: Gokuldham Ke Bappa
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham Colony comes alive with festive decorations and joy as the society prepares to welcome Bappa. Later, Tapu Sena steps in and lays down a set of rules before everyone.

episodes.title: Tapu Sena Ke Niyam
episodes.synopsis: The colony members warmly embrace the new rules set by Tapu Sena and begin putting them into practice. Later, the Binjola kids lay down a condition before anyone can relish the prasad. What could it be?

episodes.title: Bachho Ki Zidd
episodes.synopsis: The Binjola kids refuse to let anyone eat the prasad until Bappa is offered his share first. As their demand starts getting out of hand, how will the colony members handle the situation?

episodes.title: Ratan Aur Rupa Ki Badhti Pareshani
episodes.synopsis: Tensions rise as devotees begin complaining about not receiving the prasad. Later, Bhide is called in to resolve the matter. How will Gokuldham Society handle this situation?

episodes.title: Champaklal Ki Koshish
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal tries to convince the children to eat and drop their stubbornness. But just then, another problem arises. How will the society handle it?

episodes.title: Tapu Ka Idea
episodes.synopsis: The colony members eagerly wait for Tapu's idea to unfold so they can begin the Rangarang Program. During the aarti, the plan is set into motion. But will it be enough to convince the kids?

episodes.title: Bachho Ki Aastha
episodes.synopsis: Veer and Bansri are deeply heartbroken after learning what the colony members have done. As the society leaves everything in Bappa's hands, how will the children be convinced?

episodes.title: Bappa Meets The Kids
episodes.synopsis: Moved by the devotion of Veer and Bansri, Lord Ganesh himself appears before them and assures them that he has accepted their laddoos. Later, the children gather everyone in the society compound.

episodes.title: Prayers And Prasad
episodes.synopsis: All the members offer their prayers and prasad before Bappa. Meanwhile, Tapu Sena takes on the task of distributing the prasad to those whose names are on the list.

episodes.title: Rangaram Karyakaram
episodes.synopsis: As the Rangarang program begins, the members offer a heartfelt Ganesh Vandana in different languages and celebrate the event with joy.

episodes.title: Tapu Sena Ki Performance
episodes.synopsis: Taarak recites a poetry and after the elders, it is now time for the Tapu Sena to perform. Will everyone enjoy their act?

episodes.title: Surprise Birthday Plan For Pinku
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena puts together a surprise birthday plan for Pinku, but Iyer walks in unexpectedly. Will their surprise still work out as planned?

episodes.title: Pinku Ka Birthday
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena informs Bhide and the society members about Pinku's surprise birthday. As everyone gathers at the clubhouse, will Pinku arrive to be surprised?

episodes.title: Kaha Hai Pinku?
episodes.synopsis: The society members gather in the clubhouse and celebrate while waiting for Pinku. Just then, Gogi reveals that Pinku is not at home. Where could he be?

episodes.title: Veer Aur Bansri Ke Tuition Classes
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena learns the traditional steps of Garba, while Veer and Bansri head to Bhide's house for tuition. Will the class go smoothly?

episodes.title: Sonu's New Wall Paint
episodes.synopsis: Sonu scrapes the wall paint while cleaning before her friend's visit. How will Bhide react, and will he agree to get it repainted?

episodes.title: Bhide Seeks Jethalal's Help
episodes.synopsis: Disguised as a customer, a man tries to steal from Jethalal's shop but Bagha catches him. Later, Bhide asks Jethalal for help in buying wall paints.

episodes.title: Bhide Ka Confidence
episodes.synopsis: Bhide confidently assures Madhvi and Sonu that he will paint Sonu's room himself. But how will it actually turn out?

episodes.title: Bhide Looks For A Painter
episodes.synopsis: Madhvi and Sonu clean up the mess made by Bhide and ask him to give up on painting Sonu's room himself. Later, Bhide starts looking for a painter.

episodes.title: Painter Arrives At Bhide's House
episodes.synopsis: A Lucknowi painter arrives at Bhide's house to paint Sonu's room. Will he be of help or bring more trouble for the Bhide family?

episodes.title: Naya Painter
episodes.synopsis: Bhide hires a new painter for Sonu's room, but the painter dozes off before starting the work. How will Bhide get the room painted?

episodes.title: Room Painting Ki Tension
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena decides to help paint Sonu's room while Sonu considers cancelling her plan of calling her friend home. Later, Madhvi comes up with a solution. What is it?

episodes.title: Bhide Family Ki Khushi
episodes.synopsis: As Sonu's room gets painted with Asian Paints, Bhide and Madhvi decide to give their entire house a fresh new look. While the painting is underway, the Bhide family enjoys some much-needed relaxation time.

episodes.title: Gada Electronics Ki Nayi Scheme
episodes.synopsis: Bagha and Nattu Kaka excitedly wait to show Jethalal the new banner outside the shop. But will Jethalal appreciate their effort or end up scolding them instead?

episodes.title: Garba Ki Taiyyari
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and the others enjoy practising garba in the shop, while the Mahila Mandal excitedly plans the upcoming Navratri celebrations. What surprises and fun moments await the Gokuldham residents this festive season?

episodes.title: Roopa Aur Ratan Ka Surprise
episodes.synopsis: Ratan and Roopa go missing on the first day of Navratri, leaving everyone in the society worried and curious. Just as the celebration begins to feel incomplete, they arrive with a big surprise that leaves everyone stunned. What could it be?

episodes.title: Garba With A Twist
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena and the other members decorate the clubhouse beautifully for the Garba celebrations. As everyone gathers to play, who will steal the spotlight on the dance floor?

episodes.title: Garba Competition
episodes.synopsis: The Garba competition heats up as the members showcase their best moves and festive spirit. Who will emerge as the star performer?

episodes.title: Garba Ki Takkar
episodes.synopsis: The Garba competition continues in full swing as everyone showcases their best moves. Later, the winners are honored with a beautiful winning garland.

episodes.title: Taarak Gets Scolded
