episodes.synopsis: Anjali scolds Taarak for eating outside food while she has prepared a healthy salad for him at home. How will Taarak manage to get out of this tricky situation?

episodes.title: Taarak Ka Badhta Weight
episodes.synopsis: Anjali takes Dr. Hathi's advice to help Taarak reduce his weight. Later, the men of Gokuldham discuss Taarak's diet and fitness plan in their own amusing way as they try to come up with a plan to convince Anjali.

episodes.title: Taarak Ka Khaana
episodes.synopsis: Taarak and his friends brainstorm ways to escape his healthy tiffin. Later, Jethalal deals with an unusual customer at his shop.

episodes.title: Taarak Ki Peedha
episodes.synopsis: As Taarak gets ready to enjoy the delicious food sent by Jethalal, Anjali suddenly arrives at his office. Will Taarak get caught or manage to escape the situation?

episodes.title: Sunday Funday For Taarak
episodes.synopsis: All the men of the colony come together to secretly make Sunday a fun day for Taarak by getting him all his favourite food behind Anjali's back. Will their plan succeed?

episodes.title: Mission Masaledaar
episodes.synopsis: While Anjali visits Ratan and Roopa's house to prepare diet food, Jethalal and the others continue their Mission Masaledaar to help Taarak. Will their plan succeed?

episodes.title: Anjali Catches Hold Of Taarak
episodes.synopsis: Bhide tries to distract Anjali so that Taarak's food can be delivered. But just then, Anjali walks in while the delivery is taking place. Will Mission Masaledaar succeed or end in trouble?

episodes.title: Punishment For Taarak And Friends
episodes.synopsis: Taarak tries to win Anjali's forgiveness with a heartfelt poem. Later, Anjali agrees to stay but sets a condition to punish Taarak and his friends. What will her punishment be?

episodes.title: Veer And Bansri Ki Shararat
episodes.synopsis: Veer and Bansri get scolded for bursting crackers in the society compound. Later, the members of Gokuldham society gear up to celebrate the festival of lights with great joy and excitement.

episodes.title: Popatlal Ke Ghar Ki Laxmi
episodes.synopsis: A woman named Rambha arrives at Gokuldham Society to meet Popatlal. Could she finally be the girl of Popatlal's dreams?

episodes.title: Laddoo Ka Box
episodes.synopsis: Babita and Iyer give a box of laddoos to the Bhides, the same one that has been secretly circling around the society. When Bhide passes it on to the Sodhi family, will the laddoo box finally find its rightful owner again?

episodes.title: One Box Across The Society
episodes.synopsis: To track down his laddoo box, Popatlal first asks Taarak and then the other members continue questioning each other in the society. Will he discover that his box has been passed around the entire neighbourhood?

episodes.title: Popatlal Ka Jadoo
episodes.synopsis: Everyone gathers in the clubhouse, hoping the laddoo box will finally be found. Later, Popatlal performs a magic trick that leaves the members stunned. How will they react to this unexpected surprise?

episodes.title: Binjola Parivaar Ki Meeting
episodes.synopsis: On Babita's request, Iyer offers to drop Jethalal to the office, but his car refuses to start. Later, the entire Binjola family gathers for an important discussion. What big matter are they about to reveal?

episodes.title: Scooter Ka Naamkaran
episodes.synopsis: The Binjolas invite Batuk Maharaj to help them name their new scooter. With everyone pitching in ideas, will they finally settle on the perfect name?

episodes.title: Feku Gada
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal's friends tease him for not donating to the old-age home. Feeling upset, he later talks to Tapu about it. How will Champaklal handle the situation?

episodes.title: Vridhashram Ka Cheque
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal deals with a new set of customers at his shop, while Taarak reminds him about handing over the cheque to the old age home. Will Jethalal finally complete the task this time, or will fresh hurdles come his way again?

episodes.title: Struggle To Get A Cheque
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal visits the bank to request a new cheque book and later sits down to prepare the cheque. But is another hurdle waiting to stop him this time?

episodes.title: Receipt Kaha Hai?
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal loses the receipt for a payment and panics, knowing he already told Bapuji it was done. Will he find a way out of this mess?

episodes.title: Finding The Receipt
episodes.synopsis: After losing the receipt, Jethalal hides from Champaklal in the society and tries to contact the auto driver, hoping he might have left it there. Will Jethalal be able to find the missing receipt?

episodes.title: Jethalal Aur Taarak Ka Struggle
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal pins his hopes on Iyer to find the missing receipt, while Champaklal keeps calling to ask about it. Later, he calls Bagha and Nattu Kaka but none of them respond. Will he find the receipt?

episodes.title: The Lost Receipt
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal rushes to his shop to search for the missing receipt but ends up having to pay a fine along the way. With Champaklal calling him repeatedly, how will Jethalal explain the situation about the lost receipt?

episodes.title: Nakli Receipt
episodes.synopsis: Tapu comes up with a plan to help Jethalal by creating a fake receipt and asks him to show it to Champaklal. But will Champaklal see through their plan?

episodes.title: Jethalal Ki Chori Pakdi Gayi
episodes.synopsis: Nattu Kaka and Bagha arrive just in time to hand over another fake receipt to Champaklal, exposing Jethalal and Tapu's lie. How will Jethalal face Champaklal's anger now?

episodes.title: Champaklal Ne Sunai Saza
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal decides to punish Jethalal and Tapu by announcing that he's leaving for Bhachau. Later, Rupa arrives with food for the Gada family.

episodes.title: Tapu Aur Goli Ka Zabardast Challenge
episodes.synopsis: While Tapu Sena enjoys a game of cricket, Veer and Bansri provoke Goli against Tapu, leading him to challenge Tapu. Who will emerge victorious?

episodes.title: Mahila Mandal Plays Cricket
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and Goli collide, causing Tapu's catch to be dropped and the challenge to be lost. Later, the Mahila Mandal decides to join in and play cricket.

episodes.title: Bhide Ka Gussa
episodes.synopsis: Madhavi and Babita accidentally break the glass of their own house while playing cricket, leaving everyone worried about Bhide's reaction. Meanwhile, Bhide learns about the incident and assumes Tapu is behind it. How will the misunderstanding unfold?

episodes.title: Bhide Fights With Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and Jethalal get into a fight regarding Tapu and the broken glass, and only Inspector Pandey can control the chaos. Will they resolve the case or confuse Pandey even more?

episodes.title: Bhide And Jethalal Present Their Sides
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and Iyer put their side of the story before Inspector Pandey, and Jethalal explains his as well. Soon after, the Mahila Mandal arrives at the police station. Will Madhavi and Babita admit what really happened?

episodes.title: Iyer And Bhide Apologise
episodes.synopsis: The Mahila Mandal finally admit that they were the ones who broke the window glass, clearing Tapu of all blame. With the truth out, Bhide and Iyer are left embarrassed and now must find a sincere way to apologise to Jethalal.

episodes.title: Popatlal Runs After Bhide
episodes.synopsis: Bhide grows tense as he struggles to find someone to fix the broken glass. Later, Popatlal snaps at him and chases him around the society. What caused his outburst?

episodes.title: Abdul Ka Surprise
episodes.synopsis: Bhide gives Abdul a lesson on saving water. Later, at the shop, Abdul tells everyone he has a surprise waiting for them. What could it be?

episodes.title: Abdul Ki Cycle
episodes.synopsis: Abdul celebrates with everyone in the society as he completes 500 days with his cycle. Meanwhile, Popatlal gets a call to interview a high profile criminal who is about to be released from jail.

episodes.title: Chunnilal Ki Cycle
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal meets Chunnilal Talatode outside the jail to take his interview. Later, Chunnilal enquires about his lucky cycle which happens to be with Abdul. How will this turn out?

episodes.title: Planning To Bring The Cycle
episodes.synopsis: Chunnilal tries to buy the cycle from Abdul but flees the moment he spots Popatlal. Later, he hatches a plan to sneak into Gokuldham. Will he manage to reclaim his lucky cycle?

episodes.title: Anmol Cycle Anmol Daam
episodes.synopsis: Chunnilal's men offer Abdul an unusually high price for his cycle, raising suspicion. With Abdul refusing to sell, how will they try to take it now?

episodes.title: Gadhe Ke Nishaan Waali Cycle
episodes.synopsis: The society members can't stop discussing the huge offer Abdul received for his cycle. Later, they call Babu Chipke to inspect it. What will he discover?

episodes.title: Cycle Ka Raaz
episodes.synopsis: Babu Chipke assures everyone in Gokuldham that the cycle is nothing extraordinary. Still, the members grow curious and try to uncover its secret, while Chunnilal thinks of a way to snatch it.

episodes.title: Cycle Ki Kundli
episodes.synopsis: Ratan tells a story while everyone keeps wondering what's really special about the cycle. Later, Roshan suggests getting it checked by her uncle. What will they discover about the cycle now?

episodes.title: Rustom Ghantiwala Ka Inspection
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham members head out to meet Rustom to uncover the truth about the cycle. Meanwhile, Chunnilal makes his plan to reclaim it. What happens when their paths collide?

episodes.title: Cycle Se Emotional Attachment
episodes.synopsis: While Champaklal raises a solid point about the cycle, Chunnilal Talatode arrives in Gokuldham disguised as Dinesh Ghoda. What is he plotting now?

episodes.title: Popatlal Ki Condition
episodes.synopsis: Just as Chunnilal is about to take the cycle out of the society he runs into Popatlal. Popatlal lays down a condition before he will allow Chunnilal to take it. What will Chunnilal do?

episodes.title: Protecting The Cycle
episodes.synopsis: Suspicion around the cycle keeps growing in the society, and everyone tries to protect it. Meanwhile, Chunnilal comes up with a new plan to steal it. What happens next?

episodes.title: Cycle Ki Chori
episodes.synopsis: Chunnilal finally puts his plan into motion and heads to Gokuldham Colony to steal the cycle. Will the society members be able to save it in time?

episodes.title: Abdul Ki Cycle Hui Chori
episodes.synopsis: Chunnilal manages to steal the cycle, leaving Bhide and Abdul stunned. How will they get it back now?

episodes.title: Tapu Sena Ki Smartness
episodes.synopsis: Using their quick thinking, Tapu Sena swaps Abdul's cycle, leaving Chunnilal annoyed when he realises he stole the wrong one. Later, while trying to remove the mark from the cycle, they uncover something unexpected. What could it be?

episodes.title: Sone Ki Cycle
episodes.synopsis: The society members are stunned to discover that the cycle is made of gold. Will Chunnilal come up with yet another plan to steal it?

episodes.title: Abdul Bana Crorepati
episodes.synopsis: Abdul and the society celebrate his newfound fortune after discovering the gold cycle. While everyone enjoys taking a ride, Chunnilal hatches a plan to slip into Gokuldham and reclaim the cycle.

episodes.title: Chunnilal Barges Into Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: Chunnilal storms into Gokuldham with his men and tries to take the cycle at gunpoint. How will the society deal with this threat?

episodes.title: Abdul Gets Kidnapped
episodes.synopsis: Chunnilal and his men kidnap Abdul and demand the gold cycle in exchange. Will the Gokuldham members give up the cycle to save him?

episodes.title: Abdul Held Hostage
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham members come together to plan Abdul's rescue in exchange for the cycle, while Abdul remains held at a remote spot. How will they manage to bring him back safely?

episodes.title: Rescuing Abdul
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham members head out with the cycle to rescue Abdul at the spot Chunnilal mentioned, while the rest of the society anxiously waits back home. What unfolds next?

episodes.title: Chunnilal Ka Foolproof Plan
episodes.synopsis: Chunnilal's men trick the Gokuldham members, blindfold them, and take them to an isolated location. Meanwhile, the others pray for their safety. Will the Gokuldham members outsmart Chunnilal and his gang?

episodes.title: Abdul Aur Cycle Ki Adla Badli
episodes.synopsis: Chunnilal gets the cycle and the Gokuldham members get Abdul. Before they can escape, they trick the gang. Will they manage to get away with the cycle?

episodes.title: Gokuldham Ka Teamwork
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham celebrates Abdul's return, but curiosity grows over how Chunnilal got the gold cycle. What new secret will come to light?

episodes.title: Popatlal Ko Lagi Thand
episodes.synopsis: Abdul, Ratan and Dr Hathi discuss putting the gold cycle behind them. Later, Sodhi plays a prank on Popatlal when he complains of feeling cold.

episodes.title: Importance Of Exercising
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham men tease Popatlal for feeling cold. Later, Champaklal insists on taking Jethalal out for exercise. Will Jethalal agree?

episodes.title: Zumba Session For Champaklal And Friends
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal and his friends enjoy a Zumba session at the park. Meanwhile, Jethalal waits for Tapu and Champaklal to return as he needs to leave for the office. Later, one of Champaklal's friends arrives at the house and finds it locked.

episodes.title: Waiting For Champaklal
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal scolds Bagha and Nattu Kaka for calling him to work early, while Tapu keeps Nanji Kaka entertained at home as they wait for Champaklal. But where has Champaklal gone?

episodes.title: Searching For Champaklal
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena sets out to search for Champaklal and later informs Bhide and Popatlal. Will they be able to find him?

episodes.title: Champaklal Hue Gayab
episodes.synopsis: The search for Champaklal continues as the Gokuldham members circulate his photo and ask around about his whereabouts. Where has Champaklal gone?

episodes.title: Champaklal Chadhe Pedh Par
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal climbs a tree to help a child retrieve his kite but gets stuck. How will Tapu Sena and the others bring him down safely?

episodes.title: Champaklal Ko Neeche Laane Ki Koshish
episodes.synopsis: The entire society gathers at the park to support Champaklal and bring him food, while Tapu and Gogi look for a way to help him get down. How will they manage it?

episodes.title: Bagha To The Rescue
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham members devise a plan to bring Champaklal down and turn to Bagha for help. Will he find a solution?

episodes.title: Snake Attack
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham members bring ladders and tie them together to help Champaklal get down, but he spots a snake on the tree. How will he come down now?

episodes.title: Bapuji Ko Kaise Bachaye?
episodes.synopsis: Trapped in a tree, Bapuji faces fresh danger as a snake slithers towards him. Can the colony members rescue him in time?

episodes.title: The Snake Charmer
episodes.synopsis: Abdul calls a snake charmer to rescue Champaklal by catching the snake. But will this solution create more problems instead?

episodes.title: Dadaji Ko Neeche Utaro Mission
episodes.synopsis: Tapu calls the Dahi Handi team to help bring Champaklal down from the tree. Will this plan work?

episodes.title: Another Trouble For Champaklal
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Pandey suspects Champaklal was attempting suicide, creating another problem for him. Later, Nanji Kaka arrives to meet Champaklal. Will he learn about the tree incident?

episodes.title: Yaadon Ka Pitara
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal reminisces about his younger days with Tapu and Jethalal and recalls legendary actor Dharmendra. Later, the other members also share their memories of the late actor Dharmendra.

episodes.title: Dharamaji Ki Yaadon Ki Baarat
episodes.synopsis: In memory of the late actor Dharmendra, the Gokuldham colony celebrates New Year's Eve, joined by Sanket Gokhale.

episodes.title: Quiz Show On Dharam Ji
episodes.synopsis: The program continues with the society members dressing up as Dharmendra ji from his iconic films. Later, they come together to play a quiz based on Dharam ji and his memorable career.

episodes.title: Dance And Masti Dharam Ji Style
episodes.synopsis: The Dharam Ji celebration continues in Gokuldham as the members share interesting facts and trivia about the legendary actor, while also dancing and singing his famous songs.

episodes.title: Dharam Ji Fever Continues
episodes.synopsis: The Dharam Ji fever continues in Gokuldham as the members showcase their dancing skills. Which member will shine?

episodes.title: Yaadon Ki Baraat Manaye Saath Saath
episodes.synopsis: Tapu and Sonu steal the spotlight with their performance, followed by Taarak's heartfelt words on the legendary stardom and grace of the late actor Dharmendra.

episodes.title: Naye Saal Ka Suvichaar
episodes.synopsis: Veer and Bansari pull off a prank by writing a cryptic thought for the day and challenging everyone to decode it. Will they be able to figure it out?

episodes.title: Bagha And Nattu Kaka Ki Party-Sharty
episodes.synopsis: On the first day of the new year, Jethalal reaches his shop and finds Bagha and Nattu Kaka asleep outside the godown in an inebriated state. How will Nattu Kaka and Bagha explain this situation?

episodes.title: Jethalal Ke Saal Ka Pehla Din
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal's tension spikes when Bawri turns up at the shop on the very first day of the year. Later, the new area head of Topo Mobile visits Gada Electronics with a fresh offer and scheme. How will Jethalal make the most of it?

episodes.title: Topo Mobile Ki Scheme
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal invites all the Gokuldham members to his shop to avail the scheme offered by Topo Mobiles. As everyone promises to arrive on time, will Jethalal end up facing new troubles?

episodes.title: Topo Mobile Kaha Hain?
episodes.synopsis: With renewed positivity, Jethalal heads to his shop determined to sell 50 mobile phones within two hours, but the Topo Mobile parcel is yet to arrive. Will Jethalal achieve his target?

episodes.title: Topo Mobile Crisis
episodes.synopsis: It's almost 11 am and the Topo Mobile stock has still not arrived at Gada Electronics. As chaos builds up outside the shop, how will Jethalal and his team manage the Topo Mobile crisis?

episodes.title: Chaos At Gada Electronics
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal shares his worries with the Gokuldham residents as customers continue to wait outside the shop. Later, Inspector Pandey arrives looking to buy a Topo Mobile as well. How will Jethalal manage to meet all these demands?

episodes.title: Fifty Mobiles In Two Hours
episodes.synopsis: As customers continue to pour in for Topo Mobile and time keeps slipping away, will Jethalal manage to sell 50 mobile phones within two hours?

episodes.title: Topo Ka Khilona
episodes.synopsis: As everyone begins unboxing their phones, they realise they've been given toy phones instead of real ones. Just as Jethalal celebrates his win, how will the furious customers react?

episodes.title: Gada Electronics Hai Hai
episodes.synopsis: As the crowd tries to break into Gada Electronics, Jethalal pulls the shutter down to save himself. With Inspector Pandey ready to arrest him, how will Jethalal prove his innocence?

episodes.title: Kati Patang
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham members chase after a kite and reminisce about their childhood memories of flying kites. Later, Rupa and the kids decide to go to Jaipur for the Patang Utsav. Will they be able to make the trip?

episodes.title: Popatlal Ke Liye Aaya Rishta
episodes.synopsis: As Rupa decides to go to Jaipur, her maasi brings a rishta for Popatlal, revealing that Babli has set a challenge: she will marry whoever manages to cut her kite. Will Popatlal finally find his bride?

episodes.title: Patang King Pohche Jaipur
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham men are thrilled about Popatlal's trip to Jaipur, yet they doubt whether he will be able to cut Babli's kite. Later, Popatlal brings out his special kite, only for Veer and Bansri to tear it. How will he compete now?

episodes.title: Exploring The Pink City
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham members explore Jaipur as Popatlal heads out to buy a kite for his big challenge. Meanwhile, the rest of the Gokuldham men eagerly await the day of the contest.

episodes.title: Popatlal Hua Taiyaar
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham members enjoy a lively evening in Jaipur. Later, Popatlal gears up for his much awaited challenge with Babli.

episodes.title: Patang Ka Muqabla
episodes.synopsis: As Babli arrives for the challenge, Popatlal steps forward to meet her and the competition begins. Will Popatlal emerge victorious?

episodes.title: Patang Kati Shaadi Ghati
episodes.synopsis: As Babli continues to cut everyone's kites, Popatlal waits for 4 pm to enter the competition. Will he manage to cut Babli's kite?

episodes.title: Babli Vs Popatlal
episodes.synopsis: The competition between Babli and Popatlal intensifies as both contestants try to cut each other's kites. Who will win the contest?

episodes.title: Republic Day Program Ki Chinta
episodes.synopsis: Bhide is stopped by Inspector Pandey while returning home. Later, he grows anxious about the arrangements for the Republic Day program.

episodes.title: Sundar Arrives In Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: Sundar travels all the way from the USA and stays back for the Republic Day program. Later, the members prepare enthusiastically for the celebrations.

episodes.title: Republic Day Ka Vishesh Karyakram
episodes.synopsis: Bhide takes on the responsibility of anchoring the Republic Day program and shares facts about India through a quiz round. How will the members perform in the game?

episodes.title: Raajya Aur Unki Vishesh Baatein
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham members pick chits and share interesting facts about different states. As the competition heats up, who will win the round?

episodes.title: Desh Ki Baatein
episodes.synopsis: The competition continues as they keep learning about various states. Who will emerge victorious?

episodes.title: Punishment Or Pass?
episodes.synopsis: The members continue discussing various states and their key facts. Who will answer correctly within the time limit, and who will face the punishment?

episodes.title: Har Dil Mei Hindustan
episodes.synopsis: As Popatlal waits for his chance to punish Bhide, Bhide gives the correct answer. Later, all the members come together for a dance to celebrate the country.

episodes.title: Suvichaar Ki Chinta
episodes.synopsis: Bhide struggles to write the thought for the day as Veer, Bansri, and Sodhi try to help him. Later, a couple arrives at Gada Electronics. Will they make a purchase or land Jethalal in trouble?

episodes.title: Topo Company Ki Dealership
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal grows anxious when the email confirming his dealership fails to arrive, even as news of the deal spreads everywhere. Will he be able to finally secure the dealership?

episodes.title: Big Day For Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Excitement runs high as Jethalal prepares for a crucial meeting to finalise his authorised dealership. With everyone rooting for him, will he succeed?

episodes.title: Deal Pakki
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal is on cloud nine as he finally receives the papers confirming his dealership. But with his luck, will the deal go through smoothly or will new hurdles stand in the way?

episodes.title: Bawri Ke Motichoor Laddoo
episodes.synopsis: As Jethalal, Nattu Kaka, and Bagha celebrate securing the Topo Mobile dealership, Bawri arrives with sweets for them. What will happen once they eat them?

episodes.title: Neend Mein Dooba Gada Electronics
episodes.synopsis: Everyone at Gada Electronics struggles to stay awake after eating the laddoos just as customers walk in to shop. Later, they try eating chillies to fight the drowsiness. Will their plan succeed?

episodes.title: Dukaan Mein Party Sharty
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal waits for Babita's friend to arrive and shop while struggling to stay awake. Later, when she finally comes, she spots an alcohol bottle in Jethalal's hands. How will this misunderstanding be resolved?

episodes.title: Taarak Asks For Half Day
episodes.synopsis: Taarak tries to take leave from work to help Jethalal. Meanwhile, Champaklal wants to go to Gada Electronics to congratulate him. What will happen when he sees Jethalal in that condition?

episodes.title: Stalling Champaklal's Visit
episodes.synopsis: Anjali and Babita do everything they can to stall Champaklal's visit to Jethalal's shop. Later, Taarak turns to Bhide for help. Will they manage to keep Champaklal from reaching Gada Electronics?

episodes.title: Race Against Time For Taarak
episodes.synopsis: As Taarak struggles to find a rickshaw, Champaklal and Bhide head toward Gada Electronics. In this race against time, can Taarak get there and help Jethalal before Champaklal arrives?

episodes.title: Sodhi Comes To Rescue
episodes.synopsis: Taarak takes a U-turn after receiving a call from his boss, while Bhide does everything he can to delay Champaklal's visit. Later, Taarak turns to Sodhi for help. How will he come to Jethalal's rescue?

episodes.title: Laddoo Ka Asar
episodes.synopsis: Taarak reaches the shop and finds Ratan and Sodhi lying there in an inebriated state. Later, Dr Hathi, Popatlal, and Taarak also end up eating the laddoos. What will happen when Champaklal arrives?

episodes.title: Pankaj Takes Advantage
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal reaches the shop and finds all the men lying there, with an alcohol bottle nearby, making him assume they are drunk. Later, Pankaj, Jethalal's competitor, arrives and tries to take advantage of the situation.

episodes.title: Dukaan Mein Party Sharty
episodes.synopsis: Pankaj approaches the police and Sara from Topo Mobile, accusing Jethalal of throwing a party inside his shop. As everyone is found passed out, will Jethalal face consequences?

episodes.title: Bawri Clarifies The Situation
episodes.synopsis: Bawri rushes into the shop and reveals the truth about the sleep inducing laddoo mix up. Later, Inspector Pandey conducts a breath analyser test. Will they be found guilty?

episodes.title: Alcohol Bottle Goes Missing
episodes.synopsis: Another wave of confusion hits when the alcohol bottle goes missing, and the Mahila Mandal suspects the men have hidden it deliberately. Where could the bottle have disappeared to?

episodes.title: Gokuldham Mein Neend Gayab
episodes.synopsis: After the sleeping laddoo incident, the Gokuldham men struggle to fall asleep at night. How will they deal with this new problem?

episodes.title: Night Walk For Gokuldham Men
episodes.synopsis: Unable to sleep, the Gokuldham men head out for a late night walk. Soon, they find themselves caught in a misunderstanding with a woman. How will they clear up this fresh confusion?

episodes.title: Taarak's Poem For Anjali
episodes.synopsis: Veer and Bansri gear up with their water guns to attack Ratan and Rupa. Later, Taarak's poem ends up upsetting Anjali. How will he make things right?

episodes.title: Popatlal Meets Chutki Baba
episodes.synopsis: Ratan introduces Popatlal to Chutki Baba, claiming he can help solve his marriage woes. What will happen when Popatlal finally meets Chutki Baba?

episodes.title: Chutki Baba Ka Upaay
episodes.synopsis: Chutki Baba gives Popatlal a special remedy, promising it will help him find a bride soon. As Holika Dahan draws near, will Popatlal manage to complete the ritual in time?

episodes.title: Popatlal Loses The Ring
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal is devastated after losing the ring given to him by Chutki Baba, which he believes will finally lead him to his life partner. Will the Gokuldham members help him recover it?

episodes.title: Popatlal Ke Liye Kavitayein
episodes.synopsis: After Popatlal completes his ritual, the Gokuldham members gather to celebrate Holika Dahan with poems, games, and laughter. How will this Holika Dahan turn out for Popatlal?

episodes.title: Jethalal And Babita's Face Off
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and Babita get into a playful Holi challenge where Jethalal must find Babita within an hour while she hides. Will Jethalal win the challenge, or will he have to face Iyer's punishment?

episodes.title: Holi Ka Mahayudh
episodes.synopsis: As Holi celebrations begin, Jethalal and Babita kick off their challenge. Will Team Jethalal manage to find Babita and win the game?

episodes.title: Team Jethalal Begin Their Search
episodes.synopsis: Team Jethalal spreads out across the colony to search for Babita. As the hunt intensifies, will they manage to find her, or will Jethalal lose the challenge?

episodes.title: Search For Babita Intensifies
episodes.synopsis: Team Jethalal intensively searches for Babita across their respective houses, while Iyer helps her stay hidden so she cannot be caught. With time running out, will Babita finally be found?

episodes.title: Searching The Clubhouse For Babita
episodes.synopsis: Team Jethalal reaches the clubhouse, convinced that Babita is hiding there. Later, their search leads them to the terrace. Will Team Jethalal finally catch Babita there?

episodes.title: Holi Challenge Ka Winner
episodes.synopsis: With just 12 minutes left, Jethalal instructs his team to search the temple, the garden, and the society entrance. Is he about to lose the challenge, or will he turn the game around and win?

episodes.title: Iyer Punishes Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Iyer comes up with a very strict punishment for Jethalal, leaving him dejected. Will Iyer soften his stance, or will Jethalal have to bear the consequences?

episodes.title: Bhide Reprimands Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Tapu accidentally spills colour on Bhide, prompting Bhide to gather everyone in the society compound. Later, Tapu comes up with a plan to promote the rhymes and poems they've created for kids.

episodes.title: Bhide Ki Khushkhabri
episodes.synopsis: Bhide returns home with the happy news of buying a gold jewellery set for Sonu. Later, they head to the jewellery shop. Will they run into any trouble there?

episodes.title: Bhallas Come To Bhide's House
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and Madhavi bring the Bhallas home to buy the gold set. Later, Bhide arranges the cash to give the Bhallas. Will Bhide fall into a trap?

episodes.title: Gold Jewellery Set For Sonu
episodes.synopsis: Just when the Bhallas are about to leave without giving them the gold set, Popatlal arrives with the remaining money and helps Bhide. Later, Bhide shows the gold jewellery to everyone.

episodes.title: Bhide Guards The Golden Jewellery Set
episodes.synopsis: After verifying the golden jewellery set is authentic, Bhide takes extra precautions to protect it overnight before placing it in the bank locker the next day. Will his caution bring unexpected trouble?

episodes.title: Bhallas Get Caught
episodes.synopsis: Bhide is taken by the police along with the gold jewellery after the Bhallas are caught. Later, the police and the Bhallas go missing. How will the Bhides deal with this fraud?

episodes.title: Bhides Plead Infront Of Inspector Pandey
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and Madhavi are taken to the police station. As they narrate the entire incident to Inspector Pandey, will they be found guilty or innocent?

episodes.title: Gokuldham Members Crack The Case
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and Madhavi request Inspector Pandey to help them find the real culprit. Before he can help them, the Gokuldham men enter the police station with the Bhallas and the fake policemen. Will Bhide and Madhavi be found innocent?

episodes.title: Catching The Thieves
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham men chase the thieves and narrate the entire incident to Inspector Pandey. Later, Bhide and Madhavi get a new gold set for Sonu.

episodes.title: Champaklal Ke Liye Gift
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal gets a joke book as a present for Champaklal. Meanwhile, Bhide asks a question to the kids in his tuition class. Will they be able to answer it correctly?

episodes.title: Ram Navami Ka Celebration
episodes.synopsis: Veer and Bansri come up with a plan to celebrate Ram Navami differently this year. What is their plan?

episodes.title: Rupa And Ratan's Contribution
episodes.synopsis: With Rupa and Ratan's help, Tapu Sena decorates the entire society for Ram Navami as everyone celebrates with joy and happiness.

episodes.title: Quiz On Shri Ram
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham residents play a quiz on Shri Ram and learn about his great deeds.

episodes.title: Sureele Bhajan
episodes.synopsis: The quiz continues with some of the Gokuldham residents answering correctly and others getting it wrong, followed by a group of children singing bhajans in praise of Shri Ram.

episodes.title: Society Ke Rules And Regulations
episodes.synopsis: The Mahila Mandal asks Bhide for the terrace keys, but he denies the request and Popatlal interferes. How will this issue be resolved?

episodes.title: Tapu Sena To The Rescue
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena has taken on the responsibility of cleaning the terrace, making it ready for the Mahila Mandal. Will they finish it in time?

episodes.title: Popatlal Ke Jacket Ka Daag
episodes.synopsis: Bhide, Madhavi and Popatlal are ready to leave with Sodhi, but a stain on Popatlal's jacket causes a delay. How will this be resolved?

episodes.title: Popatlal Phisal Gaya
episodes.synopsis: While trying to change his clothes in a hurry, Popatlal falls to the ground and gets hurt. How will he make it to the samaroh?

episodes.title: Bhide Ka Tyaag Patra
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal lashes out at Bhide, making him decide to resign from his post as the society secretary. How will the other Gokuldham residents react to this?

episodes.title: Taarak's Advice
episodes.synopsis: Taarak tries to convince Bhide not to resign from his post as society secretary. Will Bhide listen to his advice?

episodes.title: Bhide Aur Popatlal Ka Aamna Saamna
episodes.synopsis: The entire society gathers as Bhide is ready to resign. Will the members be able to resolve the conflict between Popatlal and Bhide?

episodes.title: Bhide's Resignation
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal firmly puts forth his arguments against Bhide. Will Bhide finally resign from his post as the society secretary?

episodes.title: Popatlal Apologises To Bhide
episodes.synopsis: The society members come together to convince Bhide not to resign, while Popatlal finally apologises for his mistake. What decision will Bhide take now?

episodes.title: Jethalal Tries To Find A Contractor
episodes.synopsis: After Jethalal promises to find a contractor for the society's repair work, he struggles to arrange one. Will he be able to live up to his promise?

episodes.title: Society Maintenance
episodes.synopsis: The society members celebrate the completion of the terrace work while other repairs are still pending, and Bhide asks everyone to arrange additional funds.

episodes.title: Sapne Ki Baat Cheet
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and Taarak get into a conversation about dreams, while Rupa excitedly shows off the new jewellery she has bought.

episodes.title: Rupa Ki Royal Angoothi
episodes.synopsis: Rupa and Ratan begin planning their shop's anniversary celebration, and Rupa decides to prepare Mawa Kachori for the occasion, sharing the news with the other members.

episodes.title: Shop Anniversary Ki Taiyaariyan
episodes.synopsis: Ratan begins the preparations for the shop's anniversary celebration, while Rupa gets busy making fresh Mawa Kachori for the special day. How will their anniversary celebration turn out?

episodes.title: Anniversary Day For Rupa And Ratan's Shop
episodes.synopsis: Rupa and Ratan get ready to celebrate their shop's anniversary and seek blessings from Champaklal.

episodes.title: Mahila Mandal's Shopping Spree
episodes.synopsis: The Mahila Mandal of Gokul Dham Society are heading out to shop at Rupa and Ratan's store, gearing up for a fun-filled spree together. What delights will they find?

episodes.title: A Saree Shopping Moment
episodes.synopsis: Along with the Mahila Mandal, Popatlal also reaches the saree shop and buys six sarees, as Rupa and Ratan's store creates excitement, with Bavri and Bagha joining the shopping fun.

episodes.title: The Hunt For Rupa’s Royal Ring
episodes.synopsis: When Rupa realises her family's royal ring is missing, she turns to the Gokuldham members for help in the search. Will they be able to find it?

episodes.title: Rupa’s Missing Ring
episodes.synopsis: While the Gokuldham members continue searching for Rupa's royal ring, she realises it must have slipped off while she was preparing kachoris. Will they manage to find it?

episodes.title: Chacha Ji’s Ring Trouble
episodes.synopsis: Chaos unfolds in Gokuldham when a ring gets stuck in Chacha Ji's stomach and everyone pitches in to help.

episodes.title: Chacha Ji's Medical Emergency
episodes.synopsis: Chacha Ji is being taken to the hospital, but Ratan finds the ring at home. What is troubling Chacha Ji's stomach?

episodes.title: Society's Repair Funds
episodes.synopsis: Bhide is collecting repair funds from Gokuldham members. Will Jethalal pay on time?

episodes.title: Jethalal Seeks Extension
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal delays submitting the society repair cheque and asks Bhide for an extension. How will Bhide respond?

episodes.title: The Shocking Call
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal grows anxious when Bapuji doesn't return from the temple, until a shocking call discloses his whereabouts.

episodes.title: Bapuji's Shocking Return
episodes.synopsis: As Gokuldham members search for Bapuji, he returns without his cap and in torn clothes. What could be the reason?

episodes.title: Bapuji's Bravery Under Scrutiny
episodes.synopsis: Taarak and Jethalal confront Bapuji about his daring act, insisting he shouldn't take such risks. How will Bapuji respond to their concern?

episodes.title: Jethalal On The Spot
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji asks Jethalal if he has donated to Ghushal and demands proof. Will Jethalal be able to justify himself?

episodes.title: Bhide On A Mission
episodes.synopsis: Bhide grows furious with Jethalal for delaying the society repair cheque and sets out determined to get it.

episodes.title: The Cheque Drama
episodes.synopsis: Bhide informs Bapuji that Jethalal has forgotten to submit the society repair cheque. How will Bapuji react to this?

episodes.title: Jethalal’s Last Hope
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal turns to Taarak for help, and Taarak comes up with a plan. Will it succeed?

episodes.title: Cheque Trouble Continues
episodes.synopsis: Taarak's strategy to help Jethalal with the cheque fails, and they must find a new one. What will they do next?

episodes.title: Jethalal’s Confession
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal tells Bhide the truth and tries to bribe him, while Bapuji overhears. How will things unfold?

episodes.title: Jethalal Exposed
episodes.synopsis: Bhide summons the entire Gokuldham society to expose Jethalal's lie. But will he succeed in finding Jethalal's cheque or not?

episodes.title: Bagha’s Clever Strategy
episodes.synopsis: Bagha and Natu Kaka devise a new plan to rescue Jethalal. Will this strategy turn out in their favor?

episodes.title: Qayamat Ki Raat
episodes.synopsis: As Bagha's plan fails, an agitated Jethalal turns toward an illegal solution to fix his problem. But will Taarak stop him or stand by his side?

episodes.title: Jethalal’s Next Big Move
episodes.synopsis: With Gafoor bhai's help, Jethalal and Bagha hatch a new plan. Will it work?

episodes.title: The Spare Key Mystery
episodes.synopsis: Gafoor Bhai helps create the society office key but secretly keeps a spare one for himself. What's his true reason behind holding onto it?

episodes.title: Jethalal’s Moment Of Truth
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal calls the entire Gokuldham society together to witness the missing cheque drama. Will this moment clear his name or reveal a hidden lie?

episodes.title: Bhide Exposes Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Bhide exposes Jethalal's lie before the entire Gokuldham society. How will Bapuji respond to this revelation?

episodes.title: Uthak Baithak
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji makes Jethalal, Bhide, Taarak, and Popatlal do sit-ups. Later, Jethalal calls Taarak over for an ice cream treat.

episodes.title: Roshan’s Big Mistake
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi safely keeps his friend's money at home, but when Roshan unknowingly gives it to someone else, a sudden problem creates tension.

episodes.title: Roshan’s Trouble
episodes.synopsis: The fruit vendor flees with Roshan's money. Can the Mahila Mandal come up with a plan to recover it?

episodes.title: Mahila Mandal’s Next Move
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi is furious after his worker gives away money without asking, but when the truth about the Mahila Mandal comes out before him, what will he do?

episodes.title: Sodhi’s Money Mystery
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi's friend says the money cover was already opened while counting it, making Roshan worried. How will she handle the situation?

episodes.title: Gokuldham’s Next Move
episodes.synopsis: After being cheated, the Gokuldham members now plan together how to get their money back from the fruit vendor.

episodes.title: Sodhi Loses Control
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi is ready to attack the fruit vendor in anger. Will the Gokuldham members be able to stop him?

episodes.title: The Missing Money Mystery
episodes.synopsis: Sodhi finds the vendor's house locked and starts to worry, did the fruit vendor run away with the cash?

episodes.title: Strange Sight At Gokuldam
episodes.synopsis: The entrance Golkuldam is suddenly covered with watermelons, making everyone wonder who they belong to and what will happen next?

episodes.title: Bapuji Caught In Chaos
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham society members rush to help Bapuji after a shocking watermelon blockage traps him outside.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Members Hunt Fruit Buyer
episodes.synopsis: While the gate blocked by watermelons, Gokuldham society members desperately search for a fruit buyer.

episodes.title: Mama Gives Bhide An Idea
episodes.synopsis: Bhide contacts Mama with a desperate request, can he find a buyer for the watermelons?

episodes.title: Tapu Sena Reveals The Truth
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena explains the watermelon mystery, what shocking truth will Gokuldham society members discover?

episodes.title: Watermelon Mission For Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena reveals the truth, but will Gokuldham society members find a buyer for all those watermelons?

episodes.title: Madhavi Dials Bapuji
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal is determined to confront Bhide, but an unexpected call to Bapuji changes everything. What happens next?

episodes.title: Taarak's Race Against Time
episodes.synopsis: Taarak sets wrong alarm and oversleeps but can he make it on time after his boss' wake-up call?

episodes.title: All Eyes On Taarak's Boss
episodes.synopsis: Everyone is looking at Taarak's Boss with surprise, but what has he done to grab all the attention?

episodes.title: Taarak's Boss In Trouble
episodes.synopsis: People are eager to take a photo with Taarak's boss, but what's the reason behind the excitement?

episodes.title: The Search For A Mahurat
episodes.synopsis: Can Batuk Maharaj help Bhide find the ideal time to begin the society's renovation?

episodes.title: Jethalal Sparks Panic
episodes.synopsis: A simple ritual takes an unexpected turn in Gokuldham. What has left everyone concerned?

episodes.title: Popatlal Schools Bhide
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal is not convinced by the renovation arrangements. Will Bhide be able to justify them?

episodes.title: Sapno Ka Ghar
episodes.synopsis: Bagha and Bawri dream about their future home, and Bagha assures her that he will work tirelessly to make all her wishes come true.

episodes.title: Bagha's Love-Filled Task
episodes.synopsis: Bagha heads out for a special reason, but will everything go according to plan?

episodes.title: Bawri's Tough Test
episodes.synopsis: Will Jethalal's unexpected condition test Bawri's patience and her commitment to Bagha?

episodes.title: Bagha's Surprise Visitor
episodes.synopsis: An unexpected guest drops by Gada Electronics, leaving Bagha puzzled and curious.

episodes.title: Mystery Gift For Bagha
episodes.synopsis: Bagha gets a watch as a surprise gift from a visitor, leaving everyone wondering who it might be.

episodes.title: Bagha’s Mysterious Invitation
episodes.synopsis: Bagha receives a mysterious invitation from a stranger, but Tapu Sena, Popatlal, and Sodhi accompany him for support. What unexpected twist might lie ahead?

episodes.title: Bagha Meets Balam
episodes.synopsis: Balam invites Bagha to his house and begins sharing memories from his past. Who exactly is Balam?

episodes.title: Balam's Shocking Demand
episodes.synopsis: A shocking truth from Balam catches Bagha off guard. What impact will it have on their lives?

episodes.title: Bagha’s Crossroad
episodes.synopsis: After meeting Balam, Bagha confides in Natu Kaka before setting out to meet Bawri. Will he tell her the truth?

episodes.title: Bagha’s Secret
episodes.synopsis: Bagha lied to the Gokuldham members about Balam's identity because he wanted to hide the truth and avoid questions about his childhood friend.

episodes.title: Bagha's Tough Decision
episodes.synopsis: Balam makes an offer to Bagha, but what decision will Bagha ultimately make?

episodes.title: Natkhat Acharya Ji
episodes.synopsis: How far will Bagha go to accomplish Mission BBB?

episodes.title: A Tough Choice
episodes.synopsis: Will Bagha leave Bawri for his friend, or will he follow his heart and face the consequences?

episodes.title: Drama To Stop The Wedding
episodes.synopsis: To stop the wedding, Bagha pretends to be drunk and creates a scene in front of everyone to push Bawri away. How will Bawri react?

episodes.title: Bawri In Tears
episodes.synopsis: Bawri reaches Gokuldham Society and tells the Mahila Mandali about Bagha trying to stop the wedding. Will they support her?

episodes.title: Mahila Mandali Confronts Bagha
episodes.synopsis: Mahila Mandali visits Gada Electronics to confront Bagha after learning about his attempt to stop the wedding. Will they stand by Bawri and against Bagha?

episodes.title: Bagha Seeks Help
episodes.synopsis: Bagha asks Tapu to help stop the wedding, so how will Tapu support him now?

episodes.title: Tapu’s Clever Act
episodes.synopsis: Tapu dresses up and joins Bagha in the garden for a drama, but when Mahila Mandali arrives, will they believe she is Bagha's girlfriend or see through their act?

episodes.title: Tapu’s Plan Works
episodes.synopsis: After catching Bagha with another girl in the park, the Mahila Mandali warns him to stay away from Bawri. Unaware that the girl is actually Tapu in disguise, they firmly rebuke Bagha. Will the truth come out?

episodes.title: Bagha Exposed
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham Society is thrown into absolute chaos after the Mahila Mandali exposes a video of Bagha with a mysterious girl. But when Babuji claims she looks familiar, Tapu's hidden agenda faces sudden exposure.

episodes.title: Bagha's Plan Works
episodes.synopsis: When Balam arrives at Bagha's house and learns that Bagha pretended everything just to break his relationship with Bawri, what will happen next when the truth starts coming out?

episodes.title: Balam's Marriage Proposal
episodes.synopsis: Balam introduces himself as Bawri's childhood friend and expresses his desire to marry her. How will the Gokuldham members react to this shocking revelation?

episodes.title: Will Mahila Mandali Stop Bawri
episodes.synopsis: Heartbroken because of Bagha, Bawri decides to leave Mumbai and return to Kanpur. As the Mahila Mandali rushes to find her, will they be able to stop her and bring her back home?

episodes.title: Bawri Reflects On Her Past
episodes.synopsis: As Gokuldham residents urge Bawri to marry Balam, she revisits her cherished memories with Bagha. Will she be able to move on?

episodes.title: Bawri And Balam's Engagement
episodes.synopsis: Will Bawri say yes and get engaged to Balam, or will her heart choose a different path?

episodes.title: Balam's Hidden Truth
episodes.synopsis: As Bawri and Bagha end up in the same hospital, will Balam finally confess that he was the one who separated them?

episodes.title: A Sweet Get-Together
episodes.synopsis: With Abdul's shop closed, the Purush Mandali heads to Jethalal's house with ice cream, but Tapu and Babuji surprise them with a fun prank.

episodes.title: Jethalal's Shop Gets Sealed
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal arrives at the shop early, expecting a surprise from Natu Kaka and Bagha, but is left shocked to find the shop sealed. Who is behind it?

episodes.title: Jethalal's Difficult Situation
episodes.synopsis: As Iyer and Babita Ji bring their friend to the shop, Jethalal is left wondering how to manage the situation with the shop sealed.

episodes.title: Taarak Mehta's Efforts to Help Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Taarak Mehta, Bagha, and Natu Kaka try to find the notice behind the shop sealing, but they discover that no notice was given. What will Jethalal do now?

episodes.title: An Unexpected Twist For Jethalal
episodes.synopsis: Even after Jethalal pays the fine, the municipal officials reveal they never sealed his shop. If not them, who put up the seal?

episodes.title: Rita Reporter Reaches The Shop
episodes.synopsis: After a customer informs Rita Reporter about Jethalal's sealed shop, she rushes to cover the story, but Natu Kaka and Bagha try to stop her.

episodes.title: Jethalal In Deep Trouble
episodes.synopsis: Clients are demanding payments, and rumors of Jethalal running away are spreading fast. How will he clear his name now?

episodes.title: Jethalal Faces Babuji's Anger
episodes.synopsis: After learning that Jethalal's shop has been sealed, Babuji loses his temper and tells him to leave the house. How will Jethalal handle this difficult situation?

episodes.title: Pandey Ji On the Case
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal turns to Inspector Pandey Ji for help. Will he uncover who was really behind sealing Jethalal's shop?

episodes.title: Monika Visits Gada Electronics
episodes.synopsis: Monika arrives at Gada Electronics, but Pandey Ji says the shop is sealed. How will Jethalal handle the situation, and will Monika still give him the agency?

episodes.title: Jethalal Is Finally Proven Innocent
episodes.synopsis: Pandey Ji informs Jethalal that he is innocent, as the tax was unpaid by another shop owner, and due to a mistake, Gada Electronics was wrongly sealed.

episodes.title: Popatlal Searches For The Bhide Family
episodes.synopsis: Bhide leaves overnight with his family. The next morning, Popatlal finds their house empty and their phones switched off, leaving the Gokuldham family wondering where the Bhide family has gone.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Waits For Bhide
episodes.synopsis: Bhide stays at his uncle's house due to an unexpected dispute, while Madhvi and Sonu return to Gokuldham. As the renovation work remains pending, everyone in Gokuldham eagerly waits for Bhide to return.

episodes.title: Bhide’s Important Meeting
episodes.synopsis: The Mahila Mandal wonders what Bhide is going to say in the meeting, and even Madhvi has no idea. As all the Gokuldham members gather, everyone eagerly waits to see what happens in the meeting.

episodes.title: Chachaji’s Special Selection
episodes.synopsis: Everyone in Gokuldham is curious to know who Chachaji will choose for the Muh Dikhayi ceremony.

episodes.title: Bhide’s Surprise For Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: The members of Gokuldham Society are excited about the Muh Dikhayi ceremony and eager to discover Bhide's surprise. What special surprise has Bhide planned?

episodes.title: Veer & Bansari Take Center Stage
episodes.synopsis: Champak Chacha entrusts Veer and Bansari with the honor of performing the Mukh Dikhayi ceremony, declaring that they represent the future of Gokuldham Society.

episodes.title: One More Surprise From Bhide
episodes.synopsis: The renovation work is finally complete, and everyone is happy to see the new Gokuldham Society. But Bhide has one more surprise waiting for everyone.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Gets A Surprise Guest
episodes.synopsis: As Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah celebrates 18 glorious years, everyone shares their heartfelt thoughts. Just then, Asit Modi announces a special guest, leaving everyone excited to find out who it is.

episodes.title: Spider-Man In Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: The residents of Gokuldham Society warmly welcome Spider-Man. His presence fills everyone with joy as he interact with each member.

episodes.title: Celebrating Memories Together
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham relives some of the most memorable moments from Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah, bringing back old memories and special emotions.

episodes.title: Bhide's Unexpected Problem
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham men's group praises Bhide for the successful renovation, but he suddenly reveals that a new problem has arisen. What could it be?

episodes.title: Bhide Gets A Surprise Gift
episodes.synopsis: After the Purush Mandal praises Bhide for the society's renovation, the Mahila Mandal and Tapu Sena plan a special surprise for him at his house.

episodes.title: Bhide In Trouble
episodes.synopsis: Everyone praises Bhide's management, but new renovation charges leave him stressed. Will he protect his promise to society members?

episodes.title: Bhide's Tough Decision
episodes.synopsis: After learning he owes the contractor an extra ₹5 lakh for the society's renovation, Bhide tells Madhavi, who urges him to seek Taarak's help. What will happen next?

episodes.title: Bhide Gets Pranked
episodes.synopsis: A prank on the society's renovation budget leaves Bhide stressed and confused as Gokuldham members enjoy his hilarious reactions.

episodes.title: Madhavi's Pickle Order
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal learns that his friend wants Madhavi Bhabhi's pickles. Soon, the Bhide family gets busy preparing and delivering the order.

episodes.title: Bhide’s Pickle Delivery Hassle
episodes.synopsis: Bhide heads to the market for lemons and chilies, while Madhavi seeks Roopa’s help. Can the Bhide family complete the order on time?

episodes.title: Bhide Family’s Big Win
episodes.synopsis: The Bhide family successfully delivers all pickle orders on time and receives great feedback, leaving Bhide delighted with their achievement.

episodes.title: Madhavi’s Pickle Trouble
episodes.synopsis: Madhavi fears a piece of her bangle broke in the pickle. Tapu Sena panics as Bhide faces an FDA raid. Will it be found, or will FDA charges follow?

episodes.title: Gokuldham Stands By The Bhide Family
episodes.synopsis: Madhavi’s pickle licence is at risk, prompting Gokuldham Society members to unite and help the Bhide family overcome the crisis.

episodes.title: Duplicate Pickle Scandal
episodes.synopsis: A counterfeit of Madhavi's pickle product hits the market, leaving the Bhide family in trouble. Will the FDA uncover the truth?

episodes.title: Bhide & Family Win The Pickle Case
episodes.synopsis: It's a relief for the Gokuldham society as the truth behind the duplicate pickle unfolds.

episodes.title: Popatlal's Bride
episodes.synopsis: Abdul sparks total confusion among Chachaji and the Mahila Mandal after spotting Popatlal carrying a bride in his arms.

episodes.title: Popatlal Manifests His Bride
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal manifests his future wife with a statue and asks the Purush Mandali to choose a photo to showcase.

episodes.title: Bhide Becomes Popatlal’s Target
episodes.synopsis: The Mahila Mandal helps Popatlal choose a photo and reveals Bhide’s role. Later, Popatlal playfully scares Bhide at the soda shop.

episodes.title: Bapuji’s Chain Disappears
episodes.synopsis: Madhavi’s earrings go missing, followed by Bapuji’s gold chain. The compound springs into action, but can the missing chain be found?

episodes.title: Goli Finds A Surprise
episodes.synopsis: The search for Madhvi’s earrings turns chaotic as Goli discovers money and sweets, but the earrings remain missing and the house becomes a mess!

episodes.title: Gokuldham’s Mysterious Theft
episodes.synopsis: As another theft shocks Gokuldham, the Purush Mandali gathers to investigate who's behind the incidents.

episodes.title: Gold Vanishes From Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal wakes up to find Bapuji’s gold chain missing, while Babita Ji’s gold bracelet also disappears, leaving everyone shocked.

episodes.title: The Theft Investigation Begins
episodes.synopsis: Bhide informs the police about the theft, and Inspector Chalu Pandey arrives soon after to investigate the case and search for clues.

episodes.title: Bhide Calls A Night Meeting
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Chalu Pandey finds the same theft pattern and begins searching for the culprit. Later, Bhide calls a night meeting to plan precautions.

episodes.title: Tapu Thinks Of A Clever Plan
episodes.synopsis: Everyone is worried about the thefts and comes up with different ideas, but Tapu suddenly gets a plan that could change everything.

episodes.title: Jethalal’s One Thought Creates Panic
episodes.synopsis: Everyone gathers for a meeting at the clubhouse, but when Jethalal points out the risk of a theft at home, everyone suddenly rushes back!

episodes.title: Dr. Haathi’s Secret Gold Stash
episodes.synopsis: During the meeting, Iyer suggests taking turns guarding the society in pairs for an hour each night. Afterward, everyone hurries home to secure their gold in secret hiding spots.

episodes.title: Tapu Sena On Guard
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena keeps a close watch on Gokuldham as everyone stays alert for the mysterious thief. Will they finally catch the culprit?

episodes.title: Purush Mandali On Guard
episodes.synopsis: The Purush Mandali asks Tapu Sena to rest and takes over the night watch to catch the thief and stop the thefts in Gokuldham Society. Will they succeed?

episodes.title: Jethalal Catches The Thief
episodes.synopsis: Taarak and Jethalal catch a masked man using itching powder and a blanket, but their victory turns awkward when they discover Inspector Chalu Pandey.

episodes.title: The Thief Strikes Again
episodes.synopsis: After Sodhi leaves his balcony door open to catch the thief, his home and several others are robbed that night. Will the police find the thief?

episodes.title: Chalu Pandey Takes Charge
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham residents await Chalu Pandey as he arrives with expert officer James to solve the theft mystery. Will they catch the thief?

episodes.title: Popatlal’s Shocking Arrest
episodes.synopsis: Chalu Pandey finds the stolen jewellery at Popatlal’s house and arrests him. Will the Gokuldham members prove his innocence?

episodes.title: Purush Mandali Defends Popatlal
episodes.synopsis: Purush Mandali backs Popatlal at the police station. As he blames a mannequin for the thefts, will Chalu Pandey believe him?

episodes.title: Chalu Pandey Gives A Chance
episodes.synopsis: Chalu Pandey gives Purush Mandali time to prove Popatlal’s innocence and find evidence to get him out of jail.

episodes.title: Purush Mandali Seeks Evidence
episodes.synopsis: Purush Mandali discusses what happened at the police station before heading to Popatlal’s house to find evidence and prove his innocence.

episodes.title: The Mannequin Scare
episodes.synopsis: Purush Mandali hear a sound from the mannequin and panic as its saree slips off, leaving everyone terrified. What will happen next?

episodes.title: Chalu Pandey Investigates The Mannequin Mystery
episodes.synopsis: Purush Mandali shares their terrifying experience with Chalu Pandey, who visits Gokuldham Society to uncover the mystery of Popatlal's mannequin.

episodes.title: The Mannequin Mystery Deepens
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal requests Chalu Pandey to come at night, assuring him that he will get proof along with evidence, but will Chalu Pandey make it and uncover the truth behind the mannequin mystery?

episodes.title: Tapusena Uncovers The Doll’s Secret
episodes.synopsis: Tapusena uncovers a shocking secret about the mysterious doll, leaving everyone stunned. Ratan suggests calling a baba, and Jethalal calls Bagha for help.

episodes.title: Bhide Steps Into The Haunted Mystery
episodes.synopsis: Bagha and Bawri visit Gokuldham Society, where Bawri shares a baba’s address. Bhide, Bagha and Iyer reach there, but the dark surroundings and ghost stories scare everyone.

episodes.title: A Shocking Ghostly Encounter
episodes.synopsis: They finally reach Laltan Baba, but chaos erupts when he thinks a ghost is inside Bagha and starts hitting him, leading to an unexpected spectacle.

episodes.title: Laltan Baba Joins The Fight
episodes.synopsis: Bagha, Iyer, and Bhide bring Laltan Baba to Gokuldham. Can he put an end to the ghostly scare?

episodes.title: Lalten Baba’s Ghost Trap
episodes.synopsis: The residents of Gokuldham remain terrified by the ghost. Lalten Baba arrives with a lantern and rope, hoping his unusual plan will solve the mystery.

episodes.title: Lalten Baba Faces The Ghost
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and Ratan help secure Lalten Baba's trap, while Lalten Baba, Bhide and Iyer head to Popatlal's house to face the ghost.

episodes.title: Ghostly Chaos In Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: As Lalten Baba encounters the ghost, panic spreads in Gokuldham. Fear grows when Bhide and Iyer appear in skeleton costumes and a lantern breaks.

episodes.title: Fear Of A Ghost Shakes Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: Everyone in Gokuldham is frightened by rumors of a ghost and begins to believe Bapuji is possessed, leading to confusion and panic among the residents.

episodes.title: The Missing Mannequin
episodes.synopsis: With Chalu Pandey’s ultimatum nearing its end, the search for clues takes an unexpected turn when Popatlal’s mannequin goes missing.

episodes.title: Can Popatlal Be Saved?
episodes.synopsis: Bhide and Tapu Sena discover that Lalten Baba is a fraud. With no clue left to prove Popatlal's innocence, the Gokuldham members pray to God.

episodes.title: The Real Culprit Revealed
episodes.synopsis: A video recorded by Binjola's kids reveals the truth behind the thefts. Following Bapuji's clues, Gokuldham begins its search.

episodes.title: The Plan To Save Popatlal
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham members try to catch the cat with the help of Binjola’s kids. Will their plan succeed and help free Popatlal from jail?

episodes.title: The Truth Behind The Theft
episodes.synopsis: Tapu Sena and the Purush Mandali reach the police station with evidence to expose the real culprit. Will Popatlal be proven innocent?

episodes.title: Chalu Pandey Solves The Case
episodes.synopsis: Chalu Pandey tracks down the real culprits behind the theft. After they confess, Popatlal is cleared of all charges and proven innocent.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Rejoices Again
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham Society welcomes Popatlal back with joy after his release. The residents rejoice as their stolen belongings are finally recovered.

episodes.title: Jethalal’s Sales Struggle
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal worries as sales decline at his store and asks Natu Kaka for ideas to boost business. Meanwhile, Ratan arrives to pick him up.

episodes.title: Tapusena's Ganpati Preparations
episodes.synopsis: Lado’s dream about Ganpati fills Gokuldham with excitement as Tapu Sena comes together to prepare a grand welcome for the festival.

episodes.title: Ganeshotsav At Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: The residents of Gokuldham Society come together for Ganeshotsav celebrations, highlighting unity, diversity and festive spirit.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Gets Creative
episodes.synopsis: Excitement fills Gokuldham Society as Tappu Sena reveals a unique fancy dress competition and the participants' pairings.

episodes.title: The Rangarang Competition Begins
episodes.synopsis: The Gokuldham residents come together for Ganesh Aarti before kicking off the Rangarang Competition, with a mystery judge awaiting them.

episodes.title: The Fancy-Dress Frenzy Starts
episodes.synopsis: The residents of Gokuldham enthusiastically prepare for their unique fancy-dress competition as Bhide becomes the first contestant to take the stage.

episodes.title: When Fashion Meets Awareness
episodes.synopsis: As the fashion show continues, Tappu and Sonu deliver a powerful act on global warming, turning the ramp into a platform for awareness.

episodes.title: New Acts, New Excitement
episodes.synopsis: The Rangarang Fancy Dress Competition continues as the Gokuldham residents showcase creative acts, with Iyer's robot avatar stealing the spotlight.

episodes.title: Stellar Performances In Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: Anjali, Babita, and Goli entertain Gokuldham with lively fancy dress acts while a mystery judge watches every performance via CCTV.

episodes.title: Gokuldham's Showstopper Acts
episodes.synopsis: As the Rangarang Fancy Dress Competition progresses, Gokuldham's residents captivate the audience with entertaining performances.

episodes.title: The Perfect Ending
episodes.synopsis: As the Rangarang Fancy Dress Competition concludes, the residents learn that the true spirit of the event lies in unity and participation.

episodes.title: A Surprise In Store
episodes.synopsis: As Tappu prepares for an important engagement, Jethalal chooses to keep some news under wraps until the time is right.

episodes.title: Champaklal's Generous Donation
episodes.synopsis: Champaklal agrees to support a girls' school in his village and asks Jethalal to arrange a donation. Meanwhile, an important secret awaits him.

episodes.title: Jethalal's Investment Nightmare
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal's investment plans collapse when he discovers he has been cheated. Will he find a way to recover his money?

episodes.title: Jethalal Seeks Help
episodes.synopsis: Devastated by the chit fund scam, Jethalal approaches Taarak for guidance and uncovers a surprising connection at the police station.

episodes.title: Nattu Kaka And Bagha's Quick Fix
episodes.synopsis: As Jethalal worries about arranging money, Nattu Kaka and Bagha come up with a plan to raise funds quickly. Will it work out?

episodes.title: Jethalal's Relief Is Short-Lived
episodes.synopsis: After arranging the donation amount, Jethalal feels relieved. But unexpected news soon leaves him facing a fresh challenge.

episodes.title: Will Jethalal Find the Funds?
episodes.synopsis: With the expected funds delayed, a stressed Jethalal turns to Mehta Saab for help. Can his suggested solution save the day before time runs out?

episodes.title: Mission Locker Key
episodes.synopsis: Bapuji keeps the locker keys with him, prompting Jethalal and Taarak to plot a secret mission. Will they succeed in getting the funds?

episodes.title: Jethalal's High Stakes Gold Deal
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal entrusts all his gold to Mangilalji to raise funds for a donation. Will this gamble pay off?

episodes.title: A New Financial Lesson for Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: With Jethalal's financial troubles behind him, a new idea inspires Gokuldham residents to learn valuable lessons about managing money wisely.

episodes.title: Tappu Sena's Festive Dilemma
episodes.synopsis: As Navratri approaches, Tappu Sena's festive preparations face an unexpected hurdle. Will they be able to keep their celebration plans alive?

episodes.title: A Surprise Before Navratri
episodes.synopsis: As worries over Navratri celebrations grow, an unexpected development brings fresh hope to the society. What news will Jethalal share at the meeting?

episodes.title: Jethalal Sparks Curiosity
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal announces a surprise, sparking excitement across the society. At the meeting, everyone eagerly waits for the big reveal.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Gears Up For Navratri
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal and the residents urge Bhide to let Vishvasur and Mohini organize Navratri. Will he agree, or will trouble arise?

episodes.title: Tappu Sena's Navratri Dilemma
episodes.synopsis: As Gokuldham gears up for Navratri, an unexpected discovery leaves Tappu Sena disappointed. Will their concerns be addressed in time?

episodes.title: A Hidden Catch In The Deal
episodes.synopsis: As Gokuldham's Navratri preparations gather pace, unexpected restrictions and surprises leave the residents questioning what they've signed up for.

episodes.title: Navratri Preparations In Trouble
episodes.synopsis: As Gokuldham prepares for Navratri, pending work and Vishvasur's negligence threaten the celebrations. Will the residents finish on time?

episodes.title: Is Vishwasur Really Genuine?
episodes.synopsis: Vishwasur arrives in Gokuldham, but his actions and arrangements disappoint residents. Is he genuine or fooling everyone?

episodes.title: Vishwasur's Garba Decision Infuriates Residents
episodes.synopsis: Vishwasur stops residents from playing garba on the society grounds and asks them to dance in the garden. How will they react now?

episodes.title: Jethalal Is Left Worried
episodes.synopsis: Jethalal discovers Vishwasur’s cunning and fraudulent ways. How will the Gokuldham residents react when they learn the truth?

episodes.title: Vishwasur's Agreement Leaves Purush Mandali Helpless
episodes.synopsis: Purush Mandal seeks legal help against Vishwasur's agreement but learns the case is weak. Fearing fines, they lose hope yet pray for a solution.

episodes.title: Will Vishwasur Face The Crowd's Wrath?
episodes.synopsis: Jigna and Jackson's delay sparks chaos among the crowd. Jethalal discovers Tapu Sena orchestrated it to teach Vishwasur a lesson.

episodes.title: Tapu Brings The Hidden Truth To Light
episodes.synopsis: Tapu finally reveals the real reason behind Jigna and Jackson's delay, leaving Vishwasur stunned and everyone eager to know the truth.

episodes.title: Diwali Preparations At Gada Electronics
episodes.synopsis: Gada Electronics gears up for Diwali as the festive preparations bring excitement and cheer.

episodes.title: Mahila Mandal’s Faral Fest in Gokuldham
episodes.synopsis: The festive spirit takes over Gokuldham as Diwali celebrations begin. The Mahila Mandal prepares a delightful variety of traditional faral items, bringing together flavors, traditions, and festive cheer for everyone in the society.

episodes.title: Diwali Plans Hit A Roadblock
episodes.synopsis: After winning Bhide's approval with their Diwali preparations, Tappu Sena faces a fresh setback when he refuses permission for their party. Determined not to give up, they now look for a way to change his decision.

episodes.title: A Diwali Without Electricity In Gokuldham!
episodes.synopsis: After a power outage leaves Gokuldham in darkness, the residents light diyas and sing bhajans. Can they bring back the Diwali spirit?

episodes.title: Will Motibhai End Gokuldham's Power Crisis?
episodes.synopsis: As Gokuldham waits anxiously in the dark, Motibhai takes charge of the power crisis. Can he restore electricity and save the day?

episodes.title: Jethalal Seeks Bapuji's Blessings
episodes.synopsis: On Labh Pacham, Bapuji blesses Tapu and Jethalal, explaining the day's significance and sharing valuable lessons on wisdom and prosperity.

episodes.title: A Twist In The Party Plan
episodes.synopsis: Iyer, Bhide, and Sodhi's party plan faces trouble when Roshan overhears their conversation. What unexpected step will she take now?

episodes.title: The Balloon Seller’s Wise Words
episodes.synopsis: Baapuji reunites with his old friends and meets a balloon seller whose thoughtful outlook impresses him. Touched by the boy, he buys his balloons.

episodes.title: Gokuldham Turns To Popatlal For Travel Advice
episodes.synopsis: Gokuldham residents turn to Popatlal for travel advice, as he has experience with foreign trips. Will his suggestions make their trip a success?

episodes.title: Binjola Family’s Rajasthani Feast
episodes.synopsis: Rupa and Ratan Binjola invite the Gokuldham society members to savor a traditional Rajasthani feast. Will everyone enjoy the royal spread?

episodes.title: The Mystery Of The Missing Bag
episodes.synopsis: Ratan Bhai accidentally leaves his bags on his scooter. When Abdul finds it, he takes it along to return later after delivering Hathi Bhai’s groceries. But when Ratan discovers his bag is missing, panic sets in. Will Abdul reunite Ratan with his bags before the misunderstanding grows?

episodes.title: Binjola Family's Dinner Prank Sparks Drama
episodes.synopsis: The Binjola family's dinner prank disappoints society members. Bapuji feels hurt by the joke. Will they be able to win everyone over again?

episodes.title: A Misunderstanding Gives Popatlal Hope
episodes.synopsis: Popatlal overhears Bhide's conversation and mistakenly believes he's searching for a bride for him. What twist awaits him next?
